    '<path d="M78 130 C70 112 62 100 56 92" fill="none" stroke="#234232" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>' +
    '<path d="M82 130 C92 110 104 98 112 88" fill="none" stroke="#234232" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>' +
    '<ellipse cx="56" cy="82" rx="30" ry="42" transform="rotate(-22 56 82)" fill="#234232"/>' +
    '<ellipse cx="56" cy="82" rx="20" ry="32" transform="rotate(-22 56 82)" fill="none" stroke="#d7e4c4" stroke-width="3.5"/>' +
    '<ellipse cx="56" cy="82" rx="10" ry="22" transform="rotate(-22 56 82)" fill="none" stroke="#d7e4c4" stroke-width="2.5"/>' +
    '<ellipse cx="114" cy="74" rx="32" ry="44" transform="rotate(18 114 74)" fill="#2f4a38"/>' +
    '<ellipse cx="114" cy="74" rx="21" ry="33" transform="rotate(18 114 74)" fill="none" stroke="#e7f0dc" stroke-width="3.5"/>' +
    '<ellipse cx="114" cy="74" rx="11" ry="22" transform="rotate(18 114 74)" fill="none" stroke="#e7f0dc" stroke-width="2.5"/>'
};

const POTS = {
  fern: ['#7d9474', '#e3d3b4', 0],
  pothos: ['#c4893a', '#f0d7a6', 2],
  cactus: ['#eadcc8', '#c46b45', 8],
  calathea: ['#6c596e', '#e6d5c2', 1]
};

function plantSVG(id) {
  const pot = POTS[id];
  return '<svg class="plant-svg" viewBox="0 0 160 196" aria-hidden="true">' +
    FOLIAGE[id] + potMarkup(pot[0], pot[1], pot[2]) + '</svg>';
}

function actionIcon(task) {
  if (task === 'Rotate') {
    return '<svg class="i" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M19.5 12a7.5 7.5 0 1 1-2.1-5.2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M19.8 4.2v5h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>';
  }
  if (task === 'Check soil') {
    return '<svg class="i" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 16c2.2 2 11.8 2 14 0" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M7 16V9.5h10V16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M4.5 9.5h15" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>';
  }
  if (task === 'Mist') {
    return '<svg class="i" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="1.5" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="12.2" cy="5.6" r="1.5" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="16.2" cy="8.4" r="1.5" fill="currentColor"/><path d="M5 15.5h14M7 19.5h10" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>';
  }
  return '<svg class="i" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="currentColor" d="M12 2.4c3.6 5 6.2 8.2 6.2 12a6.2 6.2 0 0 1-12.4 0c0-3.8 2.6-7 6.2-12z"/></svg>';
}

const MOON = '<svg class="i" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="currentColor" d="M15.5 3.2A8 8 0 1 0 20.8 14 6.6 6.6 0 0 1 15.5 3.2z"/></svg>';

const MARK = '<svg class="mark" viewBox="0 0 72 72" aria-hidden="true">' +
  '<ellipse cx="36" cy="54" rx="22" ry="8" fill="#d9c6a6"/>' +
  '<path d="M16 52c4-18 14-28 22-26-2 10-2 18-8 26" fill="#3f6b4e"/>' +
  '<path d="M34 52c4-20 16-30 26-24-4 12-10 20-20 24" fill="#234232"/>' +
  '<path d="M24 50c10-6 22-8 30-2-10 2-20 6-28 10" fill="#6d8f62"/>' +
  '<ellipse cx="36" cy="52" rx="18" ry="6" fill="#c4a27a"/>' +
  '<circle cx="28" cy="40" r="3" fill="#234232"/>' +
  '<circle cx="40" cy="36" r="2.2" fill="#234232"/>' +
  '<circle cx="48" cy="44" r="2.4" fill="#234232"/>' +
  '</svg>';

function historyList(entries, stampDate, kind) {
  if (!entries.length) {
    const empty = kind === 'water' ? 'No drink on the record yet.' : 'Nothing noted yet.';
    return '<p>' + empty + '</p>';
  }
  return '<ul>' + entries.map((entry) => {
    const fresh = entry.indexOf(stampDate + ' ·') === 0;
    return '<li class="' + (fresh ? 'is-new' : '') + '">' + esc(entry) +
      (fresh ? '<span class="new-tag">New</span>' : '') + '</li>';
  }).join('') + '</ul>';
}

function lightBlock(plant) {
  const level = lightLevel(plant.light);
  const panes = [1, 2, 3].map((pane) => {
    const on = pane <= level;
    const bright = on && level === 3 && pane === 3;
    return '<span class="pane' + (on ? ' on' : '') + (bright ? ' bright' : '') + '"></span>';
  }).join('');
  return '<section class="fact fact-light">' +
    '<h3>Light</h3>' +
    '<div class="light-row">' +
      '<div class="window" aria-hidden="true">' + panes + '</div>' +
      '<div><p class="fact-strong">' + esc(plant.light) + '</p><p>' + esc(lightNote(plant.light)) + '</p></div>' +
    '</div></section>';
}

function factsHTML(plant, stampDate) {
  const parts = splitHistory(plant.history);
  return '<div class="facts">' +
    lightBlock(plant) +
    '<section class="fact fact-water"><h3>Water</h3>' + historyList(parts.water, stampDate, 'water') + '</section>' +
    '<section class="fact fact-notes"><h3>Observations</h3>' + historyList(parts.notes, stampDate, 'notes') + '</section>' +
    '</div>';
}

function careButtons(plant, rich) {
  const verb = verbFor(plant.task);
  const water = rich
    ? actionIcon(plant.task) + '<span class="btn-label">' + esc(verb) + '</span><span class="btn-sub">' + esc(LOG_LINE[plant.task] || 'Logs this care') + '</span>'
    : '<span class="sr-only">' + esc(plant.name) + '. </span>' + esc(verb);
  let html = '<div class="actions' + (plant.status === 'pending' ? '' : ' is-single') + '">';
  html += '<button type="button" class="btn btn-water" data-action="watered" data-id="' + plant.id + '" data-focusid="watered-' + plant.id + '">' + water + '</button>';
  if (plant.status === 'pending') {
    const snooze = rich
      ? MOON + '<span class="btn-label">Snooze</span><span class="btn-sub">Later today</span>'
      : '<span class="sr-only">' + esc(plant.name) + '. </span>Snooze';
    html += '<button type="button" class="btn btn-snooze" data-action="snooze" data-id="' + plant.id + '" data-focusid="snooze-' + plant.id + '">' + snooze + '</button>';
  }
  html += '</div>';
  return html;
}

function doneActions(plant) {
  const next = nextOpen();
  if (next) {
    return '<p class="done-note">Logged today.</p>' +
      '<button type="button" class="btn btn-next" data-action="select" data-id="' + next.id + '" data-focusid="next-' + next.id + '">Care for ' + esc(next.name) + ' next</button>';
  }
  return '<p class="done-note">Logged today.</p>' +
    '<button type="button" class="btn btn-next" data-action="clear" data-focusid="back-sill">Back to the sill</button>';
}

function detailBody(plant, stampDate, rich) {
  const stamp = plant.status === 'done' ? 'Logged' : plant.status === 'snoozed' ? 'Later' : '';
  const art = '<div class="art-wrap">' + plantSVG(plant.id) +
    (stamp && rich ? '<p class="stamp' + (plant.status === 'snoozed' ? ' is-later' : '') + '">' + stamp + '</p>' : '') +
    '</div>';
  const taskLine = plant.status === 'done'
    ? 'Today’s task was ' + plant.task.toLowerCase() + '.'
    : 'Today’s task: ' + plant.task + '.';
  const copy = '<p class="eyebrow">' + esc(plant.species) + '</p>' +
    (rich ? '<h2 class="plant-name" id="room-title">' + esc(plant.name) + '</h2>' : '<p class="plant-name">' + esc(plant.name) + '</p>') +
    '<p class="aside">' + esc(ASIDES[plant.id] || '') + '</p>' +
    '<p class="where">' + esc(plant.location) + ' · ' + esc(statusPhrase(plant)) + '</p>' +
    '<p class="task-line">' + esc(taskLine) + '</p>';
  const actions = plant.status === 'done' ? doneActions(plant) : (rich ? careButtons(plant, true) : '');
  if (rich) {
    return '<div class="room-hero">' + art + '<div class="room-copy">' + copy + '</div></div>' + actions + factsHTML(plant, stampDate);
  }
  return art + copy + actions + factsHTML(plant, stampDate);
}

function sillHTML() {
  const buttons = state.plants.slice().sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order).map((plant) => {
    const selected = state.selectedId === plant.id;
    return '<button type="button" class="sill-btn is-' + tone(plant) + (selected ? ' is-selected' : '') + '" data-action="select" data-id="' + plant.id + '" data-focusid="sill-' + plant.id + '" data-nav="item"' +
      (selected ? ' aria-current="true"' : '') + '>' +
      plantSVG(plant.id) +
      '<span class="sill-name">' + esc(plant.name) + '</span>' +
      '<span class="sill-state">' + esc(sillState(plant)) + '</span>' +
      '</button>';
  }).join('');
  return '<nav class="sill" aria-label="Plants on the sill">' + buttons + '</nav>';
}

function posterHTML(place) {
  const items = donePlants().map((plant) => {
    const latest = plant.history[0] || verbFor(plant.task);
    return '<li><span class="recap-name">' + esc(plant.name) + '</span>' +
      '<span class="recap-did">' + esc(latest) + '</span>' +
      '<span class="recap-was">Was ' + esc(wasDue(plant.baseDue)) + '</span></li>';
  }).join('');
  const hint = place === 'room'
    ? 'Choose someone on the sill, or open the settled list, for light, water, and notes.'
    : 'Open any settled plant below for light, water, and notes.';
  return '<div class="poster">' +
    '<h2 id="done-title">The sill is quiet</h2>' +
    '<p>All four cares are logged. Nothing is overdue and nothing is waiting. ' + hint + '</p>' +
    '<ul class="recap">' + items + '</ul>' +
    '<div class="next-slip"><h3>Next glance</h3><p>' + esc(glanceCopy()) + '</p></div>' +
    '</div>';
}

function roomHTML(stampDate) {
  const plant = state.selectedId ? findPlant(state.selectedId) : null;
  const quiet = !plant;
  let body;
  if (!plant) body = posterHTML('room');
  else body = '<div id="detail">' + detailBody(plant, stampDate, true) + '</div>';
  return '<section class="room' + (quiet ? ' is-quiet' : '') + '"' +
    (plant ? ' aria-labelledby="room-title"' : ' aria-labelledby="done-title"') + '>' +
    sillHTML() + body + '</section>';
}

function ticketHTML(plant, index, total, stampDate, prefix) {
  const selected = state.selectedId === plant.id;
  const open = selected && (desktop() || state.mobileOpen);
  const showInline = !desktop() && state.mobileOpen && selected;
  const more = desktop()
    ? '<span class="sr-only">Show details.</span>'
    : '<span class="more">' + (open ? 'Hide notes' : 'Notes') + '</span>';
  const actions = !desktop() && plant.status !== 'done'
    ? '<div class="row-actions' + (plant.status === 'pending' ? '' : ' is-single') + '">' +
        '<button type="button" class="btn btn-water" data-action="watered" data-id="' + plant.id + '" data-focusid="watered-' + plant.id + '"><span class="sr-only">' + esc(plant.name) + '. </span>' + esc(verbFor(plant.task)) + '</button>' +
        (plant.status === 'pending'
          ? '<button type="button" class="btn btn-snooze" data-action="snooze" data-id="' + plant.id + '" data-focusid="snooze-' + plant.id + '"><span class="sr-only">' + esc(plant.name) + '. </span>Snooze</button>'
          : '') +
      '</div>'
    : '';
  const detail = showInline
    ? '<section class="inline-detail" id="detail" aria-label="Light, water, and notes for ' + esc(plant.name) + '">' +
        detailBody(plant, stampDate, false) + '</section>'
    : '';
  return '<li class="ticket is-' + tone(plant) + (selected ? ' is-selected' : '') + '" id="ticket-' + plant.id + '">' +
    '<button type="button" class="ticket-btn" data-action="select" data-id="' + plant.id + '" data-focusid="select-' + plant.id + '" data-nav="item" aria-expanded="' + (open ? 'true' : 'false') + '"' +
      (open ? ' aria-controls="detail"' : '') +
      (selected ? ' aria-current="true"' : '') + '>' +
      '<span class="sr-only">' + esc(prefix) + ' ' + (index + 1) + ' of ' + total + '. </span>' +
      '<span class="ord" aria-hidden="true">' + (index + 1) + '</span>' +
      '<span class="t-copy"><span class="t-kicker">' + esc(plant.task) + '</span>' +
        '<span class="t-name">' + esc(plant.name) + '</span>' +
        '<span class="t-meta">' + esc(plant.species) + ' · ' + esc(plant.location) + '</span>' +
        more + '</span>' +
      '<span class="t-due">' + esc(plant.due) + '</span>' +
    '</button>' + actions + detail + '</li>';
}

function queueHTML(stampDate) {
  const pending = pendingPlants();
  const snoozed = snoozedPlants();
  if (allDone()) {
    if (desktop()) {
      return '<section id="queue" tabindex="-1" data-focusid="queue" aria-labelledby="queue-title">' +
        '<div class="queue-head"><h2 class="queue-title" id="queue-title">Today’s care</h2><p class="count">All logged</p></div>' +
        '<p class="queue-note">All four are logged. The sill has the recap and the next glance. Settled plants below still open their notes.</p>' +
        '</section>';
    }
    return '<section id="queue" tabindex="-1" data-focusid="queue" aria-labelledby="done-title">' + posterHTML('queue') + '</section>';
  }

  let lists = '';
  if (!pending.length) {
    lists += '<p class="queue-empty">Nothing is due this sitting. Snoozed care sits under Later today, ready when you are.</p>';
  } else {
    lists += '<ol class="care-list">' + pending.map((plant, index) => ticketHTML(plant, index, pending.length, stampDate, 'Priority')).join('') + '</ol>';
  }
  if (snoozed.length) {
    lists += '<h3 class="later-title" id="later-title">Later today</h3>' +
      '<ol class="care-list" aria-labelledby="later-title">' +
      snoozed.map((plant, index) => ticketHTML(plant, index, snoozed.length, stampDate, 'Snoozed,')).join('') +
      '</ol>';
  }
  return '<section id="queue" tabindex="-1" data-focusid="queue" aria-labelledby="queue-title">' +
    '<div class="queue-head"><h2 class="queue-title" id="queue-title">Today’s care</h2><p class="count">' + esc(countLine()) + '</p></div>' +
    lists + '</section>';
}

function settledHTML(stampDate) {
  const done = donePlants();
  if (!done.length) return '';
  const items = done.map((plant) => {
    const selected = state.selectedId === plant.id;
    const open = selected && (desktop() || state.mobileOpen);
    const showInline = !desktop() && state.mobileOpen && selected;
    const detail = showInline
      ? '<section class="inline-detail" id="detail" aria-label="Light, water, and notes for ' + esc(plant.name) + '">' +
          detailBody(plant, stampDate, false) + '</section>'
      : '';
    return '<li>' +
      '<button type="button" class="settled-btn' + (selected ? ' is-selected' : '') + '" data-action="select" data-id="' + plant.id + '" data-focusid="select-' + plant.id + '" data-nav="item" aria-expanded="' + (open ? 'true' : 'false') + '"' +
        (showInline || (desktop() && selected) ? ' aria-controls="detail"' : '') +
        (selected ? ' aria-current="true"' : '') + '>' +
        '<span class="sr-only">Settled. </span><span class="s-name">' + esc(plant.name) + '</span>' +
        '<span class="s-did">' + esc(plant.history[0] || verbFor(plant.task)) + '</span></button>' +
      detail + '</li>';
  }).join('');
  return '<section class="settled" aria-labelledby="settled-title"><h2 class="settled-title" id="settled-title">Settled</h2><ul class="settled-list">' + items + '</ul></section>';
}

function rhythmHTML(now) {
  const logged = loggedCount();
  const usual = state.week[now.weekIndex];
  const note = 'Bigger stone, busier day, Monday to Sunday. Today is ' + now.dayName +
    ', usually ' + usual + '. Today’s ring is the log: ' + logged + ' of 4.';
  const days = state.week.map((value, index) => {
    const today = index === now.weekIndex;
    const progress = today ? (logged / 4) * 100 : 0;
    return '<li class="day' + (today ? ' is-today' : '') + '" data-n="' + value + '">' +
      '<span class="stone-ring" style="--p:' + progress.toFixed(2) + '" aria-hidden="true"><span class="stone" style="--n:' + value + '"></span></span>' +
      '<span class="day-label"><span aria-hidden="true">' + WEEKSHORT[index] + '</span><span class="sr-only">' + WEEKDAYS[index] + '</span></span>' +
      '<span class="day-num"><span class="sr-only">rhythm </span>' + value + '</span>' +
      '<span class="day-flag">' + (today ? 'Today' : '') + '</span>' +
      '</li>';
  }).join('');
  return '<figure class="rhythm"><figcaption><span class="rhythm-title">Weekly rhythm</span><span class="rhythm-note">' +
    esc(note) + '</span></figcaption><ol class="tray">' + days + '</ol></figure>';
}

function headerHTML(now) {
  return '<header class="top"><div class="brand">' + MARK +
    '<div><p class="kicker">Household plant care</p><h1>Moss</h1><p class="dateline">' + esc(now.dateLine) + '</p></div></div>' +
    '<p class="lede">' + esc(ledeText(now)) + '</p></header>';
}

function footerHTML() {
  return '<footer class="colophon"><p>Moss keeps house for Frida, Orbit, Dot, and Drama.</p>' +
    '<p>Keyboard: Tab moves through every control. Arrow keys walk the sill, the queue, or the settled list. Escape closes notes, or closes the undo slip and keeps the change.</p></footer>';
}

function appHTML() {
  const now = nowParts();
  const wide = desktop();
  const rhythm = rhythmHTML(now);
  const ledger = '<div class="ledger">' + (wide ? rhythm : '') + queueHTML(now.stampDate) + settledHTML(now.stampDate) + '</div>';
  const main = wide
    ? '<main class="layout">' + roomHTML(now.stampDate) + ledger + '</main>'
    : '<main class="layout">' + ledger + '</main>';
  return headerHTML(now) + (wide ? '' : rhythm) + main + footerHTML();
}

function arm(ms) {
  window.clearTimeout(state.timer);
  state.timer = window.setTimeout(expireUndo, ms);
  if (state.timer && typeof state.timer.unref === 'function') state.timer.unref();
}

function expireUndo() {
  if (state.toastHold) {
    arm(8000);
    return;
  }
  state.undoStack = [];
  state.toast = null;
  syncToast();
}

function topUndo() {
  return state.undoStack.length ? state.undoStack[state.undoStack.length - 1] : null;
}

function syncToast() {
  const el = document.getElementById('toast');
  if (!el) return;
  const next = state.toast || '';
  if (next === toastShown && el.dataset.ready === '1') return;
  toastShown = next;
  el.dataset.ready = '1';
  state.toastHold = false;
  if (!next) {
    el.hidden = true;
    el.innerHTML = '';
    document.body.classList.remove('has-toast');
    return;
  }
  const undo = topUndo();
  const undoBtn = undo
    ? '<button type="button" class="btn btn-undo" data-action="undo" data-focusid="undo"><span class="btn-label">Undo</span><span class="btn-sub">' + esc(undo.label) + '</span></button>'
    : '';
  el.innerHTML = '<p class="toast-msg">' + esc(next) + '</p>' + undoBtn +
    '<button type="button" class="btn btn-dismiss" data-action="dismiss" data-focusid="dismiss">Close</button>';
  el.hidden = false;
  document.body.classList.add('has-toast');
}

function focusDesired(id) {
  if (!id || !document.querySelector) return;
  let el = document.querySelector('[data-focusid="' + id + '"]');
  if (!el && id.indexOf('next-') === 0) {
    el = document.querySelector('[data-focusid="select-' + id.slice(5) + '"]');
  }
  if (!el && id.indexOf('watered-') === 0) {
    el = document.querySelector('[data-focusid="select-' + id.slice(8) + '"]');
  }
  if (!el) el = document.getElementById('detail') || document.getElementById('queue');
  if (el && typeof el.focus === 'function') el.focus();
}

function render() {
  const root = document.getElementById('app');
  if (!root) return;
  const active = document.activeElement;
  const current = active && active.dataset ? active.dataset.focusid || '' : '';
  const desired = state.focusAfterRender || current;
  state.focusAfterRender = null;
  const y = window.scrollY || 0;
  document.body.classList.toggle('is-desktop', desktop());
  document.body.classList.toggle('is-quiet', desktop() && !state.selectedId && allDone());
  document.title = titleFor();
  root.innerHTML = appHTML();
  syncToast();
  if (typeof window.scrollTo === 'function') window.scrollTo(0, y);
  focusDesired(desired);
  if (state.scrollTicket) {
    const node = document.getElementById('ticket-' + state.scrollTicket);
    state.scrollTicket = null;
    if (node && typeof node.scrollIntoView === 'function') node.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
  }
}

function pushUndo(plant, kind) {
  const label = plant.name + ' ' + (kind === 'snooze' ? 'snoozed' : verbFor(plant.task).toLowerCase());
  state.undoStack.push({
    id: plant.id,
    plant: clonePlant(plant),
    label,
    kind
  });
  state.focusReturn = 'select-' + plant.id;
}

function markWatered(id) {
  const plant = findPlant(id);
  if (!plant || plant.status === 'done') return;
  pushUndo(plant, 'water');
  plant.status = 'done';
  plant.due = 'Done today';
  plant.history = [nowParts().stampDate + ' · ' + verbFor(plant.task), ...plant.history];
  const next = nextOpen();
  if (next) {
    state.selectedId = next.id;
    state.mobileOpen = false;
  } else {
    state.selectedId = null;
    state.mobileOpen = false;
  }
  state.toast = plant.name + ': ' + verbFor(plant.task) + '.';
  state.focusAfterRender = 'undo';
  arm(8000);
  render();
}

function snoozePlant(id) {
  const plant = findPlant(id);
  if (!plant || plant.status !== 'pending') return;
  pushUndo(plant, 'snooze');
  plant.status = 'snoozed';
  plant.due = 'Later today';
  state.selectedId = plant.id;
  state.mobileOpen = true;
  state.toast = plant.name + ' snoozed for later today.';
  state.focusAfterRender = 'undo';
  arm(8000);
  render();
}

function undo() {
  const entry = state.undoStack.pop();
  if (!entry) return;
  const index = state.plants.findIndex((plant) => plant.id === entry.id);
  if (index >= 0) state.plants[index] = entry.plant;
  state.selectedId = entry.id;
  state.mobileOpen = true;
  state.scrollTicket = desktop() ? null : entry.id;
  if (state.undoStack.length) {
    state.toast = entry.plant.name + ' is back on the queue.';
    state.focusAfterRender = 'undo';
    arm(8000);
  } else {
    state.toast = entry.plant.name + ' is back on the queue.';
    state.focusAfterRender = 'select-' + entry.id;
    arm(2800);
  }
  render();
}

function dismissToast() {
  window.clearTimeout(state.timer);
  state.undoStack = [];
  state.toast = null;
  const back = state.focusReturn || (state.selectedId ? 'select-' + state.selectedId : 'queue');
  syncToast();
  focusDesired(back);
}

function selectPlant(id) {
  const plant = findPlant(id);
  if (!plant) return;
  const same = state.selectedId === id;
  if (!desktop() && same) state.mobileOpen = !state.mobileOpen;
  else {
    state.selectedId = id;
    state.mobileOpen = true;
  }
  if (!desktop()) state.scrollTicket = id;
  render();
}

function clearSelection() {
  state.selectedId = null;
  state.mobileOpen = false;
  state.focusAfterRender = 'queue';
  render();
}

function onClick(event) {
  const target = event.target.closest ? event.target.closest('[data-action]') : null;
  if (!target) return;
  const action = target.dataset.action;
  const id = target.dataset.id;
  if (action === 'select') selectPlant(id);
  else if (action === 'watered') markWatered(id);
  else if (action === 'snooze') snoozePlant(id);
  else if (action === 'undo') undo();
  else if (action === 'dismiss') dismissToast();
  else if (action === 'clear') clearSelection();
}

function onKey(event) {
  if (event.altKey || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) return;
  if (event.key === 'Escape') {
    if (state.toast) {
      event.preventDefault();
      dismissToast();
      return;
    }
    if (!desktop() && state.mobileOpen) {
      event.preventDefault();
      state.mobileOpen = false;
      state.focusAfterRender = state.selectedId ? 'select-' + state.selectedId : 'queue';
      render();
    }
    return;
  }
  if (event.key !== 'ArrowDown' && event.key !== 'ArrowUp' && event.key !== 'Home' && event.key !== 'End') return;
  const current = event.target.closest ? event.target.closest('[data-nav="item"]') : null;
  if (!current) return;
  const group = current.closest('.care-list, .settled-list, .sill');
  if (!group) return;
  const items = Array.from(group.querySelectorAll('[data-nav="item"]'));
  const index = items.indexOf(current);
  if (index < 0) return;
  let next = index;
  if (event.key === 'ArrowDown') next = Math.min(items.length - 1, index + 1);
  if (event.key === 'ArrowUp') next = Math.max(0, index - 1);
  if (event.key === 'Home') next = 0;
  if (event.key === 'End') next = items.length - 1;
  if (next === index) return;
  event.preventDefault();
  const id = items[next].dataset.id;
  state.selectedId = id;
  state.mobileOpen = !desktop();
  state.focusAfterRender = items[next].dataset.focusid;
  if (!desktop()) state.scrollTicket = id;
  render();
}

function boot() {
  const first = pendingPlants()[0];
  state.selectedId = first ? first.id : null;
  state.mobileOpen = false;
  const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
  if (toast) {
    toast.addEventListener('pointerenter', () => { state.toastHold = true; });
    toast.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => { state.toastHold = false; });
    toast.addEventListener('focusin', () => { state.toastHold = true; });
    toast.addEventListener('focusout', (event) => {
      if (!toast.contains(event.relatedTarget)) state.toastHold = false;
    });
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', onClick);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  const mq = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia('(min-width: 960px)') : null;
  if (mq && typeof mq.addEventListener === 'function') {
    mq.addEventListener('change', () => {
      if (!mq.matches && state.selectedId) state.mobileOpen = true;
      render();
    });
  }
  render();
}

if (typeof document !== 'undefined') boot();

grok-4.7/13-frontend-playful/styles.css

/* Moss — a paper sunroom ledger. Local fonts only. */

:root {
  --paper: #f3ecdf;
  --paper-2: #fbf7ef;
  --ink: #241e1a;
  --ink-soft: #4a4038;
  --moss: #24382c;
  --moss-mid: #2f4a38;
  --leaf: #3f6b4e;
  --clay: #8a3b24;
  --clay-deep: #6b2e1c;
  --sand: #f4e6d4;
  --line: #e3d4be;
  --wood: #c4a27a;
  --gold: #a87430;
  --display: "Noto Serif Display", "Noto Serif", "Liberation Serif", "DejaVu Serif", Georgia, serif;
  --sans: Cantarell, "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans", sans-serif;
  --shadow: #e4d5bf;
  color-scheme: light;
}

*,
*::before,
*::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
  scroll-behavior: auto;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  color: var(--ink);
  background-color: var(--paper);
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 42% at 0% -8%, rgba(190, 206, 170, 0.55), transparent 52%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 36% at 100% 0%, rgba(226, 196, 160, 0.5), transparent 48%),
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 27px, rgba(36, 30, 26, 0.028) 28px);
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 1.02rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

body.has-toast {
  padding-bottom: 7rem;
}

::selection {
  background: #d5e3c6;
  color: var(--ink);
}

h1, h2, h3, p, ul, ol, figure {
  margin: 0;
}

button {
  font: inherit;
  color: inherit;
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  padding: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
}

:focus {
  outline: 3px solid var(--ink);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

:focus:not(:focus-visible) {
  outline: none;
}

.sr-only {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

.skip {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0.75rem;
  top: 0.75rem;
  z-index: 6;
  transform: translateY(-160%);
  background: var(--paper-2);
  color: var(--ink);
  border: 2px solid var(--ink);
  padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.skip:focus {
  transform: none;
}

.shell {
  width: min(1120px, calc(100% - 1.5rem));
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding-block: 1.1rem 2.4rem;
}

.noscript {
  padding-top: 2rem;
}

.noscript h1 {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 3.2rem;
  line-height: 0.9;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
}

.noscript ol {
  margin-top: 1rem;
  padding-left: 1.2rem;
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.45rem;
}

.kicker,
.dateline,
.eyebrow {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.top {
  margin-bottom: 1.15rem;
}

.brand {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  align-items: center;
}

.mark {
  width: 68px;
  height: 68px;
  flex: none;
}

h1 {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: clamp(3rem, 8vw, 4.75rem);
  letter-spacing: -0.045em;
  line-height: 0.84;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.lede {
  margin-top: 0.85rem;
  max-width: 34ch;
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-style: italic;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-size: 1.32rem;
  line-height: 1.28;
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

.rhythm {
  margin-bottom: 1.35rem;
}

.rhythm-title {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: clamp(1.45rem, 2vw, 1.8rem);
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.1;
}

.rhythm-note {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
  max-width: 68ch;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

.tray {
  list-style: none;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(7, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.25rem;
  align-items: end;
  margin-top: 0.7rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.45rem 0.55rem;
  background: var(--sand-2, #efe2d0);
  background: #efe2d0;
  border-radius: 42px 48px 36px 40px;
  box-shadow: inset 0 -9px 0 #e3d0b4;
  position: relative;
}

.day {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 0.18rem;
  min-width: 0;
}

.stone-ring {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 3px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: transparent;
}

.day.is-today .stone-ring {
  background: conic-gradient(var(--moss-mid) calc(var(--p) * 1%), #e7d3b4 0);
}

.stone {
  width: calc(14px + var(--n) * 8px);
  height: calc(14px + var(--n) * 8px);
  background: #8aa37a;
  border-radius: 58% 42% 50% 50% / 46% 58% 42% 54%;
}

.day[data-n="2"] .stone { background: #6e8f6a; border-radius: 46% 54% 42% 58% / 55% 42% 58% 45%; }
.day[data-n="3"] .stone { background: #4f7354; border-radius: 52% 48% 60% 40% / 42% 60% 40% 58%; }
.day[data-n="4"] .stone { background: #345540; border-radius: 40% 60% 48% 52% / 60% 40% 55% 45%; }

.day.is-today .stone {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #efe2d0, 0 0 0 4px var(--clay);
}

.day-label,
.day-num,
.day-flag {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  line-height: 1.1;
}

.day-label {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.day-num {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

.day-flag {
  min-height: 1em;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--clay-deep);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.layout {
  display: block;
}

.room {
  position: relative;
  background: radial-gradient(130% 80% at 50% 0%, #f7f1e4 0%, var(--paper-2) 62%);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 64px 52px 26px 30px;
  box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 var(--shadow);
  padding: 1.15rem 1.05rem 1.15rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
}

.room-hero {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(108px, 142px) minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
  align-items: center;
}

.room-hero .art-wrap { margin: 0; }
.room-hero .plant-svg { width: 100%; }

.sill {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  align-items: end;
  gap: 0.15rem;
  padding-bottom: 0.35rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
  border-bottom: 8px solid var(--wood);
  border-radius: 0 0 8px 8px;
}

.sill-btn {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.05rem;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 0.15rem 0.1rem 0.35rem;
  width: 100%;
}

.sill-btn:hover {
  background: rgba(47, 74, 56, 0.06);
  border-radius: 14px 18px 8px 12px;
}

.sill-btn.is-selected {
  box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 var(--moss-mid);
  border-radius: 14px 18px 4px 8px;
}

.sill-btn .plant-svg {
  width: min(76px, 100%);
  height: auto;
}

.sill-name {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  line-height: 1.05;
}

.sill-state {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.sill-btn.is-late .sill-state { color: var(--clay-deep); }
.sill-btn.is-done .sill-state { color: var(--moss); }
.sill-btn.is-snoozed .sill-state { color: var(--ink-soft); }

.art-wrap {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  justify-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
}

.art-wrap .plant-svg {
  width: min(230px, 78%);
  height: auto;
}

.stamp {
  position: absolute;
  top: 8%;
  right: 6%;
  width: 4.5rem;
  height: 4.5rem;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border: 2px solid var(--clay);
  color: var(--clay-deep);
  border-radius: 50%;
  transform: rotate(-12deg);
  background: rgba(251, 247, 239, 0.88);
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.stamp.is-later {
  border-color: var(--moss-mid);
  color: var(--moss);
}

.eyebrow { margin-bottom: 0.15rem; }

.plant-name,
.poster h2,
.queue-title,
.settled-title {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  line-height: 0.95;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.plant-name {
  font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 3.4rem);
}

.aside,
.where,
.task-line,
.done-note {
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

.aside {
  margin-top: 0.45rem;
  max-width: 38ch;
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 1.12rem;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.where,
.task-line {
  margin-top: 0.35rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.task-line {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.done-note {
  margin-top: 0.8rem;
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
}

.actions {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.45fr 0.85fr;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  margin-top: 0.85rem;
}

.actions.is-single {
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
}

.btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  min-height: 48px;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-align: center;
  transition: background 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease;
}

.btn-label { font-weight: 600; }

.btn-water {
  background: var(--moss);
  color: #f7f1e6;
  border-radius: 999px 999px 999px 12px;
  box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #1a120e;
}

.btn-water:hover { background: #1c3026; }
.btn-water:active { background: #14241c; }

.btn-snooze {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--ink);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 12px 999px 999px 999px;
  box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #d9c6a6;
}

.btn-snooze:hover { background: #f3e6d4; }
.btn-snooze:active { background: #eadcc6; }

.btn-next,
.room .btn-next {
  margin-top: 0.7rem;
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--moss);
  color: #f7f1e6;
  border-radius: 999px;
  box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #1a120e;
}

.btn-next:hover { background: #1c3026; }

.room .btn-water,
.room .btn-snooze {
  width: 100%;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
  grid-template-areas: "icon label" "icon sub";
  justify-items: start;
  text-align: left;
  min-height: 58px;
  padding: 0.65rem 0.9rem;
}

.room .i {
  grid-area: icon;
  align-self: center;
  width: 1.2rem;
  height: 1.2rem;
}

.room .btn-label { grid-area: label; font-size: 1.05rem; }
.room .btn-sub { grid-area: sub; font-size: 0.84rem; font-weight: 500; }
.btn-water .btn-sub { color: #d7e4cf; }
.btn-snooze .btn-sub { color: var(--ink-soft); }

.i { width: 1.15rem; height: 1.15rem; }

.facts {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  margin-top: 1rem;
  padding-top: 0.85rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.fact h3 {
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}

.light-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  align-items: center;
}

.fact-strong {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.fact p + p { margin-top: 0.15rem; color: var(--ink-soft); }

.window {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 26px);
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 6px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border: 2px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 10px 10px 3px 3px;
  flex: none;
}

.pane {
  height: 34px;
  background: #e6d9c4;
  border-radius: 2px;
}

.pane.on { background: #e4c27a; }
.pane.on.bright { background: #c4893a; }

.fact ul {
  list-style: none;
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.35rem;
}

.fact li {
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 0.95rem;
  font-size: 0.98rem;
}

.fact li::before {
  content: "";
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--moss-mid);
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 0.5em;
}

.fact-notes li::before {
  border-radius: 1px;
  background: var(--clay);
}

.fact li.is-new { font-weight: 600; }

.new-tag {
  margin-left: 0.35rem;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--clay-deep);
}

.queue-head {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.queue-title { font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 3vw, 2.15rem); }

.count {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  text-align: right;
}

.queue-empty {
  padding: 0.85rem 0.9rem;
  border: 1.5px dashed #8a7664;
  border-radius: 16px 6px 18px 10px;
  max-width: 46ch;
  margin-bottom: 0.9rem;
}

.later-title {
  margin: 0.85rem 0 0.45rem;
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.care-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0 0 0 1.2rem;
  border-left: 2px solid #cbb892;
}

.ticket {
  position: relative;
  margin: 0 0 0.7rem;
  scroll-margin: 1rem;
}

.ticket::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  width: 11px;
  height: 11px;
  left: calc(-1.2rem - 6px);
  top: 1.25rem;
  background: var(--moss-mid);
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.ticket.is-late::before {
  background: var(--clay);
  border-radius: 2px;
}

.ticket.is-soon::before,
.ticket.is-snoozed::before {
  background: var(--paper);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--moss-mid);
}

.ticket.is-snoozed::before {
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #8a7664;
}

.ticket.is-late {
  background: #f6e4dc;
  border-radius: 3px 22px 14px 18px;
  border-left: 6px solid var(--clay);
}

.ticket.is-today {
  background: var(--sand);
  border-radius: 18px 5px 16px 12px;
}

.ticket.is-soon {
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 16px 8px 18px 6px;
}

Evaluation 8.5 / 10 graded blind as submission E

Chunky outlined cards with a 'Start here' tag, sections grouped Overdue/Due today/Coming up, a shelf illustration and a dome-bar rhythm. Copy and interactions are complete and readable. The desktop left rail goes empty below the rhythm.

Strengths

  • Clear priority grouping with counts
  • Task-specific verbs (Rotated, Soil checked), focus moves to Undo
  • No text under 12px and no low-contrast hits in the scan
  • All-done: 'All tended for now' plus a Done today list

Weaknesses

  • Left column on desktop is empty below the fold
  • Big cards make the mobile list long
Evidence the grader checked
  • harness.js (Playwright, 1440 and 390 px): all flows pass at both widths, doneClicks 4, finOv 0
  • fonts.js: E <12px 0, lowContrast 0
  • Details for Frida revealed 3 history lines

Objective checks

  • Browser: horizontal scroll at 390 px no; console errors 0; network requests 0

haiku-5.5/13-frontend-playful/RESPONSE.md

Moss: response notes

Moss is a single screen for today's plant care. It is plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with no framework, no packages, no remote assets, and no network calls. It opens from index.html directly.

Personality

  • Voice. Moss speaks like a dry, affectionate houseplant ombudsman. Each plant has one short line per state ("Dot does not do hugs.", "Orbit would like a small rotation. Nothing dramatic."). The copy never scolds about a missed watering; an overdue plant is described as sulking politely.
  • Shape language. Pebble-shaped cards with asymmetric corners alternate down the list. Plant avatars are blobs, buttons are pills, and the brand mark is a leaf with a sun dot. Nothing is a perfect rectangle, which keeps the list from reading as a wall of identical cards.
  • Tactile cues. Items that need attention have a hard ink shadow, like a sticker pressed onto paper. Items that can wait are flat with a dashed outline. Done items take on a soft moss fill.
  • Palette. Cream paper with a faint dot grain, moss green, terracotta, ochre, and a dusty plum for Drama. There are no gradients, no glass panels, and no neon. Illustrations are inline SVG: the four plants, the brand mark, and the all-done sun. The windowsill is CSS with those plants set on it. There are no clip-art faces.
  • Small moments of delight.
    • Watering drops a droplet onto the plant, and the avatar gives a small perk.
    • Snoozing sends a "z z" floating up from the card.
    • The windowsill mirrors the queue. Overdue plants droop, and tended plants stand up.
    • The all-done sun is asleep, with closed eyes, and gently bobs.

Interaction model

  • Queue order. Overdue comes first, most overdue at the top, then Due today, then Done today, then Coming up. The first item needing attention carries a "Start here" sticker. When anything is overdue, the summary line names the most overdue plant ("1 plant overdue. Start with Frida.").
  • Watered (and its siblings). The primary button reads Watered for Frida, Rotated for Orbit, Soil checked for Dot, and Misted for Drama. It writes a history entry dated Today, sets the next due date from the task interval, moves the plant to Done today, advances the progress count, and adds one to today's bar in the rhythm chart.
  • Snooze a day. Pushes the due date one day later. An overdue plant stays overdue, and the toast says so ("Frida snoozed a day. Still overdue, though."). Snooze is offered only for overdue and due-today items.
  • Undo. Every action shows a toast with an Undo button for six seconds. The toast stays up while it is hovered or focused. Only the most recent action can be undone, and a new action replaces the toast.
  • Details. Opens in place on each card with three sections: Light, Water and mist, and Observations. Each section lists entries from the plant's history, and new actions are filed into the matching section.
  • All done. When nothing is overdue or due today, the queue shows a sleepy-sun card with a rotating line, the summary line changes, and the toast for the final action adds "That is everything for today."
  • Seven-day rhythm. Each bar is one day, with its tended count shown above it and the weekday below. Today's bar is terracotta. A note names the busiest day.
  • Layout. On phones the order is brand, then queue, then windowsill and rhythm, so the work comes first. From 900px wide, the brand, windowsill, and rhythm form a sticky rail on the left and the queue fills the right. From 640px, the details sections sit in three columns.

Accessibility

  • Semantics. The brand is the h1, sections are h2, and queue groups are h3. Lists are real ol elements. All controls are native buttons. The tended count uses a progress element with a label. Details toggles set aria-expanded and aria-controls. Today's bar has aria-current="date".
  • Screen-reader text. Each rhythm bar carries visually hidden text such as "Thu: 4 care moments, today" for the day it describes. Buttons include the plant's name in hidden text, so "Watered" becomes "Watered Frida". The windowsill and all illustrations are aria-hidden.
  • Announcements. One role="status" region announces each action and undo. The toast and the region carry the same message.
  • Focus. After an action, focus moves to the same control if it still exists. If the plant has moved out of that control's group, focus goes to Undo. After Undo, focus returns to the control that was used. A skip link jumps past the brand to the queue heading.
  • Visible focus. A 3px ink outline with an offset on light surfaces, and an ochre outline on the dark toast.
  • Targets. Every button is at least 44px tall.
  • Colour. State is never shown by colour alone. Each card has a text chip ("2 days overdue", "Due today", "Tomorrow", "Tended · next in 5 days"). Overdue cards also get a heavier border, and their plants droop on the windowsill.
  • Motion. prefers-reduced-motion turns off all animation and transition, and hides the droplet and the z's. State changes still happen, just instantly.
  • Contrast. I chose text colours against their backgrounds to meet 4.5:1 for normal text. I checked the main pairs by hand; I did not run an automated contrast audit.

Technical notes

  • Data. PLANTS.json is mirrored into app.js, because fetch() is blocked on file:// pages. PLANTS.json is not loaded at runtime. If the data changes, update both.
  • No persistence. Reloading resets to the seed data. Undo works within a session only.
  • Dates. Weekday labels come from the device clock. History dates keep the seed's September values and are not rewritten. The "Today" entries are new.
  • Intervals. Watering recurs every 5 days, rotating every 7, soil checks every 3, misting every 2. These are in the TASKS table in app.js.
  • Theme. Light only. There is no dark theme.

What I checked

  • node --check app.js passes.
  • Headless Firefox rendered the page at 320, 390, and 1280px wide. I checked the mobile, desktop, and all-done states by eye.
  • A test harness loaded the real app.js and ran the actions in sequence: snooze, undo, watering, opening details, and finishing every task. After each step it checked the groups, the toast text, the rhythm note, and the focus target. All matched the intended behaviour.
  • Not checked: a real keyboard-only session, a screen reader pass, and other browsers.

haiku-5.5/13-frontend-playful/TASK.md

Task 13 — Frontend design: playful mobile-first product

Build a polished mobile-first web app screen for Moss, a gentle household plant-care companion. Use only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: no frameworks, package installs, remote assets, external fonts, or network requests.

Visual direction: warm, tactile, optimistic, and a little odd. Use an expressive shape language and small moments of delight while keeping text readable and controls obvious. Avoid childish clip art, neon gradients, glass panels, and a wall of indistinguishable cards.

The experience must include:

  • Today's care queue for the four plants in PLANTS.json, clearly prioritizing overdue care.
  • A plant detail view or expandable panel with light, water, and observation history.
  • Working “watered” and “snooze” actions that update the interface and offer a brief undo path.
  • A compact weekly rhythm visualization.
  • A useful all-done state.
  • Desktop composition that makes good use of space without merely stretching the mobile column.
  • Keyboard operation, visible focus, semantic controls, and reduced-motion support.

Create index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Use CSS or inline SVG for any illustration. Add RESPONSE.md explaining the personality, interaction model, and accessibility choices. Work only in this directory.

haiku-5.5/13-frontend-playful/app.js

/*
 * Moss: today's care queue.
 * Plain JavaScript, no network. SEED mirrors PLANTS.json; fetch() is blocked
 * on file:// pages, so the data is inlined here instead.
 */
(() => {
  'use strict';

  const SEED = {
    plants: [
      { id: 'fern', name: 'Frida', species: 'Boston fern', location: 'Bathroom', task: 'Water', due: '2 days overdue', urgency: 4, light: 'Low, indirect', history: ['Sep 19 · Misted', 'Sep 16 · Watered', 'Sep 12 · New frond'] },
      { id: 'pothos', name: 'Orbit', species: 'Golden pothos', location: 'Bookshelf', task: 'Rotate', due: 'Today', urgency: 2, light: 'Medium, indirect', history: ['Sep 20 · Watered', 'Sep 14 · Rotated', 'Sep 10 · Wiped leaves'] },
      { id: 'cactus', name: 'Dot', species: 'Bunny ears cactus', location: 'South window', task: 'Check soil', due: 'Today', urgency: 1, light: 'Bright, direct', history: ['Sep 08 · Watered', 'Sep 01 · New pad noted', 'Aug 22 · Rotated'] },
      { id: 'calathea', name: 'Drama', species: 'Calathea orbifolia', location: 'Bedroom', task: 'Mist', due: 'Tomorrow', urgency: 0, light: 'Medium, filtered', history: ['Sep 21 · Misted', 'Sep 18 · Watered', 'Sep 15 · Brown edge noted'] },
    ],
    week: [1, 3, 2, 4, 2, 1, 3],
  };

  // What each care task logs, what its button says, and how long until the next one.
  const TASKS = {
    Water: { verb: 'Watered', button: 'Watered', every: 5 },
    Rotate: { verb: 'Rotated', button: 'Rotated', every: 7 },
    'Check soil': { verb: 'Checked soil', button: 'Soil checked', every: 3 },
    Mist: { verb: 'Misted', button: 'Misted', every: 2 },
  };

  const MOODS = {
    fern: {
      overdue: 'Frida has been sulking politely. A drink should fix it.',
      today: 'Frida is getting dramatic about the dry spell.',
      done: 'Frida is drinking it all in. Fronds up.',
      coming: 'Frida is comfortable for now. Fronds unbothered.',
    },
    pothos: {
      overdue: 'Orbit has been leaning toward the window. A quarter turn, please.',
      today: 'Orbit would like a small rotation. Nothing dramatic.',
      done: 'Orbit is facing the room again. Very dignified.',
      coming: 'Orbit is leaning gently. Nothing urgent.',
    },
    cactus: {
      overdue: 'Dot has waited with spiky patience. Check the soil.',
      today: 'Dot would like the soil checked. Gently. Dot does not do hugs.',
      done: 'Dot checked out. Dot is unimpressed, and pleased about it.',
      coming: 'Dot is fine. Dot has been fine for a while.',
    },
    calathea: {
      overdue: 'Drama needs a mist, immediately. Everything is a big deal.',
      today: 'Drama needs a mist and a moment of silence.',
      done: 'Drama is misty and magnificent.',
      coming: 'Drama is preparing a scene for tomorrow. Mist first.',
    },
  };

  const ALL_DONE_LINES = [
    'Nothing needs you right now. The plants are pretending they did it themselves.',
    'Everyone has been watered, turned, misted, or politely inspected. Moss is napping.',
    'The leaves are content. Go do something that is not plant-related.',
  ];

  const GROUPS = ['overdue', 'today', 'done', 'coming'];
  const GROUP_TITLES = { overdue: 'Overdue', today: 'Due today', done: 'Done today', coming: 'Coming up' };
  const WEEKDAYS = ['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'];

  const $ = (selector) => document.querySelector(selector);
  const queueBody = $('#queue-body');
  const queueTitle = $('#queue-title');
  const lede = $('#lede');
  const progress = $('#progress');
  const progressCount = $('#progress-count');
  const sill = $('#sill');
  const rhythm = $('#rhythm');
  const rhythmNote = $('#rhythm-note');
  const toast = $('#toast');
  const toastText = $('#toast-text');
  const undoButton = $('#undo');
  const announcer = $('#announce');

  const TOAST_UNDO_MS = 6000;
  const TOAST_NOTE_MS = 3000;

  const state = {
    plants: SEED.plants.map(seedPlant),
    week: SEED.week.slice(),
  };
  const expanded = new Set();
  let undo = null; // { prev, focus } for the most recent action
  let toastTimer = 0;

  // Helpers

  function esc(value) {
    return String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({
      '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;',
    }[c]));
  }

  const plural = (n, word) => `${n} ${word}${Math.abs(n) === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
  const clone = (value) => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
  const find = (id) => state.plants.find((p) => p.id === id);

  function parseDue(text) {
    if (/tomorrow/i.test(text)) return 1;
    if (/today/i.test(text)) return 0;
    const overdue = text.match(/(\d+)\s+days?\s+overdue/i);
    if (overdue) return -Number(overdue[1]);
    return 0;
  }

  function seedPlant(raw) {
    return {
      id: raw.id,
      name: raw.name,
      species: raw.species,
      location: raw.location,
      task: raw.task,
      urgency: raw.urgency,
      light: raw.light,
      dueIn: parseDue(raw.due), // negative = overdue, 0 = today, 1+ = days out
      tended: false, // done today
      history: raw.history.map((line) => {
        const [when, ...rest] = line.split(' · ');
        return { when, text: rest.join(' · ') };
      }),
    };
  }

  function groupOf(p) {
    if (p.tended) return 'done';
    if (p.dueIn < 0) return 'overdue';
    if (p.dueIn === 0) return 'today';
    return 'coming';
  }

  function groupedPlants() {
    const groups = { overdue: [], today: [], done: [], coming: [] };
    for (const p of state.plants) groups[groupOf(p)].push(p);
    for (const list of Object.values(groups)) {
      list.sort((a, b) => a.dueIn - b.dueIn || b.urgency - a.urgency);
    }
    return groups;
  }

  const openCount = () => state.plants.filter((p) => !p.tended && p.dueIn <= 0).length;

  function dueLabel(p, group) {
    if (group === 'done') return `Tended · next in ${plural(p.dueIn, 'day')}`;
    if (p.dueIn < 0) return `${plural(-p.dueIn, 'day')} overdue`;
    if (p.dueIn === 0) return 'Due today';
    if (p.dueIn === 1) return 'Tomorrow';
    return `In ${plural(p.dueIn, 'day')}`;
  }

  const bucketOf = (text) => {
    if (/water|mist/i.test(text)) return 'water';
    if (/rotat|light/i.test(text)) return 'light';
    return 'notes';
  };

  // Rendering

  function plantArt(id) {
    return `<svg viewBox="0 0 80 80" focusable="false" aria-hidden="true">${ART[id]()}</svg>`;
  }

  const POT = '<path d="M21 44h38l-4.5 25a4 4 0 0 1-4 3.5H29.5a4 4 0 0 1-4-3.5z" fill="#b5673d"/>'
    + '<rect x="17" y="37" width="46" height="10" rx="5" fill="#cf7d52"/>';

  const ART = {
    fern: () => {
      const fronds = [-68, -40, -15, 12, 38, 64].map((angle, i) => {
        const len = i % 2 ? 26 : 32;
        const fill = i % 2 ? '#7a9d55' : '#4f7a38';
        return `<ellipse cx="40" cy="${40 - len / 2}" rx="4.5" ry="${len / 2}" transform="rotate(${angle} 40 40)" fill="${fill}"/>`;
      });
      return fronds.join('') + POT;
    },
    pothos: () => '<path d="M40 38Q36 30 30 26M40 38Q46 30 52 22" stroke="#4d6b30" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>'
      + '<ellipse cx="26" cy="26" rx="11" ry="8" transform="rotate(-30 26 26)" fill="#6f9a45"/>'
      + '<ellipse cx="52" cy="20" rx="10" ry="8" transform="rotate(20 52 20)" fill="#5d8a3b"/>'
      + '<ellipse cx="60" cy="40" rx="9" ry="7" transform="rotate(60 60 40)" fill="#7fa552"/>'
      + '<ellipse cx="32" cy="42" rx="9" ry="7" transform="rotate(-70 32 42)" fill="#5d8a3b"/>'
      + '<circle cx="22" cy="24" r="2" fill="#f0c95a"/><circle cx="56" cy="18" r="1.6" fill="#f0c95a"/>'
      + POT,
    cactus: () => '<rect x="31" y="14" width="14" height="30" rx="7" fill="#7f9c6c"/>'
      + '<rect x="45" y="24" width="11" height="20" rx="5.5" fill="#6d8c5c"/>'
      + '<rect x="22" y="30" width="10" height="16" rx="5" fill="#6d8c5c"/>'
      + '<g fill="#f3e3b5"><circle cx="38" cy="22" r="1.2"/><circle cx="36" cy="32" r="1.2"/>'
      + '<circle cx="50" cy="30" r="1.1"/><circle cx="27" cy="36" r="1.1"/></g>'
      + POT,
    calathea: () => '<ellipse cx="30" cy="30" rx="11" ry="13" transform="rotate(-20 30 30)" fill="#5f8a4e"/>'
      + '<ellipse cx="51" cy="28" rx="10" ry="12" transform="rotate(18 51 28)" fill="#6f9a57"/>'
      + '<path d="M30 42L26 22M30 30l-6-3M30 34l-7 1M51 40L52 20M51 30l6-3M51 35l6 1" stroke="#c4d99c" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>'
      + POT,
  };

  const SUN_ART = '<svg class="all-done__art" viewBox="0 0 120 120" focusable="false" aria-hidden="true">'
    + '<circle cx="60" cy="62" r="40" fill="#e3a72f"/>'
    + '<path d="M60 24C58 12 68 4 80 6c-2 12-10 20-20 18z" fill="#55733a"/>'
    + '<path d="M44 62q5 5 10 0M66 62q5 5 10 0M55 76q5 3 10 0" stroke="#2b2319" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>'
    + '</svg>';

  function careItem(p, group, isFirst) {
    const rule = TASKS[p.task];
    const open = expanded.has(p.id);
    const name = esc(p.name);
    const actions = [];

    if (group !== 'done') {
      actions.push(`<button type="button" class="btn btn--primary" data-action="tend" data-id="${p.id}" data-focus="${p.id}:tend">${rule.button}<span class="sr-only"> ${name}</span></button>`);
    }
    if (group === 'overdue' || group === 'today') {
      actions.push(`<button type="button" class="btn" data-action="snooze" data-id="${p.id}" data-focus="${p.id}:snooze">Snooze a day<span class="sr-only"> ${name}</span></button>`);
    }
    actions.push(`<button type="button" class="btn btn--quiet" data-action="toggle" data-id="${p.id}" data-focus="${p.id}:toggle" aria-expanded="${open}" aria-controls="details-${p.id}">Details<span class="sr-only"> for ${name}</span></button>`);

    const byBucket = { light: [], water: [], notes: [] };
    for (const entry of p.history) byBucket[bucketOf(entry.text)].push(entry);

    return `
      <li class="care care--${p.id} care--${group}" data-plant="${p.id}">
        ${isFirst ? '<span class="sticker" aria-hidden="true">Start here</span>' : ''}
        <div class="care__row">
          <div class="care__avatar">${plantArt(p.id)}</div>
          <div>
            <p class="care__name"><strong>${name}</strong> <span class="care__species">${esc(p.species)}</span></p>
            <p class="care__task">${esc(p.task)} · ${esc(p.location)}</p>
            <p class="care__mood">${esc(MOODS[p.id][group])}</p>
            <p class="care__due"><span class="chip chip--${group}">${esc(dueLabel(p, group))}</span></p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="care__actions">${actions.join('')}</div>
        <div class="care__details" id="details-${p.id}"${open ? '' : ' hidden'}>
          <dl class="facts">
            <div><dt>Light</dt><dd>${esc(p.light)}</dd></div>
            <div><dt>Spot</dt><dd>${esc(p.location)}</dd></div>
          </dl>
          <div class="logs">
            ${logSection('Light', byBucket.light)}
            ${logSection('Water and mist', byBucket.water)}
            ${logSection('Observations', byBucket.notes)}
          </div>
        </div>
      </li>`;
  }

  function logSection(title, entries) {
    const items = entries.length
      ? entries.map((e) => `<li><span class="when">${esc(e.when)}</span>${esc(e.text)}</li>`).join('')
      : '<li class="empty">Nothing logged yet.</li>';
    return `<section><h4>${title}</h4><ul>${items}</ul></section>`;
  }

  function renderQueue(groups) {
    const allDone = groups.overdue.length === 0 && groups.today.length === 0;
    const parts = [];
    if (allDone) {
      const line = ALL_DONE_LINES[new Date().getDate() % ALL_DONE_LINES.length];
      parts.push(`
        <div class="all-done">
          ${SUN_ART}
          <h3>All tended for now</h3>
          <p>${esc(line)}</p>
        </div>`);
    }
    const startHere = groups.overdue[0] || groups.today[0];
    for (const group of GROUPS) {
      const list = groups[group];
      if (!list.length) continue;
      const items = list.map((p) => careItem(p, group, p === startHere));
      parts.push(`
        <section class="group group--${group}" aria-labelledby="group-${group}">
          <h3 class="group__title" id="group-${group}">${GROUP_TITLES[group]} <span class="group__count">${list.length}</span></h3>
          <ol class="care-list">${items.join('')}</ol>
        </section>`);
    }
    queueBody.innerHTML = parts.join('');
  }

  function renderSummary(groups) {
    const { overdue, today } = groups;
    if (overdue.length) {
      lede.textContent = `${plural(overdue.length, 'plant')} overdue. Start with ${overdue[0].name}.`;
    } else if (today.length) {
      lede.textContent = `${plural(today.length, 'plant')} due today. Easy does it.`;
    } else {
      lede.textContent = 'Everyone is tended for now. Go be a plant-adjacent human.';
    }
    progress.max = state.plants.length;
    progress.value = groups.done.length;
    progressCount.textContent = `${groups.done.length}/${state.plants.length}`;
  }

  function renderSill() {
    sill.innerHTML = state.plants
      .map((p) => `<span class="sill__plant sill__plant--${p.id} is-${groupOf(p)}" data-plant="${p.id}">${plantArt(p.id)}</span>`)
      .join('');
  }

  function renderRhythm() {
    const today = new Date();
    const last = state.week.length - 1;
    const days = state.week.map((count, i) => {
      const date = new Date(today);
      date.setDate(today.getDate() - (last - i));
      return { label: WEEKDAYS[date.getDay()], count, isToday: i === last };
    });
    const busiest = days.reduce((best, day) => (day.count > best.count ? day : best));
    rhythmNote.textContent = `Busiest day: ${busiest.label} (${busiest.count}). Today so far: ${plural(days[last].count, 'care moment')}.`;

    rhythm.innerHTML = `
      <ol class="rhythm__list">
        ${days.map((d) => `
          <li class="rhythm__day${d.isToday ? ' is-today' : ''}"${d.isToday ? ' aria-current="date"' : ''}>
            <span class="rhythm__count" aria-hidden="true">${d.count}</span>
            <span class="rhythm__bar" style="--n:${d.count}" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <span class="rhythm__label" aria-hidden="true">${d.label}</span>
            <span class="sr-only">${d.label}: ${plural(d.count, 'care moment')}${d.isToday ? ', today' : ''}</span>
          </li>`).join('')}
      </ol>`;
  }

  function render(pending = {}) {
    const groups = groupedPlants();
    renderSummary(groups);
    renderQueue(groups);
    renderSill();
    renderRhythm();
    if (pending.fx) applyFx(pending.fx);
    if (pending.focus) focusAfterRender(pending.focus);
  }

  function focusAfterRender(key) {
    const target = queueBody.querySelector(`[data-focus="${key}"]`);
    if (target) target.focus();
    else if (!toast.hidden && !undoButton.hidden) undoButton.focus();
    else queueTitle.focus();
  }

  // Small moments of delight: a droplet and a perk for watering, a sleepy z for snoozing.

  function applyFx({ id, kind }) {
    const item = queueBody.querySelector(`li[data-plant="${id}"]`);
    if (!item) return;
    if (kind === 'tend') {
      const avatar = item.querySelector('.care__avatar');
      const drop = document.createElement('span');
      drop.className = 'drop';
      drop.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      avatar.classList.add('is-perking');
      avatar.append(drop);
      setTimeout(() => drop.remove(), 800);
      sill.querySelector(`.sill__plant--${id}`)?.classList.add('is-perking');
    } else {
      const zzz = document.createElement('span');
      zzz.className = 'zzz';
      zzz.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      zzz.textContent = 'z z';
      item.append(zzz);
      setTimeout(() => zzz.remove(), 1700);
    }
  }

  // Actions

  function act(message, prev, focus, fx) {
    undo = { prev, focus };
    showToast(message, true);
    render({ focus, fx });
  }

  function tend(id) {
    const p = find(id);
    const rule = TASKS[p.task];
    const prev = clone(state);
    p.tended = true;
    p.dueIn = rule.every;
    p.history.unshift({ when: 'Today', text: rule.verb });
    state.week[state.week.length - 1] += 1;

    const finished = openCount() === 0 ? ' That is everything for today.' : '';
    act(`${p.name} ${rule.verb.toLowerCase()}. Lovely.${finished}`, prev, `${id}:tend`, { id, kind: 'tend' });
  }

  function snooze(id) {
    const p = find(id);
    const prev = clone(state);
    p.dueIn += 1;
    const message = p.dueIn < 0
      ? `${p.name} snoozed a day. Still overdue, though.`
      : `${p.name} snoozed a day. Zzz.`;
    act(message, prev, `${id}:snooze`, { id, kind: 'snooze' });
  }

  function toggleDetails(id, button) {
    const open = !expanded.has(id);
    if (open) expanded.add(id);
    else expanded.delete(id);
    button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
    document.getElementById(`details-${id}`).hidden = !open;
  }

  // Toast with undo

  function showToast(message, withUndo) {
    toastText.textContent = message;
    undoButton.hidden = !withUndo;
    toast.hidden = false;
    announcer.textContent = message;
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(hideToast, withUndo ? TOAST_UNDO_MS : TOAST_NOTE_MS);
  }

  function hideToast() {
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toast.hidden = true;
    undo = null;
  }

  const pauseToast = () => clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  const resumeToast = () => {
    if (toast.hidden || toast.matches(':hover, :focus-within')) return;
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(hideToast, TOAST_NOTE_MS);
  };
  toast.addEventListener('pointerenter', pauseToast);
  toast.addEventListener('pointerleave', resumeToast);
  toast.addEventListener('focusin', pauseToast);
  toast.addEventListener('focusout', resumeToast);

  undoButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (!undo) return;
    const { prev, focus } = undo;
    state.plants = prev.plants;
    state.week = prev.week;
    showToast('Put back. Nothing lost.', false);
    undo = null;
    render({ focus });
  });

  queueBody.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    const button = event.target.closest('button[data-action]');
    if (!button) return;
    const { action, id } = button.dataset;
    if (action === 'tend') tend(id);
    else if (action === 'snooze') snooze(id);
    else if (action === 'toggle') toggleDetails(id, button);
  });

  render();
})();

haiku-5.5/13-frontend-playful/index.html

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="color-scheme" content="light">
  <title>Moss · Today's care</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
</head>
<body>
  <a class="skip-link" href="#queue-title">Skip to today's care</a>

  <main class="layout">
    <header class="hero">
      <div class="brand">
        <svg class="brand__mark" viewBox="0 0 48 48" focusable="false" aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="M9 31C4 20 10 8 23 8c10 0 16 7 15 16-1 10-9 17-19 16-5-.5-9-3-10-9z" fill="#5d7d3f"/>
          <path d="M17 33c3-7 7-11 14-15" stroke="#f6efe0" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
          <circle cx="37" cy="11" r="4.5" fill="#e3a72f"/>
        </svg>
        <h1 class="brand__name">Moss</h1>
      </div>
      <p class="tagline">Little errands for the leafy ones.</p>
      <p class="lede" id="lede">Getting the plants organised.</p>
      <div class="progress-row">
        <span class="progress-row__label" id="progress-label">Tended today</span>
        <progress id="progress" class="progress" max="4" value="0" aria-labelledby="progress-label">0 of 4</progress>
        <span class="progress-row__count" id="progress-count" aria-hidden="true">0/4</span>
      </div>
    </header>

    <section class="queue" id="queue" aria-labelledby="queue-title">
      <h2 class="queue__title" id="queue-title" tabindex="-1">Today's care</h2>
      <div id="queue-body"></div>
    </section>

    <aside class="rail" aria-label="Windowsill and this week">
      <div class="sill" id="sill" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      <section class="rhythm" aria-labelledby="rhythm-title">
        <h2 class="section-title" id="rhythm-title">Seven-day rhythm</h2>
        <p class="rhythm__note" id="rhythm-note"></p>
        <div id="rhythm"></div>
      </section>
    </aside>
  </main>

  <div class="toast" id="toast" hidden>
    <p class="toast__text" id="toast-text"></p>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn--undo" id="undo">Undo</button>
  </div>
  <p class="sr-only" id="announce" role="status"></p>

  <script src="app.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
