step-5-preview/13-frontend-playful/RESPONSE.md

Moss — design response

Personality

Moss is a warm, slightly odd paper artefact: a seed-packet sticker sheet that happens to be a care app. The palette is cream paper, warm brown ink, moss and sage greens, terracotta, and butter yellow — nothing neon, nothing glassy. Surfaces are tactile rather than floating: 1.5px ink-tinted borders, soft drop shadows, chunky pill buttons with a hard bottom edge that compresses when pressed (a physical, thumb-friendly response), and a rotating cast of organic blob shapes instead of identical rounded rectangles. Small washi-tape stickers, dashed "garden centre label" borders, and hand-drawn-feeling inline SVG plants (frond fan, trailing pothos, bunny-ear cactus with a butter flower, striped calathea) carry the expressiveness — no clip art, no illustration library, no remote assets.

The voice is a gentle gardener who whispers. "Snoozed until evening. No guilt accrued." "She will act unimpressed. She is not." Each plant has a one-line personality note in the rail, and the queue hint rewrites itself around whatever is most urgent. Delight is rationed into small moments: a droplet that falls past the toast icon when a plant is watered, a marker-stroke highlight behind headings, a slowly nudging overdue pill, staggered card entrances, and leaf-count markers on the weekly rhythm chart.

Interaction model

Today's queue is the spine of the page. Plants are ordered by urgency, so Frida (2 days overdue) always sits on top with a terracotta "overdue" pill and a tinted card frame; "Today" and "Tomorrow" get softer chips. The header progress strip (a striped fill that springs open) shows how many of four plants are tended.

Watered is the primary action on every card: one tap logs the care timestamp into that plant's history, animates the progress strip, removes the card from the queue, and raises a toast with the plant's reaction — plus an Undo button that lives for 7 seconds and restores the entire previous state (queue, history, progress). When a keyboard user's focused button disappears with the card, focus is deliberately moved to the next sensible control (next card's Watered button, then the snooze corner, then the all-done panel), so nobody gets dumped on <body>.

Snooze moves the plant to the dashed "snooze corner" below the queue with "until evening" framing, keeping both actions available there (Watered, Wake up). Every mutation — water, snooze, wake, and the demo reset — pushes a snapshot onto an undo stack and offers the same brief undo path.

Details expands an inline panel (real aria-expanded/aria-controls button, hidden panel so collapsed content stays out of the accessibility tree) with care facts — light requirement, last soak date, next task — and the full history timeline, where care events are bold and observations ("Brown edge noted", "New frond") are italicised whispers.

Weekly rhythm is a compact SVG: one stem per day, one leaf per care visit, counts labelled, today marked with a butter sun and a dark "today" chip, and a sentence caption ("15 little visits across seven days — steady beats heroic"). It has a text equivalent via role="img" and a descriptive aria-label.

All-done state appears the moment the queue empties: a blob-shaped panel with a sprout-in-hands illustration, copy that adapts to what remains snoozed, and a "wind back to this morning" reset so the state is always explorable.

Desktop composition is a two-column layout, not a stretched phone: the queue keeps a comfortable measure on the left while a right rail holds the weekly rhythm and greenhouse notes. Inside each card, desktop switches to a three-column arrangement — illustration, identity, stacked actions — and the details toggle tucks under the meta row.

Accessibility choices

  • Semantics first: header/main/aside/section landmarks, a skip link, real <button> controls, <ul> lists for the queue and history, an <output role="status"> toast with aria-live="polite", a labelled role="progressbar" with aria-valuetext, and aria-hidden on decorative SVGs.
  • Keyboard: every control is natively focusable and operable; Escape dismisses the toast; focus is actively managed after destructive-feeling actions; :focus-visible rings are 3px moss-dark outlines with offset, and buttons use 2px borders plus shadow states so hover/active/focus are distinguishable without colour alone.
  • Contrast: body text is #33291f on #fffcf5/#f6efe3, secondary text stays above 4.5:1, and coloured chips (moss, terracotta, butter) were picked to keep white/dark text legible rather than using light tint-on-tint.
  • Reduced motion: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce collapses all animations and transitions (card entrances, the nudge, the pour, progress spring), and the droplet delight is a decorative extra that simply stops.
  • No network: everything — fonts (system serif/sans stacks), illustrations (inline SVG), icons, data (a mirrored copy of PLANTS.json) — is local, so the page works offline from file://.

Files

  • index.html — structure and static copy
  • styles.css — design system, responsive composition, motion
  • app.js — state, rendering, interactions, undo, illustrations

Open index.html in a browser. No build step, no dependencies.

step-5-preview/13-frontend-playful/TASK.md

Task 13 — Frontend design: playful mobile-first product

Build a polished mobile-first web app screen for Moss, a gentle household plant-care companion. Use only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: no frameworks, package installs, remote assets, external fonts, or network requests.

Visual direction: warm, tactile, optimistic, and a little odd. Use an expressive shape language and small moments of delight while keeping text readable and controls obvious. Avoid childish clip art, neon gradients, glass panels, and a wall of indistinguishable cards.

The experience must include:

  • Today's care queue for the four plants in PLANTS.json, clearly prioritizing overdue care.
  • A plant detail view or expandable panel with light, water, and observation history.
  • Working “watered” and “snooze” actions that update the interface and offer a brief undo path.
  • A compact weekly rhythm visualization.
  • A useful all-done state.
  • Desktop composition that makes good use of space without merely stretching the mobile column.
  • Keyboard operation, visible focus, semantic controls, and reduced-motion support.

Create index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Use CSS or inline SVG for any illustration. Add RESPONSE.md explaining the personality, interaction model, and accessibility choices. Work only in this directory.

step-5-preview/13-frontend-playful/app.js

/* ==========================================================================
   Moss — app logic
   No frameworks, no network: the four plants from PLANTS.json live here,
   everything else is state + DOM.
   ========================================================================== */

(() => {
  'use strict';

  /* --- Data (mirrors PLANTS.json) --------------------------------------- */

  const DATA = {
    plants: [
      { id: 'fern',    name: 'Frida', species: 'Boston fern',       location: 'Bathroom',     task: 'Water',      due: '2 days overdue', urgency: 4, light: 'Low, indirect',    history: ['Sep 19 · Misted', 'Sep 16 · Watered', 'Sep 12 · New frond'] },
      { id: 'pothos',  name: 'Orbit', species: 'Golden pothos',     location: 'Bookshelf',    task: 'Rotate',     due: 'Today',          urgency: 2, light: 'Medium, indirect', history: ['Sep 20 · Watered', 'Sep 14 · Rotated', 'Sep 10 · Wiped leaves'] },
      { id: 'cactus',  name: 'Dot',   species: 'Bunny ears cactus', location: 'South window', task: 'Check soil', due: 'Today',          urgency: 1, light: 'Bright, direct',   history: ['Sep 08 · Watered', 'Sep 01 · New pad noted', 'Aug 22 · Rotated'] },
      { id: 'calathea',name: 'Drama', species: 'Calathea orbifolia',location: 'Bedroom',      task: 'Mist',       due: 'Tomorrow',       urgency: 0, light: 'Medium, filtered', history: ['Sep 21 · Misted', 'Sep 18 · Watered', 'Sep 15 · Brown edge noted'] }
    ],
    week: [1, 3, 2, 4, 2, 1, 3]
  };

  /* Display-only extras: sticker colours and whispered notes. */
  const TINTS = {
    fern:     { tint: '#9dbb9a', bg: '#e3ecdf' },
    pothos:   { tint: '#f0c265', bg: '#fbeed2' },
    cactus:   { tint: '#e2a173', bg: '#f7e4d3' },
    calathea: { tint: '#a8c3d4', bg: '#dfe9ee' }
  };

  const NOTES = {
    fern:     'Frida loves steam — every shower is her spa day. Misting counts as watering to her.',
    pothos:   'Orbit leans toward the window. A quarter turn each week keeps him honest.',
    cactus:   'Dot is low-drama. Forget her for a month; she absolutely respects it.',
    calathea: 'Drama folds her leaves when sulking. It is a performance. She is fine.'
  };

  const REACTIONS = {
    fern:     'Fronds uncurling already.',
    pothos:   'Roots humming, vines considering the window.',
    cactus:   'She will act unimpressed. She is not.',
    calathea: 'Leaves lifting within the hour, most likely.'
  };

  const today = new Date();
  const todayIndex = (today.getDay() + 6) % 7; // Monday-first week

  const initialItems = () => DATA.plants.map((p) => ({ ...p, status: 'todo' }));

  const state = {
    items: initialItems(),
    past: [] // undo snapshots
  };

  /* --- Helpers ----------------------------------------------------------- */

  const $ = (sel, root = document) => root.querySelector(sel);

  const el = {
    list: $('#plant-list'),
    date: $('#today-date'),
    greeting: $('#greeting'),
    progress: $('#progress'),
    progressFill: $('#progress-fill'),
    progressCount: $('#progress-count'),
    hint: $('#queue-hint'),
    queueHeading: $('#queue-heading'),
    done: $('#done-state'),
    doneTitle: $('#done-title'),
    doneMsg: $('#done-msg'),
    reset: $('#reset-day'),
    snoozeCorner: $('#snooze-corner'),
    snoozeList: $('#snooze-list'),
    rhythmFigure: $('#rhythm-figure'),
    rhythmCaption: $('#rhythm-caption'),
    notesBody: $('#notes-body'),
    toast: $('#toast'),
    toastMsg: $('#toast-msg'),
    toastUndo: $('#toast-undo')
  };

  const fmtLong = today.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' });
  const fmtShort = today.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });

  const escapeHtml = (str) => String(str)
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');

  const isOverdue = (item) => /overdue/i.test(item.due);
  const byUrgency = (a, b) => b.urgency - a.urgency;

  const queueItems = () => state.items.filter((i) => i.status === 'todo').sort(byUrgency);
  const snoozedItems = () => state.items.filter((i) => i.status === 'snoozed');
  const doneCount = () => state.items.filter((i) => i.status === 'done').length;

  /* --- Icons ------------------------------------------------------------- */

  const DROP = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M12 3c3.5 4.2 6 7.4 6 10.2A6 6 0 0 1 6 13.2C6 10.4 8.5 7.2 12 3z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>';
  const CLOCK = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2"/><path d="M12 7v5l3.5 2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>';
  const SUN = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4.2" fill="currentColor"/><g stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 2.5v3M12 18.5v3M2.5 12h3M18.5 12h3M5.3 5.3l2.1 2.1M16.6 16.6l2.1 2.1M18.7 5.3l-2.1 2.1M7.4 16.6l-2.1 2.1"/></g></svg>';

  /* --- Plant illustrations (inline SVG) ---------------------------------- */

  function pot(body = '#c8663f', rim = '#a34e2b') {
    return `
      <path d="M38 76 h44 l-5 24a9 9 0 0 1 -9 8 h-16 a9 9 0 0 1 -9 -8 z" fill="${body}"/>
      <path d="M38.6 82.5 h42.8 l-1.2 5.6 h-40.4 z" fill="#3a1c0d" opacity=".12"/>
      <rect x="33" y="67" width="54" height="11" rx="5.5" fill="${rim}"/>`;
  }

  function plantSvg(id) {
    if (id === 'fern') {
      const fronds = [-64, -38, -16, 8, 34, 60]
        .map((r, i) => `<path d="M60 72 C 53 52 42 36 24 28 C 36 46 47 62 60 72 Z"
            fill="${i % 2 ? '#5e8a68' : '#3d6b4f'}" transform="rotate(${r} 60 72)"/>`).join('');
      return `<svg viewBox="0 0 120 120" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">${pot()}${fronds}</svg>`;
    }
    if (id === 'pothos') {
      const leaf = 'M0 0 C -8 -5 -8 -17 0 -21 C 8 -17 8 -5 0 0 Z';
      const spots = [[40, 64, -35, 1], [31, 51, -58, .9], [46, 55, -12, .8],
                     [79, 63, 38, 1], [88, 51, 60, .9], [73, 55, 14, .8]]
        .map(([x, y, r, s]) => `<path d="${leaf}" fill="#3d6b4f" transform="translate(${x} ${y}) rotate(${r}) scale(${s})"/>`)
        .join('');
      return `<svg viewBox="0 0 120 120" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">${pot()}
        <path d="M56 68 C 44 64 34 56 30 42" stroke="#5e8a68" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <path d="M64 68 C 76 66 85 60 89 48" stroke="#5e8a68" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        ${spots}</svg>`;
    }
    if (id === 'cactus') {
      return `<svg viewBox="0 0 120 120" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">${pot()}
        <rect x="45" y="22" width="27" height="52" rx="13.5" fill="#4d7f57" transform="rotate(-9 58 74)"/>
        <rect x="61" y="32" width="22" height="44" rx="11" fill="#5e8a68" transform="rotate(13 72 74)"/>
        <g stroke="#2b4d38" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round">
          <path d="M50 34 l-4 -3 M52 46 l-5 -2 M53 58 l-5 -1" transform="rotate(-9 58 74)"/>
          <path d="M68 44 l4 -3 M67 56 l5 -2 M66 66 l5 -1" transform="rotate(13 72 74)"/>
        </g>
        <g fill="#f0c265">
          <circle cx="51" cy="20" r="4.5"/>
          <circle cx="45" cy="24" r="3"/><circle cx="57" cy="24" r="3"/>
          <circle cx="45" cy="17" r="3"/><circle cx="57" cy="17" r="3"/>
        </g></svg>`;
    }
    // calathea
    const leaf = 'M0 0 C -15 -12 -17 -36 0 -54 C 17 -36 15 -12 0 0 Z';
    const leaves = [[-52, .85], [-24, 1], [6, 1.05], [40, .9]]
      .map(([r, s], i) => `
        <g transform="rotate(${r} 60 74)">
          <g transform="scale(${s}) translate(${(60 / s - 60).toFixed(1)} ${(74 / s - 74).toFixed(1)})">
            <path d="${leaf}" fill="${i % 2 ? '#4f7f5c' : '#3d6b4f'}" transform="translate(60 74)"/>
            <path d="M60 70 L60 28" stroke="#c9dcc4" stroke-width="2" opacity=".65" transform="translate(60 74)"/>
          </g>
        </g>`).join('');
    return `<svg viewBox="0 0 120 120" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">${pot()}${leaves}</svg>`;
  }

  /* --- Rendering --------------------------------------------------------- */

  function renderHeader() {
    el.date.textContent = fmtLong;
    const h = today.getHours();
    el.greeting.textContent = h < 12 ? 'Good morning, gardener' : h < 18 ? 'Good afternoon, gardener' : 'Good evening, gardener';

    const total = state.items.length;
    const done = doneCount();
    el.progressFill.style.width = `${(done / total) * 100}%`;
    el.progress.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(done));
    el.progress.setAttribute('aria-valuetext', `${done} of ${total} plants tended`);
    el.progressCount.textContent = String(done);
  }

  function cardEl(item) {
    const li = document.createElement('li');
    const t = TINTS[item.id] || TINTS.fern;
    li.className = 'plant' + (isOverdue(item) ? ' plant--overdue' : '');
    li.dataset.id = item.id;
    li.style.setProperty('--plant-tint', t.tint);
    li.style.setProperty('--plant-tint-bg', t.bg);

    const lastWater = item.history.find((h) => /water|mist/i.test(h));
    const lastWaterDate = lastWater ? lastWater.split(' · ')[0] : 'No record';
    const dueChip = isOverdue(item)
      ? `<span class="chip chip--overdue"><span class="chip__dot"></span>${escapeHtml(item.due)}</span>`
      : `<span class="chip chip--due">${escapeHtml(item.due)}</span>`;

    li.innerHTML = `
      <div class="plant__main">
        <div class="plant__art">${plantSvg(item.id)}</div>
        <div class="plant__info">
          <h3 class="plant__name">${escapeHtml(item.name)}<span class="plant__species">${escapeHtml(item.species)}</span></h3>
          <div class="plant__chips">
            <span class="chip chip--task">${escapeHtml(item.task)}</span>
            ${dueChip}
          </div>
        </div>
        <p class="plant__meta">${escapeHtml(item.location)} &middot; ${escapeHtml(item.light)}</p>
        <div class="plant__actions">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn--water" data-action="water">${DROP}Watered</button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn--ghost" data-action="snooze">${CLOCK}Snooze</button>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn--link plant__toggle" data-action="toggle"
                aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="detail-${item.id}">Details</button>
      </div>
      <div class="plant__detail" id="detail-${item.id}" hidden>
        <div class="detail__grid">
          <div class="detail__block">
            <h4>Care facts</h4>
            <div class="detail__facts">
              <p class="fact"><span class="fact__icon" aria-hidden="true">${SUN}</span>
                <span><span class="fact__value">${escapeHtml(item.light)}</span> light<br>
                <span class="fact__note">in the ${escapeHtml(item.location.toLowerCase())}</span></span></p>
              <p class="fact"><span class="fact__icon" aria-hidden="true">${DROP}</span>
                <span><span class="fact__value">${escapeHtml(lastWaterDate)}</span>
                <span class="fact__note">last soaked</span></span></p>
              <p class="fact"><span class="fact__icon" aria-hidden="true">${CLOCK}</span>
                <span><span class="fact__value">${escapeHtml(item.task)}</span>
                <span class="fact__note">${escapeHtml(item.due)}</span></span></p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="detail__block">
            <h4>Light, water &amp; observations</h4>
            <ul class="timeline">
              ${item.history.map((entry) => {
                const [date, ...rest] = entry.split(' · ');
                const label = rest.join(' · ');
                const care = /water|mist|rotat|wipe|fertil/i.test(label);
                return `<li class="timeline__item">
                  <span class="timeline__date">${escapeHtml(date)}</span>
                  <span class="timeline__kind ${care ? 'timeline__kind--care' : 'timeline__kind--note'}">${escapeHtml(label)}</span>
                </li>`;
              }).join('')}
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    return li;
  }

  function renderQueue() {
    const queue = queueItems();
    const topOverdue = queue.find(isOverdue);

    el.hint.textContent = topOverdue
      ? `Start with ${topOverdue.name} — ${topOverdue.due}. The rest can wait for evening.`
      : queue.length
        ? 'Easy day: a light pass is plenty.'
        : '';

    el.list.replaceChildren(...queue.map(cardEl));

    const snoozed = snoozedItems();
    el.done.hidden = queue.length > 0;
    if (queue.length === 0) {
      if (snoozed.length) {
        el.doneTitle.textContent = 'That\u2019s the queue for now';
        el.doneMsg.textContent = `${snoozed.map((i) => i.name).join(' and ')} ${snoozed.length > 1 ? 'are' : 'is'} snoozing until evening — everything else is tended.`;
      } else {
        el.doneTitle.textContent = 'Every plant is tended';
        el.doneMsg.textContent = `You gave all ${state.items.length} plants exactly what they needed. The fern is already uncurling.`;
      }
    }
  }

  function renderSnoozed() {
    const snoozed = snoozedItems();
    el.snoozeCorner.hidden = snoozed.length === 0;
    el.snoozeList.replaceChildren(...snoozed.map((item) => {
      const li = document.createElement('li');
      li.className = 'snooze-item';
      li.dataset.id = item.id;
      li.innerHTML = `
        <span class="snooze-item__art">${plantSvg(item.id)}</span>
        <span>
          <span class="snooze-item__name">${escapeHtml(item.name)}</span>
          <span class="snooze-item__until">snoozed until evening</span>
        </span>
        <span class="snooze-item__actions">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn--water" data-action="water">${DROP}Watered</button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn--ghost" data-action="wake">Wake up</button>
        </span>`;
      return li;
    }));
  }

  function renderRhythm() {
    const week = DATA.week;
    const total = week.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    const baseY = 104, x0 = 30, step = 42;
    const dayNames = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'];
    const parts = [];

    parts.push(`<path d="M14 ${baseY} H 300" stroke="#e0d2b6" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="2 7" stroke-linecap="round"/>`);

    week.forEach((count, i) => {
      const x = x0 + i * step;
      const tipY = baseY - (18 + count * 12);
      const isToday = i === todayIndex;
      const stem = isToday ? '#3d6b4f' : '#8aa886';

      parts.push(`<path d="M ${x} ${baseY} C ${x + 2} ${(baseY + tipY) / 2 + 12} ${x - 3} ${tipY + 14} ${x} ${tipY}"
        stroke="${stem}" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>`);

      for (let l = 0; l < count; l++) {
        const t = (l + 1) / (count + 0.35);
        const y = tipY + (baseY - tipY) * t;
        const side = l % 2 === 0 ? -1 : 1;
        const fill = (l + i) % 2 ? '#3d6b4f' : '#7fa886';
        parts.push(`<ellipse cx="${x + side * 11}" cy="${y - 3}" rx="9.5" ry="5.6"
          transform="rotate(${side * 24} ${x + side * 11} ${y - 3})" fill="${fill}"/>`);
      }

      if (isToday) {
        parts.push(`<circle cx="${x}" cy="${tipY - 16}" r="11" fill="#f0c265"/>`);
        parts.push(`<text x="${x}" y="${tipY - 12.5}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#33291f">${count}</text>`);
        parts.push(`<rect x="${x - 17}" y="${baseY + 8}" width="34" height="18" rx="9" fill="#33291f"/>
          <text x="${x}" y="${baseY + 21}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-weight="800" fill="#f6efe3">today</text>`);
      } else {
        parts.push(`<text x="${x}" y="${tipY - 12}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#97876f">${count}</text>`);
        parts.push(`<text x="${x}" y="${baseY + 21}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" font-weight="700" fill="#6f604c">${dayNames[i]}</text>`);
      }
    });

    const label = `Care rhythm for this week: ${week
      .map((c, i) => `${dayNames[i]} ${c} ${c === 1 ? 'visit' : 'visits'}${i === todayIndex ? ' (today)' : ''}`)
      .join(', ')}.`;

    el.rhythmFigure.innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 314 132" role="img" aria-label="${escapeHtml(label)}">${parts.join('')}</svg>`;

    el.rhythmCaption.innerHTML = `<strong>${total} little visits</strong> across seven days — ${total <= 14 ? 'steady beats heroic' : 'a full week of care'}.`;
  }

  function renderNotes() {
    const queue = queueItems();
    const featured = [...queue].sort(byUrgency);
    const calmest = [...queue].sort((a, b) => a.urgency - b.urgency)[0];
    const picks = queue.length
      ? [featured[0], calmest].filter((p, i, arr) => arr.indexOf(p) === i)
      : state.items.slice(0, 2);

    el.notesBody.innerHTML = `<ul class="notes__list">${picks.map((item) => `
      <li class="note-item">
        <span class="note-item__avatar">${plantSvg(item.id)}</span>
        <span><span class="note-item__who">${escapeHtml(item.name)}</span>
        <p>${escapeHtml(NOTES[item.id])}</p></span>
      </li>`).join('')}</ul>`;
  }

  function renderAll() {
    renderHeader();
    renderQueue();
    renderSnoozed();
    renderRhythm();
    renderNotes();
  }

  /* --- Toast + undo ------------------------------------------------------ */

  let toastTimer = null;
  let undoHandler = null;

  function showToast(message, onUndo) {
    el.toastMsg.textContent = message;
    undoHandler = onUndo || null;
    el.toastUndo.hidden = !onUndo;
    el.toast.hidden = false;
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(hideToast, 7000);

    // small delight: a droplet falls past the toast icon
    el.toast.classList.remove('toast--pour');
    void el.toast.offsetWidth; // restart the animation
    el.toast.classList.add('toast--pour');
  }

  function hideToast() {
    el.toast.hidden = true;
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    undoHandler = null;
  }

  el.toastUndo.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (undoHandler) undoHandler();
    hideToast();
    el.queueHeading.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && !el.toast.hidden) hideToast();
  });

  /* --- Actions ----------------------------------------------------------- */

  function snapshot() {
    state.past.push(state.items.map((i) => ({ ...i, history: [...i.history] })));
    if (state.past.length > 25) state.past.shift();
  }

  function restore() {
    const prev = state.past.pop();
    if (!prev) return;
    state.items = prev;
    renderAll();
    showToast('Brought it back — nothing happened.');
  }

  const findItem = (id) => state.items.find((i) => i.id === id);

  function water(id) {
    const item = findItem(id);
    if (!item) return;
    snapshot();
    item.history = [`${fmtShort} · Watered`, ...item.history];
    item.status = 'done';
    renderAll();
    showToast(`${item.name} is watered. ${REACTIONS[id] || ''}`.trim(), restore);

    // When the focused button disappears with the card, land focus on the
    // next sensible control so keyboard users keep their place.
    const next = queueItems()[0];
    if (next) focusCard(next.id, 'water');
    else if (snoozedItems().length) focusSnoozed(snoozedItems()[0].id, 'wake');
    else el.done.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }

  function snooze(id) {
    const item = findItem(id);
    if (!item) return;
    snapshot();
    item.status = 'snoozed';
    renderAll();
    showToast(`${item.name} snoozed until evening. No guilt accrued.`, restore);
    focusSnoozed(id, 'wake');
  }

  function wake(id) {
    const item = findItem(id);
    if (!item) return;
    snapshot();
    item.status = 'todo';
    renderAll();
    showToast(`${item.name} is back in the queue.`, restore);
    focusCard(id, 'water');
  }

  function resetDay() {
    snapshot();
    state.items = initialItems();
    renderAll();
    showToast('Morning restored. The queue is yours again.', restore);
  }

  function focusCard(id, action) {
    const card = el.list.querySelector(`.plant[data-id="${id}"]`);
    const btn = card && card.querySelector(`[data-action="${action}"]`);
    if (btn) btn.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }

  function focusSnoozed(id, action) {
    const row = el.snoozeList.querySelector(`.snooze-item[data-id="${id}"]`);
    const btn = row && row.querySelector(`[data-action="${action}"]`);
    if (btn) btn.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }

  function toggleDetail(btn) {
    const panel = document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute('aria-controls'));
    if (!panel) return;
    const open = btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!open));
    panel.hidden = open;
    btn.textContent = open ? 'Details' : 'Hide details';
  }

  /* --- Events ------------------------------------------------------------ */

  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const btn = e.target.closest('button[data-action]');
    if (!btn) return;
    const holder = btn.closest('[data-id]');
    if (!holder) return;
    const id = holder.dataset.id;

    switch (btn.dataset.action) {
      case 'water': water(id); break;
      case 'snooze': snooze(id); break;
      case 'wake': wake(id); break;
      case 'toggle': toggleDetail(btn); break;
    }
  });

  el.reset.addEventListener('click', resetDay);

  // focus targets for focus management
  [el.done, el.queueHeading].forEach((n) => n && n.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1'));

  /* --- Boot -------------------------------------------------------------- */

  renderAll();
})();

<html lang="en">
<head>

  <meta name="description" content="Moss — a gentle household plant-care companion. Today's care queue, plant histories, and a weekly rhythm, all in one page.">
  <title>Moss — a gentle plant companion</title>
  <link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 32 32'%3E%3Crect width='32' height='32' rx='9' fill='%233d6b4f'/%3E%3Cpath d='M23 7C14 7 9 12 9 20c0 2 .5 4 1.4 5.4C12.6 16 17 12.6 23 11.6c-5.2 1.2-9.2 4.8-11 10.4h4.2C19.6 15.6 22 11.4 23 7z' fill='%23f6efe3'/%3E%3C/svg%3E">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
</head>
<body>
  <a class="skip-link" href="#main">Skip to today&rsquo;s queue</a>

  <div class="page">
    <header class="topbar">
      <div class="brand">
        <span class="brand__mark" aria-hidden="true">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" focusable="false">
            <path d="M23 5C13.4 5 8 10.4 8 19c0 2.4.6 4.7 1.8 6.6C12.4 15.8 17.2 11.9 24 10.6c-6 1.3-10.4 5.3-12.4 11.3 8.6-1.6 11.4-6.4 11.4-12.5V5z" fill="currentColor"/>
            <path d="M24 10.6c5.4 1.2 7.6 5 7.4 9.6-.2 3.6-2.4 6-5.4 6.8-2.4-3.6-3-7.8-2-16.4z" fill="currentColor" opacity=".55"/>
          </svg>
        </span>
        <div class="brand__text">
          <h1>Moss</h1>
          <p class="brand__tagline">a gentle plant companion</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="daycard">
        <p class="daycard__date" id="today-date">Today</p>
        <p class="daycard__greeting" id="greeting">Hello</p>
        <div class="progress" id="progress" role="progressbar" aria-labelledby="progress-label" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="4" aria-valuenow="0" aria-valuetext="0 of 4 plants tended">
          <div class="progress__track"><div class="progress__fill" id="progress-fill"></div></div>
          <p class="progress__label" id="progress-label"><strong id="progress-count">0</strong> of 4 tended</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </header>

    <main id="main" class="layout">
      <section class="queue" aria-labelledby="queue-heading">
        <div class="queue__head">
          <h2 id="queue-heading">Today&rsquo;s queue</h2>
          <p class="queue__hint" id="queue-hint">Overdue friends come first.</p>
        </div>

        <ul class="plants" id="plant-list"></ul>

        <div class="done" id="done-state" hidden>
          <div class="done__art" aria-hidden="true">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 160 120" focusable="false">
              <path class="done__hand" d="M40 96c0-16 8-28 22-32 6-2 12-2 18 0 14 4 22 16 22 32 0 8-6 12-14 12H54c-8 0-14-4-14-12z" fill="#e8d9bf"/>
              <path d="M80 96V52" stroke="#3d6b4f" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
              <path d="M80 62C68 60 60 52 58 40c12 0 20 8 22 22z" fill="#3d6b4f"/>
              <path d="M80 54c12-2 20-10 22-22-12 0-20 8-22 22z" fill="#5e8a68"/>
              <circle cx="80" cy="42" r="7" fill="#f0c265"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <h3 id="done-title">Every plant is tended</h3>
          <p id="done-msg">You gave four plants exactly what they needed. The fern is already uncurling.</p>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn--ghost" id="reset-day">Wind back to this morning</button>
        </div>

        <section class="snooze-corner" id="snooze-corner" aria-labelledby="snooze-heading" hidden>
          <h3 id="snooze-heading"><span class="snooze-corner__icon" aria-hidden="true">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" focusable="false"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M12 7v5l3.5 2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
          </span>The snooze corner</h3>
          <p class="snooze-corner__hint">Snoozed until evening. No guilt accrued.</p>
          <ul class="snooze-list" id="snooze-list"></ul>
        </section>
      </section>

      <aside class="rail" aria-label="Garden overview">
        <section class="card rhythm" aria-labelledby="rhythm-heading">
          <div class="card__head">
            <h2 id="rhythm-heading">This week&rsquo;s rhythm</h2>
            <p class="card__sub">One leaf per care visit.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="rhythm__figure" id="rhythm-figure"></div>
          <p class="rhythm__caption" id="rhythm-caption"></p>
        </section>

        <section class="card notes" aria-labelledby="notes-heading">
          <div class="card__head">
            <h2 id="notes-heading">Greenhouse notes</h2>
            <p class="card__sub">Whispered, never pushy.</p>
          </div>
          <div id="notes-body"></div>
        </section>
      </aside>
    </main>

    <footer class="footer">
      <p>Moss keeps everything in this one page &mdash; no accounts, no cloud, no notifications. Just you and four plants.</p>
      <p class="footer__meta">Plant data mirrors <code>PLANTS.json</code>.</p>
    </footer>
  </div>

  <output class="toast" id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true" hidden>
    <span class="toast__icon" id="toast-icon" aria-hidden="true">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" focusable="false"><path d="M12 3c3.5 4.2 6 7.4 6 10.2A6 6 0 0 1 6 13.2C6 10.4 8.5 7.2 12 3z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>
    </span>
    <span class="toast__msg" id="toast-msg"></span>
    <button type="button" class="toast__undo" id="toast-undo">Undo</button>
  </output>

  <script src="app.js" defer></script>
</body>
</html>

step-5-preview/13-frontend-playful/styles.css

/* ==========================================================================
   Moss — a gentle plant companion
   Warm paper, ink lines, terracotta and moss. Tactile, sticker-like surfaces;
   no glass, no neon, no clip art.
   ========================================================================== */

/* --- Tokens ------------------------------------------------------------- */

:root {
  --paper: #f6efe3;
  --paper-deep: #efe5d3;
  --card: #fffcf5;
  --sand: #eadcc2;
  --line: #e0d2b6;

  --ink: #33291f;
  --ink-soft: #6f604c;
  --ink-faint: #97876f;

  --moss: #3d6b4f;
  --moss-deep: #2b4d38;
  --sage: #9dbb9a;
  --sage-light: #dfe9d8;

  --terra: #b4552f;
  --terra-light: #f3ddd0;
  --butter: #f0c265;
  --butter-light: #fbeed2;
  --sky: #7d9cb0;
  --sky-light: #dde8ee;

  --radius-card: 26px;
  --radius-blob: 34px 44px 38px 46px / 40px 34px 44px 42px;

  --shadow-soft: 0 12px 28px -18px rgb(51 41 31 / 45%);
  --shadow-lift: 0 18px 34px -20px rgb(51 41 31 / 50%);

  --font-body: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  --font-display: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;

  --ease-spring: cubic-bezier(.34, 1.56, .64, 1);
}

/* --- Reset -------------------------------------------------------------- */

*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

html { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }

body {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: var(--ink);
  background-color: var(--paper);
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(rgb(51 41 31 / 4%) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 22px 22px;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

h1, h2, h3, p, ul, ol, figure { margin: 0; }
ul, ol { padding: 0; list-style: none; }
img, svg { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
button { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
code { font-size: .9em; }

:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--moss-deep);
  outline-offset: 3px;
  border-radius: 6px;
}

.toast :focus-visible, .btn--water:focus-visible {
  outline-color: var(--card);
}

.skip-link {
  position: absolute;
  left: 12px;
  top: -64px;
  z-index: 20;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--card);
  border-radius: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: top .18s ease;
}
.skip-link:focus-visible { top: 12px; }

/* --- Page frame --------------------------------------------------------- */

.page {
  width: min(1120px, 100%);
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding: clamp(16px, 3vw, 36px) clamp(14px, 3vw, 32px) 40px;
}

/* --- Topbar ------------------------------------------------------------- */

.topbar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 18px;
  padding: clamp(16px, 2.6vw, 24px) clamp(18px, 3vw, 30px);
  background:
    radial-gradient(120% 160% at 100% 0%, var(--butter-light) 0%, transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(90% 140% at 0% 100%, var(--sage-light) 0%, transparent 60%),
    var(--card);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-blob);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* washi-tape sticker on the header */
.topbar::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -12px;
  right: 8%;
  width: 84px;
  height: 26px;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, var(--sage) 0 8px, #b7cdb4 8px 16px);
  opacity: .5;
  transform: rotate(6deg);
  border-radius: 3px;
}

.brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.brand__mark {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 54px;
  height: 54px;
  flex: none;
  color: var(--card);
  background: var(--moss);
  border-radius: 46% 54% 52% 48% / 50% 46% 54% 50%;
  box-shadow: inset 0 -4px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 12%), 4px 5px 0 var(--sage);
}
.brand__mark svg { width: 34px; height: 34px; }

.brand h1 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 5vw, 2.4rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -.01em;
  line-height: 1;
}

.brand__tagline {
  font-size: .86rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-style: italic;
}

.daycard {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;
  min-width: min(280px, 100%);
  padding: 12px 18px;
  background: var(--paper);
  border: 1.5px dashed var(--line);
  border-radius: 20px;
}

.daycard__date {
  font-size: .78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

.daycard__greeting {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.progress {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.progress__track {
  flex: 1;
  height: 12px;
  background: var(--sand);
  border-radius: 999px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.progress__fill {
  height: 100%;
  width: 0%;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, var(--moss) 0 10px, var(--sage) 10px 20px);
  border-radius: 999px;
  transition: width .5s var(--ease-spring);
}

.progress__label {
  font-size: .85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* --- Layout ------------------------------------------------------------- */

.layout {
  display: grid;
  gap: clamp(20px, 3vw, 32px);
  margin-top: clamp(20px, 3vw, 32px);
  align-items: start;
}

@media (min-width: 940px) {
  .layout {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.5fr) minmax(300px, 1fr);
  }
}

/* --- Queue head --------------------------------------------------------- */

.queue__head { margin-bottom: 16px; }

.queue__head h2,
.card__head h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(1.35rem, 3.4vw, 1.6rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  display: inline-block;
  background: linear-gradient(transparent 62%, var(--butter) 62%, var(--butter) 92%, transparent 92%);
  padding-inline: 2px;
}

.queue__hint,
.card__sub {
  font-size: .9rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  margin-top: 2px;
}

/* --- Plant cards -------------------------------------------------------- */

.plants {
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
}

.plant {
  position: relative;
  background: var(--card);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-card);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
  padding: 16px;
  animation: card-in .45s var(--ease-spring) both;
}

.plant:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .06s; }
.plant:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .12s; }
.plant:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: .18s; }

@keyframes card-in {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px) rotate(-.4deg); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
}

/* little corner sticker, tinted per plant */
.plant::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -9px;
  right: 22px;
  width: 46px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: var(--plant-tint, var(--sage));
  opacity: .8;
  transform: rotate(4deg);
}

.plant--overdue {
  border-color: var(--terra);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lift), inset 0 0 0 3px var(--terra-light);
}

.plant__main {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
  grid-template-areas:
    "art info toggle"
    "art meta meta"
    "actions actions actions";
  gap: 6px 14px;
  align-items: start;
}

.plant__art {
  grid-area: art;
  position: relative;
  width: 84px;
  height: 84px;
  flex: none;
  display: grid;
  place-items: end center;
}

.plant__art::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: var(--plant-tint-bg, var(--sage-light));
  border-radius: 52% 48% 56% 44% / 48% 56% 44% 52%;
}

.plant__art svg {
  position: relative;
  width: 74px;
  height: 74px;
}

.plant__info { grid-area: info; min-width: 0; }

.plant__name {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.15;
}

.plant__species {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: .82rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
  margin-left: 6px;
}

.plant__meta {
  grid-area: meta;
  font-size: .85rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.plant__chips {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 3px 11px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: .76rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .03em;
  border: 1.5px solid transparent;
}

.chip--task {
  background: var(--moss);
  color: var(--card);
}

.chip--due {
  background: var(--butter-light);
  color: #7a5a13;
  border-color: #e6cd93;
}

.chip--overdue {
  background: var(--terra);
  border-color: var(--terra);
  color: #fff;
  animation: nudge 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.chip--overdue .chip__dot {
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #fff;
}

@keyframes nudge {
  0%, 88%, 100% { transform: rotate(0); }
  92% { transform: rotate(-2.5deg); }
  96% { transform: rotate(2.5deg); }
}

/* --- Action buttons ----------------------------------------------------- */

.plant__actions {
  grid-area: actions;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 10px;
}

.plant__toggle { grid-area: toggle; }

.btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 7px;
  padding: 9px 16px;
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: .9rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform .12s ease, box-shadow .12s ease, background-color .15s ease;
  user-select: none;
}

.btn svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; flex: none; }

.btn--water {
  background: var(--moss);
  border-color: var(--moss);
  color: var(--card);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--moss-deep);
  flex: 1 1 auto;
}
.btn--water:hover { background: var(--moss-deep); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 5px 0 var(--moss-deep); }
.btn--water:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--moss-deep); }

.btn--ghost {
  background: transparent;
  border-color: #c9b795;
  color: var(--ink);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 0 rgb(51 41 31 / 10%);
}
.btn--ghost:hover { background: var(--paper-deep); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 5px 0 rgb(51 41 31 / 12%); }
.btn--ghost:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(51 41 31 / 10%); }

.btn--link {
  background: transparent;
  border-color: transparent;
  color: var(--moss-deep);
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-style: dotted;
  text-underline-offset: 4px;
  padding: 9px 8px;
}
.btn--link:hover { color: var(--terra); }

/* --- Detail panel ------------------------------------------------------- */

.plant__detail[hidden] { display: none; }

.plant__detail {
  margin-top: 14px;
  padding: 16px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(80% 120% at 100% 0%, var(--butter-light), transparent 60%),
    var(--paper);
  border: 1.5px dashed var(--line);
  border-radius: 20px;
  animation: panel-in .3s ease both;
}

@keyframes panel-in {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
}

.detail__grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
}

@media (min-width: 560px) {
  .detail__grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr; }
}

.detail__block h4 {
  font-size: .74rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.detail__facts {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
}

.fact {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: .92rem;
}

.fact__icon {
  flex: none;
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--sand);
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}
.fact__icon svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; }

.fact__value { font-weight: 600; }
.fact__note { color: var(--ink-faint); font-size: .84rem; }

.timeline {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
}

.timeline__item {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: baseline;
  padding: 7px 2px;
  border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--line);
  font-size: .92rem;
}
.timeline__item:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }

.timeline__date {
  flex: none;
  width: 62px;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: .8rem;
  color: var(--moss-deep);
}

.timeline__kind {
  color: var(--ink);
}
.timeline__kind--care { font-weight: 700; }
.timeline__kind--note { color: var(--ink-soft); font-style: italic; }

/* --- Snooze corner ------------------------------------------------------ */

.snooze-corner {
  margin-top: 18px;
  padding: 16px;
  border: 2px dashed #c9b795;
  border-radius: var(--radius-card);
  background: rgb(255 252 245 / 60%);
}

.snooze-corner[hidden] { display: none; }

.snooze-corner h3 {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.snooze-corner__icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--sky-light);
  color: var(--sky);
}
.snooze-corner__icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

.snooze-corner__hint {
  font-size: .86rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  margin: 2px 0 12px 36px;
}

.snooze-list { display: grid; gap: 10px; }

.snooze-item {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px 12px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  background: var(--card);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 16px;
}

.snooze-item__art {
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  flex: none;
}
.snooze-item__art svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }

.snooze-item__name {
  font-weight: 700;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.snooze-item__until {
  font-size: .82rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.snooze-item__actions {
  margin-left: auto;
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
}

/* --- All-done state ----------------------------------------------------- */

.done {
  position: relative;
  text-align: center;
  padding: clamp(28px, 6vw, 48px) clamp(18px, 4vw, 40px);
  background:
    radial-gradient(70% 90% at 50% 0%, var(--butter-light), transparent 65%),
    radial-gradient(60% 80% at 100% 100%, var(--sage-light), transparent 60%),
    var(--card);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 40px 48px 42px 50px / 46px 40px 50px 44px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
  animation: card-in .5s var(--ease-spring) both;
}

.done[hidden] { display: none; }

.done__art {
  width: min(220px, 62%);
  margin: 0 auto 10px;
}
.done__art svg { width: 100%; height: auto; }

.done h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 4.6vw, 2rem);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.done p {
  max-width: 38ch;
  margin: 8px auto 20px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

/* --- Rail cards --------------------------------------------------------- */

.rail {
  display: grid;
  gap: clamp(16px, 2.4vw, 24px);
}

.card {
  background: var(--card);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-card);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
  padding: 18px;
}

.rhythm__figure {
  margin: 12px -4px 4px;
}

.rhythm__figure svg { width: 100%; height: auto; }

.rhythm__caption {
  font-size: .88rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.rhythm__caption strong { color: var(--ink); }

.notes__list {
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.note-item {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  background: var(--paper);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 16px;
  font-size: .9rem;
}

.note-item__avatar {
  flex: none;
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
}
.note-item__avatar svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }

.note-item__who {
  display: block;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: .78rem;
  letter-spacing: .08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--moss-deep);
}

.note-item p { color: var(--ink-soft); }

/* --- Footer ------------------------------------------------------------- */

.footer {
  margin-top: clamp(28px, 5vw, 48px);
  padding-top: 18px;
  border-top: 1.5px dashed var(--line);
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 6px 20px;
  font-size: .84rem;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

/* --- Toast -------------------------------------------------------------- */

.toast {
  position: fixed;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: 18px;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 30;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  width: min(430px, calc(100vw - 28px));
  padding: 11px 12px 11px 16px;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--card);
  border-radius: 18px;
  box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -14px rgb(51 41 31 / 60%);
  animation: toast-in .35s var(--ease-spring);
}

.toast[hidden] { display: none; }

@keyframes toast-in {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, 14px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, 0); }
}

.toast__icon {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 30px;
  height: 30px;
  flex: none;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--moss);
  color: #cfe4d2;
}
.toast__icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

/* delight: a droplet falls past the icon when a plant is watered */
.toast--pour .toast__icon::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 26px;
  left: 50%;
  width: 6px;
  height: 8px;
  margin-left: -3px;
  border-radius: 50% 50% 60% 60% / 40% 40% 70% 70%;
  background: var(--butter);
  animation: pour .7s ease-in both;
}

@keyframes pour {
  0%   { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px) scale(.6); }
  25%  { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
  100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px) scale(.8); }
}

.toast__msg { flex: 1; font-size: .92rem; }

.toast__undo {
  flex: none;
  padding: 7px 14px;
  border: 2px solid var(--butter);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--butter);
  font-size: .85rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color .15s ease, color .15s ease;
}
.toast__undo:hover { background: var(--butter); color: var(--ink); }

@media (min-width: 940px) {
  .toast {
    left: auto;
    right: 24px;
    bottom: 24px;
    transform: none;
    animation-name: toast-in-desktop;
  }
  @keyframes toast-in-desktop {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); }
    to   { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
  }
}

/* --- Desktop plant card refinement -------------------------------------- */

@media (min-width: 700px) {
  .plant { padding: 20px 22px; }

  .plant__main {
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
    grid-template-areas:
      "art info actions"
      "art meta toggle";
    align-items: center;
  }

  .plant__art { width: 104px; height: 104px; align-self: center; }
  .plant__art svg { width: 92px; height: 92px; }

  .plant__actions {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    margin-top: 0;
    min-width: 132px;
  }

  .plant__toggle { justify-self: end; }
}

/* --- Reduced motion ----------------------------------------------------- */

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after {
    animation-duration: .01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: .01ms !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }
  .chip--overdue { animation: none; }
}

Evaluation 8 / 10 graded blind as submission A

A warm two-column layout with a 'Start here' hero card, a sticky detail panel and a solid rhythm chart. Everything works, but an empty Undo toast shows on first load, which is a visible bug.

Strengths

  • Watered, snooze and undo all work, and focus moves to the Undo button
  • Skip link, descriptive labels ('Mark Frida as watered') and aria-expanded on Details
  • All-done message names the next task (Drama tomorrow)

Weaknesses

  • An empty dark toast with Undo/x is visible on page load because CSS display:flex overrides the hidden attribute
  • 19 text nodes under 12px on mobile
  • Queue cards are fairly uniform after the first one
Evidence the grader checked
  • harness.js (Playwright, 1440 and 390 px): initialUndoVisible=['Undo'] at both widths; own screenshot A-desktop-0 shows the empty toast
  • Water then undo: overdue count 2->1->2; snooze undo restored
  • styles.css:155 .toast{display:flex} with no [hidden] rule
  • doneClicks 4/4 lead to 'All caught up — nicely done'

Objective checks

  • Browser: horizontal scroll at 390 px no; console errors 0; network requests 0

muse-wonder/13-frontend-playful/RESPONSE.md

Moss — design response

Personality

Moss is warm, tactile, and optimistic, with a little oddness kept on a short leash. The page feels like a potting bench rather than a dashboard: a dotted warm-sand ground, deep moss green ink, terracotta for anything that needs a drink, and a muted sun yellow reserved for small rewards. Each plant gets its own tint and its own corner treatment — cards alternate which corner is squared off, due badges sit at a slight tilt like stickers, and plant portraits live in blobby, hand-pressed shapes instead of identical circles. Serif display type (local Georgia/Palatino stack, no downloaded fonts) gives names like Frida, Orbit, Dot, and Drama a storybook weight, while plain sans body text keeps instructions easy to read. Delight is small and earned: a brief burst of leaves when a plant is watered, a striped progress bar that fills as the queue clears, and an all-done sun illustration. There are no neon gradients, glass panels, or walls of identical cards — urgency, not uniformity, drives the hierarchy, so overdue Frida is visibly larger and terracotta-bordered while tomorrow's Drama stays quiet.

Interaction model

Today's care queue is sorted by urgency, so the one overdue task (Frida the fern, "Water — 2 days overdue") is always first and explicitly labelled "Start here." Every plant card offers the same two obvious actions: a primary Watered/Done button (worded "Watered" for water and mist tasks, "Done" for rotate/check tasks) and a Snooze button that rests the plant until tomorrow. Both actions remove the plant from the active queue, update the "cared for today" progress, and raise a notification with an Undo button that stays available for six seconds; snoozed plants also collect in a "Snoozed until tomorrow" list with their own "Bring back" control, so nothing ever silently disappears. Selecting Details on any card (or acting inside the panel) loads that plant into the detail panel, which shows light needs, water guidance, next task, current status, and a dated observation history, and offers the same water/snooze actions there. A compact weekly rhythm chart shows care visits per day (Mon 1, Tue 3, Wed 2, Thu 4, Fri 2, Sat 1, Sun 3) with today highlighted. When the queue empties, a useful all-done state replaces it: it confirms the day is clear, names the next upcoming care (Drama's mist tomorrow) or lists who is snoozed, and offers "Review snoozed plants" and "Bring everyone back" to reset. On desktop (900px and up) the layout becomes a true two-column composition — queue and greeting on the left, a sticky detail/week/notes sidebar on the right — rather than a stretched mobile column; on mobile everything stacks and the detail panel scrolls into view when selected.

Accessibility choices

All controls are native <button> elements with descriptive aria-labels where the visible label alone would be ambiguous, so the full flow — water, snooze, undo, details, bring back, reset — works by keyboard alone, including Escape to dismiss the notification. Focus is always visible via a thick terracotta :focus-visible outline, and the notification moves focus to Undo so the undo path is reachable without hunting. Landmarks, a skip link to the queue, ordered headings, and a real list for the queue give screen-reader users the same priority order sighted users see. The toast region uses aria-live="polite", the progress bar exposes role="progressbar" with value text, and the week chart is a role="img" graphic with a text equivalent list, so no information lives only in colour or bar height — overdue state is also written out as a text badge. Touch targets are at least 44px, body text keeps strong contrast against the warm ground, and a prefers-reduced-motion media query (plus a matching JavaScript check) disables the leaf burst, smooth scrolling, and transitions for people who ask for calm.

muse-wonder/13-frontend-playful/TASK.md

Task 13 — Frontend design: playful mobile-first product

Build a polished mobile-first web app screen for Moss, a gentle household plant-care companion. Use only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: no frameworks, package installs, remote assets, external fonts, or network requests.

Visual direction: warm, tactile, optimistic, and a little odd. Use an expressive shape language and small moments of delight while keeping text readable and controls obvious. Avoid childish clip art, neon gradients, glass panels, and a wall of indistinguishable cards.

The experience must include:

  • Today's care queue for the four plants in PLANTS.json, clearly prioritizing overdue care.
  • A plant detail view or expandable panel with light, water, and observation history.
  • Working “watered” and “snooze” actions that update the interface and offer a brief undo path.
  • A compact weekly rhythm visualization.
  • A useful all-done state.
  • Desktop composition that makes good use of space without merely stretching the mobile column.
  • Keyboard operation, visible focus, semantic controls, and reduced-motion support.

Create index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Use CSS or inline SVG for any illustration. Add RESPONSE.md explaining the personality, interaction model, and accessibility choices. Work only in this directory.

muse-wonder/13-frontend-playful/app.js

/* Moss — gentle plant-care companion. Data mirrors PLANTS.json (embedded so the page works from file:// with no network). */
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var PLANTS = [
    { id: "fern", name: "Frida", species: "Boston fern", location: "Bathroom", task: "Water", due: "2 days overdue", urgency: 4, light: "Low, indirect", water: "Keep soil evenly moist; mist fronds 2–3 times a week.", history: ["Sep 19 · Misted", "Sep 16 · Watered", "Sep 12 · New frond"] },
    { id: "pothos", name: "Orbit", species: "Golden pothos", location: "Bookshelf", task: "Rotate", due: "Today", urgency: 2, light: "Medium, indirect", water: "Water when the top 2 cm of soil feel dry.", history: ["Sep 20 · Watered", "Sep 14 · Rotated", "Sep 10 · Wiped leaves"] },
    { id: "cactus", name: "Dot", species: "Bunny ears cactus", location: "South window", task: "Check soil", due: "Today", urgency: 1, light: "Bright, direct", water: "Water sparingly, only when the soil is bone dry.", history: ["Sep 08 · Watered", "Sep 01 · New pad noted", "Aug 22 · Rotated"] },
    { id: "calathea", name: "Drama", species: "Calathea orbifolia", location: "Bedroom", task: "Mist", due: "Tomorrow", urgency: 0, light: "Medium, filtered", water: "Keep lightly moist; mist often and avoid tap-water spots.", history: ["Sep 21 · Misted", "Sep 18 · Watered", "Sep 15 · Brown edge noted"] }
  ];
  var WEEK = [1, 3, 2, 4, 2, 1, 3];
  var WEEK_LABELS = ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"];
  var TODAY_INDEX = 1; // Tuesday

  var ART = {
    fern: '<svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" width="44" height="44" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><g fill="none" stroke="#33512e" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M32 54V34"/><path d="M32 40C24 38 18 32 16 24M32 36c-6-4-8-10-8-16M32 40c8-2 14-8 16-16M32 36c6-4 8-10 8-16M32 32V16"/></g><path d="M22 54h20" stroke="#b94f21" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>',
    pothos: '<svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" width="44" height="44" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M14 8c14 4 8 14 20 18s10 12 16 14" fill="none" stroke="#33512e" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M20 10c4-4 10-2 11 2-3 3-9 2-11-2ZM30 24c5-2 10 1 10 5-4 2-9-1-10-5ZM42 38c5 0 8 4 7 8-4 1-8-3-7-8Z" fill="#5c7a3e"/></svg>',
    cactus: '<svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" width="44" height="44" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><ellipse cx="26" cy="26" rx="9" ry="13" fill="#5c7a3e"/><ellipse cx="42" cy="20" rx="7" ry="10" fill="#7da05c" transform="rotate(18 42 20)"/><path d="M16 52h32l-4 8H20Z" fill="#b94f21"/><circle cx="23" cy="22" r="1.4" fill="#fffdf4"/><circle cx="29" cy="30" r="1.4" fill="#fffdf4"/><circle cx="42" cy="17" r="1.4" fill="#fffdf4"/></svg>',
    calathea: '<svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" width="44" height="44" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><g fill="#5c7a3e"><ellipse cx="22" cy="26" rx="9" ry="14" transform="rotate(-18 22 26)"/><ellipse cx="42" cy="26" rx="9" ry="14" transform="rotate(18 42 26)"/></g><ellipse cx="32" cy="20" rx="8" ry="13" fill="#7da05c"/><path d="M32 54V36" stroke="#33512e" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M20 56h24" stroke="#b94f21" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>'
  };

  var state = {};
  PLANTS.forEach(function (p) { state[p.id] = "pending"; }); // pending | done | snoozed
  var selectedId = "fern";
  var undoStack = [];
  var toastTimer = null;

  var queueList = document.getElementById("queue-list");
  var snoozedWrap = document.getElementById("snoozed-wrap");
  var snoozedList = document.getElementById("snoozed-list");
  var allDone = document.getElementById("all-done");
  var allDoneCopy = document.getElementById("all-done-copy");
  var reviewSnoozedBtn = document.getElementById("review-snoozed-btn");
  var detailContent = document.getElementById("detail-content");
  var progressLabel = document.getElementById("progress-label");
  var progressFill = document.getElementById("progress-fill");
  var progressBar = document.getElementById("progress-bar");
  var toast = document.getElementById("toast");
  var toastMsg = document.getElementById("toast-msg");

  function byId(id) { return PLANTS.filter(function (p) { return p.id === id; })[0]; }
  function pendingPlants() {
    return PLANTS.filter(function (p) { return state[p.id] === "pending"; })
      .sort(function (a, b) { return b.urgency - a.urgency; });
  }
  function isWaterTask(p) { return /water|mist/i.test(p.task); }
  function primaryLabel(p) { return isWaterTask(p) ? "Watered" : "Done"; }

  function leafBurst(card) {
    if (window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches || !card) return;
    var burst = document.createElement("span");
    burst.className = "leaf-burst"; burst.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    burst.style.right = "70px"; burst.style.top = "18px";
    for (var i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      var leaf = document.createElement("i");
      var angle = (i / 7) * Math.PI * 2;
      leaf.style.setProperty("--tx", Math.round(Math.cos(angle) * 46) + "px");
      leaf.style.setProperty("--ty", Math.round(Math.sin(angle) * 34 - 8) + "px");
      leaf.style.setProperty("--rot", (i * 47) + "deg");
      burst.appendChild(leaf);
    }
    card.appendChild(burst);
    setTimeout(function () { burst.remove(); }, 750);
  }

  function showToast(message) {
    toastMsg.textContent = message;
    toast.hidden = false;
    if (toastTimer) clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(hideToast, 6000);
  }
  function hideToast() { toast.hidden = true; if (toastTimer) clearTimeout(toastTimer); }

  function act(id, action, cardEl) {
    var plant = byId(id);
    undoStack.push({ id: id, prev: state[id], action: action });
    state[id] = action === "watered" ? "done" : "snoozed";
    if (action === "watered") leafBurst(cardEl);
    render();
    showToast(action === "watered"
      ? plant.name + " marked as " + primaryLabel(plant).toLowerCase() + ". Nice one."
      : plant.name + " snoozed until tomorrow.");
    var undoBtn = document.getElementById("toast-undo");
    if (undoBtn) undoBtn.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }

  function undo() {
    var last = undoStack.pop();
    if (!last) { hideToast(); return; }
    state[last.id] = last.prev;
    selectedId = last.id;
    render();
    toastMsg.textContent = "Undone — " + byId(last.id).name + " is back in today's queue.";
    if (toastTimer) clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(hideToast, 4000);
    var card = queueList.querySelector('[data-plant="' + last.id + '"] .btn-detail');
    if (card) card.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }

  function renderDetail() {
    var p = byId(selectedId) || PLANTS[0];
    var statusNote = state[p.id] === "done" ? "Cared for today — thank you."
      : state[p.id] === "snoozed" ? "Snoozed until tomorrow." : "Waiting in today's queue.";
    detailContent.innerHTML =
      '<h2 id="detail-heading">' + p.name + '</h2>' +
      '<p class="detail-species">' + p.species + ' · ' + p.location + '</p>' +
      '<dl class="detail-facts">' +
      '<div class="fact"><dt>Light</dt><dd>' + p.light + '</dd></div>' +
      '<div class="fact"><dt>Water</dt><dd>' + p.water + '</dd></div>' +
      '<div class="fact"><dt>Next task</dt><dd>' + p.task + ' · ' + p.due + '</dd></div>' +
      '<div class="fact"><dt>Status</dt><dd>' + statusNote + '</dd></div></dl>' +
      '<h3 class="history-heading">Observation history</h3>' +
      '<ul class="history-list">' + p.history.map(function (h) { return "<li>" + h + "</li>"; }).join("") + '</ul>' +
      (state[p.id] === "pending"
        ? '<div class="detail-actions"><button type="button" class="btn btn-water" data-detail-action="watered" data-id="' + p.id + '">' + primaryLabel(p) + '</button>' +
          '<button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" data-detail-action="snoozed" data-id="' + p.id + '">Snooze until tomorrow</button></div>'
        : '<p class="detail-hint">' + statusNote + ' Use Undo in the notification, or “Bring everyone back”, to restore the queue.</p>');
  }

  function renderQueue() {
    var pending = pendingPlants();
    queueList.innerHTML = pending.map(function (p, i) {
      var overdue = /overdue/i.test(p.due);
      var featured = i === 0 && overdue;
      var badgeClass = overdue ? "due-badge is-overdue" : (/tomorrow/i.test(p.due) ? "due-badge is-tomorrow" : "due-badge");
      return '<li><article class="plant-card plant-card--' + p.id + (featured ? " is-featured" : "") + (selectedId === p.id ? " is-selected" : "") + '" data-plant="' + p.id + '">' +
        (featured ? '<p class="detail-eyebrow">Start here</p>' : '') +
        '<div class="card-top"><div class="plant-art" aria-hidden="true">' + ART[p.id] + '</div>' +
        '<div class="card-main"><h3 class="plant-name">' + p.name + '</h3>' +
        '<p class="plant-meta">' + p.species + ' · ' + p.location + '</p>' +
        '<span class="' + badgeClass + '">' + p.due + '</span>' +
        '<p class="task-line"><strong>' + p.task + '</strong> — ' + (overdue ? "this one has been waiting, so it goes first." : /tomorrow/i.test(p.due) ? "not urgent yet; a gentle heads-up." : "due today, in good time.") + '</p></div></div>' +
        '<div class="card-actions">' +
        '<button type="button" class="btn ' + (isWaterTask(p) ? "btn-water" : "btn-primary") + '" data-action="watered" data-id="' + p.id + '" aria-label="Mark ' + p.name + ' as ' + primaryLabel(p).toLowerCase() + '">' + primaryLabel(p) + '</button>' +
        '<button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" data-action="snoozed" data-id="' + p.id + '" aria-label="Snooze ' + p.name + ' until tomorrow">Snooze</button>' +
        '<button type="button" class="btn-detail" data-action="select" data-id="' + p.id + '" aria-expanded="' + (selectedId === p.id) + '" aria-controls="detail-panel">Details <span class="chev" aria-hidden="true">▾</span></button>' +
        '</div></article></li>';
    }).join("");

    var snoozed = PLANTS.filter(function (p) { return state[p.id] === "snoozed"; });
    snoozedWrap.hidden = snoozed.length === 0;
    snoozedList.innerHTML = snoozed.map(function (p) {
      return '<li class="snoozed-item"><span><strong>' + p.name + '</strong> · ' + p.task + ' — resting until tomorrow</span>' +
        '<button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" data-action="wake" data-id="' + p.id + '">Bring back</button></li>';
    }).join("");

    var doneCount = PLANTS.filter(function (p) { return state[p.id] === "done"; }).length;
    var cared = doneCount + snoozed.length;
    progressLabel.textContent = cared + " of " + PLANTS.length + " cared for today" + (snoozed.length ? " (" + snoozed.length + " snoozed)" : "");
    progressFill.style.width = (cared / PLANTS.length * 100) + "%";
    progressBar.setAttribute("aria-valuenow", String(cared));
    progressBar.setAttribute("aria-valuetext", cared + " of " + PLANTS.length + " plants cared for");

    var isAllDone = pending.length === 0;
    allDone.hidden = !isAllDone;
    if (isAllDone) {
      allDoneCopy.textContent = snoozed.length
        ? "Today's queue is clear. " + snoozed.map(function (p) { return p.name; }).join(", ") + " will pop back tomorrow — nothing is forgotten."
        : "Every plant on today's list has been tended. Drama the calathea is next, with a mist due tomorrow.";
      reviewSnoozedBtn.hidden = snoozed.length === 0;
    }
    if (isAllDone && !byId(selectedId)) selectedId = PLANTS[0].id;
  }

  function renderWeek() {
    var max = Math.max.apply(null, WEEK);
    document.getElementById("week-chart").innerHTML = WEEK.map(function (v, i) {
      var h = Math.round(v / max * 100);
      return '<div class="week-day' + (i === TODAY_INDEX ? " is-today" : "") + '">' +
        '<span class="week-count" aria-hidden="true">' + v + '</span>' +
        '<div class="week-bar-wrap" aria-hidden="true"><div class="week-bar" style="height:' + h + '%"></div></div>' +
        '<span class="week-day-label">' + WEEK_LABELS[i] + (i === TODAY_INDEX ? " · today" : "") + '</span></div>';
    }).join("");
  }

  function render() { renderQueue(); renderDetail(); }

  document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var btn = e.target.closest("[data-action],[data-detail-action]");
    if (!btn) return;
    var id = btn.getAttribute("data-id");
    var card = btn.closest(".plant-card");
    if (btn.hasAttribute("data-detail-action")) { act(id, btn.getAttribute("data-detail-action"), null); return; }
    var action = btn.getAttribute("data-action");
    if (action === "watered") act(id, "watered", card);
    else if (action === "snoozed") act(id, "snoozed", card);
    else if (action === "wake") { undoStack.push({ id: id, prev: state[id], action: "wake" }); state[id] = "pending"; selectedId = id; render(); showToast(byId(id).name + " is back in today's queue."); }
    else if (action === "select") {
      selectedId = id; render();
      if (window.innerWidth < 900) document.getElementById("detail-panel").scrollIntoView({ behavior: window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches ? "auto" : "smooth", block: "nearest" });
    }
  });

  document.getElementById("toast-undo").addEventListener("click", undo);
  document.getElementById("toast-close").addEventListener("click", hideToast);
  document.getElementById("reset-btn").addEventListener("click", function () {
    PLANTS.forEach(function (p) { state[p.id] = "pending"; });
    undoStack = []; selectedId = "fern"; render(); hideToast();
    document.getElementById("queue-heading").focus({ preventScroll: false });
  });
  reviewSnoozedBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
    snoozedWrap.scrollIntoView({ behavior: window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches ? "auto" : "smooth" });
    var first = snoozedList.querySelector("button"); if (first) first.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  });
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) { if (e.key === "Escape" && !toast.hidden) hideToast(); });

  renderWeek();
  render();
})();

muse-wonder/13-frontend-playful/index.html

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Moss — today's plant care</title>
<meta name="description" content="Moss is a gentle household plant-care companion. See who needs water first, snooze what can wait, and keep a calm weekly rhythm.">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
</head>
<body>
<a class="skip-link" href="#queue-heading">Skip to today's care queue</a>

<header class="topbar">
  <div class="brand">
    <svg class="brand-mark" viewBox="0 0 48 48" width="40" height="40" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
      <path d="M24 42c0-8 0-14 1-20" fill="none" stroke="#33512e" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <path d="M25 22c-7 1-12-3-13-10 7-1 12 3 13 10Z" fill="#5c7a3e"/>
      <path d="M25 18c1-7 6-11 12-11 0 7-4 12-12 11Z" fill="#7da05c"/>
      <path d="M8 42h32" stroke="#c75b2b" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </svg>
    <div>
      <p class="brand-name">Moss</p>
      <p class="brand-sub">a gentle plant-care companion</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <p class="today-chip"><span aria-hidden="true">●</span> Tuesday · Sep 23</p>
</header>

<div class="layout">
  <main class="main-col">
    <section class="hello" aria-labelledby="hello-heading">
      <h1 id="hello-heading">Good morning.<br>Frida needs you first.</h1>
      <p class="hello-copy">Four plants, one calm pass around the house. Start with whoever is overdue — the rest can wait their turn.</p>
      <div class="progress-wrap">
        <p class="progress-label" id="progress-label" aria-live="polite">0 of 4 cared for today</p>
        <div class="progress-track" role="progressbar" aria-label="Plants cared for today" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="4" aria-valuenow="0" id="progress-bar">
          <div class="progress-fill" id="progress-fill"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section aria-labelledby="queue-heading" class="queue-section">
      <div class="section-head">
        <h2 id="queue-heading" tabindex="-1">Today's care queue</h2>
        <p class="section-note">Most urgent at the top</p>
      </div>

      <ul class="queue" id="queue-list"></ul>

      <div class="all-done" id="all-done" hidden>
        <svg viewBox="0 0 120 90" width="110" height="82" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="all-done-art">
          <circle cx="60" cy="38" r="20" fill="#e9b44c"/>
          <g stroke="#e9b44c" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round">
            <path d="M60 6v8M28 16l6 6M92 16l-6 6M16 38h9M95 38h9"/>
          </g>
          <path d="M60 78c0-10 1-16 2-22" fill="none" stroke="#33512e" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          <path d="M62 56c-9 1-15-4-16-13 9-1 15 4 16 13Z" fill="#5c7a3e"/>
          <path d="M62 50c1-9 7-14 15-14 0 9-5 15-15 14Z" fill="#7da05c"/>
          <path d="M28 82h64" stroke="#c75b2b" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        </svg>
        <h3>All caught up — nicely done</h3>
        <p id="all-done-copy">Every plant on today's list has been tended. Drama the calathea is next, with a mist due tomorrow.</p>
        <div class="all-done-actions">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" id="review-snoozed-btn" hidden>Review snoozed plants</button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" id="reset-btn">Bring everyone back</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="snoozed-wrap" id="snoozed-wrap" hidden>
        <h3 class="snoozed-heading">Snoozed until tomorrow</h3>
        <ul class="snoozed-list" id="snoozed-list"></ul>
      </div>
    </section>
  </main>

  <aside class="side-col">
    <section class="detail-card" aria-labelledby="detail-heading" id="detail-panel">
      <p class="detail-eyebrow" id="detail-eyebrow">Plant detail</p>
      <div id="detail-content"><!-- filled by app.js --></div>
    </section>

    <section class="week-card" aria-labelledby="week-heading">
      <div class="section-head section-head--tight">
        <h2 id="week-heading">This week's rhythm</h2>
        <p class="section-note">Care visits per day</p>
      </div>
      <div class="week-chart" id="week-chart" role="img" aria-label="Bar chart of care visits this week: Monday 1, Tuesday 3, Wednesday 2, Thursday 4, Friday 2, Saturday 1, Sunday 3. Today is Tuesday."></div>
      <ol class="sr-only">
        <li>Monday: 1 care visit</li><li>Tuesday: 3 care visits (today)</li><li>Wednesday: 2 care visits</li>
        <li>Thursday: 4 care visits</li><li>Friday: 2 care visits</li><li>Saturday: 1 care visit</li><li>Sunday: 3 care visits</li>
      </ol>
      <p class="week-note">Thursday is your busiest watering day. Today is comfortably light — three small jobs.</p>
    </section>

    <section class="note-card" aria-labelledby="note-heading">
      <h2 id="note-heading">A Moss note</h2>
      <p>Overdue does not mean in trouble. Frida the fern would like a drink soon, but a few hours will not change anything. Go at kitchen-kettle pace.</p>
    </section>
  </aside>
</div>

<footer class="footer">
  <p>Moss keeps care calm: whoever is overdue goes first, everything else waits its turn.</p>
</footer>

<div class="toast-region" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
  <div class="toast" id="toast" hidden>
    <p class="toast-msg" id="toast-msg"></p>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-undo" id="toast-undo">Undo</button>
    <button type="button" class="toast-close" id="toast-close" aria-label="Dismiss notification">×</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script src="app.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
