muse-wonder/13-frontend-playful/styles.css

/* Moss — warm, tactile, mobile-first. No external fonts or assets. */
:root{
  --paper:#f1e6cd;
  --paper-deep:#e7d7b4;
  --card:#fffdf4;
  --ink:#22331c;
  --ink-soft:#4a5a40;
  --moss:#33512e;
  --moss-deep:#243a20;
  --leaf:#5c7a3e;
  --leaf-soft:#dce5c8;
  --clay:#b94f21;
  --clay-deep:#9a3f18;
  --clay-soft:#f6ddcb;
  --sun:#e9b44c;
  --sun-soft:#f8e8bd;
  --line:#d8c9a3;
  --radius-lg:26px 26px 26px 10px;
  --radius-md:20px 20px 20px 8px;
  --shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(51,81,46,.14), 0 14px 28px -18px rgba(51,81,46,.45);
  --font-body:"Avenir Next","Trebuchet MS","Segoe UI",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
  --font-display:Georgia,"Iowan Old Style","Palatino Linotype",serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{
  margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);
  font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;
  background-image:radial-gradient(rgba(51,81,46,.07) 1.2px, transparent 1.3px);
  background-size:22px 22px;
}
.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}
.skip-link{position:absolute;left:12px;top:-60px;z-index:50;background:var(--moss-deep);color:#fff;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:0 0 12px 12px;font-weight:700;transition:top .2s}
.skip-link:focus{top:0;color:#fff}
:focus{outline:none}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--clay);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:6px}
button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer;min-height:44px}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--font-display);line-height:1.12;color:var(--moss-deep);margin:0}
p{margin:0}

/* Header */
.topbar{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:18px 18px 4px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.brand-mark{flex:none}
.brand-name{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.55rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--moss-deep);line-height:1}
.brand-sub{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:2px}
.today-chip{background:var(--moss);color:#fdf6df;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:999px 999px 999px 6px;white-space:nowrap}
.today-chip span{color:var(--sun);font-size:.65rem;vertical-align:2px}

/* Layout: single column on mobile */
.layout{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:8px 18px 28px;display:grid;gap:22px}
.main-col,.side-col{display:grid;gap:22px;align-content:start;min-width:0}

/* Hello */
.hello{padding:14px 4px 2px}
.hello h1{font-size:2.15rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.hello-copy{margin-top:10px;color:var(--ink-soft);max-width:34ch}
.progress-wrap{margin-top:16px;max-width:420px}
.progress-label{font-size:.85rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--moss)}
.progress-track{margin-top:6px;height:12px;background:#e2d3ac;border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.progress-fill{height:100%;width:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg,var(--leaf) 0 10px,#6d904b 10px 20px);border-radius:999px;transition:width .5s ease}

/* Sections */
.section-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px}
.section-head h2{font-size:1.3rem}
.section-head--tight h2{font-size:1.12rem}
.section-note{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--ink-soft);white-space:nowrap}

/* Queue cards — each plant gets its own tint + corner treatment */
.queue{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:14px}
.plant-card{
  background:var(--card);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:16px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.plant-card:nth-child(odd){border-radius:26px 10px 26px 26px}
.plant-card.is-featured{border:2px solid var(--clay);background:#fff8ec;padding:20px 16px 16px}
.plant-card.is-selected{border-color:var(--moss);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--leaf-soft), var(--shadow)}
.plant-card--fern{--accent:var(--leaf);--accent-soft:var(--leaf-soft)}
.plant-card--pothos{--accent:#7a6a2f;--accent-soft:var(--sun-soft)}
.plant-card--cactus{--accent:var(--clay);--accent-soft:var(--clay-soft)}
.plant-card--calathea{--accent:#6b5a7a;--accent-soft:#e6dff0}
.card-top{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start}
.plant-art{flex:none;width:58px;height:58px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--accent-soft);border-radius:58% 42% 55% 45%/48% 55% 45% 52%}
.is-featured .plant-art{width:72px;height:72px}
.card-main{flex:1;min-width:0}
.plant-name{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--moss-deep);line-height:1.1}
.is-featured .plant-name{font-size:1.55rem}
.plant-meta{font-size:.83rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:2px}
.due-badge{display:inline-block;margin-top:8px;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.02em;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px 999px 999px 4px;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--moss-deep);transform:rotate(-1.5deg)}
.due-badge.is-overdue{background:var(--clay);color:#fff;transform:rotate(-2.5deg)}
.due-badge.is-tomorrow{background:#eee6cf;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.task-line{margin-top:10px;font-size:.95rem}
.task-line strong{color:var(--moss-deep)}
.card-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:14px}
.btn{border-radius:999px 999px 999px 8px;padding:9px 18px;font-weight:700;font-size:.92rem;border:1.5px solid transparent}
.btn-primary{background:var(--moss);color:#fdf6df}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--moss-deep)}
.btn-water{background:var(--clay);color:#fff}
.btn-water:hover{background:var(--clay-deep)}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;border-color:var(--moss);color:var(--moss)}
.btn-ghost:hover{background:var(--leaf-soft)}
.btn-detail{background:transparent;border-color:var(--line);color:var(--ink);border-radius:999px;padding:9px 14px;font-weight:600;font-size:.88rem}
.btn-detail:hover{border-color:var(--moss)}
.btn-detail .chev{display:inline-block;transition:transform .25s}
.btn-detail[aria-expanded="true"] .chev{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.leaf-burst{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;font-size:0}
.leaf-burst i{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:9px;height:14px;background:var(--leaf);border-radius:80% 4px 80% 4px;animation:burst .7s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes burst{to{transform:translate(var(--tx),var(--ty)) rotate(var(--rot)) scale(.4);opacity:0}}

/* Detail panel + inline expansion */
.detail-card,.week-card,.note-card{background:var(--card);border:1.5px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:18px}
.detail-card{border-radius:10px 26px 26px 26px;border-top:6px solid var(--moss)}
.week-card{border-radius:26px 26px 10px 26px}
.note-card{border-radius:26px 10px 26px 26px;background:var(--sun-soft);border-color:#e3cd8f}
.note-card h2,.week-card h2{font-size:1.12rem;margin-bottom:8px}
.note-card p{font-size:.92rem;color:#5a4a22}
.detail-eyebrow{font-size:.75rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--clay)}
.detail-card h2{font-size:1.45rem;margin:4px 0 2px}
.detail-species{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.88rem}
.detail-facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin:16px 0}
.fact{background:#f6efdb;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px 14px 14px 6px;padding:10px 12px}
.fact dt{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.fact dd{margin:3px 0 0;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--moss-deep)}
.history-heading{font-size:.85rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--moss-deep);margin:4px 0 8px}
.history-list{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0 0 0 6px;border-left:2px dotted #b9a86f}
.history-list li{padding:4px 0 4px 12px;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--ink);position:relative}
.history-list li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-7px;top:11px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--sun);border:2px solid var(--card)}
.detail-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:16px}
.detail-hint{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:10px}

/* Week chart */
.week-chart{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:8px;height:110px;padding-top:8px}
.week-day{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:100%;justify-content:flex-end}
.week-bar-wrap{width:100%;max-width:34px;flex:1;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;background:#f1e8cf;border-radius:8px 8px 4px 4px;border:1px solid var(--line);overflow:hidden}
.week-bar{width:100%;background:var(--leaf);border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;min-height:8px}
.week-day.is-today .week-bar{background:var(--clay)}
.week-day-label{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.week-day.is-today .week-day-label{color:var(--clay-deep)}
.week-count{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--moss-deep)}
.week-note{margin-top:12px;font-size:.87rem;color:var(--ink-soft)}

/* All-done + snoozed */
.all-done{background:var(--card);border:2px dashed var(--leaf);border-radius:28px;padding:26px 20px;text-align:center;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.all-done h3{font-size:1.4rem;margin:10px 0 6px}
.all-done p{color:var(--ink-soft);max-width:38ch;margin:0 auto}
.all-done-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin-top:16px}
.snoozed-wrap{margin-top:18px}
.snoozed-heading{font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:8px}
.snoozed-list{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:8px}
.snoozed-item{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;background:#f6efdb;border:1px dashed #b9a86f;border-radius:16px 16px 16px 6px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:.92rem}
.snoozed-item button{flex:none}

/* Toast */
.toast-region{position:fixed;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:60;display:flex;justify-content:center;pointer-events:none}
.toast{pointer-events:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--moss-deep);color:#fdf6df;border-radius:16px 16px 16px 6px;padding:10px 8px 10px 16px;box-shadow:0 16px 32px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.5);max-width:520px;width:100%;animation:toast-in .3s ease}
@keyframes toast-in{from{transform:translateY(12px);opacity:0}}
.toast-msg{flex:1;font-size:.92rem;font-weight:600}
.btn-undo{background:var(--sun);color:#3d2f05;border:none;padding:8px 16px}
.btn-undo:hover{background:#dcb13e}
.toast-close{background:transparent;border:none;color:#fdf6df;font-size:1.35rem;line-height:1;min-width:44px;padding:4px}
.footer{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 18px 26px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:.85rem}

/* Desktop: queue left, sticky detail/week right — not a stretched column */
@media (min-width:900px){
  .layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.25fr) minmax(300px,.85fr);gap:28px;padding-top:14px}
  .hello h1{font-size:2.7rem}
  .side-col{position:sticky;top:18px}
  .toast-region{left:auto;right:22px;bottom:22px;justify-content:flex-end}
  .plant-card{padding:18px 20px}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.001s!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.001s!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}
  .leaf-burst{display:none}
}

Evaluation 8 / 10 graded blind as submission O

Chunky outlined cards with wavy underlines and a strong dark greeting card. Inline expandable details and all flows work. On mobile, the hero, rhythm and 'Tomorrow' card all come before today's queue.

Strengths

  • Clear overdue-first queue with inline detail
  • Focus to Undo; live regions; reduced motion

Weaknesses

  • Mobile queue pushed below three panels including tomorrow's list
  • Greeting 'Three plants would like a word' beside '0 of 4 settled'
Evidence the grader checked
  • O-mobile.png order
  • harness.js (Playwright, 1440 and 390 px): all flows pass, doneClicks 4

Objective checks

  • Browser: horizontal scroll at 390 px no; console errors 0; network requests 0

muse-wonder-full/13-frontend-playful/RESPONSE.md

Moss — design & interaction notes

Personality

Warm, tactile, optimistic, a little odd — never guilt-driven. The visual language is chunky ink outlines, hard offset shadows, rotated sticker chips ("1 overdue", the date pill), a wavy underline under today's task, and four different blob/arch frames for the plant portraits (inline SVG, drawn per species: fern fronds, trailing pothos, bunny-ear pads, calathea stripes). Palette is moss green, terracotta clay, and butter on a warm speckled paper ground; type is a rounded system stack only — no external fonts, no remote assets, no network requests, so the page works offline from file://. Plant data mirrors PLANTS.json (embedded in app.js for exactly that reason). Copy stays dry and kind: "Frida unclenches", "No guilt — plants respect a rain check". No glass panels, neon gradients, clip-art, or wall of identical cards — the overdue plant gets a heavier border, peach ground, and a gently wiggling chip so urgency reads at a glance.

Interaction model

  • Queue, urgency-first. Today's care queue is an ordered list sorted by urgency: Frida (Water, 2 days overdue) → Orbit (Rotate, today) → Dot (Check soil, today) → Drama (Mist, tomorrow, dashed border, explicitly optional). Progress ("x of 4 settled") and the overdue sticker update live.
  • Watered / task-done & Snooze. Every card has a task-specific done action (Watered / Rotated / Checked / Misted) plus "Snooze 1 day". Done plants leave the queue with a small petal burst and a per-plant thank-you; snoozed plants move to tomorrow. Both land in "Settled & snoozed" and trigger a toast with an Undo button (8 seconds, plus a persistent Undo in the settled list, so the undo path never fully expires). Focus moves to the toast's Undo since the acted-on card unmounts; Escape dismisses.
  • Detail view. A "Details" toggle expands light, location, next-care guidance, water notes, and the verbatim observation history from PLANTS.json. Frida's panel starts open because she's the priority.
  • Weekly rhythm. Compact pill bars for Mon–Sun from week: [1,3,2,4,2,1,3], Friday (today) highlighted in clay with a caption naming busiest/quietest days.
  • All-done state. When nothing overdue/due-today remains, an all-done panel appears that still earns its place: it previews tomorrow (including snoozed items), while the rhythm, settled list with undos, and tomorrow panel stay visible.
  • Desktop. ≥960px the single column becomes a sticky left rail (greeting, rhythm, tomorrow) beside the queue, with two-column detail grids — composition, not stretching.

Accessibility choices

Semantic landmarks (header/main/section/footer), real <button>s everywhere, an ordered list for the queue, aria-expanded/aria-controls on detail toggles, and descriptive aria-labels on icon-adjacent actions. A skip link jumps to the queue. Toast messages are mirrored to a visually-hidden aria-live="polite" region; the chart uses role="img" with a full text equivalent ("Mon 1, Tue 3, … Friday is today"). Focus is always visible (3px clay outline via :focus-visible), touch targets are ≥46px, and body text uses high-contrast ink on paper. prefers-reduced-motion disables the wiggle, transitions, smooth scrolling, and the JS petal burst. A <noscript> block lists all four plants, their care, history, and the weekly counts. Everything is fully operable by keyboard (Tab/Enter/Space, Escape to dismiss).

Files

index.html (structure), styles.css (mobile-first + desktop rail), app.js (state, rendering, undo, toast, rhythm). Open index.html in any browser — no build or server required; optionally python3 -m http.server in this directory.

muse-wonder-full/13-frontend-playful/TASK.md

Task 13 — Frontend design: playful mobile-first product

Build a polished mobile-first web app screen for Moss, a gentle household plant-care companion. Use only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: no frameworks, package installs, remote assets, external fonts, or network requests.

Visual direction: warm, tactile, optimistic, and a little odd. Use an expressive shape language and small moments of delight while keeping text readable and controls obvious. Avoid childish clip art, neon gradients, glass panels, and a wall of indistinguishable cards.

The experience must include:

  • Today's care queue for the four plants in PLANTS.json, clearly prioritizing overdue care.
  • A plant detail view or expandable panel with light, water, and observation history.
  • Working “watered” and “snooze” actions that update the interface and offer a brief undo path.
  • A compact weekly rhythm visualization.
  • A useful all-done state.
  • Desktop composition that makes good use of space without merely stretching the mobile column.
  • Keyboard operation, visible focus, semantic controls, and reduced-motion support.

Create index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Use CSS or inline SVG for any illustration. Add RESPONSE.md explaining the personality, interaction model, and accessibility choices. Work only in this directory.

muse-wonder-full/13-frontend-playful/app.js

"use strict";
/* Moss — data mirrors PLANTS.json (embedded so the page works from file:// with no network). */
const PLANTS = [
  { id:"fern", name:"Frida", species:"Boston fern", location:"Bathroom", task:"Water", doneLabel:"Watered",
    due:"2 days overdue", urgency:4, light:"Low, indirect",
    water:"Keep evenly moist. Water when the surface is just dry to the touch; bathroom humidity does the rest.",
    next:"Water again in about 3 days; mist between waterings.",
    thanks:"Frida unclenches. Bathroom fern, restored.",
    history:["Sep 19 · Misted","Sep 16 · Watered","Sep 12 · New frond"] },
  { id:"pothos", name:"Orbit", species:"Golden pothos", location:"Bookshelf", task:"Rotate", doneLabel:"Rotated",
    due:"Today", urgency:2, light:"Medium, indirect",
    water:"Water when the top 3 cm of soil is dry. Today's job is a quarter-turn so all sides get the bookshelf light.",
    next:"Rotate again in a week; check water in 2–3 days.",
    thanks:"Orbit gets a new view of the room. Thrilling, for a pothos.",
    history:["Sep 20 · Watered","Sep 14 · Rotated","Sep 10 · Wiped leaves"] },
  { id:"cactus", name:"Dot", species:"Bunny ears cactus", location:"South window", task:"Check soil", doneLabel:"Checked",
    due:"Today", urgency:1, light:"Bright, direct",
    water:"Soak rarely, only when the soil is completely dry all the way down. If in doubt, don't — Dot prefers a drought to a flood.",
    next:"Check again in a week. No water today unless bone dry.",
    thanks:"Dot remains Dot. Stoic. Slightly rounder.",
    history:["Sep 08 · Watered","Sep 01 · New pad noted","Aug 22 · Rotated"] },
  { id:"calathea", name:"Drama", species:"Calathea orbifolia", location:"Bedroom", task:"Mist", doneLabel:"Misted",
    due:"Tomorrow", urgency:0, light:"Medium, filtered",
    water:"Keep lightly moist, ideally with filtered water. Mist in the morning so leaves dry by evening.",
    next:"Mist tomorrow morning; water check in 2 days.",
    thanks:"Drama accepts the mist. No notes. A miracle.",
    history:["Sep 21 · Misted","Sep 18 · Watered","Sep 15 · Brown edge noted"] }
];
const WEEK = [1, 3, 2, 4, 2, 1, 3];
const DAYS = ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"];
const TODAY_INDEX = 4; // Friday in this week's rhythm

const SVG = {
  fern: '<svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" width="52" height="52" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M32 56V22M32 34C22 32 14 24 12 12c12 1 19 9 20 22ZM32 28c0-11 7-18 18-20 0 12-6 19-18 20ZM32 44c-8-1-14-6-16-14 9 1 15 6 16 14Z" fill="#2e4a34"/><path d="M20 56h24" stroke="#c96f4a" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>',
  pothos: '<svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" width="52" height="52" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M32 8c-2 16 12 18 8 30M32 8c2 14-12 16-9 28" stroke="#2e4a34" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M40 22c6-1 10 2 11 8-6 1-10-2-11-8ZM23 30c-6 0-9 3-10 8 6 1 9-2 10-8ZM37 40c5 1 8 4 8 9-5 0-8-3-8-9Z" fill="#5a8a5e"/><circle cx="32" cy="8" r="4" fill="#e9b949"/></svg>',
  cactus: '<svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" width="52" height="52" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><ellipse cx="32" cy="38" rx="11" ry="17" fill="#5a8a5e"/><ellipse cx="19" cy="24" rx="7" ry="10" fill="#2e4a34"/><ellipse cx="45" cy="24" rx="7" ry="10" fill="#2e4a34"/><circle cx="29" cy="32" r="1.6" fill="#f2e8d5"/><circle cx="36" cy="42" r="1.6" fill="#f2e8d5"/><circle cx="31" cy="48" r="1.6" fill="#f2e8d5"/><path d="M20 56h24" stroke="#c96f4a" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>',
  calathea: '<svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" width="52" height="52" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><ellipse cx="32" cy="30" rx="16" ry="20" fill="#2e4a34"/><path d="M32 12v36M20 22c8 3 16 3 24 0M19 36c9 3 17 3 26 0" stroke="#dce8d2" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none"/><path d="M18 56h28" stroke="#c96f4a" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>'
};

const state = new Map(PLANTS.map((p) => [p.id, "pending"]));
const expanded = new Set(["fern"]);
const reducedMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
let lastAction = null;
let toastTimer = null;

const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const queueEl = $("queue"), settledEl = $("settled-list"), toastEl = $("toast");

function dueClass(p) { return p.urgency >= 3 ? "overdue" : p.urgency >= 1 ? "today" : "tomorrow"; }
function esc(s) { return s.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;"); }

function plantCard(p) {
  const isOpen = expanded.has(p.id);
  const chip = dueClass(p);
  const hist = p.history.map((h) => "<li>" + esc(h) + "</li>").join("");
  const optional = p.urgency === 0 ? '<p class="plant-task">Due tomorrow — an early mist is welcome, never required.</p>' : "";
  return '<li class="plant plant--' + chip + '" data-id="' + p.id + '">' +
    '<div class="plant-top"><div class="plant-blob blob-' + p.id + '">' + SVG[p.id] + "</div>" +
    '<div><h3 class="plant-name">' + esc(p.name) + '</h3>' +
    '<p class="plant-meta">' + esc(p.species) + " · " + esc(p.location) + "</p>" +
    '<span class="due-chip due-chip--' + chip + '">' + esc(p.due) + "</span></div></div>" +
    '<p class="plant-task">Today: <strong>' + esc(p.task) + "</strong></p>" + optional +
    '<div class="plant-actions">' +
    '<button type="button" class="btn btn--done" data-action="done" data-id="' + p.id + '" aria-label="Mark ' + esc(p.name) + " as " + esc(p.doneLabel.toLowerCase()) + '">' + esc(p.doneLabel) + ' ✓</button>' +
    '<button type="button" class="btn btn--snooze" data-action="snooze" data-id="' + p.id + '" aria-label="Snooze ' + esc(p.name) + ' until tomorrow">Snooze 1 day</button>' +
    '<button type="button" class="btn btn--detail" data-action="detail" data-id="' + p.id + '" aria-expanded="' + isOpen + '" aria-controls="detail-' + p.id + '">' + (isOpen ? "Hide details" : "Details") + "</button>" +
    "</div>" +
    '<div class="plant-detail" id="detail-' + p.id + '"' + (isOpen ? "" : " hidden") + '>' +
    '<div class="detail-grid"><dl>' +
    '<div class="detail-fact"><dt>Light</dt><dd>' + esc(p.light) + "</dd></div>" +
    '<div class="detail-fact"><dt>Where</dt><dd>' + esc(p.location) + "</dd></div>" +
    '<div class="detail-fact"><dt>Next</dt><dd>' + esc(p.next) + "</dd></div></dl>" +
    "<div><h4>Water notes</h4><p>" + esc(p.water) + "</p></div></div>" +
    "<h4>Observation history</h4><ul class=\"history\">" + hist + "</ul>" +
    "</div></li>";
}

function render() {
  const pending = PLANTS.filter((p) => state.get(p.id) === "pending").sort((a, b) => b.urgency - a.urgency);
  queueEl.innerHTML = pending.map(plantCard).join("");

  const settled = PLANTS.filter((p) => state.get(p.id) !== "pending");
  settledEl.innerHTML = settled.map((p) => {
    const s = state.get(p.id);
    const label = s === "done" ? p.doneLabel + " today" : "Snoozed → tomorrow";
    return '<li class="settled-item"><p><strong>' + esc(p.name) + '</strong> · ' + esc(p.task) +
      ' <span class="settled-tag' + (s === "snoozed" ? " settled-tag--snoozed" : "") + '">' + esc(label) + "</span></p>" +
      '<button type="button" class="btn btn--undo" data-action="undo" data-id="' + p.id + '" aria-label="Undo for ' + esc(p.name) + '">Undo</button></li>';
  }).join("");
  $("settled-empty").hidden = settled.length > 0;

  const neededToday = PLANTS.filter((p) => p.urgency >= 1);
  const neededLeft = neededToday.filter((p) => state.get(p.id) === "pending");
  const doneCount = settled.length;
  $("progress-fill").style.width = Math.round((doneCount / PLANTS.length) * 100) + "%";

  const overdueLeft = PLANTS.filter((p) => p.urgency >= 3 && state.get(p.id) === "pending").length;
  const sticker = $("overdue-sticker");
  sticker.textContent = overdueLeft ? overdueLeft + " overdue" : "Nothing overdue";
  sticker.classList.toggle("is-clear", overdueLeft === 0);

  const progressText = $("progress-text");
  if (neededLeft.length === 0) {
    progressText.textContent = "All of today's care is settled. " + doneCount + " of " + PLANTS.length + " plants attended to.";
  } else {
    const first = neededLeft.sort((a, b) => b.urgency - a.urgency)[0];
    progressText.textContent = doneCount + " of " + PLANTS.length + " settled today. Next up: " + first.name + " (" + first.task.toLowerCase() + ", " + first.due.toLowerCase() + ").";
  }

  // Tomorrow list = plants due tomorrow + anything snoozed
  const tomorrowItems = PLANTS.filter((p) => (p.urgency === 0 && state.get(p.id) === "pending") || state.get(p.id) === "snoozed");
  $("tomorrow-list").innerHTML = tomorrowItems.length
    ? tomorrowItems.map((p) => "<li><strong>" + esc(p.name) + "</strong> (" + esc(p.species) + ") · " + esc(p.task) + " · " + esc(p.location) + (state.get(p.id) === "snoozed" ? " · snoozed from today" : "") + "</li>").join("")
    : "<li>Nothing queued — a rare, quiet tomorrow.</li>";

  // All-done state: nothing due today/overdue remains
  const allDone = neededLeft.length === 0;
  const panel = $("all-done");
  panel.hidden = !allDone;
  if (allDone) {
    const stillTomorrow = PLANTS.filter((p) => p.urgency === 0 && state.get(p.id) === "pending");
    $("all-done-copy").textContent = "Nothing else needs you today. Kettle on. Plants: quietly photosynthesising.";
    $("all-done-next").textContent = stillTomorrow.length
      ? "Tomorrow: " + stillTomorrow.map((p) => p.name + " (" + p.task.toLowerCase() + ")").join(", ") + (settled.some((p) => state.get(p.id) === "snoozed") ? ", plus anything snoozed above." : ".")
      : "Even tomorrow's early bird is done. Check the weekly rhythm — Thursday is usually your busiest day.";
  }
}

function announce(msg) { $("live-region").textContent = msg; }

function burst(card) {
  if (reducedMotion.matches || !card) return;
  for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
    const s = document.createElement("span");
    s.className = "burst"; s.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    s.style.left = "55%"; s.style.top = "38%";
    s.style.setProperty("--dx", (Math.random() * 120 - 60) + "px");
    s.style.setProperty("--dy", (-20 - Math.random() * 70) + "px");
    s.style.background = ["#5a8a5e", "#e9b949", "#c96f4a"][i % 3];
    card.appendChild(s);
    setTimeout(() => s.remove(), 750);
  }
}

function showToast(msg) {
  $("toast-msg").textContent = msg;
  toastEl.hidden = false;
  announce(msg + " Undo available.");
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer = setTimeout(hideToast, 8000);
  $("toast-undo").focus();
}
function hideToast() { toastEl.hidden = true; clearTimeout(toastTimer); }

function act(id, kind, sourceBtn) {
  const p = PLANTS.find((x) => x.id === id);
  if (!p) return;
  if (kind === "detail") {
    expanded.has(id) ? expanded.delete(id) : expanded.add(id);
    render();
    const btn = queueEl.querySelector('[data-action="detail"][data-id="' + id + '"]');
    if (btn) btn.focus();
    return;
  }
  const prev = state.get(id);
  if (kind === "undo") {
    state.set(id, "pending"); lastAction = null; hideToast(); render();
    announce(p.name + " is back in today's queue.");
    const card = queueEl.querySelector('[data-id="' + id + '"] .btn--done');
    if (card) card.focus();
    return;
  }
  const cardEl = sourceBtn ? sourceBtn.closest(".plant") : null;
  if (kind === "done") burst(cardEl);
  lastAction = { id, prev };
  state.set(id, kind === "done" ? "done" : "snoozed");
  render();
  showToast(kind === "done" ? p.thanks : p.name + " snoozed until tomorrow. No guilt — plants respect a rain check.");
}

document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  const btn = e.target.closest("button[data-action]");
  if (btn) act(btn.dataset.id, btn.dataset.action, btn);
});
$("toast-undo").addEventListener("click", () => { if (lastAction) act(lastAction.id, "undo"); });
$("toast-dismiss").addEventListener("click", hideToast);
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Escape") hideToast(); });

function renderRhythm() {
  const max = Math.max.apply(null, WEEK);
  const items = WEEK.map((v, i) =>
    '<li class="' + (i === TODAY_INDEX ? "is-today" : "") + '">' +
    '<span class="rhythm-bar" style="height:' + Math.round(26 + (v / max) * 62) + 'px">' + v + "</span>" +
    '<span class="rhythm-day">' + DAYS[i] + (i === TODAY_INDEX ? '<span class="visually-hidden"> (today)</span>' : "") + "</span></li>"
  ).join("");
  $("rhythm-chart").innerHTML =
    '<ul class="rhythm-bars" role="img" aria-label="Bar chart of care moments per day, Monday to Sunday: ' +
    WEEK.map((v, i) => DAYS[i] + " " + v).join(", ") + '. Friday is today.">' + items + "</ul>";
}

$("today-label").textContent = "Friday · Sep 22";
renderRhythm();
render();

muse-wonder-full/13-frontend-playful/index.html

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="description" content="Moss — a gentle household plant-care companion. Today's care queue, plant details, and weekly rhythm.">
<title>Moss — Today's care queue</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
<script src="app.js" defer></script>
</head>
<body>
<a class="skip-link" href="#queue-heading">Skip to today's care queue</a>

<div class="page">
  <header class="topbar">
    <p class="wordmark">
      <svg class="wordmark-leaf" viewBox="0 0 32 32" width="30" height="30" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M26 4C14 5 6 12 6 22c0 2 .5 4 .5 4S11 27 16 25c7-3 10-11 10-21Z" fill="#2e4a34"/><path d="M8 24C12 17 18 11 24 7" stroke="#f2e8d5" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
      Moss
    </p>
    <p class="topbar-date" id="today-label">Today</p>
  </header>

  <div class="layout">
    <div class="rail">
      <section class="hello" aria-labelledby="hello-heading">
        <p class="sticker sticker--overdue" id="overdue-sticker">1 overdue</p>
        <h1 id="hello-heading">Good morning.<br>Three plants would like a word.</h1>
        <p class="hello-sub" id="progress-text" role="status">0 of 4 settled today. Start with Frida — she's waited longest.</p>
        <div class="progress" aria-hidden="true"><span class="progress-fill" id="progress-fill"></span></div>
        <p class="hello-note">Small sips, often. Moss keeps the list so your leaves don't have to shout.</p>
      </section>

      <section class="rhythm" aria-labelledby="rhythm-heading">
        <h2 id="rhythm-heading">Weekly rhythm</h2>
        <p class="rhythm-sub">Care moments this week, Mon–Sun. Today is Friday.</p>
        <div id="rhythm-chart"></div>
        <p class="rhythm-caption" id="rhythm-caption">Busiest: Thursday (4). Quietest: Monday &amp; Saturday (1).</p>
      </section>

      <section class="tomorrow" aria-labelledby="tomorrow-heading">
        <h2 id="tomorrow-heading">Tomorrow, gently</h2>
        <ul class="tomorrow-list" id="tomorrow-list">
          <li><strong>Drama</strong> (Calathea) · Mist · Bedroom</li>
        </ul>
        <p class="tomorrow-note">Anything you snooze today joins this list.</p>
      </section>
    </div>

    <main class="maincol">
      <section aria-labelledby="queue-heading">
        <div class="queue-head">
          <h2 id="queue-heading" tabindex="-1">Today's care queue</h2>
          <p class="queue-order">Sorted by who needs you first — overdue at the top.</p>
        </div>
        <ol class="queue" id="queue"></ol>

        <section class="all-done" id="all-done" hidden tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="all-done-heading">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 80 64" width="72" height="58" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M40 58V30" stroke="#2e4a34" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M40 34C28 34 18 26 16 12c14 1 22 8 24 22Z" fill="#5a8a5e"/><path d="M40 26c0-12 8-20 20-22 0 13-7 21-20 22Z" fill="#2e4a34"/><path d="M14 58h52" stroke="#c96f4a" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
          <h3 id="all-done-heading">All done — everyone's settled.</h3>

        <p class="settled-empty" id="settled-empty">Nothing here yet. Completed and snoozed care will collect here.</p>
      </section>
    </main>
  </div>

  <footer class="footer">

</div>

<div class="toast" id="toast" hidden>

</div>

muse-wonder-full/13-frontend-playful/styles.css

/* Moss — warm, tactile, optimistic. System fonts only. No external assets. */
:root{
  --paper:#f2e8d5; --paper-dot:#e6d7b8; --ink:#22301f; --moss:#2e4a34; --moss-soft:#dce8d2;
  --clay:#c96f4a; --clay-dark:#9c4f30; --butter:#e9b949; --sage:#5a8a5e; --sky:#7fa8a0;
  --card:#fffaf0; --radius:18px; --shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--ink);
  --font:"Avenir Next","Trebuchet MS","Segoe UI",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;font-family:var(--font);color:var(--ink);line-height:1.5;
  background:var(--paper);background-image:radial-gradient(var(--paper-dot) 1.2px,transparent 1.3px);background-size:22px 22px}
.visually-hidden{position:absolute!important;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}
.skip-link{position:absolute;left:1rem;top:-4rem;z-index:50;background:var(--moss);color:#fff;padding:.7rem 1rem;border-radius:0 0 12px 12px;font-weight:700}
.skip-link:focus{top:0}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--clay-dark);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:6px}
.page{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:1rem 1rem 2.5rem}
button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}

/* Header */
.topbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;padding:.4rem 0 1rem}
.wordmark{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;font-size:1.7rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0;color:var(--moss)}
.wordmark-leaf{flex:none}
.topbar-date{margin:0;font-weight:700;background:var(--butter);border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:999px;padding:.25rem .8rem;transform:rotate(2deg);box-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--ink);font-size:.9rem}

/* Hello / rail */
.hello{position:relative;background:var(--moss);color:#f6f1df;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:28px 28px 28px 6px;padding:1.4rem 1.3rem 1.2rem;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.hello h1{font-size:1.85rem;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:.4rem 0 .6rem}
.hello-sub{margin:0 0 .8rem;font-size:1.02rem}
.hello-note{margin:.8rem 0 0;font-size:.92rem;color:#d9e4c8}
.sticker{display:inline-block;margin:0;font-weight:800;font-size:.82rem;padding:.25rem .7rem;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:999px}
.sticker--overdue{background:var(--clay);color:#fff;transform:rotate(-3deg)}
.sticker--overdue.is-clear{background:var(--butter);color:var(--ink)}
.progress{height:14px;background:#1e3323;border:2px solid #f6f1df;border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden}
.progress-fill{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:var(--butter);border-radius:999px;transition:width .45s ease}

.rhythm,.tomorrow,.settled{background:var(--card);border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:1.1rem 1.15rem;margin-top:1.2rem}
.rhythm{border-radius:6px 26px 26px 26px}
.rhythm h2,.tomorrow h2,.settled h2{margin:0 0 .3rem;font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--moss)}
.rhythm-sub,.tomorrow-note,.settled-sub,.settled-empty{margin:0 0 .7rem;font-size:.92rem;color:#44523c}
.rhythm-bars{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:.45rem;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;height:118px}
.rhythm-bars li{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:.3rem;height:100%}
.rhythm-bar{width:100%;max-width:34px;background:var(--sage);border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:999px 999px 6px 6px;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start;padding-top:.15rem;color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:.8rem;min-height:26px}
.rhythm-bars li.is-today .rhythm-bar{background:var(--clay)}
.rhythm-day{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700}
.rhythm-bars li.is-today .rhythm-day{background:var(--butter);border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:999px;padding:0 .4rem}
.rhythm-caption{margin:.6rem 0 0;font-size:.88rem;color:#44523c}
.tomorrow-list{margin:0;padding-left:1.1rem}
.tomorrow-list li{margin:.3rem 0}

/* Queue */
.queue-head{margin:1.5rem 0 .8rem}
.queue-head h2{font-size:1.55rem;margin:0;color:var(--moss);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.queue-order{margin:.2rem 0 0;color:#44523c}
.queue{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:1.1rem}
.plant{background:var(--card);border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:24px 24px 24px 8px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:1.1rem;position:relative}
.plant--overdue{background:#fdf0e4;border-width:3px;border-radius:8px 28px 28px 28px}
.plant--tomorrow{opacity:.92;border-style:dashed}
.plant-top{display:flex;gap:1rem;align-items:flex-start}
.plant-blob{flex:none;width:76px;height:76px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:2px solid var(--ink);background:var(--moss-soft)}
.blob-fern{border-radius:58% 42% 55% 45%/50% 58% 42% 50%}
.blob-pothos{border-radius:50% 50% 50% 8px;background:#f3dfae}
.blob-cactus{border-radius:38px 38px 12px 12px;background:#f0cdb4}
.blob-calathea{border-radius:12px 38px 12px 38px;background:#cfdfd8}
.plant-name{font-size:1.45rem;margin:0;line-height:1.1;color:var(--moss)}
.plant-meta{margin:.2rem 0 0;color:#44523c;font-size:.95rem}
.due-chip{display:inline-block;margin-top:.5rem;font-weight:800;font-size:.82rem;padding:.2rem .65rem;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:999px;background:#fff}
.due-chip--overdue{background:var(--clay);color:#fff;transform:rotate(-2deg)}
.due-chip--today{background:var(--butter)}
.due-chip--tomorrow{background:var(--moss-soft)}
.plant-task{margin:.7rem 0 0;font-size:1.02rem}
.plant-task strong{text-decoration:underline wavy var(--clay) 2px;text-underline-offset:4px}
.plant-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.6rem;margin-top:.9rem}
.btn{min-height:46px;padding:.6rem 1.05rem;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:999px;font-weight:800;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--ink);transition:transform .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease}
.btn:hover{transform:translate(-1px,-1px);box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--ink)}
.btn:active{transform:translate(2px,2px);box-shadow:1px 1px 0 var(--ink)}
.btn--done{background:var(--moss);color:#fff}
.btn--done:hover{background:#3a5c42}
.btn--snooze{background:#fff}
.btn--detail{background:var(--moss-soft);box-shadow:none}
.btn--undo{background:var(--butter)}
.btn--dismiss{border-radius:50%;width:46px;padding:0;flex:none}
.btn[aria-expanded="true"]{background:var(--butter)}

/* Detail panel */
.plant-detail{margin-top:1rem;border-top:2px dashed var(--moss);padding-top:.9rem}
.plant-detail h4{margin:.7rem 0 .25rem;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--moss)}
.plant-detail h4:first-child{margin-top:0}
.plant-detail p{margin:0}
.detail-grid{display:grid;gap:.2rem}
.history{margin:0;padding-left:1.15rem}
.history li{margin:.25rem 0}
.detail-fact{display:flex;gap:.5rem;align-items:baseline}
.detail-fact dt{font-weight:800;min-width:4.2rem}
.detail-fact dd{margin:0}

/* Settled + all-done */
.settled-list{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:.6rem}
.settled-item{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;justify-content:space-between;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:14px;padding:.6rem .8rem}
.settled-item p{margin:0}
.settled-tag{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:800;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:999px;padding:.05rem .5rem;background:var(--moss-soft)}
.settled-tag--snoozed{background:var(--butter)}
.all-done{text-align:center;background:var(--moss-soft);border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:28px 8px 28px 28px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:1.6rem 1.2rem;margin-top:.4rem}
.all-done h3{font-size:1.5rem;margin:.5rem 0 .4rem;color:var(--moss)}
.all-done p{margin:.3rem auto;max-width:34rem}
.all-done-next{font-weight:700}

/* Toast */
.toast{position:fixed;left:1rem;right:1rem;bottom:1rem;z-index:40;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:18px;padding:.8rem .9rem;box-shadow:6px 6px 0 rgba(34,48,31,.35)}
.toast[hidden]{display:none}
.toast-msg{margin:0;flex:1;font-weight:650}
.footer{margin-top:2rem;text-align:center;color:#44523c;font-size:.9rem}

/* Delight: petal burst (JS adds .burst spans; disabled with reduced motion) */
.burst{position:absolute;width:10px;height:14px;border-radius:60% 40% 60% 40%;background:var(--sage);pointer-events:none;animation:burst .7s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes burst{from{transform:translate(0,0) rotate(0);opacity:1}to{transform:translate(var(--dx),var(--dy)) rotate(140deg);opacity:0}}
@keyframes gentle-wiggle{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-2deg)}50%{transform:rotate(-.5deg)}}
.due-chip--overdue{animation:gentle-wiggle 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}

/* Desktop composition: rail + queue side by side, not a stretched column */
@media (min-width:960px){
  .page{padding:1.4rem 1.5rem 3rem}
  .layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:340px 1fr;gap:1.6rem;align-items:start}
  .rail{position:sticky;top:1.2rem}
  .queue-head{margin-top:.2rem}
  .plant{padding:1.25rem 1.4rem}
  .plant-blob{width:92px;height:92px}
  .detail-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1rem}
  .toast{left:auto;right:1.5rem;max-width:460px}
  .hello h1{font-size:2rem}
}
@media (min-width:1200px){.layout{grid-template-columns:370px 1fr}}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
  *,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}
  .btn:hover{transform:none}
  .due-chip--overdue{transform:none}
}

Evaluation 7.75 / 10 graded blind as submission X

A very polished editorial design with lush illustration, but a large hero pushes the queue below the fold on desktop, much of the text is 9–11px, and snooze is a faint text link. Flows, undo and persistence work.

Strengths

  • Beautiful illustration and typography
  • Persistence; focus to next action; descriptive undo

Weaknesses

  • 65 text nodes under 12px (minimum 9px)
  • Queue starts around 700px down on desktop
  • Low-emphasis snooze; verify.cjs left in the deliverable
Evidence the grader checked
  • fonts.js: X <12px 65
  • harness.js (Playwright, 1440 and 390 px): persisted=True, doneClicks 3

Objective checks

  • Browser: horizontal scroll at 390 px no; console errors 0; network requests 0

gpt-6-astra/13-frontend-playful/RESPONSE.md

Moss — small rituals, happy roots

All requested deliverables are implemented: index.html, styles.css, and app.js, plus this explanation. Open index.html directly in a modern browser. No server, build step, package installation, external font, asset download, or network request is needed. The app embeds an exact copy of PLANTS.json; the original data file is unchanged. verify.cjs is an additional dependency-free verification script.

The personality is a pocket field journal: organic shapes, editorial typography, warm paper, forest-green ink, and small terracotta accents. Four original inline SVG illustrations give Frida, Orbit, Dot, and Drama individual identities. The little greenhouse vignette, slightly tilted field note, and rounded seed-like counters supply the oddness without turning the experience into a cartoon. The care list uses ruled rows and one warm overdue highlight. Encouragement stays brief and avoids streaks, guilt, or urgency beyond the actual overdue task. Design feasibility score: 15 (impact 4 + fit 5 + feasibility 4 + performance 4 − consistency risk 2).

The typography pairs locally available Georgia with Avenir Next, Avenir, and Trebuchet fallbacks. The palette and fonts are CSS variables, and spacing follows a mostly four-pixel rhythm. Motion is limited to short dialog and receipt entrances, button feedback, and anchor scrolling. On narrow screens, the compact illustration sits beside the introduction, followed by the care queue and supporting sections. On desktop, the queue shares a deliberate two-column composition with the rhythm visualization and field note; the plant collection spans the page below.

Frida’s overdue watering comes first, then Orbit’s rotation and Dot’s soil check. Drama remains visible under “On the horizon,” correctly marked for tomorrow. Each plant’s primary action matches its task: Watered, Rotated, Checked soil, or Misted. Snooze moves a task to tomorrow without counting it as completed. The all-done state distinguishes completed care from postponed care, shows what is next, and keeps every plant’s journal accessible. Early care is available in the detail panel.

Click a plant’s name, illustration, arrow, or collection entry to open its native modal dialog. It contains the supplied light information, last watering record, and full care and observation history. Every non-watering task also offers an independent “Log watered” action; watering Orbit does not silently complete its rotation. Observations accept up to 280 characters and are rendered as escaped text. Notes remain in the input when another action refreshes the open panel. Saving a note clears the input and adds an observation to the journal.

Every change offers a 12-second undo receipt, with the timer paused while hovered, keyboard-focused, or while the page is hidden. Different plants retain separate undo receipts during rapid actions. A newer change to the same plant replaces that plant’s previous undo opportunity. Undo restores the task, removes its added history event, and reverses the rhythm count when applicable. The chart starts with the seven provided values and adds newly recorded care to the current weekday; snoozes and written observations do not inflate that count.

Progress and observations are stored under moss-garden-v1 in browser local storage. The initial relative due dates are anchored on first opening; snoozed care returns when tomorrow arrives, including after reloading or leaving the page open overnight. Completed tasks remain completed. This is a local care snapshot, so it does not invent repeating watering schedules or send reminders. The supplied weekly series is a seeded visualization, not a calendar archive. If browser storage is unavailable, all actions still work for the current visit and the footer explains the persistence limit. Clearing that local-storage key restores the original sample.

Accessibility includes semantic headings, navigation, buttons, labeled form controls, a skip link, explicit overdue text, and visible focus rings. The native dialog contains keyboard focus, supports Escape, and restores focus to the plant that opened it. Completing a queue row transfers focus to a remaining task or the care section. Live announcements describe changes and undo availability; the announcements and undo controls move inside an open dialog so they remain accessible. The weekly chart has a full textual accessible description, numeric counts, and an underline for today. Main care buttons are at least 44 pixels tall on phones. Reduced-motion preferences remove animation and smooth scrolling; forced-colors styling preserves key outlines. The checked text color pairs meet at least 4.5:1 contrast.

Verification: run node verify.cjs to repeat 13 passing offline checks covering source-data parity, queue order, watering and snooze transitions, independent undo, persistence, midnight rollover, all-done states, early care, duplicate prevention, safe observations, undo expiration, storage failures, and static accessibility/offline boundaries. JavaScript syntax checks and an HTML nesting check also passed. These tests use a small DOM stand-in; they do not establish browser layout or actual keyboard behavior. Chrome was attempted locally but exited with SIGABRT before loading the page, so browser screenshots and end-to-end keyboard verification remain unperformed. Recommended manual review: open the file at 320px, 390px, 768px, and desktop widths; test Tab/Shift+Tab/Escape, 200% zoom, reduced motion, each action and undo, and persistence after reload.

Model ID: gpt-6-astra.

gpt-6-astra/13-frontend-playful/TASK.md

Task 13 — Frontend design: playful mobile-first product

Build a polished mobile-first web app screen for Moss, a gentle household plant-care companion. Use only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: no frameworks, package installs, remote assets, external fonts, or network requests.

Visual direction: warm, tactile, optimistic, and a little odd. Use an expressive shape language and small moments of delight while keeping text readable and controls obvious. Avoid childish clip art, neon gradients, glass panels, and a wall of indistinguishable cards.

The experience must include:

  • Today's care queue for the four plants in PLANTS.json, clearly prioritizing overdue care.
  • A plant detail view or expandable panel with light, water, and observation history.
  • Working “watered” and “snooze” actions that update the interface and offer a brief undo path.
  • A compact weekly rhythm visualization.
  • A useful all-done state.
  • Desktop composition that makes good use of space without merely stretching the mobile column.
  • Keyboard operation, visible focus, semantic controls, and reduced-motion support.

Create index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Use CSS or inline SVG for any illustration. Add RESPONSE.md explaining the personality, interaction model, and accessibility choices. Work only in this directory.

gpt-6-astra/13-frontend-playful/app.js

'use strict';

// Embedded from PLANTS.json so opening index.html needs no server or requests.
const PLANT_DATA = {
  plants: [
    { id: 'fern', name: 'Frida', species: 'Boston fern', location: 'Bathroom', task: 'Water', due: '2 days overdue', urgency: 4, light: 'Low, indirect', history: ['Sep 19 · Misted', 'Sep 16 · Watered', 'Sep 12 · New frond'] },
    { id: 'pothos', name: 'Orbit', species: 'Golden pothos', location: 'Bookshelf', task: 'Rotate', due: 'Today', urgency: 2, light: 'Medium, indirect', history: ['Sep 20 · Watered', 'Sep 14 · Rotated', 'Sep 10 · Wiped leaves'] },
    { id: 'cactus', name: 'Dot', species: 'Bunny ears cactus', location: 'South window', task: 'Check soil', due: 'Today', urgency: 1, light: 'Bright, direct', history: ['Sep 08 · Watered', 'Sep 01 · New pad noted', 'Aug 22 · Rotated'] },
    { id: 'calathea', name: 'Drama', species: 'Calathea orbifolia', location: 'Bedroom', task: 'Mist', due: 'Tomorrow', urgency: 0, light: 'Medium, filtered', history: ['Sep 21 · Misted', 'Sep 18 · Watered', 'Sep 15 · Brown edge noted'] }
  ],
  week: [1, 3, 2, 4, 2, 1, 3]
};
const CARE = {
  Water: { icon: 'drop', past: 'Watered', prompt: 'A drink for those thirsty roots.' },
  Rotate: { icon: 'rotate', past: 'Rotated', prompt: 'A little turn toward the light.' },
  'Check soil': { icon: 'soil', past: 'Checked soil', prompt: 'Check in before reaching for water.' },
  Mist: { icon: 'drop', past: 'Misted', prompt: 'A little mist is on the list.' }
};
const STORAGE_KEY = 'moss-garden-v1';
const UNDO_MS = 12000;
const $ = (selector, root = document) => root.querySelector(selector);
const escapeHTML = value => String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, character => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[character]));
const icon = name => `<svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-${name}"/></svg>`;
const art = id => `<svg class="plant-art" viewBox="0 0 160 180" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#plant-${id}"/></svg>`;
const plantById = id => PLANT_DATA.plants.find(plant => plant.id === id);
const shortDate = date => new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }).format(date);
const localDay = (date = new Date()) => `${date.getFullYear()}-${String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
const dayNumber = day => Date.parse(`${day}T12:00:00Z`) / 86400000;
const addDays = (day, amount) => new Date((dayNumber(day) + amount) * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
const validDay = day => typeof day === 'string' && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(day) && Number.isFinite(dayNumber(day)) && addDays(day, 0) === day;
const newId = () => globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?.() || `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
let storageAvailable = true;

function loadState() {
  const initial = { version: 1, anchorDay: localDay(), tasks: {}, entries: [] };
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return initial;
    const saved = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (saved?.version !== 1 || !validDay(saved.anchorDay) || !saved.tasks || typeof saved.tasks !== 'object' || !Array.isArray(saved.entries)) return initial;
    const entries = saved.entries.filter(entry => entry && typeof entry.id === 'string' && plantById(entry.plantId) && ['water', 'task', 'observation'].includes(entry.kind) && typeof entry.label === 'string' && entry.label.length <= 280 && typeof entry.at === 'string' && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(entry.at)));
    const tasks = {};
    for (const plant of PLANT_DATA.plants) {
      const task = saved.tasks[plant.id];
      if (!task || typeof task.operationId !== 'string') continue;
      if (task.status === 'done' && typeof task.completedAt === 'string' && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(task.completedAt)) && entries.some(entry => entry.id === task.eventId && entry.plantId === plant.id && entry.kind !== 'observation')) tasks[plant.id] = task;
      if (task.status === 'snoozed' && validDay(task.dueDay)) tasks[plant.id] = task;
    }
    return { version: 1, anchorDay: saved.anchorDay, tasks, entries };
  } catch {
    storageAvailable = false;
    return initial;
  }
}

let state = loadState();
let openPlantId = null;
let returnFocusKey = null;
let renderedDay = localDay();
const dialog = $('#plant-dialog');
const toastStack = $('#toast-stack');
const receipts = new Map();

function persist() {
  try { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state)); storageAvailable = true; }
  catch { storageAvailable = false; }
  $('#storage-status').textContent = storageAvailable ? 'Saved on this device. A little space of your own.' : 'Care works for this visit. Browser storage is unavailable.';
}

function announce(message) {
  $('#announcer').textContent = '';
  window.setTimeout(() => { $('#announcer').textContent = message; }, 30);
}

function dueDay(plant) {
  const task = state.tasks[plant.id];
  if (task?.status === 'snoozed') return task.dueDay;
  return addDays(state.anchorDay, plant.due === 'Tomorrow' ? 1 : plant.due.includes('overdue') ? -2 : 0);
}

function daysUntil(plant) { return dayNumber(dueDay(plant)) - dayNumber(localDay()); }
function isDone(plant) { return state.tasks[plant.id]?.status === 'done'; }
function dueText(plant) {
  if (isDone(plant)) return 'Tended to';
  const days = daysUntil(plant);
  if (days < 0) return `${Math.abs(days)} ${days === -1 ? 'day' : 'days'} overdue`;
  if (days === 0) return 'Today';
  if (days === 1) return 'Tomorrow';
  return `In ${days} days`;
}

function queueRow(plant, upcoming = false) {
  const care = CARE[plant.task];
  const overdue = daysUntil(plant) < 0;
  const snoozed = state.tasks[plant.id]?.status === 'snoozed';
  return `<article class="plant-row ${upcoming ? 'upcoming' : ''} ${overdue ? 'overdue' : ''}" aria-label="${plant.name}, ${plant.task.toLowerCase()}, ${dueText(plant).toLowerCase()}">
    <button class="plant-art-button" data-open-plant="${plant.id}" data-return="queue-art-${plant.id}" aria-label="View ${plant.name}’s care details">${art(plant.id)}</button>
    <div class="row-copy"><div class="row-heading"><h3><button class="plant-name-button" data-open-plant="${plant.id}" data-return="queue-name-${plant.id}" aria-label="View ${plant.name}’s care details">${plant.name}</button></h3><span class="due-label">${dueText(plant)}</span></div>
    <p class="plant-meta">${plant.species} <span aria-hidden="true">·</span> ${plant.location}</p>
    <p class="task-label">${icon(care.icon)}${snoozed ? 'Snoozed · ' : ''}${plant.task}${upcoming ? '' : `<span class="sr-only">. ${care.prompt}</span>`}</p></div>
    ${upcoming ? `<button class="icon-button" data-open-plant="${plant.id}" data-return="queue-next-${plant.id}" aria-label="View ${plant.name}’s upcoming care">${icon('arrow')}</button>` : `<div class="row-actions"><button class="primary-button" data-action="complete" data-plant="${plant.id}" aria-label="Mark ${plant.name} as ${care.past.toLowerCase()}">${icon(care.icon)}${care.past}</button><button class="snooze-button" data-action="snooze" data-plant="${plant.id}" aria-label="Snooze ${plant.name}’s ${plant.task.toLowerCase()} until tomorrow">${icon('clock')}Snooze</button></div>`}
  </article>`;
}

function renderQueue() {
  const sorted = [...PLANT_DATA.plants].sort((a, b) => daysUntil(a) - daysUntil(b) || b.urgency - a.urgency);
  const pending = sorted.filter(plant => !isDone(plant) && daysUntil(plant) <= 0);
  const upcoming = sorted.filter(plant => !isDone(plant) && daysUntil(plant) > 0);
  const completed = sorted.filter(isDone);
  $('#today-queue').innerHTML = pending.map(plant => queueRow(plant)).join('');
  $('#upcoming-queue').innerHTML = upcoming.map(plant => queueRow(plant, true)).join('');
  $('#upcoming-section').hidden = !upcoming.length;
  $('#queue-count').textContent = pending.length;
  $('#queue-count').setAttribute('aria-label', `${pending.length} care ${pending.length === 1 ? 'task' : 'tasks'} remaining`);
  $('#all-done').hidden = pending.length > 0;
  $('#daily-summary').textContent = pending.length ? `${pending.length} ${pending.length === 1 ? 'plant needs' : 'plants need'} a little love` : 'A little room to breathe. All done.';
  $('.daily-pill').classList.toggle('is-done', !pending.length);
  $('#queue-intro').textContent = pending.some(plant => daysUntil(plant) < 0) ? 'Start with the one that’s waited a little longer.' : pending.length ? 'A few small moments. That’s all it takes.' : 'Nothing more needs your attention today.';
  const postponed = upcoming.filter(plant => state.tasks[plant.id]?.status === 'snoozed').length;
  $('#done-description').textContent = postponed ? `${postponed} ${postponed === 1 ? 'plant is' : 'plants are'} snoozed until tomorrow. You’ll find ${postponed === 1 ? 'it' : 'them'} below when you’re ready.` : upcoming.length ? `Today’s care is complete. ${upcoming[0].name}’s ${upcoming[0].task.toLowerCase()} is up ${dueText(upcoming[0]).toLowerCase()} — until then, enjoy the green.` : 'Every plant on your list has been cared for. Take a breath, or add a little observation to a plant’s journal.';
  $('#completed-section').hidden = !completed.length;
  const doneToday = completed.filter(plant => localDay(new Date(state.tasks[plant.id].completedAt)) === localDay()).length;
  $('#completed-summary').textContent = `${completed.length} tended to${doneToday === completed.length ? ' today' : ''}`;
  $('#completed-list').innerHTML = completed.map(plant => `<div class="completed-row">${icon('check')}<button data-open-plant="${plant.id}" data-return="completed-${plant.id}" aria-label="View ${plant.name}’s care history">${plant.name}</button><span>${CARE[plant.task].past}</span></div>`).join('');
}

function renderWeek() {
  const now = new Date();
  const todayIndex = (now.getDay() + 6) % 7;
  const monday = addDays(localDay(now), -todayIndex);
  const counts = [...PLANT_DATA.week];
  for (const entry of state.entries) {
    if (entry.kind === 'observation') continue;
    const offset = dayNumber(localDay(new Date(entry.at))) - dayNumber(monday);
    if (offset >= 0 && offset < 7) counts[offset] += 1;
  }
  const days = ['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday'];
  const max = Math.max(...counts, 1);
  const chart = $('#week-chart');
  chart.innerHTML = counts.map((count, index) => `<div class="day-column ${index === todayIndex ? 'is-today' : ''}" aria-hidden="true"><span class="day-count">${count}</span><div class="day-bar"></div><span class="day-label">${days[index].slice(0, 1)}</span></div>`).join('');
  chart.querySelectorAll('.day-bar').forEach((bar, index) => { bar.style.height = `${Math.round(16 + counts[index] / max * 53)}px`; });
  chart.setAttribute('aria-label', `Weekly care moments: ${counts.map((count, index) => `${days[index]}${index === todayIndex ? ', today,' : ''} ${count}`).join('; ')}. Today is underlined.`);
  $('#week-total').textContent = counts.reduce((sum, count) => sum + count, 0);
}

function renderCollection() {
  $('#plant-collection').innerHTML = PLANT_DATA.plants.map(plant => `<button class="collection-plant" data-open-plant="${plant.id}" data-return="collection-${plant.id}" aria-label="View ${plant.name}, ${plant.species}, ${plant.location}. ${dueText(plant)}.">${art(plant.id)}<span><span class="collection-name">${plant.name}</span><span class="collection-location">${plant.location}</span><span class="collection-status">${isDone(plant) ? '✓ Tended to' : `${plant.task} · ${dueText(plant).toLowerCase()}`}</span></span></button>`).join('');
}

function historyFor(plant) {
  const added = state.entries.filter(entry => entry.plantId === plant.id).slice().reverse().map(entry => ({ date: shortDate(new Date(entry.at)), label: entry.label, kind: entry.kind, at: entry.at }));
  const original = plant.history.map(item => {
    const [date, label] = item.split(' · ');
    return { date, label, kind: /new|brown/i.test(label) ? 'observation' : label === 'Watered' ? 'water' : 'task' };
  });
  return [...added, ...original];
}

function renderDetail({ clearDraft = false } = {}) {
  if (!openPlantId) return;
  const plant = plantById(openPlantId);
  const care = CARE[plant.task];
  const draft = clearDraft ? '' : $('#observation')?.value || '';
  const selection = $('#observation')?.selectionStart || 0;
  const focusedKey = dialog.contains(document.activeElement) ? document.activeElement.dataset.focus : null;
  const history = historyFor(plant);
  const lastWater = history.find(entry => entry.kind === 'water');
  const done = isDone(plant);
  const later = daysUntil(plant) > 0;
  const wateredToday = state.entries.some(entry => entry.plantId === plant.id && entry.kind === 'water' && localDay(new Date(entry.at)) === localDay());
  $('#plant-detail').innerHTML = `<div class="detail-top"><p class="eyebrow">FROM YOUR LITTLE JUNGLE</p><button class="icon-button close-detail" data-close-detail data-focus="close" aria-label="Close plant details" autofocus>${icon('close')}</button><div class="detail-identity">${art(plant.id)}<div><h2 id="detail-name">${plant.name}</h2><p>${plant.species}<br>${plant.location}</p></div></div></div>
    <div class="detail-body"><div class="detail-facts"><section><h3>${icon('sun')}Light</h3><p>${plant.light}</p><p class="fact-note">At home in the ${plant.location.toLowerCase()}.</p></section><section><h3>${icon('drop')}Water</h3><p>${lastWater ? `Last watered ${escapeHTML(lastWater.date)}` : 'No watering recorded yet'}</p><p class="fact-note">Check the soil before a drink.</p></section></div>
    <section class="detail-task" aria-label="Current care"><p>${done ? `${icon('check')} <strong>${care.past}.</strong> This care task is complete.` : `<strong>${plant.task}</strong> · ${dueText(plant)}${state.tasks[plant.id]?.status === 'snoozed' ? ' (snoozed)' : ''}`}<br>${care.prompt}</p>
    ${!done ? `<div class="row-actions"><button class="primary-button" data-action="complete" data-plant="${plant.id}" data-focus="complete" aria-label="Mark ${plant.name} as ${care.past.toLowerCase()}">${icon(care.icon)}${care.past}${later ? ' early' : ''}</button>${!later ? `<button class="snooze-button" data-action="snooze" data-plant="${plant.id}" data-focus="snooze" aria-label="Snooze ${plant.name}’s care until tomorrow">${icon('clock')}Snooze until tomorrow</button>` : ''}</div>` : ''}
    ${plant.task !== 'Water' ? `<button class="secondary-button extra-water" data-action="water" data-plant="${plant.id}" data-focus="water" ${wateredToday ? 'disabled' : ''} aria-label="${wateredToday ? `${plant.name} was watered today` : `Log watering for ${plant.name}`}">${icon(wateredToday ? 'check' : 'drop')}${wateredToday ? 'Watered today' : 'Log watered'}</button>` : ''}</section>
    <section class="history-section" aria-labelledby="history-heading"><h3 id="history-heading">Care & observations</h3><ol class="history-list">${history.map(entry => `<li><span class="history-date">${escapeHTML(entry.date)}</span><span>${escapeHTML(entry.label)}${entry.kind === 'observation' ? '<span class="history-kind">Observation</span>' : ''}</span></li>`).join('')}</ol></section>
    <form class="observation-form" id="observation-form"><label for="observation">Notice something new?</label><textarea id="observation" name="observation" maxlength="280" required data-focus="observation" aria-describedby="observation-hint" placeholder="A new leaf? A small victory?">${escapeHTML(draft)}</textarea><div class="form-footer"><span class="form-hint" id="observation-hint">Your little field notes. Up to 280 characters.</span><button class="secondary-button" type="submit" data-focus="save-note">Save note ${icon('arrow')}</button></div></form></div>`;
  if (focusedKey) {
    const target = $(`[data-focus="${focusedKey}"]`, dialog);
    if (target && !target.disabled) target.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    else $('.close-detail', dialog).focus({ preventScroll: true });
    if (focusedKey === 'observation') $('#observation').setSelectionRange(selection, selection);
  }
}

function renderAll(options = {}) {
  renderedDay = localDay();
  const date = $('#today-date');
  date.dateTime = renderedDay;
  date.textContent = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', weekday: 'short' }).format(new Date());
  renderQueue();
  renderWeek();
  renderCollection();
  renderDetail(options);
}

function openDetail(id, trigger) {
  if (!plantById(id)) return;
  openPlantId = id;
  returnFocusKey = trigger?.dataset.return || `collection-${id}`;
  // A new plant starts a fresh note; actions within this panel preserve its draft.
  renderDetail({ clearDraft: true });
  dialog.append(toastStack);
  dialog.append($('#announcer'));
  if (!dialog.open) dialog.showModal();
  dialog.scrollTop = 0;
}

function removeReceipt(id) {
  const receipt = receipts.get(id);
  if (!receipt) return;
  clearTimeout(receipt.timer);
  receipt.element.remove();
  receipts.delete(id);
}

function offerUndo(transaction, message) {
  // Only a plant's latest change is reversible; other plants keep their own undo.
  for (const [id, receipt] of receipts) if (receipt.transaction.plantId === transaction.plantId) removeReceipt(id);
  const element = document.createElement('div');
  element.className = 'toast';
  element.innerHTML = `<span>${escapeHTML(message)}</span><button class="toast-undo" data-undo="${transaction.id}" aria-label="Undo: ${escapeHTML(message)}">Undo</button>`;
  toastStack.append(element);
  const receipt = { element, transaction, timer: null, remaining: UNDO_MS, started: performance.now(), hovered: false };
  receipts.set(transaction.id, receipt);
  const pause = () => {
    if (receipt.timer === null) return;
    clearTimeout(receipt.timer);
    receipt.timer = null;
    receipt.remaining = Math.max(0, receipt.remaining - (performance.now() - receipt.started));
  };
  const resume = () => {
    if (receipt.hovered || element.contains(document.activeElement) || document.hidden) return;
    receipt.started = performance.now();
    clearTimeout(receipt.timer);
    receipt.timer = setTimeout(() => removeReceipt(transaction.id), Math.max(receipt.remaining, 1500));
  };
  receipt.pause = pause;
  receipt.resume = resume;
  element.addEventListener('pointerenter', () => { receipt.hovered = true; pause(); });
  element.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => { receipt.hovered = false; resume(); });
  element.addEventListener('focusin', pause);
  element.addEventListener('focusout', () => setTimeout(resume, 0));
  resume();
  announce(`${message} Undo is available for 12 seconds and stays available while focused.`);
}

function focusAfterAction(plantId) {
  if (dialog.open) return;
  const target = $(`[data-action="complete"][data-plant="${plantId}"]`) || $('#today-queue [data-action="complete"]') || $('#care-queue');
  target.focus({ preventScroll: true });
}

function act(type, plantId) {
  const plant = plantById(plantId);
  if (!plant || !['complete', 'snooze', 'water'].includes(type)) return;
  if ((type === 'complete' || type === 'snooze') && isDone(plant)) return;
  if (type === 'water' && state.entries.some(entry => entry.plantId === plantId && entry.kind === 'water' && localDay(new Date(entry.at)) === localDay())) return;
  const id = newId();
  const transaction = { id, plantId, previousTask: state.tasks[plantId] ? { ...state.tasks[plantId] } : null, changesTask: type !== 'water', eventId: null };
  let message;
  if (type === 'snooze') {
    state.tasks[plantId] = { status: 'snoozed', dueDay: addDays(localDay(), 1), operationId: id };
    message = `${plant.name}’s ${plant.task.toLowerCase()} can wait until tomorrow.`;
  } else {
    const at = new Date().toISOString();
    const label = type === 'water' ? 'Watered' : CARE[plant.task].past;
    const entry = { id: newId(), plantId, kind: label === 'Watered' ? 'water' : 'task', label, at };
    state.entries.push(entry);
    transaction.eventId = entry.id;
    if (type === 'complete') state.tasks[plantId] = { status: 'done', completedAt: at, eventId: entry.id, operationId: id };
    message = `${plant.name} ${label.toLowerCase()}. A little love, logged.`;
  }
  persist();
  renderAll();
  focusAfterAction(plantId);
  offerUndo(transaction, message);
}

function undo(id) {
  const receipt = receipts.get(id);
  if (!receipt) return;
  const transaction = receipt.transaction;
  if (transaction.eventId) state.entries = state.entries.filter(entry => entry.id !== transaction.eventId);
  if (transaction.changesTask && state.tasks[transaction.plantId]?.operationId === transaction.id) {
    if (transaction.previousTask) state.tasks[transaction.plantId] = transaction.previousTask;
    else delete state.tasks[transaction.plantId];
  }
  removeReceipt(id);
  persist();
  renderAll();
  if (dialog.open) $('.close-detail', dialog).focus({ preventScroll: true });
  else focusAfterAction(transaction.plantId);
  announce(`Undone. ${plantById(transaction.plantId).name}’s previous care record is restored.`);
}

document.addEventListener('click', event => {
  const target = event.target.closest('button');
  if (!target) return;
  if (target.hasAttribute('data-close-detail')) dialog.close();
  else if (target.dataset.openPlant) openDetail(target.dataset.openPlant, target);
  else if (target.dataset.action) act(target.dataset.action, target.dataset.plant);
  else if (target.dataset.undo) undo(target.dataset.undo);
});

dialog.addEventListener('close', () => {
  document.body.append(toastStack);
  document.body.append($('#announcer'));
  const plantId = openPlantId;
  openPlantId = null;
  const target = $(`[data-return="${returnFocusKey}"]`) || $(`[data-return="collection-${plantId}"]`) || $('#care-queue');
  target.focus({ preventScroll: true });
});

// Only a click that both starts and ends outside the panel dismisses it.
let backdropStart = false;
dialog.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => { backdropStart = event.target === dialog && outsideDialog(event); });
dialog.addEventListener('click', event => { if (backdropStart && event.target === dialog && outsideDialog(event)) dialog.close(); backdropStart = false; });
function outsideDialog(event) {
  const rect = dialog.getBoundingClientRect();
  return event.clientX < rect.left || event.clientX > rect.right || event.clientY < rect.top || event.clientY > rect.bottom;
}

document.addEventListener('submit', event => {
  if (event.target.id !== 'observation-form') return;
  event.preventDefault();
  const input = $('#observation');
  const label = input.value.trim();
  if (!label) { input.setCustomValidity('Write a little observation first.'); input.reportValidity(); return; }
  const entry = { id: newId(), plantId: openPlantId, kind: 'observation', label: label.slice(0, 280), at: new Date().toISOString() };
  state.entries.push(entry);
  persist();
  renderAll({ clearDraft: true });
  offerUndo({ id: newId(), plantId: openPlantId, changesTask: false, eventId: entry.id }, `${plantById(openPlantId).name}’s observation is saved.`);
});
document.addEventListener('input', event => { if (event.target.id === 'observation') event.target.setCustomValidity(''); });

document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
  for (const receipt of receipts.values()) document.hidden ? receipt.pause() : receipt.resume();
  if (!document.hidden && localDay() !== renderedDay) renderAll();
});
// A page left open overnight should bring tomorrow's care back into the queue.
setInterval(() => { if (localDay() !== renderedDay && !document.hidden) renderAll(); }, 60000);

renderAll();
persist();

A new leaf, a leaning stem, a tiny change — getting to know your plants is care, too.</p><span class="note-signature">You’re growing together.</span><svg class="note-leaf icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#icon-leaf"/></svg></section>

      <section class="collection-section" id="your-plants" aria-labelledby="collection-heading" tabindex="-1"><div class="section-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">GOOD COMPANY</p><h2 id="collection-heading">Your little jungle.</h2></div><span class="collection-count">4 plants, right at home</span></div><div class="collection-grid" id="plant-collection"></div></section>

    <footer class="site-footer"><a class="footer-brand" href="#top">moss.</a><span>Grow at your own pace.</span><span id="storage-status">Just you, your plants, and this device.</span></footer>
