gpt-6-astra/13-frontend-playful/styles.css

:root {
  --paper: #f7f4e9;
  --paper-deep: #eeeadc;
  --white: #fffdf6;
  --ink: #293e2c;
  --muted: #58634f;
  --line: #d7dac9;
  --green: #36543b;
  --green-dark: #253e2b;
  --sage: #e3e9d7;
  --sage-dark: #c7d4b6;
  --yellow: #e7c66d;
  --rust: #99462f;
  --peach: #f1e1d5;
  --overlay: #1b3028a6;
  --shadow: #293e2c12;
  --line-on-green: #ffffff30;
  --display: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  --body: 'Avenir Next', Avenir, 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif;
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; scroll-padding-top: 24px; }
body { margin: 0; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); font-family: var(--body); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
body:has(dialog[open]) { overflow: hidden; }
button, input, textarea { font: inherit; }
button, a, input, textarea { -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
button, a { touch-action: manipulation; }
button { color: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
a { color: inherit; text-underline-offset: 5px; }
button:disabled { cursor: default; }
button, input, textarea { border-radius: 0; }
button, a, summary, input, textarea { outline-offset: 5px; }
:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--rust); }
section[tabindex="-1"]:focus { outline: none; }
section[tabindex="-1"]:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--rust); outline-offset: 8px; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
::selection { background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); }
h1, h2, h3, p { margin: 0; }
.svg-library { position: absolute; width: 0; height: 0; overflow: hidden; }
.icon { width: 21px; height: 21px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; flex-shrink: 0; }
.sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }
.skip-link { position: fixed; top: -100px; left: 16px; padding: 12px 20px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--white); z-index: 20; }
.skip-link:focus { top: 12px; }
.page-shell { max-width: 1232px; padding: 0 48px; margin: auto; }
.site-header { min-height: 106px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 60px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: var(--display); font-size: 42px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -2.8px; text-decoration: none; }
.brand-mark { width: 34px; height: 38px; fill: none; stroke: var(--green); stroke-width: 2.2; margin-right: 10px; }
.brand-period { color: var(--rust); }
nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 30px; }
.nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; text-decoration: none; gap: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }
.nav-link.active { position: relative; }
.nav-link.active::after { position: absolute; content: ''; width: 20px; height: 3px; background: var(--green); border-radius: 50%; bottom: 1px; left: calc(50% - 10px); }
.nav-link span { font-size: 11px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 50%; width: 21px; height: 21px; display: grid; place-items: center; }
.header-note { margin-left: auto; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
.hero { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 48px 0 52px; }
.eyebrow { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 1.7px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5; }
.hero-copy > .eyebrow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; letter-spacing: 1.3px; }
.tiny-sun { font-size: 22px; line-height: 1; color: var(--rust); }
.eyebrow-rule { width: 23px; height: 1px; background: var(--line); }
.hero time { color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: .6px; text-transform: uppercase; }
h1 { font-family: var(--display); font-size: clamp(48px, 5.3vw, 69px); font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.04; letter-spacing: -3px; margin: 21px 0 18px; }
h1 em { font-weight: 400; color: var(--green); }
.hero-description { color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.75; }
.daily-pill { margin-top: 24px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 30px; padding: 9px 14px; min-height: 44px; text-decoration: none; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; background: var(--white); }
.daily-pill .icon { width: 17px; height: 17px; margin-left: 7px; }
.pill-dot { height: 7px; width: 7px; background: var(--rust); border-radius: 50%; }
.daily-pill.is-done .pill-dot { background: var(--green); }
.hero-art { position: relative; padding-top: 15px; transform: rotate(-1deg); }
.garden-illustration { width: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.garden-caption { display: block; text-align: center; font-family: var(--display); font-size: 14px; font-style: italic; transform: rotate(-3deg); padding-left: 34px; margin-top: -3px; }
.dashboard-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 300px; column-gap: 56px; align-items: start; }
.section-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; }
.section-heading .eyebrow { color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 7px; }
h2 { font-family: var(--display); font-size: 31px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -.8px; }
.count-badge { display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--sage); border-radius: 45% 55% 48% 52%; font-family: var(--display); font-size: 25px; width: 44px; height: 44px; transform: rotate(8deg); }
.queue-intro { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; margin: 12px 0 21px; }
.plant-row { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 94px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0 13px; padding: 20px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.plant-row.overdue { margin-bottom: 2px; padding: 19px 17px 19px 6px; background: var(--peach); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px 24px 8px 8px; }
.plant-art-button { width: 94px; height: 115px; grid-row: 1 / 3; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; align-self: center; border-radius: 50%; }
.plant-art { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.row-heading { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
.plant-name-button { border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0 2px 1px 0; min-height: 35px; font-family: var(--display); font-size: 25px; line-height: 1.2; text-align: left; letter-spacing: -.5px; }
.plant-name-button:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 4px; }
.due-label { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.overdue .due-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--rust); background: var(--white); border-radius: 20px; padding: 4px 8px; }
.plant-meta { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); margin: 0 0 7px; }
.task-label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; }
.task-label .icon { width: 15px; height: 15px; }
.row-actions { margin-top: 13px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.primary-button, .secondary-button { border: 1px solid var(--green); background: var(--green); color: var(--white); border-radius: 8px; min-height: 42px; padding: 8px 14px; display: inline-flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; transition: background .15s ease, transform .15s ease; }
.primary-button .icon, .secondary-button .icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
.primary-button:hover { background: var(--green-dark); }
.primary-button:active, .secondary-button:active { transform: translateY(1px); }
.secondary-button { border-color: var(--line); background: transparent; color: var(--ink); }
.secondary-button:hover { background: var(--sage); }
.snooze-button { min-height: 42px; padding: 8px 10px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; background: transparent; border: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; border-radius: 8px; }
.snooze-button .icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
.snooze-button:hover { color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); }
.upcoming-section { margin-top: 25px; }
.mini-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; }
.mini-heading h3 { font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1.4px; font-weight: 700; }
.mini-heading > span { color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--display); font-style: italic; font-size: 13px; }
.plant-row.upcoming { grid-template-columns: 72px minmax(0, 1fr) 40px; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 15px 0; }
.upcoming .plant-art-button { width: 72px; height: 80px; grid-row: auto; }
.upcoming .plant-name-button { font-size: 22px; }
.upcoming .plant-meta { margin-bottom: 3px; }
.upcoming .due-label { color: var(--ink); }
.icon-button { width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--line); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; flex-shrink: 0; }
.icon-button:hover { background: var(--sage); }
.side-column { display: grid; gap: 27px; padding-top: 2px; }
.rhythm-panel { background: var(--green); color: var(--paper); border-radius: 9px 50px 9px 9px; padding: 25px 24px 20px; }
.rhythm-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.rhythm-top .eyebrow { color: var(--sage-dark); font-size: 9px; }
.rhythm-top .icon { width: 26px; height: 26px; color: var(--yellow); }
.rhythm-panel h2 { font-size: 32px; }
.rhythm-panel > p { color: var(--sage-dark); font-size: 12px; margin: 8px 0 22px; }
.week-chart { height: 118px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; align-items: end; }
.day-column { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; height: 100%; position: relative; gap: 7px; }
.day-bar { width: 20px; max-width: 100%; border-radius: 12px 12px 3px 3px; background: var(--sage-dark); position: relative; }
.day-column.is-today .day-bar { background: var(--yellow); border-radius: 12px 12px 7px 7px; }
.day-count { font-size: 10px; color: var(--paper); }
.day-label { font-size: 10px; color: var(--sage-dark); }
.day-column.is-today .day-label { color: var(--yellow); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; }
.rhythm-footer { border-top: 1px solid var(--line-on-green); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; margin-top: 22px; padding-top: 15px; font-size: 10px; }
.rhythm-footer > span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.rhythm-footer strong { font-family: var(--display); font-size: 21px; font-weight: 400; }
.legend-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; background: var(--sage-dark); border-radius: 50%; }
.field-note { position: relative; margin: 0 7px; padding: 29px 24px 31px; background: var(--paper-deep); border-radius: 2px 2px 36px 2px; transform: rotate(-2deg); }
.note-pin { position: absolute; width: 40px; height: 15px; left: calc(50% - 20px); top: -7px; background: var(--sage-dark); opacity: .85; transform: rotate(6deg); }
.field-note .eyebrow { font-size: 9px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 15px; }
.field-note h2 { font-size: 28px; font-style: italic; }

glm-5.3/13-frontend-playful/RESPONSE.md

Moss — response notes

Personality

Moss is a warm, slightly odd plant companion: a mossy pebble with a sprout, blush cheeks, and a small lie-down philosophy. The voice is gentle and wry ("Frida’s fronds droop politely when thirsty", "Drama demands humidity, as is Drama’s way") — never scolding, never infantilizing. Visually this reads through: a lowercase wordmark, wavy underlines on headings, asymmetric blob radii on cards and illustration tiles, hand-drawn inline SVG portraits per plant (each plant gets its own accent color), and a dotted paper background. No clip art, no gradients-as-decoration, no glass panels; rows are visually distinct through color, illustration, tilt, and state rather than a wall of identical cards.

Interaction model

  • Queue — an <ol> sorted overdue-first: Frida (2 days overdue) carries a terracotta "2 days overdue" pill plus a "Needs you most" pennant; then today’s tasks by urgency; then tomorrow.
  • Actions — each row has a tactile press-down primary button labeled with the actual verb (Watered / Rotated / Checked / Misted) and a dashed Snooze button. Acting swaps the buttons for a status chip, plays a little "bloom" wiggle on the plant portrait, and updates the summary, "at a glance" stats, and Moss’s mood message.
  • Undo — every action raises a toast (role="status") with an Undo button for ~7 seconds; undoing rewinds the state, restores the row’s buttons and position, refocuses the primary button, and confirms with a short "Rewound" note. Single-level undo keeps this predictable.
  • Detail panel — "Light & history" toggles an inline panel per plant with the light preference and a dotted timeline of water/mist/rotation and observation history ("New frond", "Brown edge noted").
  • Weekly rhythm — a compact SVG bar chart of care moments per day; today’s bar is deep moss green with a dot under its label, and the busiest day gets a clay dot with a caption.
  • All-done — when every plant is handled, the queue is replaced by a celebration: sleeping Moss, drifting leaf confetti, a log of what happened to each plant, and a "Replay today" button so the state is explorable.
  • Snoozing sinks a plant below the active ones with a cool blue "Snoozed · tomorrow" pill, making room for what actually needs attention.

Accessibility choices

  • Semantic HTML throughout: <ol> for the prioritized queue, real <button>s for every control, aria-expanded/aria-controls on the panel toggles with role="region" panels, <dl> for stats, <figure> for the chart.
  • Full keyboard operation: everything is a native button; after an action, focus moves to the status chip so the keyboard position isn’t lost; moving into the all-done state focuses its heading; undo restores focus to the row’s primary button.
  • A skip link jumps past the hero to the queue.
  • Visible focus everywhere via a thick :focus-visible outline with offset.
  • The toast is an aria-live="polite" region, so water/snooze/undo feedback is announced without stealing focus.
  • The rhythm chart carries an aria-label with the full data ("Care moments per day…") plus a visible caption; stats are also plain text.
  • prefers-reduced-motion disables the sway, bloom, panel pop, confetti, and toast animations, and smooth scrolling.
  • Warm-but-tested contrast: dark brown ink on cream/paper (≈10:1), cream text on moss and terracotta fills; status is never conveyed by color alone (pills always include text).

Layout

Mobile-first single column. From 920px the layout becomes a two-column grid — queue on the left, and a sticky sidebar (at-a-glance stats, weekly rhythm, "Moss says" mood) on the right — so desktop gains a real second information lane instead of a stretched phone column; detail panels widen into two columns at 620px.

Constraints honored

Plain HTML/CSS/JS only — no frameworks, no fonts, no requests, no storage; all illustrations are inline SVG, and all state lives in memory (open index.html directly in a browser).

glm-5.3/13-frontend-playful/TASK.md

Task 13 — Frontend design: playful mobile-first product

Build a polished mobile-first web app screen for Moss, a gentle household plant-care companion. Use only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: no frameworks, package installs, remote assets, external fonts, or network requests.

Visual direction: warm, tactile, optimistic, and a little odd. Use an expressive shape language and small moments of delight while keeping text readable and controls obvious. Avoid childish clip art, neon gradients, glass panels, and a wall of indistinguishable cards.

The experience must include:

  • Today's care queue for the four plants in PLANTS.json, clearly prioritizing overdue care.
  • A plant detail view or expandable panel with light, water, and observation history.
  • Working “watered” and “snooze” actions that update the interface and offer a brief undo path.
  • A compact weekly rhythm visualization.
  • A useful all-done state.
  • Desktop composition that makes good use of space without merely stretching the mobile column.
  • Keyboard operation, visible focus, semantic controls, and reduced-motion support.

Create index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Use CSS or inline SVG for any illustration. Add RESPONSE.md explaining the personality, interaction model, and accessibility choices. Work only in this directory.

glm-5.3/13-frontend-playful/app.js

/* Moss — gentle plant care. No network, no storage, no drama. */
(() => {
  "use strict";

  /* ————— Data (mirrors PLANTS.json) ————— */

  const PLANTS = [
    { id: "fern", name: "Frida", species: "Boston fern", location: "Bathroom", task: "Water", due: "2 days overdue", urgency: 4, light: "Low, indirect", history: ["Sep 19 · Misted", "Sep 16 · Watered", "Sep 12 · New frond"] },
    { id: "pothos", name: "Orbit", species: "Golden pothos", location: "Bookshelf", task: "Rotate", due: "Today", urgency: 2, light: "Medium, indirect", history: ["Sep 20 · Watered", "Sep 14 · Rotated", "Sep 10 · Wiped leaves"] },
    { id: "cactus", name: "Dot", species: "Bunny ears cactus", location: "South window", task: "Check soil", due: "Today", urgency: 1, light: "Bright, direct", history: ["Sep 08 · Watered", "Sep 01 · New pad noted", "Aug 22 · Rotated"] },
    { id: "calathea", name: "Drama", species: "Calathea orbifolia", location: "Bedroom", task: "Mist", due: "Tomorrow", urgency: 0, light: "Medium, filtered", history: ["Sep 21 · Misted", "Sep 18 · Watered", "Sep 15 · Brown edge noted"] }
  ];
  const WEEK = [1, 3, 2, 4, 2, 1, 3];
  const DAY_LETTERS = ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"];
  const DAY_FULL = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"];

  PLANTS.forEach((p) => {
    p.hist = p.history.map((s) => {
      const [d, t] = s.split(" · ");
      return { d, t };
    });
  });

  const ACC = {
    fern: ["#5d7c4e", "#dfe8d2"],
    pothos: ["#a3903c", "#efe6c4"],
    cactus: ["#6f9d84", "#dcead9"],
    calathea: ["#8d7fa8", "#e3ddec"]
  };
  const VERB = { Water: "Watered", Rotate: "Rotated", "Check soil": "Checked", Mist: "Misted" };
  const DONE_MSG = {
    fern: "Frida got a long, grateful drink.",
    pothos: "Orbit took a quarter-turn toward the window.",
    cactus: "Dot’s soil was checked — sleepy, but fine.",
    calathea: "Drama received the spa-mist treatment."
  };
  const NOTE = {
    fern: "Frida’s fronds droop politely when thirsty.",
    pothos: "Orbit leans toward the window mid-chapter.",
    cactus: "Dot’s soil may still be sleepy from August.",
    calathea: "Drama demands humidity, as is Drama’s way."
  };

  /* ————— Little icons (inline SVG) ————— */

  const ICONS = {
    check: '<svg class="ic" viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3.5 11l4.5 4.5L16.5 5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>',
    moon: '<svg class="ic" viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M13 3a7.2 7.2 0 1 0 4 9.4A6.4 6.4 0 0 1 13 3Z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>',
    chev: '<svg class="ic" viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 7.5 10 13l6-5.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>',
    sun: '<svg class="ic" viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="3.6" fill="#d9a13c"/><g stroke="#d9a13c" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M10 1.5v2M10 16.5v2M1.5 10h2M16.5 10h2M4 4l1.4 1.4M14.6 14.6 16 16M16 4l-1.4 1.4M5.4 14.6 4 16"/></g></svg>',
    flag: '<svg class="ic" viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 2v16" stroke="#c05a35" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M6.5 3.5h9l-3 3.2 3 3.3h-9z" fill="#c05a35"/></svg>'
  };

  /* ————— Plant portraits (inline SVG) ————— */

  const ART = {
    fern: `<svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" aria-hidden="true">
      <g fill="none" stroke="#516c3c" stroke-width="3.4" stroke-linecap="round">
        <path d="M32 60C31 42 27 26 19 12"/>
        <path d="M32 60C32 40 32 24 34 8"/>
        <path d="M32 60C34 44 39 27 47 14"/>
        <path d="M32 60C25 48 16 41 7 38"/>
        <path d="M32 60C39 48 49 42 57 40"/>
      </g>
      <g fill="#7fa55e">
        <circle cx="27" cy="44" r="2.6"/><circle cx="22" cy="30" r="2.6"/><circle cx="18" cy="19" r="2.4"/>
        <circle cx="33" cy="46" r="2.6"/><circle cx="33" cy="32" r="2.6"/><circle cx="34" cy="17" r="2.4"/>
        <circle cx="38" cy="45" r="2.6"/><circle cx="43" cy="30" r="2.6"/><circle cx="46" cy="19" r="2.4"/>
        <circle cx="21" cy="46" r="2.2"/><circle cx="13" cy="40" r="2.2"/>
        <circle cx="44" cy="47" r="2.2"/><circle cx="52" cy="41" r="2.2"/>
      </g>
    </svg>`,
    pothos: `<svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" aria-hidden="true">
      <path d="M8 58C22 52 18 42 28 33c9-8 16-14 28-20" fill="none" stroke="#6b8a4a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <ellipse cx="19" cy="46" rx="8" ry="5.6" fill="#7fa05a" transform="rotate(-22 19 46)"/>
      <ellipse cx="33" cy="32" rx="9" ry="6.4" fill="#a4bb61" transform="rotate(-28 33 32)"/>
      <ellipse cx="47" cy="19" rx="8" ry="5.6" fill="#7fa05a" transform="rotate(-38 47 19)"/>
      <ellipse cx="12" cy="54" rx="5.6" ry="4.2" fill="#b7c46e" transform="rotate(14 12 54)"/>
      <ellipse cx="55" cy="26" rx="5.6" ry="4.2" fill="#b7c46e" transform="rotate(60 55 26)"/>
    </svg>`,
    cactus: `<svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" aria-hidden="true">
      <g fill="#7fae8f" stroke="#5d8d70" stroke-width="2.4">
        <rect x="16" y="24" width="13" height="34" rx="6.5"/>
        <rect x="35" y="16" width="13" height="42" rx="6.5"/>
        <rect x="26" y="36" width="12" height="22" rx="6"/>
      </g>
      <g stroke="#f4e9c8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round">
        <path d="M16 32l-6-4"/><path d="M17 44l-6 4"/>
        <path d="M44 24l6-4"/><path d="M45 36l6 4"/>
        <path d="M28 26l-4-6"/><path d="M28 46l-4 6"/>
      </g>
      <circle cx="41.5" cy="13.5" r="4.2" fill="#e8a1a8"/>
    </svg>`,
    calathea: `<svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" aria-hidden="true">
      <path d="M32 60V44" stroke="#5a7a55" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
      <ellipse cx="19" cy="40" rx="10" ry="13" fill="#94ab73" transform="rotate(-22 19 40)"/>
      <ellipse cx="34" cy="30" rx="16" ry="20" fill="#7c9a6d" transform="rotate(6 34 30)"/>
      <g fill="none" stroke="#d9e6c8" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round">
        <path d="M33 48C26 40 25 24 29 13"/>
        <path d="M34 48C34 38 35 22 36 12"/>
        <path d="M36 48C42 40 44 25 41 14"/>
        <path d="M15 46c-3-4-3-10 1-15"/>
        <path d="M22 46c-3-4-3-10 1-14"/>
      </g>
    </svg>`
  };

  /* ————— Moss the mascot ————— */

  function mossSVG(mood) {
    const asleep = mood === "sleep";
    const eyes = asleep
      ? '<path d="M31 52q4.5 5 9 0M56 52q4.5 5 9 0" fill="none" stroke="#2e2a20" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>'
      : '<circle cx="35.5" cy="52" r="3.6" fill="#2e2a20"/><circle cx="60.5" cy="52" r="3.6" fill="#2e2a20"/>';
    const zzz = asleep
      ? '<g class="zzz" fill="#8a7a5c" font-weight="700"><text x="64" y="34" font-size="15">z</text><text x="74" y="22" font-size="12">z</text><text x="82" y="12" font-size="10">z</text></g>'
      : "";
    return `<svg viewBox="0 0 96 108" aria-hidden="true">
      <path d="M48 24C49 17 48 12 48 8" fill="none" stroke="#5c7a45" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <ellipse cx="39" cy="9" rx="8.5" ry="4.6" fill="#7fae5e" transform="rotate(-16 39 9)"/>
      <ellipse cx="57" cy="9" rx="8.5" ry="4.6" fill="#93bd6d" transform="rotate(16 57 9)"/>
      <path d="M48 26c21 0 40 14 40 34 0 21-17 34-40 34S8 81 8 60C8 40 27 26 48 26Z" fill="#8fa96b"/>
      <g fill="#759058"><circle cx="27" cy="44" r="2.8"/><circle cx="70" cy="60" r="2.4"/><circle cx="42" cy="88" r="2.8"/><circle cx="67" cy="38" r="2.2"/><circle cx="22" cy="66" r="2.2"/></g>
      <ellipse cx="29" cy="60" rx="4.6" ry="2.8" fill="#d99f76" opacity=".55"/>
      <ellipse cx="67" cy="60" rx="4.6" ry="2.8" fill="#d99f76" opacity=".55"/>
      ${eyes}
      <path d="M43 64q5 5 10 0" fill="none" stroke="#2e2a20" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      ${zzz}
    </svg>`;
  }

  /* ————— State ————— */

  const state = { handled: {}, open: new Set() };
  const rows = new Map();
  let hideTimer = null;
  let wasAllDone = false;

  /* ————— Elements ————— */

  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const list = $("queue-list");
  const queueTitle = $("queue-title");
  const queueSummary = $("queue-summary");
  const allDoneBox = $("all-done");
  const allDoneTitle = $("all-done-title");
  const doneLog = $("done-log");
  const toastBox = $("toast");
  const moodArt = $("mood-moss");
  const moodMsg = $("mood-msg");

  /* ————— Helpers ————— */

  const plant = (id) => PLANTS.find((p) => p.id === id);
  const dueClass = (due) => (due.includes("overdue") ? "overdue" : due === "Today" ? "today" : "tomorrow");

  function defaultActionsHTML(p) {
    return `
      <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-action="done" data-id="${p.id}">${ICONS.check}<span>${VERB[p.task]}</span></button>
      <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" data-action="snooze" data-id="${p.id}">${ICONS.moon}<span>Snooze</span></button>
      <button type="button" class="btn btn-details" data-action="toggle" data-id="${p.id}" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="panel-${p.id}">
        <span>Light &amp; history</span>${ICONS.chev}
      </button>`;
  }

  function buildRow(p) {
    const li = document.createElement("li");
    li.className = "plant-row";
    li.dataset.id = p.id;
    li.style.setProperty("--accent", ACC[p.id][0]);
    li.style.setProperty("--accent-soft", ACC[p.id][1]);
    li.innerHTML = `
      <div class="row-main">
        <div class="art-wrap" aria-hidden="true">${ART[p.id]}</div>
        <div class="row-info">
          <p class="row-topline"><span class="due-pill" data-due="${dueClass(p.due)}">${p.due}</span></p>
          <h3 class="plant-name">${p.name}</h3>
          <p class="plant-meta">${p.species} · ${p.location}</p>
          <p class="plant-note">${NOTE[p.id]}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="row-actions" role="group" aria-label="${p.name} actions">${defaultActionsHTML(p)}</div>
      <div class="plant-panel" id="panel-${p.id}" role="region" aria-label="${p.name}: light and history" hidden>
        <div class="panel-inner">
          <div class="panel-light">
            <h4>Light at ${p.location}</h4>
            <p class="light-line">${ICONS.sun}<span>${p.light}</span></p>
          </div>
          <div class="panel-history">
            <h4>Recent notes</h4>
            <ol class="history">${p.hist
              .map((h) => `<li><span class="hist-date">${h.d}</span> ${h.t}</li>`)
              .join("")}</ol>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    return li;
  }

  function sortedIds() {
    const rank = (p) => {
      const k = state.handled[p.id];
      if (k === "watered") return 300;
      if (k === "snoozed") return 200;
      return 100 - p.urgency;
    };
    return [...PLANTS].sort((a, b) => rank(a) - rank(b)).map((p) => p.id);
  }

  function orderRows() {
    sortedIds().forEach((id) => list.appendChild(rows.get(id)));
    list.querySelectorAll(".flag").forEach((f) => f.remove());
    const firstOverdue = sortedIds().find(
      (id) => !state.handled[id] && dueClass(plant(id).due) === "overdue"
    );
    if (firstOverdue) {
      rows.get(firstOverdue)
        .querySelector(".row-topline")
        .insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", `<span class="flag">${ICONS.flag}<span>Needs you most</span></span>`);
    }
  }

  function setHandledUI(p) {
    const kind = state.handled[p.id] || null;
    const li = rows.get(p.id);
    li.classList.toggle("is-done", kind === "watered");
    li.classList.toggle("is-snoozed", kind === "snoozed");
    li.classList.toggle("is-overdue", !kind && dueClass(p.due) === "overdue");
    const pill = li.querySelector(".due-pill");
    const actions = li.querySelector(".row-actions");
    if (!kind) {
      pill.textContent = p.due;
      pill.dataset.due = dueClass(p.due);
      actions.innerHTML = defaultActionsHTML(p);
      const open = state.open.has(p.id);
      const btn = actions.querySelector('[data-action="toggle"]');
      if (btn) btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
      return null;
    }
    if (kind === "watered") {
      pill.textContent = "Tended today";
      pill.dataset.due = "done";
      actions.innerHTML = `<p class="status-chip chip-done" tabindex="-1">${ICONS.check}<span>${VERB[p.task]} · today</span></p>`;
    } else {
      pill.textContent = "Snoozed · tomorrow";
      pill.dataset.due = "snoozed";
      actions.innerHTML = `<p class="status-chip chip-snooze" tabindex="-1">${ICONS.moon}<span>Snoozed till tomorrow</span></p>`;
    }
    return actions.querySelector(".status-chip");
  }

  function celebrate(id) {
    const art = rows.get(id)?.querySelector(".art-wrap");
    if (!art) return;
    art.classList.remove("bloom");
    void art.offsetWidth;
    art.classList.add("bloom");
  }

  /* ————— Toast + undo ————— */

  function showToast(msg, onUndo) {
    clearTimeout(hideTimer);
    toastBox.textContent = "";
    const card = document.createElement("div");
    card.className = "toast-card";
    const msgP = document.createElement("p");
    msgP.className = "toast-msg";
    msgP.textContent = msg;
    card.append(msgP);
    if (onUndo) {
      const btn = document.createElement("button");
      btn.type = "button";
      btn.className = "btn btn-primary btn-undo";
      btn.textContent = "Undo";
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        hideToast();
        onUndo();
      });
      card.append(btn);
    }
    toastBox.append(card);
    toastBox.classList.add("show");
    hideTimer = setTimeout(hideToast, 7000);
  }
  function hideToast() {
    clearTimeout(hideTimer);
    toastBox.classList.remove("show");
  }

  /* ————— Actions ————— */

  function doDone(p) {
    state.handled[p.id] = "watered";
    const chip = setHandledUI(p);
    celebrate(p.id);
    orderRows();
    updateAll();
    showToast(DONE_MSG[p.id], () => revertTo(p, null));
    if (chip) chip.focus();
  }

  function doSnooze(p) {
    state.handled[p.id] = "snoozed";
    const chip = setHandledUI(p);
    orderRows();
    updateAll();
    showToast(`${p.name} will wait until tomorrow — no hard feelings.`, () => revertTo(p, null));
    if (chip) chip.focus();
  }

  function revertTo(p, prev) {
    if (prev == null) delete state.handled[p.id];
    else state.handled[p.id] = prev;
    setHandledUI(p);
    orderRows();
    updateAll();
    const btn = rows.get(p.id).querySelector(".btn-primary");
    if (btn) btn.focus();
    showToast(`Rewound — ${p.name} is back on today’s plate.`);
  }

  function doToggle(id, btn) {
    const panel = document.getElementById("panel-" + id);
    const willOpen = btn.getAttribute("aria-expanded") !== "true";
    btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(willOpen));
    if (willOpen) {
      state.open.add(id);
      panel.hidden = false;
      panel.classList.remove("pop");
      void panel.offsetWidth;
      panel.classList.add("pop");
    } else {
      state.open.delete(id);
      panel.hidden = true;
    }
  }

  /* ————— Summary / mood / all-done ————— */

  function computeStats() {
    const active = PLANTS.filter((p) => !state.handled[p.id]);
    return {
      active: active.length,
      overdue: active.filter((p) => dueClass(p.due) === "overdue").length,
      tended: PLANTS.filter((p) => state.handled[p.id] === "watered").length,
      snoozed: PLANTS.filter((p) => state.handled[p.id] === "snoozed").length
    };
  }

  function moodMessage(s) {
    if (s.overdue > 0) return "Someone is overdue and slightly dramatic about it. We’re coming, we’re coming.";
    if (s.active > 0) return `${s.active} little ${s.active === 1 ? "job" : "jobs"} before sunset. Moss believes in you.`;
    return "Everything is calm. Moss is having a small lie-down in the shade.";
  }

  function updateAll() {
    const s = computeStats();
    const allDone = s.active === 0;

    queueSummary.textContent = allDone
      ? "All four tended. Go put the kettle on."
      : `${s.active} to care for · ${s.overdue} overdue` + (s.snoozed ? ` · ${s.snoozed} snoozed` : "") + (s.tended ? ` · ${s.tended} done` : "");
    $("g-active").textContent = s.active;
    $("g-overdue").textContent = s.overdue;
    $("g-done").textContent = s.tended;
    moodMsg.textContent = moodMessage(s);
    moodArt.innerHTML = mossSVG(allDone ? "sleep" : "awake");

    allDoneBox.hidden = !allDone;
    list.hidden = allDone;
    if (allDone) {
      doneLog.innerHTML = PLANTS.map((p) =>
        state.handled[p.id] === "watered"
          ? `<li>${ICONS.check}<span><strong>${p.name}</strong> — ${VERB[p.task].toLowerCase()}, happily</span></li>`
          : `<li>${ICONS.moon}<span><strong>${p.name}</strong> — snoozed till tomorrow</span></li>`
      ).join("");
      if (!wasAllDone) allDoneTitle.focus();
    }
    wasAllDone = allDone;
  }

  /* ————— Weekly rhythm ————— */

  function renderRhythm() {
    const todayIdx = (new Date().getDay() + 6) % 7;
    const W = 26, GAP = 10, x0 = 8, baseY = 92, maxH = 62;
    const max = Math.max(...WEEK);
    const peakIdx = WEEK.indexOf(max);
    let bars = "";
    WEEK.forEach((v, i) => {
      const h = 12 + (v / max) * maxH;
      const x = x0 + i * (W + GAP);
      const y = baseY - h;
      const today = i === todayIdx;
      bars += `<rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${W}" height="${h}" rx="11" fill="${today ? "#556639" : "#c2cfa2"}"${today ? ' class="bar-today"' : ""}/>`;
      if (v === max) bars += `<circle cx="${x + W / 2}" cy="${y - 9}" r="4" fill="#c05a35"/>`;
      bars += `<text x="${x + W / 2}" y="${baseY + 17}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#6f6049">${DAY_LETTERS[i]}</text>`;
      if (today) bars += `<circle cx="${x + W / 2}" cy="${baseY + 25}" r="2.6" fill="#c05a35"/>`;
    });
    const label = `Care moments per day, Monday through Sunday: ${WEEK.map((v, i) => `${DAY_FULL[i]} ${v}`).join(", ")}. Today is ${DAY_FULL[todayIdx]}.`;
    $("rhythm").innerHTML = `
      <svg viewBox="0 0 258 122" role="img" aria-label="${label}">${bars}</svg>
      <figcaption>Clay dot marks the busiest day (${DAY_FULL[peakIdx]}). Today: ${DAY_FULL[todayIdx]}.</figcaption>`;
  }

  /* ————— Wiring ————— */

  document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    const btn = e.target.closest("[data-action]");
    if (!btn) return;
    const { action, id } = btn.dataset;
    if (action === "done") doDone(plant(id));
    else if (action === "snooze") doSnooze(plant(id));
    else if (action === "toggle") doToggle(id, btn);
  });

  $("replay").addEventListener("click", () => {
    PLANTS.forEach((p) => delete state.handled[p.id]);
    PLANTS.forEach((p) => setHandledUI(p));
    orderRows();
    updateAll();
    hideToast();
    queueTitle.focus();
  });

  function init() {
    $("today-line").textContent = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, {
      weekday: "long",
      month: "long",
      day: "numeric"
    }).format(new Date());
    $("hero-moss").innerHTML = mossSVG("awake");
    $("all-done-art").innerHTML = mossSVG("sleep");
    PLANTS.forEach((p) => rows.set(p.id, buildRow(p)));
    orderRows();
    renderRhythm();
    updateAll();
  }

  init();
})();

glm-5.3/13-frontend-playful/index.html

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="light">
<title>Moss — gentle plant care</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
<script src="app.js" defer></script>
</head>
<body>

<a class="skip-link" href="#queue-list">Skip to today’s care queue</a>

<header class="hero">
  <div class="wrap hero-inner">
    <div class="hero-art" id="hero-moss" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    <h1 class="wordmark">moss<svg class="wordmark-leaf" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 22V10" stroke="#5c7a45" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/><path d="M12 12C12 6 6 3 2.5 3 3 9 7 13 12 12Z" fill="#7fae5e"/><path d="M12 15c0-5 5-8 8.5-8-.5 6-4.5 9-8.5 8Z" fill="#93bd6d"/></svg></h1>
    <p class="tagline">A gentle household plant companion. Small care, no guilt, occasional gossip.</p>
    <p class="hero-kicker" id="today-line">Today</p>
  </div>
  <svg class="wave" viewBox="0 0 1440 64" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M0 32C120 58 240 6 360 22 480 38 540 58 660 44 780 30 860 8 980 26 1100 44 1180 58 1300 40 1360 32 1400 24 1440 30L1440 64 0 64Z" fill="#f6efdd"/></svg>
</header>

<main class="wrap layout">
  <section class="queue-col" aria-labelledby="queue-title">
    <div class="queue-head">
      <h2 id="queue-title" tabindex="-1">today’s care queue</h2>
      <p class="queue-sub">Overdue friends first — that’s the whole trick.</p>
      <p class="queue-summary" id="queue-summary"></p>
    </div>

    <ol class="queue" id="queue-list"></ol>

    <section class="all-done" id="all-done" aria-labelledby="all-done-title" hidden>
      <div class="confetti" aria-hidden="true"><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
      <div class="all-done-art" id="all-done-art" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      <h2 id="all-done-title" tabindex="-1">all tended</h2>
      <p class="all-done-sub">Every leaf got its thing. The windowsill is basically a spa.</p>
      <ul class="done-log" id="done-log"></ul>
      <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" id="replay">Replay today</button>
    </section>
  </section>

  <aside class="side" aria-label="This week at a glance">
    <section class="side-card glance-card">
      <h2>at a glance</h2>
      <dl class="glance">
        <div class="glance-item"><dt>need you</dt><dd id="g-active">4</dd></div>
        <div class="glance-item"><dt>overdue</dt><dd id="g-overdue">1</dd></div>
        <div class="glance-item"><dt>tended</dt><dd id="g-done">0</dd></div>
      </dl>
    </section>

    <section class="side-card rhythm-card" aria-labelledby="rhythm-title">
      <h2 id="rhythm-title">weekly rhythm</h2>
      <figure class="rhythm" id="rhythm"></figure>
    </section>

    <section class="side-card mood-card">
      <h2>moss says</h2>
      <div class="mood-row">
        <div class="mood-art" id="mood-moss" aria-hidden="true"></div>
        <p id="mood-msg"></p>
      </div>
    </section>
  </aside>
</main>

<footer class="wrap footer">Moss keeps no secrets — everything lives on this page.</footer>

<div id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>

</body>
</html>

glm-5.3/13-frontend-playful/styles.css

/* ————— Moss: warm, tactile, a little odd ————— */

:root {
  --bg: #f6efdd;
  --paper: #fffdf4;
  --ink: #3d3226;
  --ink-soft: #6f6049;
  --line: #e0d5b8;
  --clay: #c05a35;
  --clay-soft: #fdf0e3;
  --moss: #556639;
  --moss-deep: #33401f;
  --sun: #d9a13c;
  --sky: #7d9ab0;
  --body: "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }

html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--ink);
  font: 400 16px/1.5 var(--body);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

svg { display: block; }
h1, h2, h3 { line-height: 1.15; }
::selection { background: #e5c56b; }

:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid #2f241a;
  outline-offset: 3px;
  border-radius: 4px;
}

.skip-link {
  position: absolute;
  left: 14px;
  top: -70px;
  z-index: 100;
  background: var(--moss-deep);
  color: #f7f4e3;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 650;
  transition: top 0.2s ease;
}
.skip-link:focus { top: 14px; }

.wrap { max-width: 1060px; margin-inline: auto; padding-inline: 18px; }

/* ————— Hero ————— */

.hero {
  background-color: #e7ecd6;
  background-image: radial-gradient(#d5dbbd 1.4px, transparent 1.4px);
  background-size: 26px 26px;
  padding-top: 30px;
}
.hero-inner { text-align: center; padding-bottom: 24px; }
.hero-art svg { width: 92px; margin: 0 auto; }
.wave { display: block; width: 100%; height: 46px; margin-bottom: -2px; }

.wordmark {
  margin: 10px 0 4px;
  font-size: clamp(44px, 9vw, 62px);
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  color: var(--moss-deep);
}
.wordmark-leaf {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 0.42em;
  height: 0.42em;
  margin-left: 0.06em;
  animation: sway 4.5s ease-in-out infinite;
  transform-origin: 50% 90%;
}
@keyframes sway {
  0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-6deg); }
  50% { transform: rotate(10deg); }
}

.tagline {
  margin: 0 auto;
  max-width: 38ch;
  color: #4d5a33;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}
.hero-kicker {
  display: inline-block;
  margin: 16px 0 0;
  background: var(--paper);
  border: 2px solid #d8d3b6;
  padding: 6px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-weight: 650;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
}

/* ————— Layout ————— */

.layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 36px;
  padding-block: 30px 56px;
}

h2 {
  font-size: 1.3rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  margin: 0 0 0.8em;
  text-decoration: underline wavy var(--clay);
  text-decoration-thickness: 3px;
  text-underline-offset: 9px;
}
.side-card h2 { font-size: 1.05rem; }

.queue-sub { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 0.95rem; }
.queue-summary { margin: 8px 0 0; font-weight: 650; }

/* ————— Queue ————— */

.queue {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 18px 0 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
}

.plant-row {
  background: var(--paper);
  border: 2px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 22px;
  padding: 16px 16px 15px;
  transition: background 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease, opacity 0.25s ease;
}
.plant-row.is-overdue {
  background: var(--clay-soft);
  border-color: #d68d64;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 0 rgba(192, 90, 53, 0.22);
}
.plant-row.is-snoozed { background: #f1f3ec; border-color: #c6cdd2; }
.plant-row.is-done { background: #eef0df; border-color: #b9c2a4; border-style: dashed; }

.row-main { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: center; }

.art-wrap {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 72px;
  height: 72px;
  background: var(--accent-soft, #eee);
  border-radius: 48% 52% 55% 45% / 55% 45% 52% 48%;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
}
.plant-row:nth-child(odd) .art-wrap { transform: rotate(-4deg); }
.plant-row:nth-child(even) .art-wrap { transform: rotate(3deg); }
.plant-row:hover .art-wrap,
.plant-row:focus-within .art-wrap { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.05); }
.art-wrap svg { width: 54px; height: 54px; }

@keyframes bloom {
  0% { transform: rotate(0) scale(1); }
  30% { transform: rotate(-8deg) scale(1.12); }
  60% { transform: rotate(6deg) scale(1.06); }
  100% { transform: rotate(0) scale(1); }
}
.art-wrap.bloom { animation: bloom 0.65s ease; }

.row-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.row-topline { margin: 0 0 6px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }

.due-pill {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.07em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 4px 11px;
  border-radius: 999px;
}
.due-pill[data-due="overdue"] { background: var(--clay); color: #fff7ec; }
.due-pill[data-due="today"] { background: var(--sun); color: var(--ink); }
.due-pill[data-due="tomorrow"] { background: transparent; color: var(--ink-soft); border: 1.5px dashed #b0a486; }
.due-pill[data-due="done"] { background: var(--moss); color: #f2f5e2; }
.due-pill[data-due="snoozed"] { background: var(--sky); color: #f4f8fb; }

.flag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--clay);
}
.flag .ic { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

.plant-name { margin: 0 0 2px; font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
.plant-meta { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 0.92rem; }
.plant-note { margin: 5px 0 0; color: #7b6d52; font-size: 0.92rem; font-style: italic; }

/* ————— Buttons ————— */

.btn {
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 650;
  border-radius: 13px;
  padding: 9px 15px;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  background: var(--paper);
  color: var(--ink);
  border: 2px solid var(--ink);
  box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--ink);
  transition: transform 0.16s ease, box-shadow 0.16s ease;
}
.btn:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--ink); }

.btn-primary { background: var(--moss); border-color: var(--moss-deep); color: #f7f4e3; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--moss-deep); }
.btn-primary:active { box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--moss-deep); }

.btn-ghost {
  background: transparent;
  border: 2px dashed #8d7f63;
  color: var(--ink);
  box-shadow: none;
}
.btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

.btn-details {
  background: transparent;
  border: 2px dashed #b3a784;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  box-shadow: none;
}
.btn-details[aria-expanded="true"] .ic { transform: rotate(180deg); }
.btn-details .ic { transition: transform 0.2s ease; }
.btn-details:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

.ic { width: 17px; height: 17px; flex: none; }

.row-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  margin: 14px 0 0;
  padding-left: 86px;
  align-items: center;
}
@media (max-width: 460px) { .row-actions { padding-left: 0; } }

.status-chip {
  margin: 0;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-weight: 650;
  padding: 9px 14px;
  border-radius: 13px;
}
.chip-done { background: var(--moss); color: #f2f5e2; }
.chip-snooze { background: var(--sky); color: #f4f8fb; }

/* ————— Detail panel ————— */

.plant-panel { border-top: 2px dashed #ddd0ac; margin-top: 15px; padding-top: 15px; }
.plant-panel.pop { animation: pop 0.25s ease; }
@keyframes pop {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-7px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
}

.panel-inner { display: grid; gap: 16px; }
@media (min-width: 620px) { .panel-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.5fr; gap: 22px; } }

.panel-light h4, .panel-history h4 {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  color: #8b7c5e;
}
.light-line { margin: 0; display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; font-weight: 600; }
.light-line .ic { width: 22px; height: 22px; }

.history { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 2px 0 0 4px; }
.history li {
  position: relative;
  padding: 0 0 14px 28px;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}
.history li::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 1px;
  top: 4px;
  width: 11px;
  height: 11px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent, #999);
  border: 2px solid var(--paper);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px var(--accent, #999);
}
.history li::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 6.5px;
  top: 22px;
  height: calc(100% - 26px);
  width: 2px;
  background: #e2d6b4;
}
.history li:last-child { padding-bottom: 2px; }
.history li:last-child::after { display: none; }
.hist-date { color: #8b7c5e; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin-right: 2px; }

/* ————— Sidebar ————— */

.side { display: grid; gap: 20px; align-content: start; }
.side-card {
  background: var(--paper);
  border: 2px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 26px 20px 24px 18px;
  padding: 18px;
}

.glance { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; margin: 0; }
.glance-item { background: #f3ecd8; border-radius: 14px; padding: 10px 6px; text-align: center; }
.glance dt { font-size: 0.66rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #8b7c5e; }
.glance dd { margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
#g-overdue { color: var(--clay); }
#g-done { color: var(--moss); }

.rhythm { margin: 0; }
.rhythm svg { width: 100%; height: auto; }
.rhythm text { font-family: inherit; }
.rhythm figcaption { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--ink-soft); margin-top: 8px; }

.mood-row { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: center; }
.mood-row .mood-art svg { width: 64px; }
#mood-msg { margin: 0; font-size: 0.95rem; }
.zzz { animation: floaty 3s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes floaty {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
  50% { transform: translateY(-5px); }
}

/* ————— All-done state ————— */

.all-done {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--paper);
  border: 2px solid #b9c2a4;
  border-radius: 30px 24px 32px 22px;
  padding: 38px 22px 28px;
  text-align: center;
  display: grid;
  justify-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 18px;
}
.all-done-art svg { width: 132px; }
.all-done-sub { margin: 0; max-width: 34ch; color: var(--ink-soft); }

.done-log { list-style: none; margin: 10px 0 14px; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 8px; text-align: left; }
.done-log li { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; font-size: 0.95rem; }
.done-log .ic { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
.done-log li strong { font-weight: 700; }

.confetti { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.confetti span {
  position: absolute;
  width: 9px;
  height: 9px;
  border-radius: 0 100% 0 100%;
  opacity: 0;
  animation: fall 3.6s linear infinite;
}
.confetti span:nth-child(1) { left: 8%;  background: #d9a13c; animation-delay: 0s; }
.confetti span:nth-child(2) { left: 18%; background: #7fae5e; animation-delay: 1.1s; }
.confetti span:nth-child(3) { left: 28%; background: #c05a35; animation-delay: 2.2s; }
.confetti span:nth-child(4) { left: 38%; background: #93bd6d; animation-delay: 0.6s; }
.confetti span:nth-child(5) { left: 48%; background: #d9a13c; animation-delay: 1.7s; }
.confetti span:nth-child(6) { left: 58%; background: #7d9ab0; animation-delay: 2.8s; }
.confetti span:nth-child(7) { left: 68%; background: #c05a35; animation-delay: 0.3s; }
.confetti span:nth-child(8) { left: 78%; background: #7fae5e; animation-delay: 1.4s; }
.confetti span:nth-child(9) { left: 88%; background: #93bd6d; animation-delay: 2.5s; }
.confetti span:nth-child(10){ left: 94%; background: #d9a13c; animation-delay: 0.9s; }
@keyframes fall {
  0%   { transform: translateY(-16px) rotate(0deg); opacity: 0; }
  12%  { opacity: 1; }
  85%  { opacity: 1; }
  100% { transform: translateY(230px) rotate(320deg); opacity: 0; }
}

/* ————— Toast ————— */

#toast {
  position: fixed;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: 20px;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: min(92vw, 440px);
  z-index: 50;
}
.toast-card {
  display: none;
}
#toast.show .toast-card {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  justify-content: space-between;
  background: var(--paper);
  border: 2px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 10px 10px 10px 16px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(61, 50, 38, 0.28);
  animation: toast-in 0.25s ease;
}
@keyframes toast-in {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); }
}
.toast-msg { margin: 0; flex: 1; font-size: 0.95rem; }
.btn-undo { padding: 7px 14px; }

/* ————— Footer & misc ————— */

.footer {
  text-align: center;
  color: #9a8a6a;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  padding-bottom: 40px;
}

/* ————— Desktop ————— */

@media (min-width: 920px) {
  .layout {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.55fr) minmax(300px, 1fr);
    gap: clamp(28px, 4vw, 52px);
    align-items: start;
  }
  .side { position: sticky; top: 24px; }
  .hero-inner { padding-bottom: 30px; }
  .hero-art svg { width: 104px; }
  .wordmark-leaf { animation-duration: 6s; }
  .queue { gap: 18px; }
}

/* ————— Reduced motion ————— */

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }
  .confetti { display: none; }
  .wordmark-leaf { animation: none; }
  .zzz { animation: none; }
}

Evaluation 7.5 / 10 graded blind as submission J

A soft editorial hero with a smiling pot, a refined queue and a dot-topped rhythm chart. It works, but snooze is a tiny glyph-only round button, the type gets very small (down to 7.8px), and a script caption overlaps the illustration.

Strengths

  • Pleasant soft palette and hierarchy; overdue card accented
  • Undo with focus on the Undo button; all-done 'Lovely work'
  • Collapsible notes and history

Weaknesses

  • 60 text nodes under 12px, minimum 7.84px
  • Snooze is an icon-only circle ('◷')
  • 'slow days count too' caption overlaps the pot; avatar 'A' misaligned
Evidence the grader checked
  • fonts.js: J <12px 60, min 7.84, lowContrast 34
  • harness.js (Playwright, 1440 and 390 px): undo restored, doneClicks 4
  • J-desktop.png caption overlap

Objective checks

  • Browser: horizontal scroll at 390 px no; console errors 0; network requests 0

gpt-6-luna/13-frontend-playful/RESPONSE.md

Moss — design notes

Moss treats plant care like a small, kind household ritual. The warm paper ground, leaf green, soft clay, and imperfect rounded corners give the screen a tactile feel; a simple potted plant drawing and a few restrained symbols add a little oddness without turning the plants into clip art. The overdue Boston fern gets the clearest visual priority, while the other tasks stay visible in an ordered queue. On wider screens, the queue keeps its comfortable reading width beside a dedicated rhythm and encouragement rail.

Each care task has a direct completion action and a snooze action. Completing the fern’s water task says “Watered”; other tasks use a task-appropriate “Done for today” label. Snoozing moves a plant into a separate “Taking a little breather” group and marks it for later today. Completing a task moves it into a finished group. Both actions show a brief undo button, and finishing every task reveals a useful all-done message. Plant notes expand inline to show light preferences and the supplied recent history.

The page uses semantic headings, native buttons, links, and expandable details elements. Action labels name the plant, the queue count and toast provide polite status updates, the weekly chart has a text equivalent, and keyboard focus is visibly outlined. A skip link helps keyboard users jump straight to the queue. Layouts reflow for narrow screens, and the reduced-motion preference disables decorative transitions and animation. All visuals are inline SVG or CSS; the page uses local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript without external assets or dependencies.

gpt-6-luna/13-frontend-playful/TASK.md

Task 13 — Frontend design: playful mobile-first product

Build a polished mobile-first web app screen for Moss, a gentle household plant-care companion. Use only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: no frameworks, package installs, remote assets, external fonts, or network requests.

Visual direction: warm, tactile, optimistic, and a little odd. Use an expressive shape language and small moments of delight while keeping text readable and controls obvious. Avoid childish clip art, neon gradients, glass panels, and a wall of indistinguishable cards.

The experience must include:

  • Today's care queue for the four plants in PLANTS.json, clearly prioritizing overdue care.
  • A plant detail view or expandable panel with light, water, and observation history.
  • Working “watered” and “snooze” actions that update the interface and offer a brief undo path.
  • A compact weekly rhythm visualization.
  • A useful all-done state.
  • Desktop composition that makes good use of space without merely stretching the mobile column.
  • Keyboard operation, visible focus, semantic controls, and reduced-motion support.

Create index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Use CSS or inline SVG for any illustration. Add RESPONSE.md explaining the personality, interaction model, and accessibility choices. Work only in this directory.

gpt-6-luna/13-frontend-playful/app.js

const plants = [
  { id: "fern", name: "Frida", species: "Boston fern", location: "Bathroom", task: "Water", due: "2 days overdue", urgency: 4, light: "Low, indirect", history: ["Sep 19 · Misted", "Sep 16 · Watered", "Sep 12 · New frond"] },
  { id: "pothos", name: "Orbit", species: "Golden pothos", location: "Bookshelf", task: "Rotate", due: "Today", urgency: 2, light: "Medium, indirect", history: ["Sep 20 · Watered", "Sep 14 · Rotated", "Sep 10 · Wiped leaves"] },
  { id: "cactus", name: "Dot", species: "Bunny ears cactus", location: "South window", task: "Check soil", due: "Today", urgency: 1, light: "Bright, direct", history: ["Sep 08 · Watered", "Sep 01 · New pad noted", "Aug 22 · Rotated"] },
  { id: "calathea", name: "Drama", species: "Calathea orbifolia", location: "Bedroom", task: "Mist", due: "Tomorrow", urgency: 0, light: "Medium, filtered", history: ["Sep 21 · Misted", "Sep 18 · Watered", "Sep 15 · Brown edge noted"] }
];

const week = [1, 3, 2, 4, 2, 1, 3];
const days = ["M", "T", "W", "T", "F", "S", "S"];
const state = Object.fromEntries(plants.map((plant) => [plant.id, { status: "active", due: plant.due }]));

const queueList = document.querySelector("#queue-list");
const snoozedList = document.querySelector("#snoozed-list");
const doneList = document.querySelector("#done-list");
const snoozedSection = document.querySelector("#snoozed-section");
const doneSection = document.querySelector("#done-section");
const allDone = document.querySelector("#all-done");
const queueIntro = document.querySelector("#queue-intro");
const queueCount = document.querySelector("#queue-count");
const queueCounter = document.querySelector("#queue-counter");
const toast = document.querySelector("#toast");
const toastMessage = document.querySelector("#toast-message");
const undoButton = document.querySelector("#undo-action");
const dismissButton = document.querySelector("#dismiss-toast");
let undoSnapshot = null;
let toastTimer = null;

function escapeHTML(value) {
  return String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, (character) => ({
    "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;"
  })[character]);
}

function plantIllustration(id) {
  const start = '<svg viewBox="0 0 48 48" focusable="false" aria-hidden="true">';
  const finish = '<path class="pot-fill" d="M12 32h24l-2.5 11h-19z"/><path class="pot-line" d="M10 31h28"/></svg>';
  const drawings = {
    fern: '<path d="M24 31V8m0 17C17 16 13 14 9 15c1 7 6 11 15 13m0-10c6-8 11-10 15-9-1 7-6 11-15 13m0 13c-7-7-12-8-17-6 2 6 7 9 17 9m0-9c7-7 12-8 17-6-2 6-7 9-17 9"/><path d="M14 17l8 9m13-12-10 9m-9 5 8 7m12-7-10 7"/>',
    pothos: '<path d="M24 32V11m0 17c-4-7-10-10-16-7 1 9 7 13 16 13m0-13c3-8 9-12 16-9 0 9-5 14-16 15m-1-14c-3-5-2-9 1-12 4 4 4 8 1 12"/>',
    cactus: '<path d="M24 31V10c0-4 6-4 6 0v6m-6 0c0-4-6-4-6 0v7m8-8c4-1 6 1 6 5v7m-12-6c-4-1-6 1-6 5v4"/><path d="M22 14h.1m6 7h.1m-8 4h.1m8-10h.1m4 10h.1" stroke-width="2.5"/>',
    calathea: '<path d="M24 32V9m0 19c-4-9-10-12-16-10 1 9 6 13 16 15m0-13c3-9 10-12 16-9-1 9-6 14-16 16m-1-17c-2-6 0-9 3-11 3 5 2 9-2 12m-7 7 7 6m9-10-9 8"/>'
  };
  return `${start}${drawings[id]}${finish}`;
}

function dueLabel(plant) {
  const plantState = state[plant.id];
  if (plantState.status === "snoozed") return "Later today";
  if (plantState.status === "done") return "Tended";
  return plantState.due;
}

function renderCard(plant, quiet = false) {
  const plantState = state[plant.id];
  const overdue = plantState.status === "active" && plant.due.includes("overdue");
  const due = dueLabel(plant);
  const mainAction = plant.task === "Water" ? "Watered" : "Done for today";
  const actionLabel = plant.task === "Water" ? `Mark ${plant.name} as watered` : `Mark ${plant.name}’s ${plant.task.toLowerCase()} task done`;
  const history = plant.history.map((entry) => `<li>${escapeHTML(entry)}</li>`).join("");
  const quietStatus = plantState.status === "snoozed" ? "Later today · snoozed" : "Done for today";
  return `
    <article class="plant-card${overdue ? " is-overdue" : ""}" style="--portrait-bg:${plant.id === "cactus" ? "#f0e3c7" : plant.id === "calathea" ? "#e6e8dc" : plant.id === "pothos" ? "#e4e9ce" : "#e4ead7"};--portrait-ink:${plant.id === "cactus" ? "#a2764a" : plant.id === "calathea" ? "#687f60" : plant.id === "pothos" ? "#68824d" : "#688554"}">
      <div class="plant-main">
        <span class="plant-portrait">${plantIllustration(plant.id)}</span>
        <div class="plant-copy">
          <div class="card-topline"><span class="due-chip">${overdue ? '<span class="due-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>' : ""}${escapeHTML(due)}</span></div>
          <div class="plant-title-line"><h3 class="plant-name">${escapeHTML(plant.name)}</h3><span class="plant-species">${escapeHTML(plant.species)}</span></div>
          <p class="plant-task">${escapeHTML(plant.task)} <strong>· ${plant.task === "Water" ? "Give her a drink" : plant.task === "Rotate" ? "Turn toward the light" : plant.task === "Check soil" ? "A fingertip check" : "A soft mist"}</strong></p>
          <p class="plant-location">${escapeHTML(plant.location)}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      ${quiet ? `<span class="quiet-status">${escapeHTML(quietStatus)}</span>` : `
        <div class="plant-actions" aria-label="Actions for ${escapeHTML(plant.name)}">
          <button class="action-button complete-button" type="button" data-action="complete" data-plant="${plant.id}" aria-label="${escapeHTML(actionLabel)}"><span class="action-icon" aria-hidden="true">${plant.task === "Water" ? "↗" : "✓"}</span>${mainAction}</button>
          <button class="action-button snooze-button" type="button" data-action="snooze" data-plant="${plant.id}" aria-label="Snooze ${escapeHTML(plant.name)} until later today" title="Snooze until later today"><span aria-hidden="true">◷</span><span class="snooze-label">Snooze</span></button>
        </div>
        <details class="plant-detail">
          <summary>Plant notes &amp; recent history</summary>
          <div class="detail-content">
            <div><span class="detail-label">Light likes</span><span class="light-value"><span class="light-symbol" aria-hidden="true">☼</span>${escapeHTML(plant.light)}</span></div>
            <div><span class="detail-label">Recent moments</span><ul class="history-list">${history}</ul></div>
          </div>
        </details>
      `}
    </article>`;
}

function render() {
  const active = plants.filter((plant) => state[plant.id].status === "active").sort((a, b) => b.urgency - a.urgency);
  const snoozed = plants.filter((plant) => state[plant.id].status === "snoozed");
  const done = plants.filter((plant) => state[plant.id].status === "done");
  queueList.innerHTML = active.map((plant) => renderCard(plant)).join("");
  snoozedList.innerHTML = snoozed.map((plant) => renderCard(plant, true)).join("");
  doneList.innerHTML = done.map((plant) => renderCard(plant, true)).join("");
  snoozedSection.hidden = snoozed.length === 0;
  doneSection.hidden = done.length === 0;
  allDone.hidden = active.length > 0 || snoozed.length > 0;
  queueList.hidden = active.length === 0;
  queueIntro.hidden = active.length === 0;
  queueIntro.textContent = active.some((plant) => plant.due.includes("overdue"))
    ? "First, one plant could use a bit of extra love."
    : active.length ? "A few small things, at your own pace." : "Everything is tucked in for today.";
  queueCount.textContent = active.length === 0 ? "All tended for today" : active.length === 1 ? "1 small thing" : `${active.length} small things`;
  queueCounter.innerHTML = `${String(active.length).padStart(2, "0")} <span>to tend</span>`;
}

function showToast(message, snapshot) {
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  undoSnapshot = snapshot;
  toastMessage.textContent = message;
  toast.hidden = false;
  undoButton.focus();
  toastTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    toast.hidden = true;
    undoSnapshot = null;
  }, 8000);
}

function changeStatus(id, nextStatus) {
  const plant = plants.find((item) => item.id === id);
  if (!plant) return;
  const previous = { ...state[id] };
  state[id] = nextStatus === "snoozed"
    ? { status: "snoozed", due: "Later today" }
    : { status: "done", due: "Tended" };
  render();
  if (nextStatus === "snoozed") {
    showToast(`${plant.name} is snoozed until later today.`, { id, value: previous });
  } else {
    const message = plant.task === "Water" ? `${plant.name} got a nice drink.` : `${plant.name}’s ${plant.task.toLowerCase()} is all done.`;
    showToast(message, { id, value: previous });
  }
}

function undoLastAction() {
  if (!undoSnapshot) return;
  const restoredId = undoSnapshot.id;
  state[restoredId] = undoSnapshot.value;
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toast.hidden = true;
  undoSnapshot = null;
  render();
  document.querySelector(`[data-plant="${CSS.escape(restoredId)}"]`)?.focus();
}

document.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
  const action = event.target.closest("button[data-action]");
  if (!action) return;
  changeStatus(action.dataset.plant, action.dataset.action === "snooze" ? "snoozed" : "done");
});

undoButton.addEventListener("click", undoLastAction);
dismissButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toast.hidden = true;
  undoSnapshot = null;
});

function renderWeek() {
  const todayIndex = (new Date().getDay() + 6) % 7;
  const bars = week.map((value, index) => `
    <div class="day-column${index === todayIndex ? " is-today" : ""}" aria-label="${days[index]}, ${value} care ${value === 1 ? "moment" : "moments"}${index === todayIndex ? ", today" : ""}">
      <div class="bar-wrap"><span class="day-bar" style="height:${Math.max(14, value / 4 * 100)}%"></span></div>
      <span class="day-label" aria-hidden="true">${days[index]}</span>
    </div>`).join("");
  document.querySelector("#chart-bars").innerHTML = bars;
  document.querySelector("#week-total").textContent = `${week.reduce((sum, count) => sum + count, 0)} this week`;
  document.querySelector("#week-chart").setAttribute("aria-label", `Care moments this week: ${week.join(", ")}, Monday through Sunday.`);
}

function renderDate() {
  const date = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en", { weekday: "long", month: "long", day: "numeric" }).format(new Date());
  document.querySelector("#today-date").textContent = `${date} · a gentle check-in`;
}

render();
renderWeek();
renderDate();

gpt-6-luna/13-frontend-playful/styles.css

:root {
  color-scheme: light;
  --paper: #f7f5ed;
  --paper-deep: #eeeadd;
  --ink: #25392f;
  --muted: #778078;
  --forest: #315944;
  --forest-dark: #244333;
  --moss: #8caa68;
  --lime: #d6e686;
  --coral: #df765e;
  --coral-dark: #9b4639;
  --line: #e8e5d9;
  --white: #fffef9;
  --shadow: 0 18px 50px rgb(46 61 46 / 7%);
  font-family: ui-rounded, "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  font-synthesis: none;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { min-width: 320px; scroll-behavior: smooth; }
body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 4% 16%, rgb(214 230 134 / 12%), transparent 22rem),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 98% 46%, rgb(229 203 165 / 18%), transparent 26rem),
    var(--paper);
  color: var(--ink);
}
button, a { font: inherit; }
button { color: inherit; }
a { color: inherit; }
::selection { background: #d9e9aa; color: var(--forest-dark); }

.skip-link {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0.75rem;
  left: 0.75rem;
  z-index: 20;
  padding: 0.8rem 1rem;
  transform: translateY(-160%);
  border-radius: 0.75rem;
  background: var(--forest-dark);
  color: white;
}
.skip-link:focus { transform: translateY(0); }
.app-shell { width: min(1200px, calc(100% - 52px)); margin: 0 auto; }
.topbar {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 82px;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(37 57 47 / 10%);
}
.brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; text-decoration: none; }
.brand-mark { display: grid; width: 38px; height: 38px; place-items: center; border-radius: 14px 14px 14px 5px; background: #e8edcb; transform: rotate(-4deg); }
.brand-mark svg { width: 28px; fill: none; stroke: var(--forest); stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 2.1; }
.brand-name { font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.08em; }
.brand-period { color: var(--coral); }
.topbar-note { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; color: #66756a; font-size: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 0.025em; }
.live-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #9ab97a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #e5edd6; }
.profile-button { width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 1px solid #e0e2d4; border-radius: 50%; background: #ecebdc; color: #556846; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; }

.welcome-panel {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  min-height: 278px;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 31px 0 42px;
  padding: 37px 66px 36px 58px;
  border-radius: 30px 30px 30px 12px;
  background: #e8edcf;
  isolation: isolate;
}
.welcome-panel::before, .welcome-panel::after { position: absolute; z-index: -1; content: ""; border: 1px solid rgb(92 117 70 / 13%); border-radius: 50%; }
.welcome-panel::before { width: 390px; height: 390px; right: 66px; top: -194px; }
.welcome-panel::after { width: 270px; height: 270px; right: 128px; top: -135px; }
.welcome-copy { position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 620px; }
.eyebrow { margin: 0; color: #727c58; font-size: 0.66rem; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: 0.15em; line-height: 1.4; text-transform: uppercase; }
.welcome-copy > .eyebrow { margin-bottom: 0.72rem; color: #5f774c; }
h1, h2, h3, p { margin-top: 0; }
h1, .section-heading h2, .rail-heading h2, .note-card h2, .all-done h3 { font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; font-weight: 500; }
h1 { max-width: 580px; margin-bottom: 0.7rem; color: #294a38; font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 4.25vw, 3.45rem); letter-spacing: -0.055em; line-height: 0.99; }
.title-leaf { display: inline-block; margin-left: 0.26rem; color: #b56c4e; font-family: ui-rounded, sans-serif; font-size: 0.56em; transform: rotate(-30deg) translateY(-0.35em); }
.welcome-subtitle { margin-bottom: 1.25rem; color: #63715d; font-size: 0.91rem; line-height: 1.6; }
.welcome-meta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; color: #62715d; font-size: 0.75rem; }
.welcome-meta strong { color: #3c5b45; font-weight: 720; }
.weather-mark { display: grid; width: 26px; height: 26px; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: #f4e4a9; color: #a47738; font-size: 1rem; }
.welcome-art { position: relative; display: flex; width: 270px; height: 210px; flex: 0 0 270px; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center; margin-right: 9px; }
.sun-disc { position: absolute; top: 1px; right: 43px; width: 66px; height: 66px; border-radius: 50%; background: #f1d88f; }
.hero-plant { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 230px; height: 190px; overflow: visible; }
.hero-stem { fill: #799c61; stroke: #5e8050; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 2; }
.hero-vein { fill: none; stroke: #a9be7c; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-width: 1.5; }
.pot-rim { fill: #c7765c; stroke: #a95d49; stroke-width: 1.5; }
.pot-body { fill: #d89070; stroke: #a95d49; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.5; }
.pot-face { fill: none; stroke: #654f3d; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-width: 2.4; }
.pot-shadow { fill: none; stroke: #829267; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-width: 3; opacity: 0.42; }
.art-spark { position: absolute; color: #ae9761; font-family: Georgia, serif; }
.spark-one { top: 43px; left: 17px; font-size: 1.2rem; }
.spark-two { top: 89px; right: 13px; font-size: 2.4rem; }
.art-caption { position: absolute; right: 14px; bottom: 9px; z-index: 2; color: #6c7d55; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-style: italic; transform: rotate(-5deg); }
.welcome-stitch { position: absolute; right: 7px; bottom: 12px; width: 48px; height: 20px; border-top: 1px dashed rgb(77 103 60 / 42%); border-radius: 50%; transform: rotate(15deg); }

.content-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 305px; align-items: start; gap: 58px; padding: 0 16px; }
.queue-section { min-width: 0; }
.section-heading { display: flex; align-items: end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; }
.section-kicker { margin-bottom: 0.38rem; }
.section-heading h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.82rem; letter-spacing: -0.045em; }
.queue-counter { margin-bottom: 0.2rem; color: var(--forest); font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.38rem; }
.queue-counter span { color: #869087; font-family: ui-rounded, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 0.68rem; }
.queue-intro { margin: 0.62rem 0 1.18rem; color: #788179; font-size: 0.79rem; }
.queue-list { display: grid; gap: 12px; }
.plant-card {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  align-items: center;
  column-gap: 1.1rem;
  padding: 17px 18px 15px 16px;
  border: 1px solid #eae7dc;
  border-radius: 8px 19px 19px 19px;
  background: rgb(255 254 249 / 88%);
  transition: border-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease;
}
.plant-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: #d9dfc7; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgb(52 71 49 / 6%); }
.plant-card.is-overdue { border-color: #ebc3b8; background: #fffaf4; }
.plant-card.is-overdue::before { position: absolute; top: 14px; bottom: 14px; left: -1px; width: 3px; border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0; background: var(--coral); content: ""; }
.plant-main { display: flex; min-width: 0; align-items: center; gap: 13px; }
.plant-portrait { display: grid; width: 52px; height: 52px; flex: 0 0 auto; place-items: center; border-radius: 17px 17px 17px 7px; background: var(--portrait-bg, #e2ead1); color: var(--portrait-ink, #5b7a4c); }

Hand-drawn wobbly outlines, a household-count panel and a 'Moss says' note. Simple and working. Primary button contrast fails, and every action uses the water-drop icon.

Strengths

  • Working undo, keyboard shortcuts, all-done
  • Clean responsive collapse

Weaknesses

  • White on light-green buttons is about 3.0:1
  • Water-drop icon on Rotated/Soil checked/Misted
  • Rhythm highlights the busiest day, not today

  • harness.js (Playwright, 1440 and 390 px): doneClicks 4
  • process_note: reduced-effort rerun

Objective checks

  • Browser: horizontal scroll at 390 px no; console errors 0; network requests 0
