gemini-3.1-pro/13-frontend-playful/RESPONSE.md

Moss — Design & Engineering Response

Moss is a gentle, mobile-first household plant-care companion designed to make tending house plants feel tactile, forgiving, and joyful.

1. Personality & Visual Direction

Warm, Tactile, Optimistic, and a Little Odd

Plant care is fundamentally physical, rhythmic, and biological. Moss reflects this by avoiding the cold sterility of corporate SaaS dashboards, generic glassmorphism panels, and neon gradients.

  • Earthy, Tactile Color Palette:
    • Linen & Oatmeal Canvas (#F7F4EB, #FCFBF7): Warm paper tones that feel like an organic gardening journal.
    • Moss & Foliage Greens (#1B2E21 down to #558B67): Deep chlorophyll shades for growth and grounded calm.
    • Terracotta & Clay (#B84A24, #D05E32, #FAEBE5): Warm baked earth for clay pots and gentle-yet-unmistakable overdue alerts.
    • Marigold Sunlight & Dew Teal (#ECA130, #316E7D): Optimistic accents denoting sun exposure, water droplets, and completed care.
    • Loamy Charcoal Slate Inks (#1F2722): High-contrast, deeply legible text that passes WCAG AAA contrast guidelines.
  • Expressive Botanical Shape Language:
    • Soft, asymmetrical organic squircle borders (border-radius: 28px 18px 24px 18px).
    • Tactile physical buttons with crisp offset drop-shadows (box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--border-ink)) that visibly depress on tap/click (transform: translateY(2px)).
    • Subtle paper-cut craft aesthetic that feels tangible to the finger.
  • Botanical Individuality (No Wall of Identical Cards):
    • Rather than generic icons, each plant from PLANTS.json possesses a distinct personality and custom hand-drawn inline SVG illustration:
      • Frida (Boston Fern): Overflowing feathery fronds in a terracotta pot with a drip tray; thirsty, dramatic icon.
      • Orbit (Golden Pothos): Playful climbing loop vine with heart-shaped variegated leaves; shelf pioneer.
      • Dot (Bunny Ears Cactus): Chunky bunny ear paddles with tiny yellow polka-dot glochids and a blossom; stoic sun worshipper.
      • Drama (Calathea Orbifolia): Broad striped emerald-and-silver leaves; expressive, prayerful humidity lover.

2. Interaction Model

Priority-Driven Care Queue

  • Overdue Prioritization: Frida's urgency level is 4 (2 days overdue). She is placed prominently at the head of the queue with an urgent-care alert banner and terracotta borders, ensuring dry soil is never overlooked.
  • Action Hierarchy:
    • Primary button: Contextual action with botanical icon (e.g., 💧 Water Frida, 🔄 Rotate Orbit, 🌱 Check soil Dot).
    • Secondary button: ⏱ Snooze, allowing low-guilt rescheduling by 1 day.
    • Tertiary button: Diary → to inspect light needs, soil guide, and observation history.

The Forgiving Undo Architecture

  • Rather than interrupting the user with blocking confirmation dialogs, marking a plant "Watered" or "Snoozed" applies immediately with an optimistic UI update.
  • A tactile Undo Toast slides up with a 6-second countdown bar.
  • Tapping Undo immediately restores the plant to its previous state, removes the auto-logged care entry, and returns keyboard focus to the restored card.

Interactive Observation Diary & Plant Inspector

  • Selecting any plant opens its detailed inspector:
    • Sun Meter: 4-pip tactile sun gauge indicating light requirements (from low indirect for Frida up to bright direct for Dot).
    • Water & Soil Guide: Clear intervals and moisture recommendations.
    • Observation Timeline: Chronological list of observations and care logs (preserving historical events from PLANTS.json).
    • Interactive Note Logging: Users can click quick botanical tags ("🌱 New sprout", "🍂 Dry soil", "✨ Cleaned leaves", "☀️ Rotated") or type custom observations to instantly record notes to the timeline.

Compact Weekly Rhythm

  • Visualizes the 7-day care rhythm from PLANTS.json ([1, 3, 2, 4, 2, 1, 3]).
  • Organic rounded vertical bars scale according to workload.
  • Thursday is highlighted as Today with 4 scheduled tasks, giving the user immediate situational awareness of their weekly load.
  • Interactive tap/click updates the daily narrative caption.

Useful All-Done State

  • Once all tasks due today are completed (or when all 3 due plants are handled), the queue transitions into a celebratory yet peaceful scene:
    • Whimsical artwork of content plants basking in warm windowsill sunlight with a resting watering can.
    • Reassurance that all companions are thriving.
    • A helpful forward-looking reminder: "Next on deck: Drama (Calathea orbifolia) is scheduled for a gentle mist tomorrow morning."
    • Controls to review the completed log or reset the demo queue for instant re-testing.

Desktop Composition (Beyond the Stretched Column)

  • On mobile (< 768px), the app provides a focused single-column flow with a thumb-accessible bottom bar and sliding bottom sheet.
  • On desktop (≥ 980px), the layout scales into a rich 3-column dashboard:
    • Left Sidebar (Pinned): Mascot branding, companion status note, weekly rhythm widget, and room filter chips.
    • Center Column (Fluid): Today's prioritized care queue and filter tabs.
    • Right Sidebar (Pinned): Live Plant Diary & Inspector showing full botanical specifications and interactive observation timeline for whichever plant is currently selected.
  • This creates an editorial, expansive workspace without wasted white space or awkward mobile column stretching.

3. Accessibility Choices

  1. Semantic HTML5 Landmarks:
    • Structured with <header>, <main>, <aside>, <article>, <nav>, <dialog>, and <button>.
    • Skip-to-content link for immediate keyboard navigation to the queue.
  2. Keyboard Operation & Visible Focus:
    • Every action (completing, snoozing, filtering, inspecting, adding notes, resetting demo) is reachable via standard Tab / Shift+Tab and operable with Enter and Space.
    • Escape key seamlessly closes modals, sheets, and toasts.
    • High-contrast custom :focus-visible styling with 3px solid rings and offsets ensures clear indicator visibility.
  3. Screen Readers & ARIA Semantics:
    • The undo toast uses role="status" and aria-live="polite" so screen reader users hear completion confirmations and undo availability without interruption.
    • Buttons feature descriptive aria-labels specifying both the action and the plant name (e.g., aria-label="Water Frida").
    • Sun meter and weekly rhythm columns provide clear text alternatives.
  4. Touch Targets & Contrast:
    • All interactive touch targets meet or exceed the 44×44px WCAG touch criteria.
    • Color contrasts meet WCAG AA and AAA criteria across all states.
  5. Reduced-Motion Support:
    • Full @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) support disables floating animations, bouncy transitions, toast slides, and pulsing borders, switching to instantaneous, calm state changes.

4. Self-Contained Architecture

  • Zero External Dependencies: Built with pure HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript.
  • Zero Network Calls: No remote CDNs, web fonts, or analytics.
  • Offline Reliability: Plant data is loaded from PLANTS.json with an instant embedded fallback if accessed directly through a file:// scheme where browser CORS restrictions might otherwise impede local fetches.

gemini-3.1-pro/13-frontend-playful/TASK.md

Task 13 — Frontend design: playful mobile-first product

Build a polished mobile-first web app screen for Moss, a gentle household plant-care companion. Use only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: no frameworks, package installs, remote assets, external fonts, or network requests.

Visual direction: warm, tactile, optimistic, and a little odd. Use an expressive shape language and small moments of delight while keeping text readable and controls obvious. Avoid childish clip art, neon gradients, glass panels, and a wall of indistinguishable cards.

The experience must include:

  • Today's care queue for the four plants in PLANTS.json, clearly prioritizing overdue care.
  • A plant detail view or expandable panel with light, water, and observation history.
  • Working “watered” and “snooze” actions that update the interface and offer a brief undo path.
  • A compact weekly rhythm visualization.
  • A useful all-done state.
  • Desktop composition that makes good use of space without merely stretching the mobile column.
  • Keyboard operation, visible focus, semantic controls, and reduced-motion support.

Create index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Use CSS or inline SVG for any illustration. Add RESPONSE.md explaining the personality, interaction model, and accessibility choices. Work only in this directory.

  calathea: `

      <path d="M19 44 L22 60 H42 L45 44 Z" fill="#316E7D" stroke="#222B25" stroke-width="2" />

      <path d="M32 44 Q28 32 20 22" stroke="#264330" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" />
      <path d="M32 44 Q33 26 34 14" stroke="#264330" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" />
      <path d="M32 44 Q38 32 46 22" stroke="#264330" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" />
      <!-- Broad Orbifolia Striped Leaves -->
      <!-- Left Leaf -->
      <ellipse cx="18" cy="20" rx="10" ry="12" transform="rotate(-25 18 20)" fill="#427252" stroke="#222B25" stroke-width="1.8" />

      <!-- Center Leaf (Tallest) -->
      <ellipse cx="34" cy="13" rx="11" ry="13" fill="#335940" stroke="#222B25" stroke-width="1.8" />

      <!-- Right Leaf -->

// Task Icons Map
const TaskIcons = {
  Water: "💧",
  Rotate: "🔄",
  "Check soil": "🌱",
  Mist: "💨"
};

// ==========================================================================
// Initialization & Data Loading
// ==========================================================================

async function init() {
  await loadPlantData();
  setupEventListeners();
  renderWeeklyRhythm();
  renderQueue();
  selectPlant(AppState.selectedPlantId || "fern");
  updateCompanionSummary();
}

/**
 * Loads data from PLANTS.json if available; falls back smoothly to embedded DEFAULT_DATA
 */
async function loadPlantData() {
  try {
    const response = await fetch("PLANTS.json");
    if (response.ok) {
      const data = await response.json();
      if (data && data.plants) {
        // Merge with enriched properties for tactile view
        AppState.plants = data.plants.map(p => {
          const fallback = DEFAULT_DATA.plants.find(df => df.id === p.id) || {};
          return {
            ...fallback,
            ...p,
            status: "pending"
          };
        });
        AppState.weekData = data.week || DEFAULT_DATA.week;
        return;
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // Expected when running via file:// or without HTTP server
    console.log("Using embedded plants configuration:", err.message);
  }

  // Fallback to embedded data
  AppState.plants = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_DATA.plants));
  AppState.weekData = [...DEFAULT_DATA.week];
}

// ==========================================================================
// Queue Sorting & Rendering
// ==========================================================================

/**
 * Sorts queue strictly prioritizing overdue items (urgency 4) first, then today, then upcoming
 */
function getSortedFilteredPlants() {
  let list = [...AppState.plants];

  // Apply room filter if not "all"
  if (AppState.roomFilter !== "all") {
    list = list.filter(p => p.location.toLowerCase() === AppState.roomFilter.toLowerCase());
  }

  // Apply tab view filter
  if (AppState.activeTab === "todo") {
    list = list.filter(p => p.status === "pending");
  } else if (AppState.activeTab === "completed") {
    list = list.filter(p => p.status === "completed" || p.status === "snoozed");
  }

  // Prioritize overdue care (urgency 4 first, then 2, 1, 0)
  list.sort((a, b) => {
    // If one is completed and one is pending, pending comes first
    if (a.status === "pending" && b.status !== "pending") return -1;
    if (a.status !== "pending" && b.status === "pending") return 1;
    // Highest urgency first
    return b.urgency - a.urgency;
  });

  return list;
}

function renderQueue() {
  const container = document.getElementById("plant-list-panel");
  const allDoneState = document.getElementById("all-done-state");
  const priorityBanner = document.getElementById("priority-banner");
  const sortedPlants = getSortedFilteredPlants();

  // Check if overdue plants remain
  const hasOverduePending = AppState.plants.some(p => p.urgency >= 3 && p.status === "pending");
  if (priorityBanner) {
    if (hasOverduePending && AppState.activeTab !== "completed") {
      priorityBanner.classList.remove("hidden");
    } else {
      priorityBanner.classList.add("hidden");
    }
  }

  // Check if all to-do plants are completed
  const pendingCount = AppState.plants.filter(p => p.status === "pending").length;
  if (AppState.activeTab === "todo" && pendingCount === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = "";
    allDoneState.classList.remove("hidden");
    updateCounts();
    return;
  } else {
    allDoneState.classList.add("hidden");
  }

  // If filtered list is empty
  if (sortedPlants.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = `
      <div class="empty-state-card" style="text-align: center; padding: 32px; background: var(--surface-bg); border: 2px dashed var(--border-soft); border-radius: var(--radius-lg);">
        <p style="color: var(--ink-600); font-size: 0.95rem;">No plants match this view.</p>
      </div>
    `;
    updateCounts();
    return;
  }

  // Build plant cards
  container.innerHTML = sortedPlants.map(plant => createPlantCardHtml(plant)).join("");

  updateCounts();
}

/**
 * Creates HTML for individual plant care card
 */
function createPlantCardHtml(plant) {
  const isSelected = plant.id === AppState.selectedPlantId;
  const isOverdue = plant.urgency >= 3 && plant.status === "pending";
  const isCompleted = plant.status === "completed";
  const isSnoozed = plant.status === "snoozed";

  let statusClass = "";
  if (isOverdue) statusClass = "is-overdue";
  else if (isCompleted) statusClass = "is-completed";
  else if (isSnoozed) statusClass = "is-snoozed";

  if (isSelected) statusClass += " is-selected";

  // Due badge text and style
  let badgeClass = "badge-tomorrow";
  let dueText = plant.due;
  if (isCompleted) {
    badgeClass = "badge-done";
    dueText = "✓ Done today";
  } else if (isSnoozed) {
    badgeClass = "badge-tomorrow";
    dueText = "⏱ Snoozed (+1d)";
  } else if (plant.urgency >= 3) {
    badgeClass = "badge-overdue";
  } else if (plant.urgency >= 1) {
    badgeClass = "badge-today";
  }

  const avatarSvg = PlantAvatars[plant.id] || PlantAvatars.fern;
  const taskIcon = TaskIcons[plant.task] || "🌿";

  // Action buttons
  let actionButtonsHtml = "";
  if (isCompleted) {
    actionButtonsHtml = `
      <div class="completed-note">
        <span>✓ Completed for today</span>
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary btn-reopen" data-id="${plant.id}" data-action="reopen" aria-label="Mark ${plant.name} as pending again">
        Re-open
      </button>
      <button type="button" class="btn btn-details-toggle" data-id="${plant.id}" data-action="inspect" aria-label="Inspect ${plant.name}">
        Diary & Specs →
      </button>
    `;
  } else if (isSnoozed) {
    actionButtonsHtml = `
      <div class="completed-note" style="color: var(--sun-700);">
        <span>⏱ Snoozed until tomorrow</span>
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary btn-reopen" data-id="${plant.id}" data-action="reopen" aria-label="Resume ${plant.name} care today">
        Resume today
      </button>
      <button type="button" class="btn btn-details-toggle" data-id="${plant.id}" data-action="inspect" aria-label="Inspect ${plant.name}">
        Diary & Specs →
      </button>
    `;
  } else {
    // Standard Pending State
    const actionVerb = plant.task === "Water" ? "Water" : plant.task;
    const primaryBtnClass = isOverdue ? "btn-primary is-overdue-action" : "btn-primary";

    actionButtonsHtml = `
      <button type="button" class="btn ${primaryBtnClass}" data-id="${plant.id}" data-action="complete" aria-label="${actionVerb} ${plant.name}">
        <span aria-hidden="true">${taskIcon}</span>
        ${actionVerb} ${plant.name}
      </button>
      <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-id="${plant.id}" data-action="snooze" aria-label="Snooze ${plant.name} care">
        <span aria-hidden="true">⏱</span>
        Snooze
      </button>
      <button type="button" class="btn btn-details-toggle" data-id="${plant.id}" data-action="inspect" aria-label="Inspect ${plant.name} details and history">
        Diary →
      </button>
    `;
  }

  return `
    <article class="plant-card ${statusClass}" id="card-${plant.id}" data-id="${plant.id}">
      <div class="card-main">
        <!-- Plant Avatar -->
        <div class="plant-avatar-wrap" aria-hidden="true">
          ${avatarSvg}
        </div>

        <!-- Plant Details -->
        <div class="card-details">
          <div class="card-top-row">
            <h3 class="plant-name">${plant.name}</h3>
            <span class="due-badge ${badgeClass}">${dueText}</span>
          </div>

          <div class="plant-species-row">
            <span class="species-name">${plant.species}</span>
            <span>·</span>
            <span class="location-tag" title="Located in ${plant.location}">
              📍 ${plant.location}
            </span>
          </div>

          <!-- Task Strip -->
          <div class="task-strip">
            <span class="task-icon-badge" aria-hidden="true">${taskIcon}</span>
            <span class="task-description">
              <strong>${plant.task}</strong>: ${isOverdue ? "Immediate care needed" : plant.personality}
            </span>
            <span class="light-hint" title="Light requirement">☀️ ${plant.light}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Action controls -->
      <div class="card-actions">
        ${actionButtonsHtml}
      </div>
    </article>
  `;
}

// ==========================================================================
// Action Handlers & Undo System
// ==========================================================================

/**
 * Handles completing/watering a plant task
 */
function handleComplete(plantId) {
  const plant = AppState.plants.find(p => p.id === plantId);
  if (!plant) return;

  // Snapshot for undo
  const snapshot = {
    status: plant.status,
    urgency: plant.urgency,
    due: plant.due,
    history: [...plant.history]
  };

  // Update plant state
  plant.status = "completed";
  const actionLabel = plant.task === "Water" ? "Watered" : `${plant.task} completed`;
  const todayEntry = `Today · ${actionLabel}`;
  plant.history.unshift(todayEntry);

  // Trigger UI updates
  renderQueue();
  selectPlant(plantId);
  updateCompanionSummary();

  // Show Tactile Undo Toast
  showUndoToast({
    message: `${plant.name} marked complete`,
    subtext: `${actionLabel}! You can undo this anytime.`,
    plantId: plantId,
    snapshot: snapshot
  });
}

/**
 * Handles snoozing a plant task
 */
function handleSnooze(plantId) {
  const plant = AppState.plants.find(p => p.id === plantId);
  if (!plant) return;

  // Snapshot for undo
  const snapshot = {
    status: plant.status,
    urgency: plant.urgency,
    due: plant.due,
    history: [...plant.history]
  };

  // Update plant state
  plant.status = "snoozed";
  plant.urgency = 0; // demoted for today
  plant.due = "Tomorrow (snoozed)";
  const todayEntry = `Today · Snoozed ${plant.task.toLowerCase()}`;
  plant.history.unshift(todayEntry);

  // Trigger UI updates
  renderQueue();
  selectPlant(plantId);
  updateCompanionSummary();

  // Show Tactile Undo Toast
  showUndoToast({
    message: `Snoozed ${plant.name}`,
    subtext: `Task pushed to tomorrow. Rest easy.`,
    plantId: plantId,
    snapshot: snapshot
  });
}

/**
 * Re-opens a completed or snoozed plant
 */
function handleReopen(plantId) {
  const plant = AppState.plants.find(p => p.id === plantId);
  if (!plant) return;

  const original = DEFAULT_DATA.plants.find(p => p.id === plantId);
  plant.status = "pending";
  plant.urgency = original ? original.urgency : 2;
  plant.due = original ? original.due : "Today";
  // Remove most recent today entry if present
  if (plant.history.length > 0 && plant.history[0].startsWith("Today")) {
    plant.history.shift();
  }

  renderQueue();
  selectPlant(plantId);
  updateCompanionSummary();
}

/**
 * Displays floating Undo notification with a 6-second countdown
 */
function showUndoToast({ message, subtext, plantId, snapshot }) {
  const toast = document.getElementById("undo-toast");
  const msgEl = document.getElementById("toast-message");
  const subEl = document.getElementById("toast-subtext");
  const progressEl = document.getElementById("toast-progress");

  if (!toast) return;

  // Clear previous timer
  if (AppState.toastTimer) {
    clearTimeout(AppState.toastTimer);
  }

  AppState.undoState = { plantId, snapshot };

  msgEl.textContent = message;
  subEl.textContent = subtext;

  // Reset progress bar animation
  progressEl.style.animation = "none";
  // Force reflow
  void progressEl.offsetWidth;
  progressEl.style.animation = "countdown 6s linear forwards";

  toast.classList.remove("hidden");

  // Auto-dismiss after 6 seconds
  AppState.toastTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    hideUndoToast();
  }, 6000);
}

function hideUndoToast() {
  const toast = document.getElementById("undo-toast");
  if (toast) toast.classList.add("hidden");
  if (AppState.toastTimer) {
    clearTimeout(AppState.toastTimer);
    AppState.toastTimer = null;
  }
}

/**
 * Undoes the last completed or snoozed action
 */
function undoLastAction() {
  if (!AppState.undoState) return;

  const { plantId, snapshot } = AppState.undoState;
  const plant = AppState.plants.find(p => p.id === plantId);

  if (plant && snapshot) {
    plant.status = snapshot.status;
    plant.urgency = snapshot.urgency;
    plant.due = snapshot.due;
    plant.history = [...snapshot.history];
  }

  AppState.undoState = null;
  hideUndoToast();
  renderQueue();
  selectPlant(plantId);
  updateCompanionSummary();

  // Return focus to the restored card
  const card = document.getElementById(`card-${plantId}`);
  if (card) {
    const primaryBtn = card.querySelector(".btn-primary") || card.querySelector(".btn");
    if (primaryBtn) primaryBtn.focus();
  }
}

// ==========================================================================
// Plant Inspector & Diary (Right Column / Mobile Sheet)
// ==========================================================================

/**
 * Selects a plant and updates the detailed inspector panel
 */
function selectPlant(plantId) {
  AppState.selectedPlantId = plantId;
  const plant = AppState.plants.find(p => p.id === plantId);
  if (!plant) return;

  // Highlight card in queue
  document.querySelectorAll(".plant-card").forEach(c => {
    c.classList.remove("is-selected");
  });
  const currentCard = document.getElementById(`card-${plantId}`);
  if (currentCard) currentCard.classList.add("is-selected");

  const inspectorContainer = document.getElementById("inspector-card");
  if (!inspectorContainer) return;

  const avatarSvg = PlantAvatars[plant.id] || PlantAvatars.fern;
  const taskIcon = TaskIcons[plant.task] || "🌿";

  // Render sun pips
  let sunPipsHtml = "";
  for (let i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
    sunPipsHtml += `<span class="sun-pip ${i <= plant.sunPips ? "active" : ""}"></span>`;
  }

  // Render history timeline
  const historyHtml = plant.history.map(item => {
    const parts = item.split("·");
    const dateStr = parts[0]?.trim() || "";
    const noteStr = parts[1]?.trim() || item;
    return `
      <div class="timeline-item">
        <span class="timeline-date">${dateStr}</span>
        <span class="timeline-text">${noteStr}</span>
      </div>
    `;
  }).join("");

  inspectorContainer.innerHTML = `
    <!-- Inspector Header -->
    <div class="inspector-header">
      <div class="inspector-avatar" aria-hidden="true">
        ${avatarSvg}
      </div>
      <div class="inspector-titles">
        <h3 class="inspector-name">${plant.name}</h3>
        <span class="inspector-species">${plant.species}</span>
        <div class="inspector-badge-row">
          <span class="location-tag">📍 ${plant.location}</span>
          <span class="location-tag" style="background: var(--surface-bg); border: 1px solid var(--border-soft);">
            ${plant.due}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="btn-icon close-inspector-btn" id="btn-close-inspector" aria-label="Close plant inspector">
        ✕
      </button>
    </div>

    <!-- Companion Botanical Note -->
    <p style="font-size: 0.86rem; color: var(--ink-700); font-style: italic; line-height: 1.4;">
      "${plant.personality}"
    </p>

    <!-- Care Requirements Specs -->
    <div class="inspector-specs-grid">
      <div class="spec-box">
        <span class="spec-label">
          <span aria-hidden="true">☀️</span> Light Requirement
        </span>
        <span class="spec-value">${plant.light}</span>
        <div class="sun-meter" aria-label="Sun intensity level: ${plant.sunPips} of 4">
          ${sunPipsHtml}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="spec-box">
        <span class="spec-label">
          <span aria-hidden="true">💧</span> Water & Moisture
        </span>
        <span class="spec-value">${plant.waterSchedule}</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Observation & Care History -->
    <div class="history-section">
      <div class="history-heading-row">
        <h4 class="history-title">Observation Diary</h4>
        <span class="history-count">${plant.history.length} logs recorded</span>
      </div>

      <div class="history-timeline" role="list">
        ${historyHtml}
      </div>

      <!-- Quick Add Observation Form -->
      <form class="add-observation-form" id="add-observation-form" data-id="${plant.id}">
        <div class="quick-tag-row" aria-label="Quick observation tags">
          <button type="button" class="tag-btn" data-tag="Spotted new sprout">🌱 New sprout</button>
          <button type="button" class="tag-btn" data-tag="Soil dry to touch">🍂 Dry soil</button>
          <button type="button" class="tag-btn" data-tag="Wiped dusty leaves">✨ Cleaned leaves</button>
          <button type="button" class="tag-btn" data-tag="Rotated toward sun">☀️ Rotated</button>
        </div>
        <div class="observation-input-wrap">
          <label for="obs-input-${plant.id}" class="sr-only">Add an observation</label>
          <input type="text" id="obs-input-${plant.id}" class="observation-input" placeholder="Note new growth, leaf drop, or moisture..." required>
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-secondary btn-add-obs">Add Note</button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>

    <!-- Quick Action from Inspector -->
    <div class="inspector-actions-bar">
      ${plant.status === "pending" ? `
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-id="${plant.id}" data-action="complete" style="flex: 1;">
          <span aria-hidden="true">${taskIcon}</span> Mark ${plant.task} Done
        </button>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-id="${plant.id}" data-action="snooze">
          ⏱ Snooze
        </button>
      ` : `
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-id="${plant.id}" data-action="reopen" style="flex: 1;">
          ↺ Re-open for today
        </button>
      `}
    </div>
  `;

  // Attach quick observation form listener
  const form = document.getElementById("add-observation-form");
  if (form) {
    form.addEventListener("submit", (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const input = form.querySelector(".observation-input");
      if (input && input.value.trim()) {
        addObservation(plant.id, input.value.trim());
      }
    });

    // Quick tag clicks
    form.querySelectorAll(".tag-btn").forEach(tagBtn => {
      tagBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const text = tagBtn.dataset.tag;
        if (text) addObservation(plant.id, text);
      });
    });
  }

  // Close inspector button for mobile
  const closeBtn = document.getElementById("btn-close-inspector");
  if (closeBtn) {
    closeBtn.addEventListener("click", closeMobileInspector);
  }
}

/**
 * Appends a new observation note to a plant's history
 */
function addObservation(plantId, text) {
  const plant = AppState.plants.find(p => p.id === plantId);
  if (!plant) return;

  const today = new Date();
  const months = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"];
  const dateStr = `${months[today.getMonth()]} ${today.getDate()}`;
  plant.history.unshift(`${dateStr} · ${text}`);

  selectPlant(plantId);
}

function openMobileInspector(plantId) {
  selectPlant(plantId);
  const sidebar = document.getElementById("plant-inspector-container");
  const backdrop = document.getElementById("modal-backdrop");
  if (sidebar) sidebar.classList.add("is-open");
  if (backdrop) backdrop.classList.remove("hidden");
}

function closeMobileInspector() {
  const sidebar = document.getElementById("plant-inspector-container");
  const backdrop = document.getElementById("modal-backdrop");
  if (sidebar) sidebar.classList.remove("is-open");
  if (backdrop) backdrop.classList.add("hidden");
}

// ==========================================================================
// Weekly Rhythm Visualization
// ==========================================================================

function renderWeeklyRhythm() {
  const chartEl = document.getElementById("rhythm-chart");
  const mobRhythmBody = document.getElementById("mob-rhythm-body");
  if (!chartEl) return;

  const days = ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"];
  const counts = AppState.weekData || [1, 3, 2, 4, 2, 1, 3];
  const maxCount = Math.max(...counts, 4);

  // Thu is index 3 (matching today's 4 scheduled plants)
  const todayIndex = 3;

  const chartHtml = days.map((day, idx) => {
    const count = counts[idx];
    const isToday = idx === todayIndex;
    const heightPercent = Math.round((count / maxCount) * 100);

    return `
      <button type="button" class="rhythm-col ${isToday ? "is-today" : ""}" data-day="${day}" data-count="${count}" aria-label="${day}: ${count} care tasks ${isToday ? "(today)" : ""}">
        <span class="rhythm-count">${count}</span>
        <div class="rhythm-bar-track">
          <div class="rhythm-bar-fill" style="height: ${heightPercent}%;"></div>
        </div>
        <span class="rhythm-day-label">${day}</span>
      </button>
    `;
  }).join("");

  chartEl.innerHTML = chartHtml;

  // Add click listeners to rhythm columns to update caption
  chartEl.querySelectorAll(".rhythm-col").forEach(col => {
    col.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const day = col.dataset.day;
      const count = col.dataset.count;
      const caption = document.getElementById("rhythm-caption");
      if (caption) {
        caption.innerHTML = `<strong>${day}</strong> has <strong>${count} tasks</strong> scheduled. Consistent rhythm keeps roots thriving.`;
      }
    });
  });

  // Also clone into mobile dialog if available
  if (mobRhythmBody) {
    mobRhythmBody.innerHTML = `
      <div class="weekly-rhythm-card" style="border: none; box-shadow: none; padding: 0;">
        <div class="rhythm-chart" style="margin-top: 12px;">
          ${chartHtml}
        </div>
        <p class="rhythm-caption" style="margin-top: 14px;">
          <strong>Thursday</strong> is your peak watering day (4 tasks). Friday eases up gently.
        </p>
      </div>
    `;
  }
}

// ==========================================================================
// Summary Counts & State Updates
// ==========================================================================

function updateCounts() {
  const pendingPlants = AppState.plants.filter(p => p.status === "pending");
  const overdueCount = AppState.plants.filter(p => p.urgency >= 3 && p.status === "pending").length;
  const todayCount = AppState.plants.filter(p => p.urgency >= 1 && p.urgency <= 2 && p.status === "pending").length;
  const doneCount = AppState.plants.filter(p => p.status === "completed" || p.status === "snoozed").length;

  // Update badge counters
  const counterEl = document.getElementById("active-queue-counter");
  if (counterEl) counterEl.textContent = `${pendingPlants.length} left`;

  const todoTabCount = document.getElementById("todo-tab-count");
  if (todoTabCount) todoTabCount.textContent = pendingPlants.length;

  const doneTabCount = document.getElementById("done-tab-count");
  if (doneTabCount) doneTabCount.textContent = doneCount;

  const mobQueueCount = document.getElementById("mob-queue-count");
  if (mobQueueCount) mobQueueCount.textContent = pendingPlants.length;

  const statOverdue = document.getElementById("stat-overdue-count");
  if (statOverdue) statOverdue.textContent = overdueCount;

  const statToday = document.getElementById("stat-today-count");
  if (statToday) statToday.textContent = todayCount;

  const statDone = document.getElementById("stat-done-count");
  if (statDone) statDone.textContent = doneCount;
}

function updateCompanionSummary() {
  updateCounts();
  const msgEl = document.getElementById("companion-message");
  if (!msgEl) return;

  const pendingCount = AppState.plants.filter(p => p.status === "pending").length;
  const hasOverdue = AppState.plants.some(p => p.urgency >= 3 && p.status === "pending");

  if (pendingCount === 0) {
    msgEl.textContent = "All companions are watered and content! Quiet leaves, happy roots.";
  } else if (hasOverdue) {
    msgEl.textContent = "Four quiet green lives under your roof today. Frida's fronds are asking for moisture first.";
  } else {
    msgEl.textContent = `A gentle day. Just ${pendingCount} plant${pendingCount > 1 ? "s" : ""} awaiting your touch.`;
  }
}

/**
 * Resets demo queue back to fresh initial state
 */
function resetDemoQueue() {
  AppState.plants = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_DATA.plants));
  AppState.activeTab = "todo";
  AppState.selectedPlantId = "fern";

  // Reset tab buttons
  document.querySelectorAll(".tab-btn").forEach(btn => {
    btn.classList.toggle("active", btn.dataset.filter === "todo");
    btn.setAttribute("aria-selected", btn.dataset.filter === "todo" ? "true" : "false");
  });

  renderQueue();
  selectPlant("fern");
  updateCompanionSummary();
  hideUndoToast();
}

// ==========================================================================
// Event Listeners Setup
// ==========================================================================

function setupEventListeners() {
  // Global Delegate for Card Actions (Click & Keyboard Enter)
  document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    // Action button inside card or inspector
    const btn = e.target.closest("button[data-action]");
    if (btn) {
      const plantId = btn.dataset.id;
      const action = btn.dataset.action;

      if (action === "complete") {
        handleComplete(plantId);
      } else if (action === "snooze") {
        handleSnooze(plantId);
      } else if (action === "reopen") {
        handleReopen(plantId);
      } else if (action === "inspect") {
        if (window.innerWidth < 980) {
          openMobileInspector(plantId);
        } else {
          selectPlant(plantId);
        }
      }
      return;
    }

    // Card click (open inspector on card tap)
    const card = e.target.closest(".plant-card");
    if (card && !e.target.closest("button")) {
      const plantId = card.dataset.id;
      if (window.innerWidth < 980) {
        openMobileInspector(plantId);
      } else {
        selectPlant(plantId);
      }
    }
  });

  // Undo Toast Actions
  const btnUndo = document.getElementById("btn-undo");
  if (btnUndo) {
    btnUndo.addEventListener("click", undoLastAction);
  }

  const btnToastDismiss = document.getElementById("btn-toast-dismiss");
  if (btnToastDismiss) {
    btnToastDismiss.addEventListener("click", hideUndoToast);
  }

  // Queue View Tab Buttons
  document.querySelectorAll(".tab-btn").forEach(tab => {
    tab.addEventListener("click", () => {
      document.querySelectorAll(".tab-btn").forEach(t => {
        t.classList.remove("active");
        t.setAttribute("aria-selected", "false");
      });
      tab.classList.add("active");
      tab.setAttribute("aria-selected", "true");
      AppState.activeTab = tab.dataset.filter;
      renderQueue();
    });
  });

  // Room Filter Chips
  document.querySelectorAll(".chip[data-room]").forEach(chip => {
    chip.addEventListener("click", () => {
      document.querySelectorAll(".chip[data-room]").forEach(c => {
        c.classList.remove("active");
        c.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
      });
      chip.classList.add("active");
      chip.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true");
      AppState.roomFilter = chip.dataset.room;
      renderQueue();
    });
  });

  // All-Done State Buttons
  const btnViewCompleted = document.getElementById("btn-view-completed");
  if (btnViewCompleted) {
    btnViewCompleted.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const tabCompleted = document.getElementById("tab-completed");
      if (tabCompleted) tabCompleted.click();
    });
  }

  const btnResetDemo = document.getElementById("btn-reset-demo");
  if (btnResetDemo) {
    btnResetDemo.addEventListener("click", resetDemoQueue);
  }

  // Mobile Bottom Bar Buttons
  const mobBtnQueue = document.getElementById("mob-btn-queue");
  const mobBtnRhythm = document.getElementById("mob-btn-rhythm");
  const mobBtnAllPlants = document.getElementById("mob-btn-allplants");
  const rhythmModal = document.getElementById("rhythm-modal");

  if (mobBtnQueue) {
    mobBtnQueue.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const tabTodo = document.getElementById("tab-todo");
      if (tabTodo) tabTodo.click();
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
    });
  }

  if (mobBtnRhythm) {
    mobBtnRhythm.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (rhythmModal) rhythmModal.showModal();
    });
  }

  const closeRhythmBtn = document.getElementById("close-rhythm-modal");
  if (closeRhythmBtn && rhythmModal) {
    closeRhythmBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      rhythmModal.close();
    });
  }

  if (mobBtnAllPlants) {
    mobBtnAllPlants.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const tabAll = document.getElementById("tab-all");
      if (tabAll) tabAll.click();
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
    });
  }

  // Backdrop click to close mobile inspector
  const backdrop = document.getElementById("modal-backdrop");
  if (backdrop) {
    backdrop.addEventListener("click", closeMobileInspector);
  }

  // Keyboard accessibility: Escape closes open mobile modals / sheets
  document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.key === "Escape") {
      closeMobileInspector();
      if (rhythmModal && rhythmModal.open) {
        rhythmModal.close();
      }
      hideUndoToast();
    }
  });
}

// Start Application on DOM Ready
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);

gemini-3.1-pro/13-frontend-playful/index.html

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Moss — Household Plant Companion</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
</head>
<body>
  <!-- Accessibility Skip Link -->
  <a href="#main-queue" class="skip-link">Skip to care queue</a>

  <!-- App Shell -->
  <div class="app-layout">
    
    <!-- Left Column / Companion Sidebar on Desktop -->
    <aside class="sidebar" aria-label="Companion overview">
      <header class="app-brand">
        <div class="brand-mascot" aria-hidden="true">
          <!-- Playful Marimo Moss Ball Mascot SVG -->
          <svg class="mascot-svg" viewBox="0 0 72 72" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
            <ellipse cx="36" cy="62" rx="24" ry="6" fill="#1C231F" opacity="0.12" />
            <!-- Fluffy moss body -->
            <path d="M36 14 C48 14 60 23 60 38 C60 52 48 60 36 60 C22 60 12 52 12 38 C12 23 22 14 36 14Z" fill="#3D6A4B" />
            <path d="M38 18 C48 18 56 26 56 38 C56 49 47 56 36 56 C25 56 16 49 16 38 C16 26 26 18 38 18Z" fill="#4D845D" />
            <!-- Mossy texture tufts -->
            <path d="M22 28 C20 22 26 20 28 24" stroke="#68A57A" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" />
            <path d="M48 24 C52 20 56 26 50 29" stroke="#68A57A" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" />
            <path d="M18 42 C14 45 18 50 22 47" stroke="#68A57A" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" />
            <path d="M52 44 C56 47 52 52 48 49" stroke="#68A57A" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" />
            <!-- Tiny head sprout -->
            <path d="M36 14 C36 8 32 4 28 5 C28 9 32 12 36 14 Z" fill="#9CCF82" />
            <path d="M36 14 C38 7 44 5 45 9 C43 12 39 13 36 14 Z" fill="#7EBB63" />
            <!-- Friendly face -->
            <circle cx="29" cy="38" r="3" fill="#1C231F" />
            <circle cx="43" cy="38" r="3" fill="#1C231F" />
            <ellipse cx="28" cy="37" rx="1" ry="1" fill="#FFFFFF" />
            <ellipse cx="42" cy="37" rx="1" ry="1" fill="#FFFFFF" />
            <!-- Rosy warm cheeks -->
            <ellipse cx="24" cy="42" rx="3.5" ry="2" fill="#E88B68" opacity="0.6" />
            <ellipse cx="48" cy="42" rx="3.5" ry="2" fill="#E88B68" opacity="0.6" />
            <!-- Gentle smile -->
            <path d="M33 42 C34.5 45 37.5 45 39 42" stroke="#1C231F" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" />
          </svg>
        </div>
        <div class="brand-text">
          <div class="brand-title-wrap">
            <h1 class="brand-name">Moss</h1>
            <span class="badge-tag">companion</span>
          </div>
          <p class="brand-tagline">Gentle household plant-care</p>
        </div>
      </header>

      <!-- Daily Botanical Whisper Card -->
      <section class="companion-note" aria-labelledby="companion-greeting">
        <div class="note-header">
          <span class="note-icon" aria-hidden="true">🌱</span>
          <h2 id="companion-greeting" class="note-title">Good morning, grower</h2>
        </div>
        <p class="note-body" id="companion-message">
          Four quiet green lives under your roof today. Frida's fronds are asking for moisture first.
        </p>
        <div class="companion-quick-stats" aria-label="Care progress summary">
          <div class="stat-pill stat-overdue" id="stat-overdue-pill">
            <span class="stat-num" id="stat-overdue-count">1</span>
            <span class="stat-label">overdue</span>
          </div>
          <div class="stat-pill stat-today" id="stat-today-pill">
            <span class="stat-num" id="stat-today-count">2</span>
            <span class="stat-label">due today</span>
          </div>
          <div class="stat-pill stat-done" id="stat-done-pill">
            <span class="stat-num" id="stat-done-count">0</span>
            <span class="stat-label">completed</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- Compact Weekly Rhythm Visualization -->
      <section class="weekly-rhythm-card" aria-labelledby="rhythm-heading">
        <div class="rhythm-card-header">
          <div class="rhythm-titles">
            <h2 id="rhythm-heading" class="rhythm-title">Weekly Rhythm</h2>
            <span class="rhythm-subtitle">Care cadence across 7 days</span>
          </div>
          <span class="rhythm-total-badge" id="rhythm-total-label">16 tasks</span>
        </div>

        <div class="rhythm-chart" id="rhythm-chart" role="region" aria-label="Care load per day of week">
          <!-- Injected via JavaScript from PLANTS.json week array [1,3,2,4,2,1,3] -->
        </div>

        <p class="rhythm-caption" id="rhythm-caption">
          <strong>Thursday</strong> is your peak watering day (4 tasks). Friday eases up gently.
        </p>
      </section>

      <!-- Room Filter Badges -->
      <nav class="room-nav" aria-label="Filter plants by room">
        <h3 class="nav-heading">Filter by Room</h3>
        <div class="room-chips" role="toolbar" aria-label="Location filters">
          <button type="button" class="chip active" data-room="all" aria-pressed="true">All Rooms (4)</button>
          <button type="button" class="chip" data-room="Bathroom" aria-pressed="false">Bathroom (1)</button>
          <button type="button" class="chip" data-room="Bookshelf" aria-pressed="false">Bookshelf (1)</button>
          <button type="button" class="chip" data-room="South window" aria-pressed="false">South window (1)</button>
          <button type="button" class="chip" data-room="Bedroom" aria-pressed="false">Bedroom (1)</button>
        </div>
      </nav>
      
      <!-- Footer note -->
      <footer class="sidebar-footer">
        <p class="footer-tip">Moss runs completely offline. No tracking, no hurry.</p>
      </footer>
    </aside>

    <!-- Center Column / Main Care Queue -->
    <main id="main-queue" class="main-queue" tabindex="-1">
      
      <!-- Queue Header with Status & Filter Tabs -->
      <header class="queue-header">
        <div class="queue-heading-group">
          <div class="queue-title-row">
            <h2 class="queue-heading">Today's Care Queue</h2>
            <span class="queue-counter" id="active-queue-counter" aria-label="3 items remaining">3 left</span>
          </div>
          <p class="queue-subtext">Arranged with love, putting overdue plants first so nothing wilts.</p>
        </div>

        <!-- Filter toggle tabs -->
        <div class="queue-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Care queue views">
          <button type="button" role="tab" id="tab-todo" class="tab-btn active" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="plant-list-panel" data-filter="todo">
            To Do (<span id="todo-tab-count">3</span>)
          </button>
          <button type="button" role="tab" id="tab-all" class="tab-btn" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="plant-list-panel" data-filter="all">
            All Plants (4)
          </button>
          <button type="button" role="tab" id="tab-completed" class="tab-btn" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="plant-list-panel" data-filter="completed">
            Done (<span id="done-tab-count">0</span>)
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      <!-- Urgent Attention Banner (Shown dynamically when overdue tasks exist) -->
      <section class="priority-banner" id="priority-banner" role="alert" aria-live="polite">
        <div class="banner-badge">Urgent Care</div>
        <div class="banner-content">
          <strong>Frida the Boston Fern is 2 days overdue!</strong>
          <span>Her soil dries quickly in bathroom air. A thorough drink recommended.</span>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- Plant Cards Queue Container -->
      <div id="plant-list-panel" class="plant-list" role="region" aria-label="Plants list" aria-live="polite">
        <!-- Rendered by app.js -->
      </div>

      <!-- Useful All-Done State Screen (Hidden when tasks remain, revealed when all done) -->
      <section id="all-done-state" class="all-done-state hidden" aria-labelledby="all-done-heading">
        <div class="all-done-artwork" aria-hidden="true">
          <!-- Whimsical Inline SVG of content, hydrated plants basking together -->
          <svg class="all-done-svg" viewBox="0 0 320 200" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
            <!-- Warm floor line -->
            <path d="M20 170 H300" stroke="#2C352E" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="4 6" />
            <!-- Soft sun glow -->
            <circle cx="160" cy="50" r="38" fill="#FDF1D6" />
            <circle cx="160" cy="50" r="26" fill="#F8DE9E" opacity="0.7" />
            <!-- Gentle sun rays -->
            <path d="M160 8 V20 M160 80 V92 M118 50 H130 M190 50 H202 M130 20 L138 28 M182 72 L190 80 M130 80 L138 72 M182 28 L190 20" stroke="#E5A638" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" />
            
            <!-- Happy Frida pot -->
            <path d="M50 170 L55 130 H85 L90 170 Z" fill="#D2744B" stroke="#2C352E" stroke-width="2" />
            <!-- Fern fronds arching contentedly -->
            <path d="M70 130 C45 105 30 115 25 125" stroke="#3D6A4B" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" />
            <path d="M70 130 C60 90 75 80 80 85" stroke="#4A7C59" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" />
            <path d="M70 130 C90 100 110 105 115 120" stroke="#3D6A4B" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" />
            
            <!-- Resting watering can -->
            <path d="M135 170 L140 140 H180 L185 170 Z" fill="#437785" stroke="#2C352E" stroke-width="2" />
            <path d="M140 145 C125 140 120 155 138 162" stroke="#2C352E" stroke-width="2" fill="none" />
            <path d="M175 145 C190 130 205 135 210 140" stroke="#2C352E" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" />
            <circle cx="212" cy="142" r="3" fill="#6BB0BE" />
            <!-- Resting droplets -->
            <path d="M218 152 C218 155 215 157 213 157 C211 157 208 155 211 150 C214 146 218 150 218 152Z" fill="#6BB0BE" />

            <!-- Happy Dot cactus -->
            <path d="M230 170 L234 136 H266 L270 170 Z" fill="#C9945F" stroke="#2C352E" stroke-width="2" />
            <ellipse cx="250" cy="115" rx="14" ry="22" fill="#63986F" stroke="#2C352E" stroke-width="2" />
            <ellipse cx="240" cy="95" rx="8" ry="12" fill="#75A881" stroke="#2C352E" stroke-width="2" />
            <ellipse cx="260" cy="98" rx="7" ry="10" fill="#75A881" stroke="#2C352E" stroke-width="2" />
            <!-- Little flower -->
            <circle cx="238" cy="85" r="3.5" fill="#E86E6E" />

            <!-- Little happy heart sparkle -->
            <path d="M160 115 C160 112 156 110 154 113 C152 110 148 112 148 115 C148 119 154 122 154 122 C154 122 160 119 160 115Z" fill="#D9534F" />
          </svg>
        </div>

        <h3 id="all-done-heading" class="all-done-title">All quiet on the green front!</h3>
        <p class="all-done-description">
          Every companion due for care today has been nurtured. Soil is checked, leaves are turned, and everyone is basking in the quiet light.
        </p>

        <div class="all-done-next-card">
          <span class="next-label">Next on deck:</span>
          <div class="next-plant-row">
            <span class="next-icon" aria-hidden="true">🌿</span>
            <div class="next-info">
              <strong>Drama (Calathea orbifolia)</strong>
              <span>Scheduled for a gentle mist tomorrow morning.</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="all-done-actions">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" id="btn-view-completed">
            View completed log
          </button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" id="btn-reset-demo">
            Reset demo queue
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>

    </main>

    <!-- Right Column: Interactive Plant Inspector & Care Diary (Desktop Split + Mobile Bottom Sheet / Modal) -->
    <aside class="detail-sidebar" id="plant-inspector-container" aria-label="Plant details and history">
      <div class="inspector-card" id="inspector-card">
        <!-- Rendered by app.js based on selected plant -->
        <div class="inspector-placeholder" id="inspector-placeholder">
          <div class="placeholder-icon" aria-hidden="true">🪴</div>
          <h3>Select a plant</h3>
          <p>Tap any card in the queue to inspect its light preference, moisture requirements, and observation history.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </aside>

  </div>

  <!-- Mobile Floating Quick Bar (Visible on small screens) -->
  <div class="mobile-bottom-bar" aria-label="Mobile quick navigation">
    <button type="button" class="mobile-bar-btn active" id="mob-btn-queue" aria-pressed="true">
      <span class="bar-icon" aria-hidden="true">🌱</span>
      <span class="bar-label">Queue (<span id="mob-queue-count">3</span>)</span>
    </button>
    <button type="button" class="mobile-bar-btn" id="mob-btn-rhythm" aria-pressed="false">
      <span class="bar-icon" aria-hidden="true">📊</span>
      <span class="bar-label">Rhythm</span>
    </button>
    <button type="button" class="mobile-bar-btn" id="mob-btn-allplants" aria-pressed="false">
      <span class="bar-icon" aria-hidden="true">🪴</span>
      <span class="bar-label">Plants (4)</span>
    </button>
  </div>

  <!-- Modal / Drawer Backdrop for Mobile Plant Inspector -->
  <div class="modal-backdrop hidden" id="modal-backdrop" aria-hidden="true"></div>

  <!-- Mobile Rhythm Modal Dialog -->
  <dialog class="rhythm-modal" id="rhythm-modal" aria-labelledby="mob-rhythm-title">
    <div class="modal-content">
      <div class="modal-header">
        <h2 id="mob-rhythm-title">Weekly Rhythm</h2>
        <button type="button" class="btn-icon close-modal-btn" id="close-rhythm-modal" aria-label="Close weekly rhythm dialog">✕</button>
      </div>
      <div id="mob-rhythm-body">
        <!-- Cloned or rendered weekly rhythm view -->
      </div>
    </div>
  </dialog>

  <!-- Floating Undo Toast Notification -->
  <div id="undo-toast" class="undo-toast hidden" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
    <div class="toast-indicator" aria-hidden="true">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" class="toast-check-icon">
        <circle cx="10" cy="10" r="9" fill="#3D6A4B" />
        <path d="M6 10 L9 13 L14 7" stroke="#FFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
      </svg>
    </div>
    <div class="toast-content">
      <span class="toast-message" id="toast-message">Watered Frida</span>
      <span class="toast-subtext" id="toast-subtext">She looks noticeably perkier!</span>
    </div>
    <div class="toast-actions">
      <button type="button" class="btn-undo" id="btn-undo" aria-label="Undo last action">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" class="undo-icon" aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="M3 7 H11 C13.2 7 15 8.8 15 11 C15 13.2 13.2 15 11 15 H5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" />
          <path d="M6 4 L3 7 L6 10" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
        </svg>
        Undo
      </button>
      <button type="button" class="btn-toast-dismiss" id="btn-toast-dismiss" aria-label="Dismiss notification">✕</button>
    </div>
    <!-- 6-second countdown progress bar -->
    <div class="toast-progress" id="toast-progress" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  </div>

  <script src="app.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

gemini-3.1-pro/13-frontend-playful/styles.css

/* ==========================================================================
   Moss — Household Plant Companion Design System
   Visual Direction: Warm, tactile, optimistic, and a little odd.
   No frameworks, no remote fonts, no glass panels, no neon gradients.
   ========================================================================== */

:root {
  /* Earth & Botanical Color Palette */
  --canvas-bg: #F7F4EB;
  --surface-bg: #FCFBF7;
  --surface-alt: #F1ECE0;
  --surface-accent: #EFE7D7;
  
  /* Moss & Foliage Greens */
  --moss-900: #1B2E21;
  --moss-800: #264330;
  --moss-700: #335940;
  --moss-600: #427252;
  --moss-500: #558B67;
  --moss-200: #C4DEC9;
  --moss-100: #E6F2E9;
  --moss-50:  #F2F8F4;

  /* Terracotta & Soil (Warmth, urgent alerts, clay pots) */
  --clay-900: #5A2312;
  --clay-800: #8A371B;
  --clay-700: #B84A24;
  --clay-600: #D05E32;
  --clay-500: #E2764B;
  --clay-200: #F7C6B3;
  --clay-100: #FAEBE5;
  --clay-50:  #FDF5F2;

  /* Sunlight & Marigold */
  --sun-700: #9E5D0E;
  --sun-600: #C87B19;
  --sun-500: #ECA130;
  --sun-300: #FAD178;
  --sun-100: #FDF3D8;
  --sun-50:  #FEF9EC;

  /* Moisture & Dew */
  --dew-800: #1C4852;
  --dew-600: #316E7D;
  --dew-500: #458B9C;
  --dew-200: #B8DEE6;
  --dew-100: #E2F2F5;

  /* High Contrast Loamy Inks for Typography */
  --ink-950: #151A16;
  --ink-900: #1F2722;
  --ink-800: #2D3931;
  --ink-600: #4F5E54;
  --ink-500: #6B7B71;
  --ink-300: #9FADA4;
  --ink-200: #C9D4CC;
  --ink-100: #E3E9E5;

  /* Tactile Outlines & Depth */
  --border-ink: #222B25;
  --border-soft: #D7D2C4;
  --border-muted: #E6E1D4;

  /* Organic Whimsical Shape Language */
  --radius-blob-1: 28px 18px 24px 18px;
  --radius-blob-2: 18px 26px 16px 24px;
  --radius-pot: 20px 20px 28px 28px;
  --radius-sm: 10px;
  --radius-md: 16px;
  --radius-lg: 22px;
  --radius-pill: 999px;

  /* Tactile Shadows */
  --shadow-press: 0 1px 0 var(--border-ink);
  --shadow-tactile-sm: 0 2.5px 0 var(--border-ink);
  --shadow-tactile-md: 0 4px 0 var(--border-ink);
  --shadow-tactile-lg: 0 6px 0 var(--border-ink);
  --shadow-paper: 0 8px 24px rgba(27, 46, 33, 0.08);

  /* Typography Stack - System font fallbacks */
  --font-serif: "Charter", "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino", "Georgia", serif;
  --font-sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;

  /* Motion timing */
  --transition-tactile: transform 0.14s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), box-shadow 0.14s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1);
  --transition-smooth: all 0.22s ease-out;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   CSS Reset & Base Rules
   ========================================================================== */

*, *::before, *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

html {
  font-size: 16px;
  background-color: var(--canvas-bg);
  color: var(--ink-900);
  line-height: 1.5;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

body {
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  background: var(--canvas-bg);
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  position: relative;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

/* Accessible Skip Link */
.skip-link {
  position: absolute;
  top: -100px;
  left: 20px;
  background: var(--moss-900);
  color: #FFFFFF;
  padding: 12px 20px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  font-weight: 600;
  z-index: 9999;
  text-decoration: none;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-tactile-md);
  transition: top 0.2s ease;
}

.skip-link:focus {
  top: 16px;
  outline: 3px solid var(--sun-500);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

/* Focus styles for keyboard users */
:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--moss-700);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

button:focus-visible, a:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--moss-700);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

/* Helper to visually hide elements */
.hidden {
  display: none !important;
}

.sr-only {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Tactile App Layout
   Mobile-First: Single stream on mobile, 3-column dashboard on desktop
   ========================================================================== */

.app-layout {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1440px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 16px 16px 90px 16px; /* 90px bottom padding for mobile bar */
  gap: 20px;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Left Column: Sidebar & Brand
   ========================================================================== */

.sidebar {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
}

/* Brand Header */
.app-brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  background: var(--surface-bg);
  border: 2px solid var(--border-ink);
  border-radius: var(--radius-blob-1);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-tactile-sm);
}

.brand-mascot {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  animation: subtleFloat 4s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.mascot-svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.06));
}

.brand-text {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.brand-title-wrap {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 8px;
}

.brand-name {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 1.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--moss-900);
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  line-height: 1.1;
}

.badge-tag {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  background: var(--moss-100);
  color: var(--moss-800);
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  border: 1px solid var(--moss-200);
}

.brand-tagline {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--ink-600);
}

/* Companion Note Card */
.companion-note {
  background: var(--surface-bg);
  border: 2px solid var(--border-ink);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 16px 18px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-tactile-sm);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.companion-note::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 4px;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    var(--moss-500) 0,
    var(--moss-500) 12px,
    var(--clay-500) 12px,
    var(--clay-500) 24px,
    var(--sun-500) 24px,
    var(--sun-500) 36px
  );
}

.note-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.note-icon {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.note-title {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink-900);
}

.note-body {
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  color: var(--ink-700);
  line-height: 1.45;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.companion-quick-stats {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.stat-pill {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 5px 10px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-ink);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.stat-overdue {
  background: var(--clay-100);
  color: var(--clay-900);
  border-color: var(--clay-800);
}

.stat-overdue .stat-num {
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--clay-800);
}

.stat-today {
  background: var(--sun-100);
  color: var(--sun-700);
  border-color: var(--sun-700);
}

.stat-today .stat-num {
  font-weight: 800;
}

.stat-done {
  background: var(--moss-100);
  color: var(--moss-800);
  border-color: var(--moss-700);
}

.stat-done .stat-num {
  font-weight: 800;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Weekly Rhythm Visualization
   ========================================================================== */

.weekly-rhythm-card {
  background: var(--surface-bg);
  border: 2px solid var(--border-ink);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 16px 18px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-tactile-sm);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}

.rhythm-card-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
}

.rhythm-title {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink-900);
}

.rhythm-subtitle {
  display: block;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--ink-500);
}

.rhythm-total-badge {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  background: var(--surface-alt);
  color: var(--ink-800);
  padding: 3px 9px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-soft);
}

.rhythm-chart {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);
  gap: 6px;
  align-items: flex-end;
  height: 104px;
  padding: 8px 4px 4px 4px;
  background: var(--surface-alt);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-muted);
}

.rhythm-col {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  height: 100%;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  font: inherit;
  color: inherit;
  position: relative;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  transition: transform 0.15s ease;
}

.rhythm-col:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.rhythm-col:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--moss-700);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.rhythm-count {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink-700);
  margin-bottom: 3px;
  transition: transform 0.15s ease;
}

.rhythm-col:hover .rhythm-count {
  transform: scale(1.15);
  color: var(--moss-900);
}

.rhythm-bar-track {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 28px;
  height: 60px;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
  border-radius: 8px 8px 4px 4px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.rhythm-bar-fill {
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--moss-500);
  border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0;
  transition: height 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), background-color 0.2s ease;
}

.rhythm-day-label {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink-600);
  margin-top: 5px;
}

/* Highlight "Today" (Thu - 4 tasks) */
.rhythm-col.is-today .rhythm-bar-fill {
  background: var(--clay-600);
}

.rhythm-col.is-today .rhythm-day-label {
  color: var(--clay-800);
  font-weight: 800;
  position: relative;
}

.rhythm-col.is-today::after {
  content: "today";
  position: absolute;
  top: -12px;
  font-size: 0.58rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--clay-800);
  background: var(--clay-100);
  padding: 1px 4px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1px solid var(--clay-200);
}

.rhythm-caption {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--ink-600);
  line-height: 1.4;
  padding: 2px 2px 0 2px;
}

/* Room Nav */
.room-nav {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.nav-heading {
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: var(--ink-500);
  padding-left: 2px;
}

.room-chips {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}

.chip {
  background: var(--surface-bg);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-soft);
  color: var(--ink-700);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 5px 12px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: var(--transition-tactile);
  min-height: 34px;
}

.chip:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-ink);
  background: var(--surface-accent);
}

.chip.active {
  background: var(--moss-900);
  color: #FFFFFF;
  border-color: var(--border-ink);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--border-ink);
}

.sidebar-footer {
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  color: var(--ink-500);
  padding: 8px 4px;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Center Column: Main Care Queue
   ========================================================================== */

.main-queue {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
  flex: 1;
}

.queue-header {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}

.queue-heading-group {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}

.queue-title-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 10px;
}

.queue-heading {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 1.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--moss-900);
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.queue-counter {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  background: var(--moss-200);
  color: var(--moss-900);
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-ink);
}

.queue-subtext {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--ink-600);
}

/* Queue Tab Controls */
.queue-tabs {
  display: inline-flex;
  background: var(--surface-alt);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-ink);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  padding: 4px;
  gap: 4px;
  align-self: flex-start;
  max-width: 100%;
}

.tab-btn {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink-700);
  padding: 7px 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
  white-space: nowrap;
  min-height: 38px;
}

.tab-btn:hover {
  color: var(--ink-900);
}

.tab-btn.active {
  background: var(--surface-bg);
  color: var(--ink-900);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-ink);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--border-ink);
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* Priority Attention Banner */
.priority-banner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  background: var(--clay-100);
  border: 2px solid var(--clay-800);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 12px 16px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-tactile-sm);
  animation: gentlePulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.banner-badge {
  background: var(--clay-800);
  color: #FFFFFF;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.banner-content {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--clay-900);
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.banner-content strong {
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Plant Cards List
   Tactile cards with distinct botanical personalities
   ========================================================================== */

.plant-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
}

/* Individual Plant Card */
.plant-card {
  background: var(--surface-bg);
  border: 2px solid var(--border-ink);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-tactile-md);
  padding: 16px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
  position: relative;
  transition: var(--transition-tactile);
}

.plant-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-tactile-lg);
}

/* Selected Card Highlight (Desktop Inspector Sync) */
.plant-card.is-selected {
  outline: 3px solid var(--moss-600);
  outline-offset: 1px;
}

/* Priority / Overdue Card Styling */
.plant-card.is-overdue {
  border-color: var(--clay-800);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFF9F6 0%, var(--surface-bg) 40%);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--clay-800);
}

.plant-card.is-overdue:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 6px 0 var(--clay-800);
}

/* Completed Card Styling */
.plant-card.is-completed {
  opacity: 0.85;
  background: var(--moss-50);
  border-color: var(--moss-700);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--moss-700);
}

.plant-card.is-completed .plant-name {
  text-decoration: line-through;
  text-decoration-color: var(--moss-500);
  text-decoration-thickness: 2px;
}

/* Snoozed Card Styling */
.plant-card.is-snoozed {
  opacity: 0.88;
  background: var(--sun-50);
  border-color: var(--sun-700);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--sun-700);
}

/* Card Main Content Row */
.card-main {
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
  align-items: flex-start;
}

/* Plant Botanical Avatar Container */
.plant-avatar-wrap {
  width: 72px;
  height: 72px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border-radius: var(--radius-blob-2);
  background: var(--surface-alt);
  border: 2px solid var(--border-ink);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-press);
}

.plant-avatar-svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  padding: 4px;
}

/* Plant Card Info */
.card-details {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.card-top-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}

.plant-name {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink-950);
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.due-badge {
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 3px 9px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-ink);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.due-badge.badge-overdue {
  background: var(--clay-200);
  color: var(--clay-900);
  border-color: var(--clay-800);
}

.due-badge.badge-today {
  background: var(--sun-300);
  color: var(--ink-950);
  border-color: var(--sun-700);
}

.due-badge.badge-tomorrow {
  background: var(--surface-alt);
  color: var(--ink-700);
  border-color: var(--border-soft);
}

.due-badge.badge-done {
  background: var(--moss-200);
  color: var(--moss-900);
  border-color: var(--moss-700);
}

.plant-species-row {
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  color: var(--ink-600);
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  align-items: center;
}

.species-name {
  font-style: italic;
}

.location-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
  background: var(--surface-accent);
  padding: 1px 7px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink-800);
}

/* Task Callout Strip */
.task-strip {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 4px;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  background: var(--surface-alt);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-soft);
  font-size: 0.84rem;
}

.task-icon-badge {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--surface-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-ink);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.task-description {
  color: var(--ink-800);
  font-weight: 600;
  flex: 1;
}

.light-hint {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--ink-500);
}

/* Action Controls Bar */
.card-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding-top: 4px;
  border-top: 1px dashed var(--border-soft);
}

/* Buttons */
.btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 6px;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 9px 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  border: 2px solid var(--border-ink);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: var(--transition-tactile);
  min-height: 44px; /* Accessible 44px touch target */
  min-width: 44px;
  text-decoration: none;
  background: var(--surface-bg);
  color: var(--ink-900);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-tactile-sm);
}

.btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1.5px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-tactile-md);
}

.btn:active {
  transform: translateY(2px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-press);
}

/* Primary Action Button (Water / Done) */
.btn-primary {
  background: var(--moss-700);
  color: #FFFFFF;
  border-color: var(--border-ink);

}

  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

}

}

  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(21, 26, 22, 0.55);

  z-index: 200;
}

/* Mobile Rhythm Dialog */
.rhythm-modal {

  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  background: var(--surface-bg);
  border: 2px solid var(--border-ink);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 20px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-tactile-lg);
  z-index: 250;
  width: 90%;
  max-width: 440px;
}

.modal-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.modal-header h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  color: var(--moss-900);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Floating Tactile Undo Toast
   ========================================================================== */

.undo-toast {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 80px; /* Above mobile bar on mobile */
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: var(--surface-bg);
  border: 2.5px solid var(--border-ink);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-tactile-lg);
  padding: 12px 16px 16px 16px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  z-index: 300;
  width: 92%;
  max-width: 440px;
  overflow: hidden;
  animation: slideUpBounce 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
}

.toast-indicator {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.toast-check-icon {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.toast-content {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.toast-message {

  font-weight: 700;
