mcode-m3/13-frontend-playful/styles.css

/* =========================================================
   Moss · plant companion
   Warm tactile palette · mobile-first · accessible
   ========================================================= */

:root {
  /* Palette — warm, tactile, optimistic */
  --bg: #F1E6CF;
  --bg-deep: #E8DAB9;
  --paper: #FBF3DF;
  --paper-2: #F6EBCF;
  --ink: #2A2418;
  --ink-soft: #5C513F;
  --ink-mute: #8A7C66;

  /* Greens */
  --moss: #6B7F4A;
  --moss-deep: #3E5A2E;
  --moss-soft: #C2CC9D;
  --sage: #97A577;

  /* Warm accents */
  --clay: #C97B5A;
  --clay-deep: #9C5436;
  --sun: #E8B547;
  --butter: #F4D88A;
  --rose: #D98477;
  --sky: #8FA0AB;
  --berry: #7E4F66;

  /* Status */
  --overdue: var(--clay-deep);
  --today: #B8842C;
  --tomorrow: var(--sage);
  --done: var(--moss-deep);

  /* Shape */
  --r-sm: 8px;
  --r-md: 14px;
  --r-lg: 22px;
  --r-xl: 32px;
  --r-pebble: 28px 22px 30px 24px / 22px 30px 22px 28px;

  /* Type */
  --serif: "Iowan Old Style", "Georgia", "Palatino Linotype", "Book Antiqua", serif;
  --sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace;

  /* Motion */
  --t-fast: 140ms;
  --t-med: 260ms;
  --t-slow: 480ms;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1);
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }

html, body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}

/* Paper-grain backdrop built from inline SVG noise */
body {
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(circle at 18% 22%, rgba(201, 123, 90, 0.08), transparent 38%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 82% 8%, rgba(232, 181, 71, 0.10), transparent 36%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 60% 92%, rgba(107, 127, 74, 0.10), transparent 42%),
    url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='180' height='180'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.85' numOctaves='2' stitchTiles='stitch'/><feColorMatrix values='0 0 0 0 0.16  0 0 0 0 0.12  0 0 0 0 0.06  0 0 0 0.045 0'/></filter><rect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)'/></svg>");
  background-attachment: fixed;
}

::selection { background: var(--moss-soft); color: var(--ink); }

button {
  font: inherit;
  color: inherit;
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
}

a { color: var(--moss-deep); }

/* Skip link */
.skip-link {
  position: absolute;
  top: -100px;
  left: 8px;
  z-index: 100;
  background: var(--moss-deep);
  color: var(--paper);
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.skip-link:focus { top: 8px; }

/* =================== PAGE LAYOUT =================== */
.page {
  max-width: 1180px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 22px 18px 80px;
}

/* =================== TOPBAR =================== */
.topbar {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 18px;
  padding: 6px 4px 18px;
  border-bottom: 1.5px dashed rgba(60, 50, 30, 0.18);
}

.brand {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  font-size: 22px;
  color: var(--moss-deep);
}

.brand__mark {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 0 rgba(60,50,30,0.1));
}

.brand__name { font-size: 1.1em; }

.brand__dot {
  color: var(--ink-mute);
  font-size: 1em;
  margin: 0 -2px;
}

.brand__tag {
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-style: italic;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--ink-mute);
}

.topbar__meta { padding: 0 4px; }
.hello {
  margin: 6px 0 2px;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: clamp(28px, 7.5vw, 42px);
  line-height: 1.05;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 600;
}
.hello::after {
  content: "";
  display: inline-block;
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  margin-left: 6px;
  vertical-align: 0.18em;
  background: var(--clay);
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow: -16px 4px 0 var(--sun), -32px -2px 0 var(--moss-soft);
}
.date {
  margin: 4px 0 0;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
}
.loc { color: var(--ink-mute); font-style: italic; }

/* =================== RHYTHM =================== */
.rhythm {
  margin: 22px 0 14px;
  padding: 18px 18px 14px;
  background: var(--paper);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 0 rgba(60,50,30,0.04),
    0 12px 28px -22px rgba(60,50,30,0.4);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.rhythm::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -24px; right: -30px;
  width: 110px; height: 110px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(232, 181, 71, 0.28), transparent 70%);
  border-radius: 50%;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.rhythm__head { margin-bottom: 10px; }
.rhythm__title {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 19px;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink);
}
.rhythm__sub {
  margin: 2px 0 0;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  color: var(--ink-mute);
}

.bars {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 16px 0 6px;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.bar {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}

.bar__day {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--ink-mute);
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}

.bar__pip {
  --h: 50%;
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 88px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: center;
}

.bar__pip::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 8%;
  right: 8%;
  bottom: 0;
  height: var(--h);
  background:
    linear-gradient(to top, var(--moss) 0%, var(--moss-soft) 100%);
  border-radius: 14px 14px 22px 22px / 12px 12px 30px 30px;
  box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
  transition: height var(--t-slow) var(--ease);
}

.bar__pip::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 22%;
  right: 22%;
  top: 8px;
  bottom: 6px;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%, rgba(255,255,255,0.35), transparent 40%);
  pointer-events: none;
  border-radius: 14px;
}

.bar__count {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  background: var(--paper);
  border: 1.4px solid var(--moss);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 2px 7px;
  line-height: 1;
}

/* Today gets a sun */
.bar--today .bar__pip::before {
  background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--clay) 0%, var(--butter) 100%);
}
.bar--today .bar__count {
  border-color: var(--clay-deep);
  background: var(--butter);
}
.bar--today .bar__day {
  color: var(--clay-deep);
}

.rhythm__caption {
  margin: 8px 4px 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-style: italic;
}

/* =================== SPLIT (mobile single, desktop 2-col) =================== */
.split {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 18px;
  margin-top: 18px;
}

/* =================== QUEUE =================== */
.queue__head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 4px 4px 10px;
}
.queue__title {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 22px;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  color: var(--ink);
}
.queue__count {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--ink-mute);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.cards {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

/* ---------- Card ---------- */
.card {
  position: relative;
  background: var(--paper);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  padding: 14px 14px 12px;
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 0 rgba(60,50,30,0.04),
    0 10px 22px -16px rgba(60,50,30,0.35);
  transition: transform var(--t-med) var(--ease), background var(--t-med) var(--ease);
}

.card::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: auto -2px -2px auto;
  width: 22px; height: 22px;
  background: var(--moss-soft);
  border-radius: 50% 0 var(--r-lg) 50%;
  opacity: 0.7;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.card[data-state="done"] { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #E9E6CC 0%, var(--paper) 100%); }
.card[data-state="done"]::after { background: var(--moss); opacity: 0.85; }
.card[data-state="snoozed"] { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ECDDC4 0%, var(--paper) 100%); }
.card[data-state="snoozed"]::after { background: var(--sky); opacity: 0.85; }

.card[data-selected="true"] {
  outline: 2px solid var(--moss-deep);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.card__btn {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 56px 1fr auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 4px 4px 4px 4px;
  text-align: left;
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
}
.card__btn:focus-visible {
  outline: 2.5px dashed var(--moss-deep);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.card__avatar {
  width: 56px;
  height: 56px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(60,50,30,0.08);
  position: relative;
}
.card__avatar svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }

.card__body {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.card__name {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 18px;
  color: var(--ink);
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  line-height: 1.15;
}
.card__species {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.2;
}
.card__loc {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 4px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--ink-mute);
}

.card__due {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 13px;
  text-transform: lowercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(60,50,30,0.06);
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 1.4px solid transparent;
}
.card[data-urgency="4"] .card__due {
  background: rgba(156, 84, 54, 0.14);
  color: var(--overdue);
  border-color: rgba(156, 84, 54, 0.3);
}
.card[data-urgency="2"] .card__due,
.card[data-urgency="1"] .card__due {
  background: rgba(184, 132, 44, 0.16);
  color: var(--today);
  border-color: rgba(184, 132, 44, 0.32);
}
.card[data-urgency="0"] .card__due {
  background: rgba(151, 165, 119, 0.18);
  color: #54633B;
  border-color: rgba(151, 165, 119, 0.42);
}

/* Card actions */
.card__actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 12px;
  padding-top: 10px;
  border-top: 1.4px dashed rgba(60,50,30,0.14);
}

.act {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  border-radius: 999px;
  transition: transform var(--t-fast) var(--ease), background var(--t-fast) var(--ease), color var(--t-fast) var(--ease);
  border: 1.5px solid transparent;
}
.act svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

.act--water {
  background: var(--moss-deep);
  color: var(--paper);
  border-color: var(--moss-deep);
}
.act--water:hover { background: #4F6E3B; }
.act--water:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px dashed var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

.act--snooze {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  border-color: rgba(60,50,30,0.22);
}
.act--snooze:hover { background: rgba(60,50,30,0.06); color: var(--ink); }
.act--snooze:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px dashed var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

.act:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

.card__status {
  margin-left: auto;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--moss-deep);
  display: none;
}
.card[data-state="done"] .card__status { display: inline; }
.card[data-state="snoozed"] .card__status { display: inline; color: var(--sky); }

/* Water/snooze pulse on action */
@keyframes pulse-good {
  0%   { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(62, 90, 46, 0.4); }
  100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 16px rgba(62, 90, 46, 0); }
}
.card.is-watered { animation: pulse-good var(--t-slow) var(--ease); }

/* ---------- All-done ---------- */
.alldone {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 24px 18px;
  background: var(--paper);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 0 rgba(60,50,30,0.04),
    0 12px 28px -22px rgba(60,50,30,0.4);
  margin-top: 8px;
}
.alldone[hidden] { display: none; }
.alldone__art {
  width: 160px;
  height: auto;
  margin: 0 auto 6px;
  display: block;
}
.alldone__title {
  margin: 6px 0 4px;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 22px;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}
.alldone__sub {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 14.5px;
  max-width: 36ch;
  margin-inline: auto;
}

/* =================== DETAIL PANEL =================== */
.detail {
  background: var(--paper);
  border-radius: var(--r-xl);
  padding: 22px;
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 0 rgba(60,50,30,0.04),
    0 14px 32px -22px rgba(60,50,30,0.4);
  position: sticky;
  top: 16px;
  align-self: start;
}

.detail__hero {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 110px 1fr;
  gap: 18px;
  align-items: center;
  padding-bottom: 18px;
  border-bottom: 1.5px dashed rgba(60,50,30,0.18);
}

.detail__avatar {
  width: 110px;
  height: 110px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(60,50,30,0.08);
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  position: relative;
}
.detail__avatar svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }

.detail__name {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 30px;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  line-height: 1;
}
.detail__species {
  margin: 4px 0 8px;
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 15px;
}
.detail__loc {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--ink-mute);
  padding: 4px 10px;
  background: rgba(60,50,30,0.06);
  border-radius: 999px;
}
.detail__loc svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; }

.detail__grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: 18px;
}

.fact {
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  padding: 12px 14px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: center;
}
.fact__icon {
  width: 28px; height: 28px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--paper);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--moss-deep);
}
.fact__icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
.fact__label {
  display: block;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  color: var(--ink-mute);
  font-weight: 600;
}
.fact__value {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 15px;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin-top: 1px;
}

.detail__history {
  margin-top: 20px;
}
.detail__history h3 {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 15px;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-mute);
}
.timeline {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  position: relative;
}
.timeline::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 9px; top: 4px; bottom: 4px;
  width: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--moss) 0%, transparent 100%);
  border-radius: 2px;
}
.timeline li {
  position: relative;
  padding: 6px 0 6px 28px;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}
.timeline li::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 4px; top: 11px;
  width: 12px; height: 12px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--paper);
  border: 2px solid var(--moss);
}
.timeline li:first-child::before { background: var(--clay); border-color: var(--clay-deep); }
.timeline time {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--ink-mute);
  display: inline-block;
  min-width: 6em;
  margin-right: 8px;
}

.detail__actions {
  margin-top: 22px;
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.detail__note {
  margin-top: 16px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  background: var(--butter);
  border-radius: var(--r-md);
  font-size: 13.5px;
  color: #6B4F1A;
  font-style: italic;
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: flex-start;
}
.detail__note::before {
  content: "";
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 10px; height: 10px;
  background: var(--clay-deep);
  border-radius: 50%;
  margin-top: 6px;
}

/* =================== FOOT =================== */
.foot {
  margin-top: 36px;
  padding-top: 22px;
  border-top: 1.5px dashed rgba(60,50,30,0.18);
  text-align: center;
}
.foot__line {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 15px;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-style: italic;
}
.foot__small {
  margin: 6px 0 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--ink-mute);
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

/* =================== TOAST =================== */
.toast {
  position: fixed;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: 22px;
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(20px);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px 8px 10px 14px;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--paper);
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 18px 30px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity var(--t-med) var(--ease), transform var(--t-med) var(--ease);
  z-index: 60;
  max-width: calc(100vw - 36px);
}
.toast[hidden] { display: none; }
.toast.is-on {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
  pointer-events: auto;
}
.toast__icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.toast__icon svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.toast__msg { font-weight: 500; }
.toast__undo {
  background: var(--paper);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 13px;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}
.toast__undo:hover { background: var(--butter); }
.toast__undo:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--butter); outline-offset: 2px; }

/* =================== RESPONSIVE — DESKTOP =================== */
@media (min-width: 860px) {
  .page { padding: 36px 32px 60px; }

  .topbar {
    flex-direction: row;
    align-items: flex-end;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 36px;
  }
  .topbar__meta { text-align: right; }
  .hello { text-align: right; }

  .rhythm { padding: 22px 24px; }

  .split {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.05fr) minmax(0, 1.45fr);
    gap: 24px;
    margin-top: 26px;
    align-items: start;
  }

  .queue__title { font-size: 26px; }

  /* On desktop, hide in-card actions; show via detail panel */
  .card__actions { display: none; }
  .card { padding: 16px 16px 14px; }

  .detail { padding: 26px; }
  .detail__hero { grid-template-columns: 130px 1fr; }
  .detail__avatar { width: 130px; height: 130px; }
  .detail__name { font-size: 36px; }

  .detail__grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
}

@media (min-width: 1080px) {
  .split { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.6fr); }
  .detail__name { font-size: 40px; }
}

/* =================== REDUCED MOTION =================== */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.001ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.001ms !important;
  }
  .hello::after { animation: none !important; }
}

/* =================== High contrast =================== */
@media (prefers-contrast: more) {
  :root {
    --ink: #1B1610;
    --ink-soft: #2A2418;
  }
  .card, .detail, .rhythm, .alldone { border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.4); }
}

Evaluation 6.5 / 10 graded blind as submission I

Tidy but generic: a 2x2 grid of identical cards with a rhythm chart that has no numbers, and the desktop is half empty. Watered/snooze/undo, an expandable care log and a decent all-done list all work.

Strengths

  • Expandable care log with light/water/spot
  • All-done lists what was done

Weaknesses

  • Same card four times: overdue barely stands out
  • Desktop leaves the lower half blank
  • No h1; focus lost to BODY after an action
  • Detail labels at 2.7:1 contrast
Evidence the grader checked
  • I-desktop.png grid
  • probe.js I m: Watered -> FOCUS BODY, Undo present
  • harness.js (Playwright, 1440 and 390 px): static h1=0
  • fonts.js: 'Light(2.7)'

Objective checks

  • Browser: horizontal scroll at 390 px no; console errors 0; network requests 0

deepseek-v4-pro/13-frontend-playful/RESPONSE.md

Moss — design & build notes

Personality

Moss is a warm, unhurried household companion rather than a productivity manager. The tone is optimistic and slightly odd: the app talks about plants as characters ("not a single leaf complains"), calls itself "Moss, whenever asked", and pairs matter-of-fact care tasks with gentle asides. The visual language leans tactile and botanical — warm paper, moss green, clay and ochre — with hand-drawn inline SVG leaves whose shapes match each species (feathery fern fronds, a heart-leaf pothos, bunny-ear cactus pads, a striped calathea). Every plant gets its own muted tint and silhouette so the queue never reads as a wall of identical cards. Rounded, slightly irregular "blob" geometry and soft shadows keep things organic; there are no neon gradients or glass panels.

Interaction model

  • Care queue is sorted so overdue work always floats to the top (offset ascending, then urgency descending). Frida (2 days overdue) leads, followed by today's tasks, then tomorrow's mist.
  • Detail panel is an inline expandable region: tap/click the row (or press Enter/Space on it) to reveal light, water and location facts plus the care log. The chevron and aria-expanded signal state; the panel animates with a grid-row transition.
  • "Watered" / "Snooze" are the two live actions. The primary button is labelled with the task's past tense (Watered, Rotated, Checked soil, Misted). Watering adds a dated entry to that plant's log, animates the card out, and surfaces a timed Undo toast. Snooze pushes the due date forward one day, lowers urgency, and re-sorts the list; it is equally undoable. Undo restores a snapshot of the plant's full state (including its history).
  • Weekly rhythm is a compact seven-day stem chart. Each bar's height is the task count for that day, topped with a small leaf; bars rise in on load and each day exposes a descriptive label.
  • All-done state appears only when the queue is empty. It celebrates with a swaying sprout, lists exactly what was done, and offers a link back to the weekly rhythm so the screen never dead-ends.

Accessibility & resilience

  • Keyboard: every interactive element is a real <button>/<a>; the accordion rows are buttons with aria-expanded + aria-controls, so they work with Enter/Space and Tab. Panels contain no focusable descendants that could be tabbed into while collapsed.
  • Visible focus: a high-contrast clay :focus-visible ring on all controls.
  • Semantics: <header>, <main>, <section> landmarks, h1-style brand and ordered h2 headings, <ul>/<li> for lists, <dl>-style fact grid, role="region" on panels, role="img" with an overall label on the chart, and role="status"/aria-live="polite" on the toast so undo is announced.
  • Not colour-only: overdue/today/tomorrow badges combine colour with a text label and a marker dot, so status survives colour-blindness and monochrome.
  • Reduced motion: a prefers-reduced-motion query collapses the sway, blink, rise and slide animations and disables smooth scrolling.
  • Offline: plant data from PLANTS.json is inlined in app.js, so the screen runs straight from file:// with zero fetch/network requests, external fonts or remote assets. Fonts are system stacks (a warm serif for headings, a sans for UI).

deepseek-v4-pro/13-frontend-playful/TASK.md

Task 13 — Frontend design: playful mobile-first product

Build a polished mobile-first web app screen for Moss, a gentle household plant-care companion. Use only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: no frameworks, package installs, remote assets, external fonts, or network requests.

Visual direction: warm, tactile, optimistic, and a little odd. Use an expressive shape language and small moments of delight while keeping text readable and controls obvious. Avoid childish clip art, neon gradients, glass panels, and a wall of indistinguishable cards.

The experience must include:

  • Today's care queue for the four plants in PLANTS.json, clearly prioritizing overdue care.
  • A plant detail view or expandable panel with light, water, and observation history.
  • Working “watered” and “snooze” actions that update the interface and offer a brief undo path.
  • A compact weekly rhythm visualization.
  • A useful all-done state.
  • Desktop composition that makes good use of space without merely stretching the mobile column.
  • Keyboard operation, visible focus, semantic controls, and reduced-motion support.

Create index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Use CSS or inline SVG for any illustration. Add RESPONSE.md explaining the personality, interaction model, and accessibility choices. Work only in this directory.

deepseek-v4-pro/13-frontend-playful/app.js

/* Moss — app logic. Data is inlined from PLANTS.json so the screen runs
   fully offline (file://) with no network or fetch requests. */

"use strict";

const PLANTS = [
  {
    id: "fern", name: "Frida", species: "Boston fern", location: "Bathroom",
    task: "Water", offset: -2, urgency: 4, light: "Low, indirect",
    tint: "fern",
    history: ["Sep 19 · Misted", "Sep 16 · Watered", "Sep 12 · New frond"],
  },
  {
    id: "pothos", name: "Orbit", species: "Golden pothos", location: "Bookshelf",
    task: "Rotate", offset: 0, urgency: 2, light: "Medium, indirect",
    tint: "pothos",
    history: ["Sep 20 · Watered", "Sep 14 · Rotated", "Sep 10 · Wiped leaves"],
  },
  {
    id: "cactus", name: "Dot", species: "Bunny ears cactus", location: "South window",
    task: "Check soil", offset: 0, urgency: 1, light: "Bright, direct",
    tint: "cactus",
    history: ["Sep 08 · Watered", "Sep 01 · New pad noted", "Aug 22 · Rotated"],
  },
  {
    id: "calathea", name: "Drama", species: "Calathea orbifolia", location: "Bedroom",
    task: "Mist", offset: 1, urgency: 0, light: "Medium, filtered",
    tint: "calathea",
    history: ["Sep 21 · Misted", "Sep 18 · Watered", "Sep 15 · Brown edge noted"],
  },
];

const WEEK = [1, 3, 2, 4, 2, 1, 3];
const DAY_LABELS = ["M", "T", "W", "T", "F", "S", "S"];
const DAY_NAMES = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"];

const PAST = {
  "Water": "Watered",
  "Rotate": "Rotated",
  "Check soil": "Checked soil",
  "Mist": "Misted",
};

const MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"];
const MONTHS_FULL = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June",
  "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"];
const WEEKDAYS = ["Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"];

const el = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

function dueLabel(offset) {
  if (offset <= -2) return `${-offset} days overdue`;
  if (offset === -1) return "1 day overdue";
  if (offset === 0) return "Today";
  if (offset === 1) return "Tomorrow";
  return `In ${offset} days`;
}

function dueClass(offset) {
  if (offset < 0) return "overdue";
  if (offset === 0) return "today";
  return "tomorrow";
}

function sortQueue(list) {
  return [...list].sort((a, b) => a.offset - b.offset || b.urgency - a.urgency);
}

/* ---------- Illustrations ---------- */

function leafSVG(id) {
  const common = 'viewBox="0 0 96 96" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"';
  switch (id) {
    case "fern":
      return `<svg ${common}>
        <path d="M48 92 C42 70 46 46 54 22" fill="none" stroke="#47603a" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <g fill="#6f9855">
          <path d="M44 78 C34 76 26 79 22 84 C32 81 40 79 44 78Z"/>
          <path d="M46 68 C36 66 28 69 24 74 C34 71 42 69 46 68Z"/>
          <path d="M48 58 C38 56 30 59 26 64 C36 61 44 59 48 58Z"/>
          <path d="M49 48 C40 46 32 49 28 53 C37 50 45 49 49 48Z"/>
          <path d="M51 38 C43 36 35 38 31 42 C40 40 47 39 51 38Z"/>
          <path d="M52 28 C45 26 38 28 34 31 C42 29 48 29 52 28Z"/>
        </g>
        <g fill="#8ab468">
          <path d="M50 78 C60 76 68 79 72 84 C62 81 54 79 50 78Z"/>
          <path d="M50 68 C60 66 68 69 72 74 C62 71 54 69 50 68Z"/>
          <path d="M50 58 C60 56 68 59 72 64 C62 61 54 59 50 58Z"/>
          <path d="M51 48 C60 46 68 49 72 53 C63 50 55 49 51 48Z"/>
          <path d="M51 38 C60 36 68 38 72 42 C63 40 55 39 51 38Z"/>
          <path d="M52 28 C60 26 68 28 72 31 C63 29 55 29 52 28Z"/>
        </g>
      </svg>`;
    case "pothos":
      return `<svg ${common}>
        <path d="M48 14 C48 14 16 40 16 60 C16 74 27 84 40 84 C47 84 48 78 48 72 C48 78 49 84 56 84 C69 84 80 74 80 60 C80 40 48 14 48 14Z" fill="#6f9855"/>
        <path d="M48 14 C48 14 16 40 16 60 C16 66 19 72 24 76 C28 72 30 64 31 52 C35 60 42 64 46 62 C40 54 38 36 48 14Z" fill="#8ab468"/>
        <path d="M48 84 L48 92" stroke="#47603a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
      </svg>`;
    case "cactus":
      return `<svg ${common}>
        <ellipse cx="30" cy="40" rx="13" ry="24" transform="rotate(-22 30 40)" fill="#7ba05f"/>
        <ellipse cx="66" cy="40" rx="13" ry="24" transform="rotate(22 66 40)" fill="#7ba05f"/>
        <ellipse cx="30" cy="40" rx="7" ry="16" transform="rotate(-22 30 40)" fill="#8ab468"/>
        <ellipse cx="66" cy="40" rx="7" ry="16" transform="rotate(22 66 40)" fill="#8ab468"/>
        <ellipse cx="48" cy="70" rx="24" ry="26" fill="#7ba05f"/>
        <ellipse cx="48" cy="70" rx="15" ry="17" fill="#8ab468"/>
        <circle cx="28" cy="34" r="1.4" fill="#e8dcc0"/>
        <circle cx="68" cy="34" r="1.4" fill="#e8dcc0"/>
        <circle cx="40" cy="62" r="1.4" fill="#e8dcc0"/>
        <circle cx="56" cy="70" r="1.4" fill="#e8dcc0"/>
      </svg>`;
    case "calathea":
      return `<svg ${common}>
        <path d="M48 12 C60 22 70 40 70 58 C70 74 60 86 48 86 C36 86 26 74 26 58 C26 40 36 22 48 12Z" fill="#6f9855"/>
        <path d="M48 22 C56 30 62 42 62 58 C62 72 56 82 48 86 C40 82 34 70 34 58 C34 44 40 30 48 22Z" fill="#8ab468"/>
        <path d="M30 56 C36 50 44 48 52 50" stroke="#efe6cd" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.75"/>
        <path d="M28 66 C36 60 46 58 54 60" stroke="#efe6cd" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.75"/>
        <path d="M32 76 C38 72 46 70 52 72" stroke="#efe6cd" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.75"/>
        <path d="M48 86 L48 92" stroke="#47603a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
      </svg>`;
    default:
      return "";
  }
}

function historyIcon(text) {
  if (/Watered|Misted/.test(text)) {
    return `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3 C9 9 6 12 6 15 a6 6 0 0 0 12 0 C18 12 15 9 12 3Z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>`;
  }
  if (/Rotated|Wiped/.test(text)) {
    return `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M20 11 A8 8 0 1 0 21 15"/><path d="M21 4v6h-6"/></svg>`;
  }
  return `<svg class="obs" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5 C8 8 5 12 5 14 a7 7 0 0 0 14 0 C19 12 16 8 12 5Z" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="12" cy="14" r="2.4" fill="#fffdf7"/></svg>`;
}

/* ---------- Rendering ---------- */

function renderHeader() {
  const now = new Date();
  el("today").textContent =
    `${WEEKDAYS[now.getDay()]}, ${MONTHS_FULL[now.getMonth()]} ${now.getDate()}`;
}

function renderRhythm() {
  const chart = el("rhythm-chart");
  const max = Math.max(...WEEK, 1);
  chart.innerHTML = WEEK.map((value, i) => {
    const pct = Math.round((value / max) * 100);
    return `
      <div class="day" role="img" aria-label="${DAY_NAMES[i]}: ${value} care ${value === 1 ? "task" : "tasks"}">
        <div class="bar-track">
          <div class="bar-fill" style="height:${pct}%; animation-delay:${i * 70}ms"></div>
          <span class="bar-leaf" style="bottom:${pct}%"></span>
        </div>
        <span class="dow">${DAY_LABELS[i]}</span>
      </div>`;
  }).join("");
}

function render() {
  const list = el("plant-list");
  const queue = sortQueue(PLANTS.filter((p) => !p.done));
  const done = PLANTS.filter((p) => p.done);

  el("queue-count").textContent = queue.length
    ? `${queue.length} to go`
    : "all clear";

  list.innerHTML = queue.map((p) => {
    const facts = `
      <div class="fact">
        <span class="fact-label">Light</span>
        <span class="fact-value">${p.light}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="fact">
        <span class="fact-label">Water</span>
        <span class="fact-value">${p.task}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="fact">
        <span class="fact-label">Spot</span>
        <span class="fact-value">${p.location}</span>
      </div>`;

    const history = p.history.map((entry) => {
      const [date, ...rest] = entry.split(" · ");
      const note = rest.join(" · ");
      return `
        <li>
          ${historyIcon(note)}
          <span class="h-date">${date}</span>
          <span>${note}</span>
        </li>`;
    }).join("");

    return `
      <li class="plant" data-id="${p.id}">
        <button class="expand" type="button"
          aria-expanded="false"
          aria-controls="detail-${p.id}">
          <span class="leaf-tile" style="--tint:var(--tint-${p.tint})">${leafSVG(p.id)}</span>
          <span class="meta">
            <span class="name">${p.name}</span>
            <span class="sub">${p.species} · ${p.location}</span>
            <span class="task-row">
              <span class="task-chip">${p.task}</span>
              <span class="due ${dueClass(p.offset)}">${dueLabel(p.offset)}</span>
            </span>
          </span>
          <svg class="chevron" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"/></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="actions">
          <button class="btn primary" type="button" data-action="watered" data-id="${p.id}">${PAST[p.task]}</button>
          <button class="btn ghost" type="button" data-action="snooze" data-id="${p.id}">Snooze</button>
        </div>
        <div class="detail" id="detail-${p.id}" role="region" aria-label="${p.name} care details">
          <div class="detail-inner">
            <div class="detail-body">
              <div class="facts">${facts}</div>
              <h4 class="log-title">Care log</h4>
              <ul class="history">${history}</ul>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </li>`;
  }).join("");

  bindExpands();
  bindActions();

  const doneEl = el("all-done");
  if (queue.length === 0) {
    el("all-done-sub").textContent =
      `${done.length} ${done.length === 1 ? "plant" : "plants"} watered, ${todayStamp()} — and not a single leaf complains.`;
    el("done-list").innerHTML = done.map((p) => `
      <li><span class="tick" aria-hidden="true">✓</span>${p.name} · ${PAST[p.task]}</li>`).join("");
    doneEl.hidden = false;
  } else {
    doneEl.hidden = true;
  }
}

function bindExpands() {
  document.querySelectorAll(".expand").forEach((btn) => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const panel = document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute("aria-controls"));
      const open = btn.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true";
      btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(!open));
      panel.classList.toggle("open", !open);
    });
  });
}

function bindActions() {
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-action]").forEach((btn) => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const plant = PLANTS.find((p) => p.id === btn.dataset.id);
      if (btn.dataset.action === "watered") markWatered(plant, btn);
      else snooze(plant);
    });
  });
}

/* ---------- Actions ---------- */

function todayStamp() {
  const now = new Date();
  return `${MONTHS[now.getMonth()]} ${now.getDate()}`;
}

function markWatered(plant, btn) {
  const snap = snapshot(plant);
  plant.done = true;
  plant.history.unshift(`${todayStamp()} · ${PAST[plant.task]}`);

  const item = btn.closest(".plant");
  if (item) {
    item.classList.add("leaving");
    setTimeout(render, 320);
  } else {
    render();
  }
  showToast(`${plant.name} ${PAST[plant.task].toLowerCase()}.`, () => {
    restore(plant, snap);
    render();
  });
}

function snooze(plant) {
  const snap = snapshot(plant);
  plant.offset += 1;
  plant.urgency = Math.max(0, plant.urgency - 1);
  render();
  showToast(`${plant.name} snoozed to ${dueLabel(plant.offset).toLowerCase()}.`, () => {
    restore(plant, snap);
    render();
  });
}

function snapshot(plant) {
  return { ...plant, history: [...plant.history] };
}

function restore(plant, snap) {
  Object.assign(plant, snap);
}

/* ---------- Toast / undo ---------- */

let toastTimer = null;
let pendingUndo = null;

function showToast(message, undo) {
  const toast = el("toast");
  const msg = el("toast-msg");
  const undoBtn = el("toast-undo");

  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  msg.textContent = message;
  pendingUndo = undo || null;
  undoBtn.hidden = !undo;

  toast.hidden = false;
  toast.classList.remove("show");
  void toast.offsetWidth;
  toast.classList.add("show");

  toastTimer = setTimeout(hideToast, 6000);
}

function hideToast() {
  el("toast").hidden = true;
  pendingUndo = null;
}

el("toast-undo").addEventListener("click", () => {
  if (pendingUndo) pendingUndo();
  hideToast();
});

/* ---------- Init ---------- */

renderHeader();
renderRhythm();
render();

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Moss · gentle plant care</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Moss is a gentle household plant-care companion." />
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css" />
</head>
<body>
  <div class="shell">
    <header class="topbar">
      <a class="brand" href="#" aria-label="Moss home">
        <svg class="brand-mark" viewBox="0 0 40 40" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
          <path class="stem" d="M20 35 C20 28 19 21 16 15" />
          <path class="leaf-a" d="M16 15 C9 11 5 11 3 16 C5 21 11 23 16 15 Z" />
          <path class="leaf-b" d="M17 20 C23 15 27 13 31 14 C31 20 27 24 17 20 Z" />
        </svg>
        <span class="brand-word">Moss</span>
      </a>
      <p class="today" id="today">—</p>
    </header>

    <main class="layout">
      <section class="queue" aria-labelledby="queue-title">
        <div class="section-head">
          <h2 id="queue-title">Today&rsquo;s care</h2>
          <span class="count" id="queue-count" aria-live="polite">4 to go</span>
        </div>

        <ul class="plant-list" id="plant-list"></ul>

        <div class="all-done" id="all-done" hidden>
          <svg class="all-done-art" viewBox="0 0 120 96" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
            <path class="pot" d="M34 72 h52 v12 a4 4 0 0 1 -4 4 h-44 a4 4 0 0 1 -4 -4 Z" />
            <path class="sprout" d="M60 74 C60 62 58 50 50 38" />
            <path class="leaf-l" d="M50 38 C40 30 34 30 31 38 C35 46 43 48 50 38 Z" />
            <path class="leaf-r" d="M52 44 C62 36 68 34 72 38 C70 46 62 50 52 44 Z" />
            <path class="leaf-l2" d="M60 54 C56 46 50 42 46 44 C50 52 56 56 60 54 Z" />
            <circle class="spark s1" cx="82" cy="34" r="3" />
            <circle class="spark s2" cx="34" cy="22" r="2.5" />
            <circle class="spark s3" cx="88" cy="56" r="2" />
          </svg>
          <h3 id="all-done-title">Every leaf is looked after</h3>
          <p class="all-done-sub" id="all-done-sub"></p>
          <ul class="done-list" id="done-list"></ul>
          <a class="btn text" href="#rhythm">See this week&rsquo;s rhythm</a>
        </div>
      </section>

      <aside class="side">
        <section class="rhythm" id="rhythm" aria-labelledby="rhythm-title">
          <div class="section-head">
            <h2 id="rhythm-title">Weekly rhythm</h2>
          </div>
          <p class="rhythm-hint">How busy the week is around here.</p>
          <div class="rhythm-chart" id="rhythm-chart" role="img" aria-label="Weekly care rhythm chart"></div>
        </section>

        <section class="gentle" aria-labelledby="gentle-title">
          <h2 id="gentle-title" class="visually-hidden">A gentle reminder</h2>
          <p class="gentle-text">&ldquo;Plants are just slow, quiet optimism.&rdquo;</p>
          <p class="gentle-attr">— Moss, whenever asked</p>
        </section>
      </aside>
    </main>
  </div>

  <div class="toast" id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden>
    <span class="toast-msg" id="toast-msg"></span>
    <button class="toast-undo" id="toast-undo" type="button">Undo</button>
  </div>

  <script src="app.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

deepseek-v4-pro/13-frontend-playful/styles.css

/* Moss — warm, tactile, optimistic, a little odd */

:root {
  --paper: #f7f0e2;
  --paper-2: #efe4cd;
  --card: #fffdf7;
  --ink: #35312a;
  --ink-soft: #6f6655;
  --ink-faint: #9c917c;

  --moss: #5f7d4a;
  --moss-deep: #47603a;
  --moss-soft: #8ab468;
  --clay: #c9744f;
  --clay-deep: #a85736;
  --ochre: #d7a13f;
  --ochre-deep: #9a7224;

  --line: #e3d8c1;
  --line-strong: #cfc2a5;

  --tint-fern: #e7eedb;
  --tint-pothos: #f4e9cd;
  --tint-cactus: #f6e3d5;
  --tint-calathea: #ece4dc;

  --radius: 26px;
  --shadow: 0 10px 24px -14px rgba(76, 61, 38, 0.35);
  --focus: #c9744f;
}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  background-color: var(--paper);
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(38rem 26rem at 110% -6%, rgba(201, 116, 79, 0.10), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(30rem 24rem at -12% 18%, rgba(95, 125, 74, 0.12), transparent 62%),
    radial-gradient(24rem 20rem at 90% 100%, rgba(215, 161, 63, 0.10), transparent 60%);
  background-attachment: fixed;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

.shell {
  width: min(1080px, 100% - 2rem);
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding-block: 1.25rem 4rem;
}

/* ---------- Header ---------- */

.topbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding-block: 0.5rem 1.5rem;
}

.brand {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--ink);
  border-radius: 12px;
}

.brand-mark {
  width: 2.2rem;
  height: 2.2rem;
}

.brand-mark .stem {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--moss-deep);
  stroke-width: 2.4;
  stroke-linecap: round;
}

.brand-mark .leaf-a {
  fill: var(--moss);
}

.brand-mark .leaf-b {
  fill: var(--moss-soft);
}

.brand-word {
  font-family: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 1.6rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
}

.today {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

/* ---------- Layout ---------- */

.layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  align-items: start;
}

.section-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.section-head h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 1.45rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.005em;
}

.count {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--clay-deep);
  background: #f4e3d4;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.7rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* ---------- Plant list ---------- */

.plant-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.9rem;
}

.plant {
  background: var(--card);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: transform 0.25s ease, opacity 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
}

.plant:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -16px rgba(76, 61, 38, 0.42);
}

.plant.leaving {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(-10px) scale(0.96);
}

/* expandable row */
.expand {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
  font: inherit;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

.leaf-tile {
  --tint: var(--moss-soft);
  width: 3.6rem;
  height: 3.6rem;
  border-radius: 46% 54% 52% 48% / 55% 48% 52% 45%;
  background: var(--tint);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  flex: none;
}

.leaf-tile svg {
  width: 2.7rem;
  height: 2.7rem;
  display: block;
}

.meta {
  min-width: 0;
}

.name {
  display: block;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.002em;
}

.sub {
  display: block;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.task-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  margin-top: 0.35rem;
}

.task-chip {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--moss-deep);
  background: #eef1e6;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.1rem 0.55rem;
}

.due {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.1rem 0.55rem;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.3rem;
}

.due::before {
  content: "";
  width: 0.42rem;
  height: 0.42rem;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: currentColor;
  flex: none;
}

.due.overdue {
  color: var(--clay-deep);
  background: #f7e0d3;
}

.due.today {
  color: var(--ochre-deep);
  background: #f7ead0;
}

.due.tomorrow {
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  background: #ece6d6;
}

.chevron {
  width: 1.2rem;
  height: 1.2rem;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
  transition: transform 0.25s ease;
  flex: none;
}

.expand[aria-expanded="true"] .chevron {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}

/* action bar */
.actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  padding: 0 1rem 1rem;
}

.btn {
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 600;
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 0.55rem 1rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: 1.5px solid transparent;
  transition: transform 0.15s ease, background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

.btn:active {
  transform: scale(0.97);
}

.btn.primary {
  background: var(--moss);
  color: #fdfbf5;
  flex: 1;
}

.btn.primary:hover {
  background: var(--moss-deep);
}

.btn.ghost {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
}

.btn.ghost:hover {
  border-color: var(--clay);
  color: var(--clay-deep);
}

.btn.text {
  display: inline-flex;
  color: var(--moss-deep);
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.25rem;
}

/* ---------- Detail panel ---------- */

.detail {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 0fr;
  transition: grid-template-rows 0.3s ease;
}

.detail.open {
  grid-template-rows: 1fr;
}

.detail-inner {
  overflow: hidden;
}

.detail-body {
  padding: 0 1rem 1rem;
  border-top: 1px dashed var(--line-strong);
  margin: 0 1rem;
}

.facts {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 0.6rem;
  padding: 1rem 0;
}

.fact {
  background: var(--paper);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 0.6rem 0.7rem;
}

.fact-label {
  display: block;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.fact-value {
  display: block;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-top: 0.1rem;
}

.log-title {
  margin: 0.25rem 0 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.history {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.history li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  padding: 0.45rem 0;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--paper-2);
}

.history li:last-child {
  border-bottom: 0;
}

.history .h-date {
  color: var(--ink-faint);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  min-width: 4.4rem;
}

.history svg {
  width: 1.05rem;
  height: 1.05rem;
  color: var(--moss);
  flex: none;
}

.history svg.obs {
  color: var(--clay);
}

/* ---------- Weekly rhythm ---------- */

.rhythm {
  background: var(--card);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  padding: 1.1rem 1.1rem 1.25rem;
}

.rhythm-hint {
  margin: -0.4rem 0 1rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.rhythm-chart {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  height: 8.5rem;
  padding-top: 0.75rem;
}

.day {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  height: 100%;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

.bar-track {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 2.1rem;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
}

.bar-fill {
  width: 100%;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(var(--moss-soft), var(--moss));
  transform-origin: bottom;
  animation: rise 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.3, 1) both;
}

.bar-leaf {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, 0) rotate(-45deg);
  width: 0.8rem;
  height: 0.8rem;
  border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 0;
  background: var(--moss-deep);
}

.dow {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

@keyframes rise {
  from { transform: scaleY(0); }
  to { transform: scaleY(1); }
}

/* ---------- Gentle note ---------- */

.gentle {
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
}

.gentle-text {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-style: italic;
}

.gentle-attr {
  margin: 0.35rem 0 0;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}

/* ---------- All done ---------- */

.all-done {
  text-align: center;
  background: var(--card);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  padding: 2.5rem 1.5rem;
}

.all-done-art {
  width: 8.5rem;
  height: 7rem;
  margin-inline: auto;
}

.all-done-art .pot {
  fill: #dca37a;
}

.all-done-art .sprout {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--moss-deep);
  stroke-width: 3;
  stroke-linecap: round;
}

.all-done-art .leaf-l,
.all-done-art .leaf-r,
.all-done-art .leaf-l2 {
  fill: var(--moss);
  transform-box: fill-box;
  transform-origin: center;
  animation: sway 2.6s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.all-done-art .leaf-r {
  fill: var(--moss-soft);
  animation-delay: 0.4s;
}

.all-done-art .leaf-l2 {
  animation-delay: 0.8s;
}

.all-done-art .spark {
  fill: var(--ochre);
  animation: blink 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.all-done-art .s2 { animation-delay: 0.4s; }
.all-done-art .s3 { animation-delay: 0.8s; }

@keyframes sway {
  0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-4deg); }
  50% { transform: rotate(4deg); }
}

@keyframes blink {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.35; transform: scale(0.85); }
  50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.15); }
}

.all-done h3 {
  margin: 1rem 0 0.25rem;
  font-family: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
}

.all-done-sub {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.done-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 1.25rem auto 1.5rem;
  padding: 0;
  max-width: 20rem;
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  text-align: left;
}

.done-list li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.8rem;
  background: var(--paper);
  border-radius: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.done-list .tick {
  width: 1.15rem;
  height: 1.15rem;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--moss);
  color: #fff;
  display: inline-grid;
  place-items: center;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  flex: none;
}

/* ---------- Toast ---------- */

.toast {
  position: fixed;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: 1.25rem;
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: #fbf7ee;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem 0.75rem 1.1rem;
  border-radius: 16px;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 34px -14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  max-width: min(92vw, 30rem);
  z-index: 50;
}

.toast[hidden] {
  display: none;
}

.toast.show {
  animation: toast-in 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.3, 1) both;
}

@keyframes toast-in {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(1rem); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
}

.toast-msg {
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.toast-undo {
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #ffe0c8;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.toast-undo:hover {
  color: #fff;
  text-decoration: underline;
}

/* ---------- Focus ---------- */

:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--focus);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

/* ---------- Utility ---------- */

.visually-hidden {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  margin: -1px;
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

/* ---------- Reduced motion ---------- */

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html {
    scroll-behavior: auto;
  }

  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.001ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.001ms !important;
  }
}

/* ---------- Desktop ---------- */

@media (min-width: 860px) {
  .shell {
    padding-top: 1.75rem;
  }

  .layout {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 20rem;
    gap: 2rem;
  }

  .plant-list {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .side {
    position: sticky;
    top: 1.5rem;
  }

  .gentle {
    margin-top: 1.5rem;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 1120px) {
  .layout {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 21rem;
  }
}

Evaluation 6.5 / 10 graded blind as submission R

A minimal list with a mood blob and a rhythm chart without numbers. Actions are hidden until a row is expanded. Undo and the done flow work, but the screen is sparse and generic.

Strengths

  • Expand shows light, history, Mark water/Snooze
  • Undo toast present

Weaknesses

  • Actions are not visible in the queue
  • Desktop mostly empty
  • Rhythm unlabeled
Evidence the grader checked
  • probe.js R m: actions appear only after expanding
  • harness.js (Playwright, 1440 and 390 px): doneClicks 0 without expanding
  • process_note: low-effort rerun

Objective checks

  • Browser: horizontal scroll at 390 px no; console errors 0; network requests 0

mistral-large-4/13-frontend-playful/RESPONSE.md

Moss — response notes

Personality

Moss is warm, tactile, optimistic, and a little odd — like a helpful friend who keeps plants, not a dashboard. The palette is sun-baked paper (#f6efe3), deep moss green, terracotta clay, and marigold, over a faint dotted paper texture. Cards use asymmetric "organic" corner radii, plant portraits are hand-drawn inline SVG (a swaying fern, a trailing pothos, a bunny-ears cactus, a striped calathea), and the brand mark and "Moss mood" blob gently bob. Small delights: overdue plants sway, the mood blob grows a flower when the queue is clear, and every action gets a friendly one-line toast. No gradients-as-decoration, no glass, no clip art — color is flat, warm, and confident, and type stays large and readable.

Interaction model

  • Care queue. The four plants from PLANTS.json render as an expandable list, sorted so overdue care (urgency ≥ 3) leads, followed by today's tasks, then tomorrow's; cared-for plants sink to the bottom. Overdue rows carry a clay left-edge and badge.
  • Detail panel. Each plant header is a real <button> with aria-expanded/aria-controls that reveals a panel with light needs, next task, location, recent notes (light/water/observation history), and the two actions. Escape closes the panel and returns focus to its header.
  • Watered / snooze with undo. "Mark …" marks the plant cared-for (done styling, disabled button, queue count updates); "Snooze to tomorrow" moves the task out of today. Both fire a toast with an Undo button that fully reverts the change; toasts auto-dismiss after 6 seconds.
  • Weekly rhythm. A compact seven-bar chart of the week array, with Monday-first labels and today's bar highlighted in clay. It carries a role="img" + aria-label summary and per-bar titles.
  • All-done state. When every plant is cared for, a celebratory moss panel appears above the queue ("All done — the moss is thriving") with a Start the day over reset, and the mood blob blooms.
  • Desktop composition. Above 920px the layout becomes a two-column grid: the queue on the left, a sticky sidebar on the right holding the weekly rhythm and the mood character — space is used for a companion panel, not by stretching the mobile column. Detail facts go multi-column at wider widths.

Accessibility choices

  • Fully keyboard-operable: every control is a native <button>; focus order follows the visual order; a skip link jumps to the queue.
  • Visible focus: a high-contrast double-ring :focus-visible style on all interactive elements.
  • Semantic structure: header/main/section/aside, a single h1, list markup for the queue and histories, aria-expanded/aria-controls on expanders, aria-live="polite" on the queue count, mood label, and toast (role="status").
  • The decorative SVGs are aria-hidden; plant illustrations that convey identity have role="img" + aria-label; the rhythm chart has a text alternative via role="img" + aria-label.
  • prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables all animation and transitions (bobbing, swaying, toast entrance, smooth scroll).
  • Data loads from local PLANTS.json via fetch, with an embedded copy as a fallback so the page works from file:// too. No network requests, external fonts, frameworks, or remote assets of any kind.

mistral-large-4/13-frontend-playful/TASK.md

Task 13 — Frontend design: playful mobile-first product

Build a polished mobile-first web app screen for Moss, a gentle household plant-care companion. Use only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: no frameworks, package installs, remote assets, external fonts, or network requests.

Visual direction: warm, tactile, optimistic, and a little odd. Use an expressive shape language and small moments of delight while keeping text readable and controls obvious. Avoid childish clip art, neon gradients, glass panels, and a wall of indistinguishable cards.

The experience must include:

  • Today's care queue for the four plants in PLANTS.json, clearly prioritizing overdue care.
  • A plant detail view or expandable panel with light, water, and observation history.
  • Working “watered” and “snooze” actions that update the interface and offer a brief undo path.
  • A compact weekly rhythm visualization.
  • A useful all-done state.
  • Desktop composition that makes good use of space without merely stretching the mobile column.
  • Keyboard operation, visible focus, semantic controls, and reduced-motion support.

Create index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Use CSS or inline SVG for any illustration. Add RESPONSE.md explaining the personality, interaction model, and accessibility choices. Work only in this directory.

mistral-large-4/13-frontend-playful/app.js

      '<ellipse cx="48" cy="32" rx="4.6" ry="3.8" transform="rotate(-42 48 32)"/>' +
      '<ellipse cx="36" cy="13" rx="5" ry="4"/>' +
      '<ellipse cx="31" cy="20" rx="4" ry="3.4" transform="rotate(-24 31 20)"/>' +
      '<ellipse cx="42" cy="19" rx="4" ry="3.4" transform="rotate(24 42 19)"/>' +
      '</g></svg>',
    cactus:
      '<svg viewBox="0 0 72 72" role="img" aria-label="Illustration of a bunny ears cactus in a striped pot">' +
      '<path d="M25 44 h22 l-3 18 h-16 Z" fill="#f6efe3" stroke="#c4623d" stroke-width="2"/>' +
      '<path d="M26.5 50 h19 M28 56 h16" stroke="#c4623d" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>' +
      '<ellipse cx="36" cy="38" rx="9" ry="8" fill="#7a9b6d"/>' +
      '<ellipse cx="29" cy="24" rx="6" ry="12" fill="#7a9b6d" transform="rotate(-12 29 24)"/>' +
      '<ellipse cx="43" cy="24" rx="6" ry="12" fill="#7a9b6d" transform="rotate(12 43 24)"/>' +
      '<ellipse cx="29" cy="24" rx="2.6" ry="7" fill="#a9c39a" transform="rotate(-12 29 24)"/>' +
      '<ellipse cx="43" cy="24" rx="2.6" ry="7" fill="#a9c39a" transform="rotate(12 43 24)"/>' +
      '<g fill="#f6efe3"><circle cx="27" cy="16" r="1"/><circle cx="31" cy="20" r="1"/><circle cx="41" cy="17" r="1"/><circle cx="45" cy="22" r="1"/><circle cx="34" cy="36" r="1"/><circle cx="39" cy="40" r="1"/></g>' +
      '</svg>',
    calathea:
      '<svg viewBox="0 0 72 72" role="img" aria-label="Illustration of a striped calathea in a clay pot">' +
      '<path d="M24 46 h24 l-3.5 18 h-17 Z" fill="#c4623d"/>' +
      '<rect x="21" y="43" width="30" height="6" rx="3" fill="#a94f2f"/>' +
      '<g fill="none" stroke="#3e5539" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round">' +
      '<path d="M36 44 C 34 34 28 28 20 24"/>' +
      '<path d="M36 44 C 38 33 44 27 52 23"/>' +
      '<path d="M36 44 C 36 34 36 26 36 18"/>' +
      '</g>' +
      '<g>' +
      '<ellipse cx="19" cy="21" rx="6" ry="9" fill="#55704f" transform="rotate(-28 19 21)"/>' +
      '<ellipse cx="53" cy="20" rx="6" ry="9" fill="#55704f" transform="rotate(28 53 20)"/>' +
      '<ellipse cx="36" cy="14" rx="6.4" ry="9.4" fill="#7a9b6d"/>' +
      '<path d="M17 15 L21 27 M51 14 L47 26 M36 6 L36 22" stroke="#dfe7d2" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>' +
      '</g></svg>'
  };

  var ICON = {
    sun: '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="18" height="18" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="4" fill="#e3a83b"/><g stroke="#e3a83b" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M10 1.5v2.4M10 16.1v2.4M1.5 10h2.4M16.1 10h2.4M4 4l1.7 1.7M14.3 14.3L16 16M16 4l-1.7 1.7M5.7 14.3L4 16"/></g></svg>',
    drop: '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="18" height="18" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 2 C 13 6.5 15.5 9.4 15.5 12.2 A 5.5 5.5 0 0 1 4.5 12.2 C 4.5 9.4 7 6.5 10 2 Z" fill="#55704f"/></svg>',
    pin: '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="18" height="18" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 18 C 10 18 4 12.6 4 8.4 A 6 6 0 0 1 16 8.4 C 16 12.6 10 18 10 18 Z" fill="none" stroke="#c4623d" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="10" cy="8.4" r="2" fill="#c4623d"/></svg>',
    check: '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 10.5 L8.2 14.5 L16 5.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>',
    chevron: '<svg class="chev" viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="18" height="18" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 7.5 L10 12.5 L15 7.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>',
    moon: '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M15.5 12.5 A 7 7 0 0 1 7.5 4.5 A 7 7 0 1 0 15.5 12.5 Z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>'
  };

  /* ---------- header date ---------- */
  function renderDate() {
    var d = new Date();
    var text = d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: "long", month: "long", day: "numeric" });
    $("header-date").textContent = text;
  }

  /* ---------- queue ---------- */
  function dueClass(p) {
    if (done[p.id]) return "due--done";
    if (snoozed[p.id]) return "due--soon";
    if (p.urgency >= 3) return "due--overdue";
    if (p.urgency >= 1) return "due--today";
    return "due--soon";
  }
  function dueLabel(p) {
    if (done[p.id]) return "Done";
    if (snoozed[p.id]) return "Snoozed · tomorrow";
    return p.due;
  }

  function renderQueue() {
    var list = $("plant-list");
    list.innerHTML = "";

    var sorted = plants.slice().sort(function (a, b) {
      var da = done[a.id] ? 1 : 0, db = done[b.id] ? 1 : 0;
      if (da !== db) return da - db;           // cared-for plants sink to the bottom
      return b.urgency - a.urgency;            // overdue first
    });

    sorted.forEach(function (p) {
      var isDone = !!done[p.id];
      var li = el("li", "plant" + (p.urgency >= 3 && !isDone ? " is-overdue" : "") + (isDone ? " is-done" : ""));
      li.dataset.id = p.id;

      var head = el("button", "plant-head");
      head.type = "button";
      head.setAttribute("aria-expanded", expandedId === p.id ? "true" : "false");
      head.setAttribute("aria-controls", "detail-" + p.id);
      head.innerHTML =
        '<span class="plant-art" aria-hidden="true">' + ART[p.id] + "</span>" +
        '<span class="plant-info">' +
          '<span class="plant-name">' + esc(p.name) +
            (isDone ? ' <span class="done-badge">' + ICON.check + " cared for</span>" : "") +
            '<span class="plant-species">' + esc(p.species) + "</span></span>" +
          '<span class="plant-meta">' + esc(p.location) + " · " + esc(p.task) + "</span>" +
        "</span>" +
        '<span class="due ' + dueClass(p) + '">' + esc(dueLabel(p)) + "</span>" +
        ICON.chevron;
      head.addEventListener("click", function () {
        expandedId = expandedId === p.id ? null : p.id;
        renderQueue();
        if (expandedId === p.id) {
          var panel = document.getElementById("detail-" + p.id);
          if (panel) {
            var firstBtn = panel.querySelector("button");
            if (firstBtn) firstBtn.focus();
          }
        }
      });
      li.appendChild(head);

      var detail = el("div", "plant-detail");
      detail.id = "detail-" + p.id;
      detail.hidden = expandedId !== p.id;

      var facts = el("div", "detail-grid");
      facts.innerHTML =
        '<div class="detail-fact">' + ICON.sun + "<span><strong>Light</strong> · " + esc(p.light) + "</span></div>" +
        '<div class="detail-fact">' + ICON.drop + "<span><strong>Next</strong> · " + esc(p.task) + " · " + esc(dueLabel(p)) + "</span></div>" +
        '<div class="detail-fact">' + ICON.pin + "<span><strong>Spot</strong> · " + esc(p.location) + "</span></div>";
      detail.appendChild(facts);

      var history = el("div", "history");
      var hTitle = el("h3", null, "Recent notes");
      var hList = el("ul");
      p.history.forEach(function (note) {
        hList.appendChild(el("li", null, esc(note)));
      });
      history.appendChild(hTitle);
      history.appendChild(hList);
      detail.appendChild(history);

      var actions = el("div", "detail-actions");
      var waterBtn = el("button", "btn btn-primary", ICON.check + (isDone ? "Cared for" : "Mark " + p.task.toLowerCase()));
      waterBtn.type = "button";
      waterBtn.disabled = isDone;
      waterBtn.addEventListener("click", function () { water(p); });
      var snoozeBtn = el("button", "btn btn-ghost", ICON.moon + "Snooze to tomorrow");
      snoozeBtn.type = "button";
      snoozeBtn.disabled = isDone || !!snoozed[p.id];
      snoozeBtn.addEventListener("click", function () { snooze(p); });
      actions.appendChild(waterBtn);
      actions.appendChild(snoozeBtn);
      detail.appendChild(actions);

      li.appendChild(detail);
      list.appendChild(li);
    });

    renderCount();
    renderDoneState();
  }

  function renderCount() {
    var remaining = plants.filter(function (p) { return !done[p.id]; }).length;
    var overdue = plants.filter(function (p) { return !done[p.id] && p.urgency >= 3; }).length;
    var msg;
    if (remaining === 0) msg = "Queue clear";
    else if (overdue > 0) msg = overdue + " overdue · " + remaining + " to go";
    else msg = remaining + " plant" + (remaining === 1 ? "" : "s") + " to tend";
    $("queue-count").textContent = msg;
  }

  /* ---------- actions ---------- */
  function water(p) {
    if (done[p.id]) return;
    done[p.id] = true;
    showToast(p.name + " says thank you — marked as cared for.", "Undo", function () {
      delete done[p.id];
      renderQueue();
      renderMood();
    });
    renderQueue();
    renderMood();
  }

  function snooze(p) {
    if (snoozed[p.id]) return;
    if (!originalDue[p.id]) originalDue[p.id] = { due: p.due, urgency: p.urgency };
    snoozed[p.id] = true;
    p.due = "Tomorrow";
    p.urgency = 0;
    showToast(p.name + " is snoozed until tomorrow.", "Undo", function () {
      var orig = originalDue[p.id];
      if (orig) { p.due = orig.due; p.urgency = orig.urgency; }
      delete snoozed[p.id];
      renderQueue();
    });
    renderQueue();
  }

  /* ---------- all-done state ---------- */
  function renderDoneState() {
    var allDone = plants.length > 0 && plants.every(function (p) { return done[p.id]; });
    $("all-done").hidden = !allDone;
  }

  $("reset-day").addEventListener("click", function () {
    Object.keys(done).forEach(function (k) { delete done[k]; });
    plants.forEach(function (p) {
      var orig = originalDue[p.id];
      if (orig) { p.due = orig.due; p.urgency = orig.urgency; }
      delete snoozed[p.id];
    });
    expandedId = null;
    renderQueue();
    renderMood();
    showToast("A fresh day begins. The plants are waiting.", null, null);
  });

  /* ---------- weekly rhythm ---------- */
  function renderRhythm() {
    var wrap = $("rhythm-bars");
    wrap.innerHTML = "";
    var max = Math.max.apply(null, week.concat([1]));
    var todayIdx = (new Date().getDay() + 6) % 7; // Monday-first
    week.forEach(function (v, i) {
      var day = el("div", "rhythm-day" + (i === todayIdx ? " is-today" : ""));
      var bar = el("div", "rhythm-bar" + (i === todayIdx ? " is-today" : ""));
      bar.style.height = Math.round((v / max) * 100) + "%";
      bar.title = DAY_LABELS[i] + ": " + v + " task" + (v === 1 ? "" : "s");
      var label = el("span", "rhythm-label", DAY_LABELS[i]);
      day.appendChild(bar);
      day.appendChild(label);
      wrap.appendChild(day);
    });
  }

  /* ---------- moss mood ---------- */
  function renderMood() {
    var remaining = plants.filter(function (p) { return !done[p.id]; }).length;
    var card = document.querySelector(".mood-card");
    var label = $("mood-label");
    card.classList.toggle("is-happy", remaining === 0 && plants.length > 0);
    if (remaining === 0 && plants.length > 0) {
      label.textContent = "Thriving! A little flower for a job well done.";
    } else if (remaining <= 1) {
      label.textContent = "Almost there — one little task left.";
    } else {
      label.textContent = "Doing okay — one thing at a time.";
    }
  }

  /* ---------- toast ---------- */
  function showToast(message, undoLabel, undoFn) {
    var toast = $("toast");
    var undoBtn = $("toast-undo");
    $("toast-msg").textContent = message;
    if (undoLabel && undoFn) {
      undoBtn.hidden = false;
      undoBtn.textContent = undoLabel;
      undoBtn.onclick = function () {
        hideToast();
        undoFn();
      };
    } else {
      undoBtn.hidden = true;
      undoBtn.onclick = null;
    }
    toast.hidden = false;
    if (toastTimer) clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(hideToast, TOAST_MS);
  }
  function hideToast() {
    $("toast").hidden = true;
    if (toastTimer) { clearTimeout(toastTimer); toastTimer = null; }
  }

  /* ---------- keyboard: roving is unnecessary (native buttons),
     but Escape closes an open panel and refocuses its header ---------- */
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key !== "Escape" || !expandedId) return;
    var id = expandedId;
    expandedId = null;
    renderQueue();
    var head = document.querySelector('.plant[data-id="' + id + '"] .plant-head');
    if (head) head.focus();
  });

  /* ---------- boot ---------- */
  function init(data) {
    plants = data.plants.slice();
    if (Array.isArray(data.week)) week = data.week.slice();
    renderDate();
    renderRhythm();
    renderQueue();
    renderMood();
  }

  renderDate();
  fetch("PLANTS.json", { cache: "no-store" })
    .then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : Promise.reject(new Error("bad status")); })
    .then(init)
    .catch(function () { init(FALLBACK_DATA); });
})();

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <meta name="description" content="Moss — a gentle household plant-care companion.">
  <title>Moss · Plant care, gently</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
</head>
<body>
  <a class="skip-link" href="#queue-heading">Skip to care queue</a>

  <header class="app-header">
    <div class="brand">
      <span class="brand-mark" aria-hidden="true">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 48 48" width="44" height="44" focusable="false">
          <path d="M24 42 C 10 42 4 32 6 22 C 8 12 16 6 24 6 C 33 6 41 13 42 23 C 43 33 37 42 24 42 Z" fill="#55704f"/>
          <path d="M24 40 C 24 30 24 20 24 12" stroke="#3e5539" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
          <path d="M24 26 C 18 24 14 20 13 15 C 19 16 23 20 24 26 Z" fill="#7a9b6d"/>
          <path d="M24 20 C 30 18 34 14 35 9 C 29 10 25 14 24 20 Z" fill="#7a9b6d"/>
          <circle cx="24" cy="9" r="3.4" fill="#e3a83b"/>
        </svg>
      </span>
      <span class="brand-text">
        <strong class="brand-name">Moss</strong>
        <span class="brand-tag">plant care, gently</span>
      </span>
    </div>
    <p class="header-date" id="header-date"></p>
  </header>

  <main class="layout">
    <section class="queue" aria-labelledby="queue-heading">
      <div class="queue-head">
        <h1 id="queue-heading">Today&rsquo;s care queue</h1>
        <p class="queue-count" id="queue-count" aria-live="polite"></p>
      </div>

      <div class="all-done" id="all-done" hidden>
        <span class="all-done-art" aria-hidden="true">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 96 96" width="72" height="72" focusable="false">
            <path d="M48 84 C 24 84 12 68 15 48 C 18 28 32 16 48 16 C 65 16 79 29 81 49 C 83 69 71 84 48 84 Z" fill="#55704f"/>
            <circle cx="37" cy="48" r="4.5" fill="#f6efe3"/>
            <circle cx="59" cy="48" r="4.5" fill="#f6efe3"/>
            <circle cx="38" cy="49" r="2" fill="#2f2a20"/>
            <circle cx="60" cy="49" r="2" fill="#2f2a20"/>
            <path d="M39 62 C 43 67 53 67 57 62" stroke="#f6efe3" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
            <path d="M48 16 C 48 10 51 6 55 4" stroke="#3e5539" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
            <path d="M55 4 c 6 -3 11 1 11 6 c -6 2 -11 -1 -11 -6 Z" fill="#c4623d"/>
          </svg>
        </span>
        <div class="all-done-text">
          <h2>All done — the moss is thriving</h2>
          <p>Every plant got its drink, turn, or mist. Come back tomorrow; the fern will remember you.</p>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost" id="reset-day">Start the day over</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <ul class="plant-list" id="plant-list"></ul>
    </section>

    <aside class="side" aria-label="This week at a glance">
      <section class="card rhythm-card" aria-labelledby="rhythm-heading">
        <h2 id="rhythm-heading">Weekly rhythm</h2>
        <p class="card-sub">How busy each day has been</p>
        <div class="rhythm" id="rhythm" role="img" aria-label="Bar chart of care tasks per weekday. Monday 1, Tuesday 3, Wednesday 2, Thursday 4, Friday 2, Saturday 1, Sunday 3.">
          <div class="rhythm-bars" id="rhythm-bars"></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="card mood-card" aria-labelledby="mood-heading">
        <h2 id="mood-heading">Moss mood</h2>
        <div class="mood-stage">
          <svg class="mood-blob" id="mood-blob" viewBox="0 0 120 120" width="120" height="120" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
            <path class="blob-body" d="M60 104 C 32 104 16 86 19 62 C 22 38 38 24 60 24 C 83 24 99 40 101 64 C 103 88 87 104 60 104 Z" fill="#55704f"/>
            <g class="blob-face">
              <circle cx="46" cy="62" r="5" fill="#f6efe3"/>
              <circle cx="74" cy="62" r="5" fill="#f6efe3"/>
              <circle cx="47.5" cy="63" r="2.3" fill="#2f2a20"/>
              <circle cx="75.5" cy="63" r="2.3" fill="#2f2a20"/>
              <path d="M50 78 C 55 84 65 84 70 78" stroke="#f6efe3" stroke-width="3.4" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
            </g>
            <g class="blob-bloom" aria-hidden="true">
              <path d="M60 24 C 60 16 64 10 70 8" stroke="#3e5539" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
              <circle cx="73" cy="7" r="4" fill="#c4623d"/>
              <circle cx="68" cy="4" r="3" fill="#e3a83b"/>
              <circle cx="78" cy="4" r="3" fill="#e3a83b"/>
              <circle cx="70" cy="11" r="3" fill="#e3a83b"/>
              <circle cx="77" cy="11" r="3" fill="#e3a83b"/>
              <circle cx="73" cy="7.5" r="2.2" fill="#f3d9c8"/>
            </g>
            <ellipse cx="38" cy="98" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#3e5539" opacity="0.5"/>
            <ellipse cx="84" cy="99" rx="6" ry="3.6" fill="#3e5539" opacity="0.5"/>
          </svg>
          <p class="mood-label" id="mood-label" aria-live="polite">Doing okay — one thing at a time.</p>
        </div>
      </section>
    </aside>
  </main>

  <div class="toast" id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden>
    <span class="toast-msg" id="toast-msg"></span>
    <button type="button" class="toast-undo" id="toast-undo" hidden>Undo</button>
  </div>

  <noscript>
    <p class="noscript">Moss needs JavaScript to tend your plants. Your plants are safe — nothing is lost.</p>
  </noscript>

  <script src="app.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
