gemini-3.8-flash/13-frontend-playful/RESPONSE.md

Moss — Gentle Household Plant-Care Companion

Design System, Interaction Model, and Accessibility Report

1. Personality & Visual Direction

Moss is built around the feeling of slow domestic mornings, hand-thrown terracotta ceramics, damp garden potting benches, and optimistic green life. Rather than looking like a sterile productivity tracker, a neon-accented dashboard, or a wall of interchangeable cards, Moss embraces a tactile, earthy, and charmingly idiosyncratic visual language:

  • Color Palette: Grounded in natural materials:
    • Canvas & Paper: Warm oatmeal background (#FAF6EE), clotted cream cards (#FFFDF9), and soft sand clay (#EADBC8).
    • Ink: Dark forest charcoal (#212F24) for readable contrast that feels softer and warmer than harsh #000.
    • Botanical Greens: Forest moss (#395536), fresh leaf (#557A46), lively sprout (#7CA96E), and pale sage wash (#EBF3E7).
    • Warm Terracotta & Ochre: Clay rust (#D65D38, #B94926) used for overdue urgency and hydration prompts, paired with warm mustard ochre (#D9822B) for sunlight and turning tasks.
    • Dew & Mist: Soft slate blue-green (#3B6B6B, #5C8E8E) for calming humidity tasks.
  • Expressive Shape Language:
    • Cards feature organic asymmetric radii (22px 18px 24px 18px and 24px 14px 28px 16px), giving them a hand-molded, pebble-like presence.
    • Physical tactile button treatments: buttons feature solid drop shadow offsets (3px 4px 0 #212F24 and 2px 2px 0 #212F24) that physically depress on click/active (translateY(2px); box-shadow: none).
    • Stamped tag shapes (border-radius: 8px 14px 8px 14px) and tactile pill counters.
  • Bespoke Botanical Character Silhouettes: Rather than generic clip art or external font icons, each of the four plants in PLANTS.json has an individual, inline SVG portrait reflecting its botanical anatomy and personality:
    1. Frida (Boston fern, Bathroom): Cascading arching fronds in a terracotta hanging pot with suspension cords. Expresses thirst when overdue and perks up when watered.
    2. Orbit (Golden pothos, Bookshelf): Trellis moss pole with twine, heart-shaped variegated leaves with sunny cream blotches, and an active trailing vine.
    3. Dot (Bunny ears cactus, South window): Asymmetrical rounded paddle lobes with miniature bunny-ear pads, studded with charming golden glochid spine dots in a shallow saucer pot.
    4. Drama (Calathea orbifolia, Bedroom): Fluted blush pot supporting broad oval prayer leaves with signature silver-green pinstripe veining and a morning mist droplet.

2. Interaction Model & Care Queue Prioritization

The interaction architecture is engineered for gentle clarity, low cognitive load, and frictionless operation:

  1. Queue Prioritization (Urgency First):
    • Plants are prioritized and sorted by urgency score:
      • Frida (urgency: 4, "2 days overdue") is highlighted prominently at the top of the queue with an earthy terracotta border, warning badge, and a dedicated Priority Attention Banner ("Frida is thirsty (2 days overdue)") offering immediate one-click hydration.
      • Orbit (urgency: 2, "Today") and Dot (urgency: 1, "Today") follow with high-visibility daily action tags.
      • Drama (urgency: 0, "Tomorrow") is positioned gracefully at the queue base, allowing eager gardeners to care early if desired.
  2. Working Care & Snooze Actions:
    • Each card provides explicit, context-tailored action triggers:
      • Primary: Plant-specific task action (e.g., "💧 Watered" for Frida, "🔄 Rotated" for Orbit, "✓ Checked" for Dot, "🌱 Misted" for Drama).
      • Secondary: "⏰ Snooze (+1d)" postponing care by 24 hours.
      • Inspector: "ℹ️" button opening rich plant history and specifications.
    • Performing an action updates the plant's status immediately, logs the moment to its history timeline, updates the weekly rhythm indicators, and triggers a tactile feedback cue.
  3. 5-Second Undo Path:
    • When any care or snooze action is taken, a floating toast appears with the message, an animated 5-second progress bar, and an explicit Undo button.
    • Clicking Undo (or pressing Z) restores the exact snapshot of the plant's previous state, returns it to the queue with its original urgency, removes the appended log, and reverses the rhythm counter.
    • A dedicated Tended Today completed tray also retains all completed plants with individual "Undo care" options.
  4. Plant Detail Inspector:
    • Features rich botanical data: Light preference, scheduled task, soil moisture level, humidity need, and species-specific water rules.
    • Displays the plant's historical log timeline (from PLANTS.json).
    • Includes an interactive Quick Observation Log input (+ button), enabling users to record ad-hoc notes (e.g., "Spotted a tiny new frond!") that instantly persist into the plant's history and card previews.
  5. Compact Weekly Rhythm Visualization:
    • Accurately renders the 7-day care rhythm from PLANTS.json ([1, 3, 2, 4, 2, 1, 3]), with Thursday (Day 4) highlighted as Today's care peak.
    • As tasks are completed today, the Thursday column dynamically splits its fill into completed sprout-green and remaining terracotta scheduled tasks.
    • Each column is keyboard-focusable with screen-reader accessible tooltips detailing daily care moments.
  6. Rewarding All-Done State:
    • When all tasks in the queue are completed, the interface transitions smoothly into an encouraging All Tended screen.
    • Displays a warm botanical sunbeam illustration, soothing confirmation copy, and an actionable look-ahead: "Up Next Tomorrow: Drama (Calathea) will want a gentle morning misting in the bedroom."
    • Includes quick actions to review completed logs or reset the demo state.

3. Responsive & Desktop Composition

Moss adopts a mobile-first responsive architecture that transforms intentionally across viewports:

  • Mobile Viewport (< 768px):
    • Focused single-column flow with large touch targets (minimum 44×44px).
    • Compact weekly rhythm widget, overdue attention spotlight, and clear vertical plant queue.
    • The Plant Inspector functions as an accessible bottom sheet drawer that slides up smoothly with an organic rounded top border and a soft backdrop.
  • Tablet Viewport (768px – 1079px):
    • Two-column layout with sticky left sidebar (atmosphere, rhythm, and room filters) and center care agenda.
    • Inspector acts as an off-canvas right modal drawer.
  • Desktop Viewport (≥ 1080px):
    • Asymmetric Three-Column Station:
      1. Left Column (300px): Sticky navigation housing the Home Atmosphere card, micro-stats, Weekly Rhythm widget, room filters (Bathroom, Bookshelf, South window, Bedroom), and tactile care tips.
      2. Center Column (Fluid 460–640px): Care Agenda header, Overdue Priority spotlight, active plant cards, all-done state, and completed tray.
      3. Right Column (340px): Persistent Docked Inspector. Rather than stretching the mobile card list across an empty screen, the right column stays docked to inspect the active plant, its soil moisture gauges, water rules, and observation diary in real time.

4. Accessibility & Inclusive Design Choices

Antigravity and inclusive design principles were integrated from the foundation:

  1. Semantic HTML5 & Landmarks:
    • Proper use of <header role="banner">, <main id="main-content">, <aside>, <section>, <article role="article">, native <button>, <form>, <input>, and <kbd>.
    • Hidden skip-link (.skip-link) at the very top of the page allowing keyboard users to bypass navigation straight to the care agenda.
  2. Tactile High-Contrast Focus Indicators:
    • Custom visible focus ring: :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #D65D38; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 6px; }.
    • Never relies on browser default outlines or removes focus styling.
  3. Comprehensive Keyboard Shortcuts:
    • 1 – 4: Instantly select plant cards in the care queue.
    • W or D: Mark the selected plant watered or cared for.
    • S: Snooze selected plant by 1 day.
    • O or Enter: Open plant details and inspector.
    • Z: Undo the most recent care or snooze action.
    • Esc: Close open drawers, modals, or shortcut guides.
    • ?: Toggle the keyboard navigation cheat sheet modal.
  4. Live Regions & Screen Reader Support:
    • An aria-live="polite" live announcer region (#sr-announcer) broadcasts care completions, snoozes, undo confirmations, and room filter selections to assistive technology.
    • The toast notification region uses aria-live="assertive" and aria-atomic="true" for timely undo feedback.
    • All interactive controls have descriptive aria-label, aria-pressed, and aria-expanded attributes.
  5. Reduced-Motion Support (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce):
    • Fully supported via CSS media query: completely disables all bouncy springs, infinite alert pulses, translateY hover lifts, sliding transforms, and timer bar shrink animations. Transitions execute instantaneously without disorienting movement.
  6. 100% Offline & Zero Network Requests:
    • Zero remote CDNs, packages, or web fonts. Uses system serif/sans typography pairings for optimal performance and privacy.
    • Sound feedback is procedurally synthesized entirely on-device using the native Web Audio API (sine and triangle oscillator blips), with an instant toggle button to mute or enable audio.
    • Data loads dynamically from PLANTS.json with an immediate embedded fallback guaranteeing complete functionality even when loaded via file://.

gemini-3.8-flash/13-frontend-playful/TASK.md

Task 13 — Frontend design: playful mobile-first product

Build a polished mobile-first web app screen for Moss, a gentle household plant-care companion. Use only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: no frameworks, package installs, remote assets, external fonts, or network requests.

Visual direction: warm, tactile, optimistic, and a little odd. Use an expressive shape language and small moments of delight while keeping text readable and controls obvious. Avoid childish clip art, neon gradients, glass panels, and a wall of indistinguishable cards.

The experience must include:

  • Today's care queue for the four plants in PLANTS.json, clearly prioritizing overdue care.
  • A plant detail view or expandable panel with light, water, and observation history.
  • Working “watered” and “snooze” actions that update the interface and offer a brief undo path.
  • A compact weekly rhythm visualization.
  • A useful all-done state.
  • Desktop composition that makes good use of space without merely stretching the mobile column.
  • Keyboard operation, visible focus, semantic controls, and reduced-motion support.

Create index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Use CSS or inline SVG for any illustration. Add RESPONSE.md explaining the personality, interaction model, and accessibility choices. Work only in this directory.

gemini-3.8-flash/13-frontend-playful/app.js

  // State
  let state = {
    plants: [],
    week: [],
    selectedPlantId: 'fern',
    activeFilter: 'all',
    undoStack: null, // { plantId, previousPlantState, type, timerId }
    soundEnabled: true
  };

  // Web Audio Synthesizer (pure offline, no audio files required)
  let audioCtx = null;
  function getAudioContext() {
    if (!audioCtx) {
      const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if (AudioContext) {
        audioCtx = new AudioContext();
      }
    }
    if (audioCtx && audioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
      audioCtx.resume();
    }
    return audioCtx;
  }

  function playTone(type) {
    if (!state.soundEnabled) return;
    try {
      const ctx = getAudioContext();
      if (!ctx) return;
      const now = ctx.currentTime;
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);

      if (type === 'water') {
        // Cheerful ascending water droplet blip
        osc.type = 'sine';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(440, now);
        osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(880, now + 0.14);
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.18, now);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.22);
        osc.start(now);
        osc.stop(now + 0.22);
      } else if (type === 'snooze') {
        // Soft clock ticking chime
        osc.type = 'triangle';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(360, now);
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(320, now + 0.08);
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, now);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.18);
        osc.start(now);
        osc.stop(now + 0.18);
      } else if (type === 'undo') {
        // Reverse resolving tone
        osc.type = 'sine';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(620, now);
        osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(380, now + 0.15);
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, now);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.2);
        osc.start(now);
        osc.stop(now + 0.2);
      }
    } catch {
      // Audio autoplay policy gracefully handled
    }
  }

  // DOM Elements
  const elements = {
    activePlantsList: document.getElementById('active-plants-list'),
    completedTray: document.getElementById('completed-tray'),
    completedPlantsList: document.getElementById('completed-plants-list'),
    completedCountBadge: document.getElementById('completed-count-badge'),

    resetDataBtn: document.getElementById('reset-data-btn'),
    allDoneResetBtn: document.getElementById('all-done-reset-btn'),
    allDoneHistoryBtn: document.getElementById('all-done-history-btn'),

    // Inspector
    inspector: document.getElementById('plant-inspector'),
    inspectorCloseBtn: document.getElementById('inspector-close-btn'),
    inspectorPortrait: document.getElementById('inspector-portrait'),
    inspectorSpecies: document.getElementById('inspector-species'),
    inspectorLocation: document.getElementById('inspector-location'),
    inspectorPlantName: document.getElementById('inspector-plant-name'),
    inspectorStatusPill: document.getElementById('inspector-status-pill'),
    inspectorLight: document.getElementById('inspector-light'),
    inspectorTask: document.getElementById('inspector-task'),
    inspectorMoisture: document.getElementById('inspector-moisture'),
    inspectorHumidity: document.getElementById('inspector-humidity'),
    inspectorWaterRule: document.getElementById('inspector-water-rule'),
    inspectorPrimaryBtn: document.getElementById('inspector-action-primary'),
    inspectorPrimaryLabel: document.getElementById('inspector-primary-label'),
    inspectorPrimaryIcon: document.getElementById('inspector-primary-icon'),
    inspectorSnoozeBtn: document.getElementById('inspector-action-snooze'),
    inspectorHistoryList: document.getElementById('inspector-history-list'),
    inspectorHistoryCount: document.getElementById('history-count-badge'),
    observationForm: document.getElementById('observation-form'),
    observationInput: document.getElementById('new-observation-input'),

    // Modals & Feedback
    modalBackdrop: document.getElementById('modal-backdrop'),
    toastCard: document.getElementById('toast-card'),
    toastIcon: document.getElementById('toast-icon'),
    toastMessage: document.getElementById('toast-message'),
    toastUndoBtn: document.getElementById('toast-undo-btn'),
    toastDismissBtn: document.getElementById('toast-dismiss-btn'),
    shortcutsBtn: document.getElementById('shortcuts-btn'),
    shortcutsDialog: document.getElementById('shortcuts-dialog'),
    closeShortcutsBtn: document.getElementById('close-shortcuts-dialog'),
    shortcutsDoneBtn: document.getElementById('shortcuts-done-btn'),
    soundToggleBtn: document.getElementById('sound-toggle-btn'),
    soundIcon: document.getElementById('sound-icon'),
    srAnnouncer: document.getElementById('sr-announcer')
  };

  /**
   * Initialize Application
   */
  async function init() {
    loadSavedSettings();
    await loadPlantData();
    setupEventListeners();
    renderAll();
  }

  function loadSavedSettings() {
    try {
      const soundVal = localStorage.getItem(SOUND_KEY);
      if (soundVal !== null) {
        state.soundEnabled = soundVal === 'true';
      }
      updateSoundButtonUI();
    } catch {
      // LocalStorage unavailable
    }
  }

  function updateSoundButtonUI() {
    if (elements.soundIcon) {
      elements.soundIcon.textContent = state.soundEnabled ? '🔔' : '🔕';
      elements.soundToggleBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', state.soundEnabled ? 'Disable audio chimes' : 'Enable audio chimes');
    }
  }

  async function loadPlantData() {
    // 1. Try localStorage for persisted demo modifications
    try {
      const cached = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (cached) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
        if (parsed.plants && Array.isArray(parsed.plants)) {
          state.plants = parsed.plants;
          state.week = parsed.week || DEFAULT_DATA.week;
          return;
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }

    // 2. Try fetching PLANTS.json directly
    try {
      const response = await fetch('PLANTS.json');
      if (response.ok) {
        const json = await response.json();
        state.plants = json.plants.map(p => ({
          ...p,
          status: 'pending', // 'pending' | 'done' | 'snoozed'
          initialDue: p.due,
          initialUrgency: p.urgency
        }));
        state.week = json.week || DEFAULT_DATA.week;
        saveState();
        return;
      }
    } catch {
      // fetch failed (e.g. file:// protocol restriction), fallback to embedded
    }

    // 3. Fallback to bundled data
    state.plants = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_DATA.plants)).map(p => ({
      ...p,
      status: 'pending',
      initialDue: p.due,
      initialUrgency: p.urgency
    }));
    state.week = [...DEFAULT_DATA.week];
    saveState();
  }

  function saveState() {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
        plants: state.plants,
        week: state.week
      }));
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }

  function resetToDefault() {
    state.plants = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_DATA.plants)).map(p => ({
      ...p,
      status: 'pending',
      initialDue: p.due,
      initialUrgency: p.urgency
    }));
    state.week = [...DEFAULT_DATA.week];
    state.selectedPlantId = 'fern';
    state.undoStack = null;
    hideToast();
    saveState();
    renderAll();
    announce('Moss demo queue reset to initial state.');
  }

  /**
   * Action Handlers: Water / Done, Snooze, Undo
   */
  function handleTaskDone(plantId) {
    const plant = state.plants.find(p => p.id === plantId);
    if (!plant) return;

    // Save undo state
    const previousState = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(plant));
    setUndoAction(plantId, previousState, 'done', `${plant.name} marked ${plant.task}ed!`);

    // Update plant
    plant.status = 'done';
    const taskName = plant.task === 'Water' ? 'Watered' : `${plant.task} done`;
    plant.history.unshift(`Sep 21 · ${taskName}`);
    saveState();
    playTone('water');

    renderAll();
    announce(`${plant.name} care completed. Task marked done.`);
  }

  function handleTaskSnooze(plantId) {
    const plant = state.plants.find(p => p.id === plantId);
    if (!plant) return;

    const previousState = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(plant));
    setUndoAction(plantId, previousState, 'snooze', `${plant.name} snoozed to tomorrow.`);

    plant.status = 'snoozed';
    plant.due = 'Tomorrow (Snoozed)';
    plant.urgency = 0;
    saveState();
    playTone('snooze');

    renderAll();
    announce(`${plant.name} snoozed by one day.`);
  }

  function setUndoAction(plantId, previousState, type, message) {
    if (state.undoStack && state.undoStack.timerId) {
      clearTimeout(state.undoStack.timerId);
    }

    const timerId = setTimeout(() => {
      hideToast();
      state.undoStack = null;
    }, 5000);

    state.undoStack = {
      plantId,
      previousState,
      type,
      timerId
    };

    showToast(message);
  }

  function handleUndo() {
    if (!state.undoStack) return;
    const { plantId, previousState, timerId } = state.undoStack;
    clearTimeout(timerId);

    const index = state.plants.findIndex(p => p.id === plantId);
    if (index !== -1) {
      state.plants[index] = previousState;
      saveState();
      playTone('undo');
      renderAll();
      announce(`Undone. Restored ${previousState.name} to the care queue.`);
    }

    hideToast();
    state.undoStack = null;
  }

  function handleAddObservation(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const text = elements.observationInput.value.trim();
    if (!text) return;

    const plant = state.plants.find(p => p.id === state.selectedPlantId);
    if (!plant) return;

    plant.history.unshift(`Today · ${text}`);
    elements.observationInput.value = '';
    saveState();
    renderAll();
    announce(`Observation recorded for ${plant.name}: ${text}`);
  }

  function selectPlant(id) {
    state.selectedPlantId = id;
    renderInspector();
    renderCareQueue(); // update active card highlight

    // On mobile / tablet, open drawer
    if (window.innerWidth < 1080) {
      openMobileInspector();
    }
  }

  function openMobileInspector() {
    elements.inspector.classList.add('is-open');
    elements.inspector.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    elements.modalBackdrop.classList.add('is-visible');
    elements.modalBackdrop.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
  }

  function closeMobileInspector() {
    elements.inspector.classList.remove('is-open');
    elements.inspector.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    elements.modalBackdrop.classList.remove('is-visible');
    elements.modalBackdrop.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  }

  /**
   * Rendering
   */
  function renderAll() {
    renderCareQueue();
    renderWeeklyRhythm();
    renderInspector();
    renderSummaryBadges();
  }

  function renderSummaryBadges() {
    const activeTasks = state.plants.filter(p => p.status === 'pending');
    const overdueCount = activeTasks.filter(p => p.urgency >= 3).length;
    const todayCount = activeTasks.filter(p => p.urgency > 0 && p.urgency < 3).length;
    const completedCount = state.plants.filter(p => p.status === 'done').length;

    elements.totalPlantsCount.textContent = state.plants.length;
    elements.urgentTasksCount.textContent = overdueCount;
    elements.completedTasksCount.textContent = completedCount;
    elements.completedCountBadge.textContent = completedCount;

    if (overdueCount > 0) {
      elements.householdStatusDot.className = 'status-dot alert';
      elements.householdStatusText.textContent = `${overdueCount} overdue · ${todayCount} today`;
    } else if (todayCount > 0) {
      elements.householdStatusDot.className = 'status-dot';
      elements.householdStatusText.textContent = `${todayCount} due today`;
    } else {
      elements.householdStatusDot.className = 'status-dot';
      elements.householdStatusText.textContent = 'All tended today';
    }

    // Overdue banner
    const overduePlant = state.plants.find(p => p.status === 'pending' && p.urgency >= 3);
    if (overduePlant) {
      elements.overdueBanner.hidden = false;
      elements.bannerQuenchBtn.onclick = () => handleTaskDone(overduePlant.id);
    } else {
      elements.overdueBanner.hidden = true;
    }
  }

  function renderCareQueue() {
    elements.activePlantsList.innerHTML = '';
    elements.completedPlantsList.innerHTML = '';

    // Filter plants by room
    const filteredPlants = state.activeFilter === 'all'
      ? state.plants
      : state.plants.filter(p => p.location.toLowerCase() === state.activeFilter.toLowerCase());

    const pendingPlants = filteredPlants.filter(p => p.status === 'pending');
    const completedPlants = filteredPlants.filter(p => p.status === 'done');

    // Priority sorting: Overdue (highest urgency) first
    pendingPlants.sort((a, b) => b.urgency - a.urgency);

    if (pendingPlants.length === 0) {
      elements.allDoneState.hidden = false;
    } else {
      elements.allDoneState.hidden = true;
      pendingPlants.forEach((plant, index) => {
        const card = createPlantCardElement(plant, index + 1);
        elements.activePlantsList.appendChild(card);
      });
    }

    // Completed Tray
    if (completedPlants.length > 0) {
      elements.completedTray.hidden = false;
      completedPlants.forEach(plant => {
        const row = document.createElement('li');
        row.className = 'completed-plant-row';
        row.innerHTML = `
          <div class="completed-row-info">
            <span class="completed-check-icon">✓</span>
            <span class="completed-plant-name">${plant.name}</span>
            <span class="plant-species-name">(${plant.species})</span>
          </div>
          <button class="completed-undo-btn" aria-label="Undo care for ${plant.name}">Undo care</button>
        `;
        row.querySelector('.completed-undo-btn').onclick = () => {
          plant.status = 'pending';
          plant.history.shift(); // remove today's record
          saveState();
          renderAll();
          announce(`Restored ${plant.name} to pending.`);
        };
        elements.completedPlantsList.appendChild(row);
      });
    } else {
      elements.completedTray.hidden = true;
    }
  }

  function createPlantCardElement(plant, queueIndex) {
    const isSelected = plant.id === state.selectedPlantId;
    const isOverdue = plant.urgency >= 3;
    const isToday = plant.urgency > 0 && plant.urgency < 3;

    const li = document.createElement('li');
    li.className = `plant-card ${isOverdue ? 'urgency-high' : ''} ${isSelected ? 'is-selected' : ''}`;
    li.id = `plant-card-${plant.id}`;
    li.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
    li.setAttribute('role', 'article');
    li.setAttribute('aria-label', `${plant.name}, ${plant.species}. ${plant.task} is ${plant.due}. Location: ${plant.location}.`);

    const dueBadgeClass = isOverdue ? 'overdue' : (isToday ? 'today' : 'tomorrow');
    const actionLabel = plant.task === 'Water' ? 'Watered' : (plant.task === 'Rotate' ? 'Rotated' : 'Done');
    const actionIcon = plant.task === 'Water' ? '💧' : (plant.task === 'Rotate' ? '🔄' : '✓');

    li.innerHTML = `
      <div class="plant-avatar-frame" title="Click to view ${plant.name}'s details">
        ${PLANT_SVGS[plant.id] || ''}
      </div>

      <div class="plant-info-block">
        <div class="plant-badge-row">
          <span class="due-badge ${dueBadgeClass}">${plant.due}</span>
          <span class="location-tag">📍 ${plant.location}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="plant-name-row">
          <h4 class="plant-display-name">${plant.name}</h4>
          <span class="plant-species-name">${plant.species}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="plant-task-row">
          <span class="task-chip">${actionIcon} ${plant.task}</span>
          <span class="last-log-hint">Last: ${plant.history[0] || 'No logs'}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="plant-actions-group">
        <button class="pill-btn ${isOverdue ? 'urgent-action-btn' : 'primary-btn'} card-done-btn" aria-label="Mark ${plant.task} done for ${plant.name}">
          <span>${actionIcon}</span>
          <span>${actionLabel}</span>
        </button>
        <button class="pill-btn secondary-btn card-snooze-btn" aria-label="Snooze ${plant.name} care to tomorrow" title="Snooze 1 day">
          <span>⏰</span>
        </button>
        <button class="inspect-card-btn" aria-label="Inspect ${plant.name} details" title="View care details">
          <span>ℹ️</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    `;

    // Events
    li.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (!e.target.closest('button')) {
        selectPlant(plant.id);
      }
    });

    li.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.target.closest('button')) {
        selectPlant(plant.id);
      }
    });

    const doneBtn = li.querySelector('.card-done-btn');
    doneBtn.onclick = (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      handleTaskDone(plant.id);
    };

    const snoozeBtn = li.querySelector('.card-snooze-btn');
    snoozeBtn.onclick = (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      handleTaskSnooze(plant.id);
    };

    const inspectBtn = li.querySelector('.inspect-card-btn');
    inspectBtn.onclick = (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      selectPlant(plant.id);
    };

    return li;
  }

  function renderInspector() {
    const plant = state.plants.find(p => p.id === state.selectedPlantId) || state.plants[0];
    if (!plant) return;

    elements.inspectorPortrait.innerHTML = PLANT_SVGS[plant.id] || '';
    elements.inspectorSpecies.textContent = plant.species;
    elements.inspectorLocation.textContent = `📍 ${plant.location}`;
    elements.inspectorPlantName.textContent = plant.name;

    const isDone = plant.status === 'done';
    const isOverdue = plant.urgency >= 3 && !isDone;
    elements.inspectorStatusPill.className = `inspector-status-badge ${isDone ? 'done' : (isOverdue ? 'overdue' : 'today')}`;
    elements.inspectorStatusPill.textContent = isDone ? 'Tended today' : plant.due;

    elements.inspectorLight.textContent = plant.light;
    elements.inspectorTask.textContent = plant.task;

    const guide = PLANT_CARE_GUIDES[plant.id] || {
      waterRule: "Water according to plant species soil dryness check.",
      moistureLevel: "Moderate (40-50%)",
      humidity: "Average room"
    };
    if (elements.inspectorMoisture) elements.inspectorMoisture.textContent = guide.moistureLevel;
    if (elements.inspectorHumidity) elements.inspectorHumidity.textContent = guide.humidity;
    if (elements.inspectorWaterRule) elements.inspectorWaterRule.textContent = guide.waterRule;

    const actionLabel = plant.task === 'Water' ? 'Mark Watered' : `Mark ${plant.task} Done`;
    elements.inspectorPrimaryLabel.textContent = isDone ? 'Completed' : actionLabel;
    elements.inspectorPrimaryIcon.textContent = isDone ? '✓' : (plant.task === 'Water' ? '💧' : '🌱');
    elements.inspectorPrimaryBtn.disabled = isDone;

    elements.inspectorPrimaryBtn.onclick = () => {
      if (!isDone) handleTaskDone(plant.id);
    };

    elements.inspectorSnoozeBtn.onclick = () => {
      handleTaskSnooze(plant.id);
    };

    // History Timeline
    elements.inspectorHistoryCount.textContent = `${plant.history.length} entries`;
    elements.inspectorHistoryList.innerHTML = '';
    plant.history.forEach(entry => {
      const li = document.createElement('li');
      li.className = 'history-item';
      li.innerHTML = `
        <span class="history-bullet">🌱</span>
        <span class="history-text">${entry}</span>
      `;
      elements.inspectorHistoryList.appendChild(li);
    });
  }

  function renderWeeklyRhythm() {
    elements.weeklyRhythmBars.innerHTML = '';
    const days = ['M', 'T', 'W', 'Th', 'F', 'Sa', 'Su'];
    const maxVal = Math.max(...state.week, 5);

    // Calculate total
    const totalWeekly = state.week.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    elements.weeklyTotalBadge.textContent = `${totalWeekly} moments`;

    const completedToday = state.plants.filter(p => p.status === 'done').length;
    const pendingToday = state.plants.filter(p => p.status === 'pending').length;

    state.week.forEach((count, idx) => {
      const isToday = idx === 3; // Day 4 (Thursday) is Today
      const col = document.createElement('div');
      col.className = `rhythm-col ${isToday ? 'is-today' : ''}`;
      col.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
      col.setAttribute('role', 'button');

      const heightPercent = Math.max(15, Math.round((count / maxVal) * 100));

      let barInnerHtml = `<div class="rhythm-bar-fill" style="height: ${heightPercent}%"></div>`;
      let dayTitle = `${days[idx]}: ${count} plant care moments scheduled`;

      if (isToday) {
        dayTitle = `Thu (Today): ${completedToday} tended, ${pendingToday} pending (${count} scheduled moments)`;
        col.setAttribute('aria-label', `Thursday (Today): ${completedToday} tended, ${pendingToday} pending of ${count} scheduled care moments`);

        if (completedToday > 0) {
          const completedPercent = Math.min(heightPercent, Math.round((completedToday / count) * heightPercent));
          const pendingPercent = Math.max(0, heightPercent - completedPercent);
          barInnerHtml = `
            <div class="rhythm-bar-fill is-pending-fill" style="height: ${pendingPercent}%; background: var(--terracotta);"></div>
            <div class="rhythm-bar-fill is-done-fill" style="height: ${completedPercent}%; background: var(--moss-sprout);"></div>
          `;
        }
      } else {
        col.setAttribute('aria-label', `${days[idx]}: ${count} care moments scheduled`);
      }

      col.innerHTML = `
        <span class="rhythm-count-indicator">${count}</span>
        <div class="rhythm-bar-track">
          ${barInnerHtml}
        </div>
        <span class="rhythm-day-lbl">${days[idx]}</span>
      `;

      col.title = dayTitle;
      elements.weeklyRhythmBars.appendChild(col);
    });
  }

  /**
   * Toast / Undo Notifications
   */
  function showToast(message) {
    elements.toastMessage.textContent = message;
    elements.toastCard.hidden = false;
  }

  function hideToast() {
    elements.toastCard.hidden = true;
  }

  /**
   * Accessible Screen Reader Announcement
   */
  function announce(message) {
    if (elements.srAnnouncer) {
      elements.srAnnouncer.textContent = message;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Event Listeners & Shortcuts
   */
  function setupEventListeners() {
    // Undo button
    elements.toastUndoBtn.onclick = handleUndo;
    elements.toastDismissBtn.onclick = hideToast;

    // Mobile Inspector close
    elements.inspectorCloseBtn.onclick = closeMobileInspector;
    elements.modalBackdrop.onclick = closeMobileInspector;

    // Reset button
    elements.resetDataBtn.onclick = resetToDefault;
    elements.allDoneResetBtn.onclick = resetToDefault;

    // All Done review history
    elements.allDoneHistoryBtn.onclick = () => {
      elements.completedTray.hidden = false;
      elements.completedPlantsList.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    };

    // Toggle completed tray
    elements.completedToggleBtn.onclick = () => {
      const isExpanded = elements.completedToggleBtn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
      elements.completedToggleBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', !isExpanded);
      elements.completedPlantsList.hidden = isExpanded;
    };

    // Add observation form
    elements.observationForm.onsubmit = handleAddObservation;

    // Sound toggle
    elements.soundToggleBtn.onclick = () => {
      state.soundEnabled = !state.soundEnabled;
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(SOUND_KEY, state.soundEnabled);
      } catch {}
      updateSoundButtonUI();
      announce(state.soundEnabled ? 'Audio chimes enabled' : 'Audio chimes muted');
    };

    // Filter Chips
    elements.filterChips.forEach(chip => {
      chip.onclick = () => {
        elements.filterChips.forEach(c => {
          c.classList.remove('active');
          c.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
        });
        chip.classList.add('active');
        chip.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
        state.activeFilter = chip.dataset.filter;
        renderCareQueue();
      };
    });

    // Shortcuts Dialog
    elements.shortcutsBtn.onclick = () => {
      elements.shortcutsDialog.hidden = false;
      elements.shortcutsDoneBtn.focus();
    };

    const closeShortcuts = () => {
      elements.shortcutsDialog.hidden = true;
      elements.shortcutsBtn.focus();
    };

    elements.closeShortcutsBtn.onclick = closeShortcuts;
    elements.shortcutsDoneBtn.onclick = closeShortcuts;

    // Keyboard Shortcuts System
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      // Ignore if user is currently typing in an input
      if (['INPUT', 'TEXTAREA'].includes(document.activeElement.tagName)) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
          document.activeElement.blur();
        }
        return;
      }

      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (!elements.shortcutsDialog.hidden) {
          closeShortcuts();
        } else if (elements.inspector.classList.contains('is-open')) {
          closeMobileInspector();
        }
        return;
      }

      if (e.key === '?') {
        elements.shortcutsDialog.hidden = !elements.shortcutsDialog.hidden;
        return;
      }

      if (e.key === 'z' || e.key === 'Z') {
        if (state.undoStack) {
          handleUndo();
        }
        return;
      }

      // Quick numbers 1 to 4 to select plant
      if (['1', '2', '3', '4'].includes(e.key)) {
        const index = parseInt(e.key, 10) - 1;
        if (state.plants[index]) {
          selectPlant(state.plants[index].id);
          const card = document.getElementById(`plant-card-${state.plants[index].id}`);
          if (card) card.focus();
        }
        return;
      }

      // 'W' or 'D' to water / mark done selected plant
      if (e.key === 'w' || e.key === 'W' || e.key === 'd' || e.key === 'D') {
        if (state.selectedPlantId) {
          handleTaskDone(state.selectedPlantId);
        }
        return;
      }

      // 'S' to snooze selected plant
      if (e.key === 's' || e.key === 'S') {
        if (state.selectedPlantId) {
          handleTaskSnooze(state.selectedPlantId);
        }
        return;
      }

      // 'O' to open details
      if (e.key === 'o' || e.key === 'O') {
        if (state.selectedPlantId) {
          selectPlant(state.selectedPlantId);
        }
        return;
      }
    });
  }

  // Launch app when DOM is ready
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

gemini-3.8-flash/13-frontend-playful/index.html

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <meta name="description" content="Moss — A gentle, tactile household plant-care companion.">
  <title>Moss — Gentle Plant Care</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
</head>
<body>
  <!-- Accessibility Skip Link -->
  <a href="#main-content" class="skip-link">Skip to care queue</a>

  <!-- Top App Navigation & Header -->
  <header class="app-header" role="banner">
    <div class="header-container">
      <div class="brand-group">
        <div class="brand-mascot" aria-hidden="true">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 40 40" width="36" height="36" class="moss-sprout-icon">
            <path d="M20 36 C16 30 14 22 20 14 C26 22 24 30 20 36 Z" fill="#557A46" />
            <path d="M19 24 C13 22 9 16 11 10 C16 12 19 17 19 24 Z" fill="#7CA96E" />
            <path d="M21 20 C27 18 31 12 29 6 C24 8 21 14 21 20 Z" fill="#8FBC7A" />
            <circle cx="20" cy="37" r="3" fill="#D65D38" />
          </svg>
        </div>
        <div class="brand-text">
          <h1 class="brand-title">Moss</h1>
          <p class="brand-subtitle">gentle plant companion</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="header-status">
        <div class="household-badge" id="household-status" aria-label="Household care status">
          <span class="status-dot alert" id="header-status-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <span id="header-status-text">1 overdue · 2 today</span>
        </div>
        <button id="shortcuts-btn" class="icon-btn" aria-label="Open keyboard shortcuts cheat sheet" title="Keyboard shortcuts (?)">
          <span aria-hidden="true">⌨️</span>
          <span class="shortcut-key-hint">?</span>
        </button>
        <button id="sound-toggle-btn" class="icon-btn" aria-label="Toggle subtle audio effects" title="Toggle audio feedback">
          <span id="sound-icon" aria-hidden="true">🌱</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <!-- Main Layout Container -->
  <div class="layout-wrapper">
    <!-- Left Sidebar: Household context, filters, and weekly rhythm -->
    <aside class="app-sidebar" aria-label="Plant summary and weekly rhythm">
      <!-- Household Companion Card -->
      <section class="tactile-card sidebar-card companion-mood-card">
        <div class="card-eyebrow">Home Atmosphere</div>
        <h2 class="sidebar-heading">South-Facing Sanctuary</h2>
        <p class="companion-note">
          Frida is parched in the bathroom steam, while Orbit leans into the morning light.
        </p>
        <div class="micro-stats">
          <div class="stat-pill">
            <span class="stat-num" id="total-plants-count">4</span>
            <span class="stat-lbl">friends</span>
          </div>
          <div class="stat-pill urgency-pill">
            <span class="stat-num" id="urgent-tasks-count">1</span>
            <span class="stat-lbl">thirsty</span>
          </div>
          <div class="stat-pill">
            <span class="stat-num" id="completed-tasks-count">0</span>
            <span class="stat-lbl">tended</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- Weekly Rhythm Visualization Component -->
      <section class="tactile-card sidebar-card weekly-rhythm-widget" id="weekly-rhythm-section" aria-labelledby="rhythm-heading">
        <div class="rhythm-header">
          <div>
            <div class="card-eyebrow">Weekly Rhythm</div>
            <h2 id="rhythm-heading" class="sidebar-heading">Care Distribution</h2>
          </div>
          <span class="rhythm-total-badge" id="weekly-total-badge">16 moments</span>
        </div>
        <p class="rhythm-caption">Care rhythm across the seven days. Thursday carries today's peak.</p>

        <div class="rhythm-bars" role="group" aria-label="Care moments per day of the week">
          <!-- Populated dynamically by app.js with tactile day columns -->
        </div>

        <div class="rhythm-legend">
          <span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-swatch today-swatch"></span> Today (Peak)</span>
          <span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-swatch done-swatch"></span> Completed</span>
          <span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-swatch pending-swatch"></span> Scheduled</span>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- Room Filter Pills -->
      <section class="tactile-card sidebar-card filter-card" aria-labelledby="location-filter-heading">
        <div class="card-eyebrow">Locations</div>
        <h2 id="location-filter-heading" class="sidebar-heading">Filter by Room</h2>
        <div class="location-filters" role="group" aria-label="Filter plants by room">
          <button class="filter-chip active" data-filter="all" aria-pressed="true">All Rooms <span class="chip-count">4</span></button>
          <button class="filter-chip" data-filter="Bathroom" aria-pressed="false">Bathroom <span class="chip-count">1</span></button>
          <button class="filter-chip" data-filter="Bookshelf" aria-pressed="false">Bookshelf <span class="chip-count">1</span></button>
          <button class="filter-chip" data-filter="South window" aria-pressed="false">South window <span class="chip-count">1</span></button>
          <button class="filter-chip" data-filter="Bedroom" aria-pressed="false">Bedroom <span class="chip-count">1</span></button>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- Ambient Care Observation Tip -->
      <div class="sidebar-ambient-tip" aria-hidden="true">
        <span class="tip-icon">🪨</span>
        <span class="tip-text">Tactile tip: Touch top 2 inches of soil before watering Dot the cactus.</span>
      </div>
    </aside>

    <!-- Main Content Area: Today's Care Queue -->
    <main id="main-content" class="app-main" tabindex="-1">
      <!-- Care Queue Header & Urgency Banner -->
      <section class="queue-header-area">
        <div class="queue-title-row">
          <div>
            <span class="section-tag">Care Agenda</span>
            <h2 class="main-heading">Today's Plant Queue</h2>
          </div>
          <div class="queue-actions-bar">
            <button id="reset-data-btn" class="text-action-btn" title="Reset all plants to initial demo state">
              ↺ Reset demo
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Overdue Priority Spotlight Banner -->
        <div class="urgency-banner" id="overdue-banner" role="alert">
          <div class="banner-icon-bubble" aria-hidden="true">💧!</div>
          <div class="banner-body">
            <div class="banner-tag">PRIORITY CARE NEEDED</div>
            <h3 class="banner-title">Frida is thirsty (2 days overdue)</h3>
            <p class="banner-desc">Boston ferns crave humidity and damp soil. Give Frida a deep drink in the bathroom sink.</p>
          </div>
          <button class="banner-quick-action-btn" id="banner-quench-btn" aria-label="Quick water Frida now">
            Water Frida Now
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- Active Care Queue List -->
      <section class="queue-list-section" aria-label="Plants requiring care today">
        <h3 class="sr-only">Active Plant Tasks</h3>
        <ul class="plants-list" id="active-plants-list" aria-live="polite">
          <!-- Plant cards injected here by app.js -->
        </ul>
      </section>

      <!-- All-Done State (shown when queue is empty) -->
      <section class="all-done-card" id="all-done-state" hidden aria-live="polite">
        <div class="all-done-illustration" aria-hidden="true">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 200 160" width="180" height="144" class="all-done-svg">
            <!-- Warm Sunbeam & Gentle botanical scene -->
            <circle cx="100" cy="70" r="54" fill="#F8E8C8" />
            <circle cx="100" cy="70" r="44" fill="#EBB04D" opacity="0.3" />
            <!-- Gentle Pot -->
            <path d="M70 120 L130 120 L124 146 L76 146 Z" fill="#D65D38" />
            <rect x="66" y="114" width="68" height="8" rx="4" fill="#B94926" />
            <!-- Sprouting Foliage -->
            <path d="M100 114 Q90 80 72 65 Q92 78 100 114 Z" fill="#557A46" />
            <path d="M100 114 Q110 80 128 65 Q108 78 100 114 Z" fill="#7CA96E" />
            <path d="M100 114 Q100 70 100 48 Q106 68 100 114 Z" fill="#8FBC7A" />
            <!-- Floating Little Sparkles / Spores -->
            <circle cx="64" cy="52" r="3" fill="#D65D38" />
            <circle cx="136" cy="48" r="3.5" fill="#557A46" />
            <circle cx="100" cy="30" r="2.5" fill="#EBB04D" />
          </svg>
        </div>
        <div class="all-done-content">
          <span class="done-tag">ALL TENDED</span>
          <h3 class="all-done-title">Every leaf is resting easy.</h3>
          <p class="all-done-desc">
            You've attended to all four plants for today. Moisture is balanced, pots are rotated, and soil is checked.
          </p>
          <div class="all-done-next-step">
            <span class="next-step-icon">🌿</span>
            <div class="next-step-info">
              <strong>Up Next Tomorrow:</strong> Drama (Calathea) will want a gentle morning misting in the bedroom.
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="all-done-actions">
            <button class="pill-btn secondary-btn" id="all-done-reset-btn">
              Reset Demo Queue
            </button>
            <button class="pill-btn outline-btn" id="all-done-history-btn">
              Review Completed Logs
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- Completed Plants Drawer / Tray -->
      <section class="completed-tray-section" id="completed-tray" hidden>
        <div class="completed-tray-header">
          <button class="completed-toggle-btn" id="completed-toggle-btn" aria-expanded="true">
            <span class="toggle-icon">▼</span>
            <span class="toggle-text">Tended Today (<span id="completed-count-badge">0</span>)</span>
          </button>
        </div>
        <ul class="completed-plants-list" id="completed-plants-list">
          <!-- Completed items injected here -->
        </ul>
      </section>
    </main>

    <!-- Right Column / Drawer: Plant Detail Inspector -->
    <aside class="plant-inspector" id="plant-inspector" aria-labelledby="inspector-plant-name" aria-hidden="true">
      <div class="inspector-card">
        <!-- Inspector Mobile Close Header -->
        <div class="inspector-header">
          <span class="inspector-eyebrow">Plant Inspection</span>
          <button class="inspector-close-btn" id="inspector-close-btn" aria-label="Close plant detail inspector">
            <span aria-hidden="true">✕</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        <!-- Plant Portrait & Title -->
        <div class="inspector-portrait" id="inspector-portrait">
          <!-- Injected SVG illustration -->
        </div>

        <div class="inspector-identity">
          <div class="inspector-meta-top">
            <span class="inspector-species" id="inspector-species">Species Name</span>
            <span class="inspector-location-badge" id="inspector-location">Location</span>
          </div>
          <h2 class="inspector-name" id="inspector-plant-name">Plant Name</h2>
          <div class="inspector-status-badge" id="inspector-status-pill">Due status</div>
        </div>

        <!-- Care Needs Grid (Light, Water, Soil) -->
        <div class="care-needs-grid">
          <div class="need-box">
            <div class="need-icon">☀️</div>
            <div class="need-label">Light Preference</div>
            <div class="need-value" id="inspector-light">Medium, indirect</div>
          </div>
          <div class="need-box">
            <div class="need-icon">💧</div>
            <div class="need-label">Scheduled Task</div>
            <div class="need-value" id="inspector-task">Water</div>
          </div>
          <div class="need-box">
            <div class="need-icon">🪴</div>
            <div class="need-label">Soil Moisture</div>
            <div class="need-value" id="inspector-moisture">Moist (70-80%)</div>
          </div>
          <div class="need-box">
            <div class="need-icon">🌫️</div>
            <div class="need-label">Humidity Need</div>
            <div class="need-value" id="inspector-humidity">High</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="care-guidance-callout" id="inspector-water-rule">
          Keep soil consistently damp; never allow root ball to dry out completely.
        </div>

        <!-- Interactive Action Bar for Selected Plant -->
        <div class="inspector-action-row" id="inspector-actions">
          <button class="pill-btn primary-btn flex-btn" id="inspector-action-primary">
            <span id="inspector-primary-icon">💧</span>
            <span id="inspector-primary-label">Mark Watered</span>
          </button>
          <button class="pill-btn secondary-btn" id="inspector-action-snooze" title="Snooze task by 1 day">
            <span>⏰ Snooze +1d</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        <!-- Observation History Section -->
        <section class="inspector-history-section" aria-labelledby="history-heading">
          <div class="history-header">
            <h3 id="history-heading" class="history-title">Observation Log</h3>
            <span class="history-count" id="history-count-badge">3 entries</span>
          </div>

          <!-- Add Note Form -->
          <form class="quick-observation-form" id="observation-form">
            <label for="new-observation-input" class="sr-only">Record a new observation for this plant</label>
            <div class="input-with-button">
              <input type="text" id="new-observation-input" placeholder="Note new leaf, dry tip, or turn..." required maxlength="80">
              <button type="submit" class="submit-note-btn" aria-label="Log observation">+</button>
            </div>
          </form>

          <!-- History Timeline -->
          <ul class="history-timeline" id="inspector-history-list">
            <!-- Timeline items injected here -->
          </ul>
        </section>
      </div>
    </aside>
  </div>

  <!-- Accessible Modal Backdrop for Mobile Drawer -->
  <div class="modal-backdrop" id="modal-backdrop" aria-hidden="true"></div>

  <!-- Toast / Undo Notification Bar -->
  <aside class="toast-region" id="toast-region" aria-live="assertive" aria-atomic="true">
    <div class="toast-card" id="toast-card" hidden>
      <div class="toast-icon" id="toast-icon" aria-hidden="true">🌱</div>
      <div class="toast-message" id="toast-message">Task updated.</div>
      <button class="toast-undo-btn" id="toast-undo-btn">
        <span>Undo</span>
        <span class="toast-timer-bar" id="toast-timer-bar"></span>
      </button>
      <button class="toast-dismiss-btn" id="toast-dismiss-btn" aria-label="Dismiss notification">✕</button>
    </div>
  </aside>

  <!-- Keyboard Shortcuts Cheat Sheet Dialog -->
  <div class="dialog-container" id="shortcuts-dialog" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="dialog-title" hidden>
    <div class="dialog-card">
      <div class="dialog-header">
        <h2 id="dialog-title" class="dialog-title">Keyboard Navigation</h2>
        <button class="icon-btn close-dialog-btn" id="close-shortcuts-dialog" aria-label="Close shortcuts dialog">✕</button>
      </div>
      <p class="dialog-desc">Moss is crafted for effortless, mouse-free plant care.</p>
      <ul class="shortcuts-list">
        <li><kbd>1</kbd>–<kbd>4</kbd> <span>Select plant card in queue</span></li>
        <li><kbd>W</kbd> or <kbd>D</kbd> <span>Mark selected plant cared / watered</span></li>
        <li><kbd>S</kbd> <span>Snooze task by 1 day</span></li>
        <li><kbd>Enter</kbd> or <kbd>O</kbd> <span>Open plant detail inspection</span></li>
        <li><kbd>Z</kbd> <span>Undo recent care or snooze</span></li>
        <li><kbd>Esc</kbd> <span>Close drawer or modal</span></li>
        <li><kbd>?</kbd> <span>Toggle this shortcuts guide</span></li>
      </ul>
      <div class="dialog-footer">
        <button class="pill-btn primary-btn" id="shortcuts-done-btn">Got it</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Screen Reader Live Announcements -->
  <div class="sr-only" aria-live="polite" id="sr-announcer"></div>

  <!-- Application Script -->
  <script src="app.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
