gemini-3.8-flash/13-frontend-playful/styles.css

/* ==========================================================================
   Moss — Gentle Plant Care Companion Stylesheet
   Tactile, warm, optimistic, and slightly eccentric design system.
   ========================================================================== */

:root {
  /* Earth & Botanical Color System */
  --bg-canvas: #FAF6EE;
  --bg-subtle: #F3ECE1;
  --bg-card: #FFFDF9;
  --bg-card-hover: #FEFAF2;
  
  --ink: #212F24;
  --ink-soft: #4A5B4E;
  --ink-muted: #738577;
  
  --moss-forest: #395536;
  --moss-leaf: #557A46;
  --moss-sprout: #7CA96E;
  --moss-wash: #EBF3E7;
  
  --terracotta-dark: #A33C1D;
  --terracotta: #D65D38;
  --terracotta-soft: #F4D3C7;
  --terracotta-wash: #FDF3EF;
  
  --ochre-deep: #A96118;
  --ochre: #D9822B;
  --ochre-wash: #FDF4E3;
  
  --mist-slate: #3B6B6B;
  --mist-water: #5C8E8E;
  --mist-wash: #EBF4F4;

  --sand-clay: #EADBC8;
  --border-strong: #212F24;
  --border-soft: #DFCDBA;

  /* Tactile Shadows & Borders */
  --border-width: 2px;
  --border-tactile: 2px solid var(--border-strong);
  --shadow-tactile: 3px 4px 0 var(--border-strong);
  --shadow-tactile-sm: 2px 2px 0 var(--border-strong);
  --shadow-tactile-lg: 5px 6px 0 var(--border-strong);
  --shadow-sunken: inset 2px 2px 0 rgba(33, 47, 36, 0.15);

  /* Organic Shape Radii */
  --radius-leaf-1: 24px 14px 28px 16px;
  --radius-leaf-2: 16px 26px 14px 24px;
  --radius-card: 22px 18px 24px 18px;
  --radius-pill: 999px;
  --radius-btn: 14px;
  --radius-tag: 8px 14px 8px 14px;

  /* Typography */
  --font-display: "Georgia", "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino", serif;
  --font-body: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif;
  --font-mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Menlo", monospace;

  /* Transitions */
  --transition-fast: 0.15s ease;
  --transition-normal: 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.3, 1);
  --transition-bounce: 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
}

/* Base Reset & Box Sizing */
*, *::before, *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

html {
  font-size: 16px;
  background-color: var(--bg-canvas);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  line-height: 1.5;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  position: relative;
  background-color: var(--bg-canvas);
  background-image: 
    radial-gradient(circle at 10% 20%, rgba(85, 122, 70, 0.04) 0%, transparent 40%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 90% 80%, rgba(214, 93, 56, 0.04) 0%, transparent 45%);
}

/* Accessibility Skip Link */
.skip-link {
  position: absolute;
  top: -60px;
  left: 16px;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--bg-card);
  padding: 10px 18px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-btn);
  border: 2px solid var(--terracotta);
  font-weight: 700;
  z-index: 9999;
  transition: top var(--transition-fast);
  text-decoration: none;
}

.skip-link:focus {
  top: 16px;
  outline: 3px solid var(--terracotta);
}

.sr-only {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

/* Focus Visible Styling - Tactile high-contrast */
:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--terracotta);
  outline-offset: 3px;
  border-radius: 6px;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Header & Navigation
   ========================================================================== */

.app-header {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 100;
  background: rgba(250, 246, 238, 0.94);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  border-bottom: var(--border-tactile);
  padding: 10px 20px;
}

.header-container {
  max-width: 1360px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
}

.brand-group {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}

.brand-mascot {
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: var(--border-tactile);
  border-radius: var(--radius-leaf-1);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-tactile-sm);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 2px;
}

.moss-sprout-icon {
  display: block;
}

.brand-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  line-height: 1.1;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.brand-subtitle {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  text-transform: lowercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.header-status {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.household-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: var(--border-tactile);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-tactile-sm);
  padding: 6px 14px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.status-dot {
  width: 9px;
  height: 9px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--moss-leaf);
  display: inline-block;
}

.status-dot.alert {
  background: var(--terracotta);
  animation: gentlePulse 2.5s infinite ease-in-out;
}

@keyframes gentlePulse {
  0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
  50% { transform: scale(1.3); opacity: 0.8; }
}

.icon-btn {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: var(--border-tactile);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-tactile-sm);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  position: relative;
  transition: transform var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast);
}

.icon-btn:hover {
  background: var(--bg-card-hover);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.icon-btn:active {
  transform: translateY(2px);
  box-shadow: none;
}

.shortcut-key-hint {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -4px;
  right: -4px;
  background: var(--border-strong);
  color: var(--bg-card);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-weight: 700;
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Layout Wrapper: Mobile-first transitioning to responsive 3-panel grid
   ========================================================================== */

.layout-wrapper {
  max-width: 1360px;
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 16px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 20px;
  flex: 1;
}

/* Card Foundations */
.tactile-card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: var(--border-tactile);
  border-radius: var(--radius-card);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-tactile);
  padding: 18px;
  transition: transform var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast);
}

.card-eyebrow {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.sidebar-heading {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.25;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Sidebar: Mood, Weekly Rhythm, Room Filters
   ========================================================================== */

.app-sidebar {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
}

.companion-mood-card {
  background: #FCF8F2;
  border-radius: var(--radius-leaf-1);
}

.companion-note {
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.micro-stats {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
}

.stat-pill {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 8px 6px;
  text-align: center;
}

.stat-pill.urgency-pill {
  background: var(--terracotta-wash);
  border-color: var(--terracotta);
}

.stat-num {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.stat-pill.urgency-pill .stat-num {
  color: var(--terracotta);
}

.stat-lbl {
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

/* Weekly Rhythm Widget */
.weekly-rhythm-widget {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border-radius: var(--radius-leaf-2);
}

.rhythm-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.rhythm-total-badge {
  background: var(--moss-wash);
  color: var(--moss-forest);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--moss-leaf);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
}

.rhythm-caption {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.rhythm-bars {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);
  gap: 6px;
  align-items: end;
  height: 94px;
  padding: 6px 4px 10px;
  background: var(--bg-subtle);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-soft);
  border-radius: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.rhythm-col {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  height: 100%;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 2px;
  transition: background var(--transition-fast);
}

.rhythm-col:hover, .rhythm-col:focus-visible {
  background: rgba(33, 47, 36, 0.06);
}

.rhythm-bar-track {
  width: 16px;
  height: 60px;
  background: rgba(223, 205, 186, 0.4);
  border-radius: 8px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid rgba(33, 47, 36, 0.2);
}

.rhythm-bar-fill {
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--moss-leaf);
  border-radius: 6px;
  transition: height var(--transition-normal);
}

.rhythm-col.is-today .rhythm-bar-track {
  border: 1.5px solid var(--terracotta);
  background: var(--terracotta-wash);
}

.rhythm-col.is-today .rhythm-bar-fill {
  background: var(--terracotta);
}

.rhythm-bar-fill.is-done-fill {
  border-radius: 0 0 6px 6px;
  background: var(--moss-sprout) !important;
}

.rhythm-bar-fill.is-pending-fill {
  border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
  background: var(--terracotta) !important;
}

.rhythm-day-lbl {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.rhythm-col.is-today .rhythm-day-lbl {
  color: var(--terracotta-dark);
  font-weight: 800;
}

.rhythm-count-indicator {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.rhythm-legend {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.legend-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}

.legend-swatch {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  display: inline-block;
}

.today-swatch { background: var(--terracotta); }
.done-swatch { background: var(--moss-sprout); }
.pending-swatch { background: var(--moss-leaf); }

/* Room Filter Card */
.filter-card {
  border-radius: var(--radius-leaf-1);
}

.location-filters {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 6px;
}

.filter-chip {
  background: var(--bg-subtle);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-soft);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  padding: 6px 12px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
}

.filter-chip:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
  color: var(--ink);
}

.filter-chip.active {
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--bg-card);
  border-color: var(--ink);
}

.chip-count {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  opacity: 0.8;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}

.sidebar-ambient-tip {
  background: var(--bg-subtle);
  border: 1.5px dashed var(--border-soft);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.tip-icon {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Main Content: Queue & Urgency Spotlight
   ========================================================================== */

.app-main {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 18px;
  outline: none;
}

.queue-title-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-end;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.section-tag {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--moss-leaf);
}

.main-heading {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.6rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.2;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.text-action-btn {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  transition: color var(--transition-fast);
}

.text-action-btn:hover {
  color: var(--terracotta);
  text-decoration: underline;
}

/* Overdue Priority Spotlight Banner */
.urgency-banner {
  background: var(--terracotta-wash);
  border: 2px solid var(--terracotta);
  border-radius: var(--radius-leaf-1);
  box-shadow: 3px 4px 0 var(--terracotta-dark);
  padding: 14px 18px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: transform var(--transition-fast);
}

.banner-icon-bubble {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  background: var(--terracotta);
  color: #fff;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid var(--terracotta-dark);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--terracotta-dark);
}

.banner-body {
  flex: 1;
}

.banner-tag {
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--terracotta-dark);
}

.banner-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.2;
  margin: 2px 0;
}

.banner-desc {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.banner-quick-action-btn {
  background: var(--terracotta);
  color: #fff;
  border: 2px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-tactile-sm);
  padding: 8px 16px;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: transform var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast);
}

.banner-quick-action-btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  background: #E06D48;
}

.banner-quick-action-btn:active {
  transform: translateY(2px);
  box-shadow: none;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Care Queue Plants List & Cards
   ========================================================================== */

.plants-list {
  list-style: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
}

.plant-card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: var(--border-tactile);
  border-radius: var(--radius-card);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-tactile);
  padding: 16px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
  gap: 16px;
  align-items: center;
  position: relative;
  transition: transform var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.plant-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-tactile-lg);
}

.plant-card.is-selected {
  border-color: var(--moss-forest);
  box-shadow: 4px 5px 0 var(--moss-forest);
  background: #FCFAF4;
}

/* Overdue Card Special Styling */
.plant-card.urgency-high {
  border-color: var(--terracotta);
  box-shadow: 3px 4px 0 var(--terracotta-dark);
  background: #FFFDFB;
}

.plant-card.urgency-high::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 18px;
  width: 32px;
  height: 4px;
  background: var(--terracotta);
  border-radius: 0 0 4px 4px;
}

/* Plant Card Silhouette / Avatar */
.plant-avatar-frame {
  width: 72px;
  height: 72px;
  background: var(--bg-subtle);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-leaf-1);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  position: relative;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.plant-avatar-frame svg {
  width: 60px;
  height: 60px;
  display: block;
}

.plant-card.urgency-high .plant-avatar-frame {
  background: var(--terracotta-wash);
  border-color: var(--terracotta);
}

/* Plant Info */
.plant-info-block {
  min-width: 0;
}

.plant-badge-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.due-badge {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-tag);
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.due-badge.overdue {
  background: var(--terracotta-wash);
  color: var(--terracotta-dark);
  border-color: var(--terracotta);
}

.due-badge.today {
  background: var(--ochre-wash);
  color: var(--ochre-deep);
  border-color: var(--ochre);
}

.due-badge.tomorrow {
  background: var(--mist-wash);
  color: var(--mist-slate);
  border-color: var(--mist-water);
}

.due-badge.done {
  background: var(--moss-wash);
  color: var(--moss-forest);
  border-color: var(--moss-leaf);
}

.location-tag {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.plant-name-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 8px;
}

.plant-display-name {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.plant-species-name {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  font-style: italic;
}

.plant-task-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 6px;
  font-size: 0.84rem;
}

.task-chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--bg-subtle);
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 6px;
}

.last-log-hint {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

/* Plant Actions Group */
.plant-actions-group {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Buttons */
.pill-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: var(--border-tactile);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-tactile-sm);
  transition: transform var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast), background var(--transition-fast);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.pill-btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.pill-btn:active {
  transform: translateY(2px);
  box-shadow: none;
}

.primary-btn {
  background: var(--moss-leaf);
  color: #fff;
}

.primary-btn:hover {
  background: #476839;
}

.urgent-action-btn {
  background: var(--terracotta);
  color: #fff;
}

.urgent-action-btn:hover {
  background: #BC4925;
}

.secondary-btn {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  color: var(--ink);
}

.secondary-btn:hover {
  background: var(--bg-subtle);
}

.outline-btn {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.inspect-card-btn {
  background: var(--bg-subtle);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--border-strong);
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
}

.inspect-card-btn:hover {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.inspect-card-btn:active {
  transform: translateY(1px);
  box-shadow: none;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   All Done State
   ========================================================================== */

.all-done-card {
  background: #FDF9F2;
  border: 2px dashed var(--moss-leaf);
  border-radius: var(--radius-card);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-tactile);
  padding: 32px 24px;
  text-align: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  animation: fadeIn 0.4s ease;
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.all-done-svg {
  display: block;
}

.done-tag {
  background: var(--moss-wash);
  color: var(--moss-forest);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--moss-leaf);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  padding: 3px 12px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  display: inline-block;
}

.all-done-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin-top: 6px;
}

.all-done-desc {
  max-width: 480px;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  line-height: 1.45;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.all-done-next-step {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-soft);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  max-width: 440px;
  text-align: left;
}

.all-done-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Completed Tasks Tray
   ========================================================================== */

.completed-tray-section {
  border-top: 1.5px dashed var(--border-soft);
  padding-top: 14px;
}

.completed-toggle-btn {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 6px 4px;
}

.completed-toggle-btn:hover {
  color: var(--ink);
}

.toggle-icon {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  transition: transform var(--transition-fast);
}

.completed-toggle-btn[aria-expanded="false"] .toggle-icon {
  transform: rotate(-90deg);
}

.completed-plants-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin-top: 10px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.completed-plant-row {
  background: rgba(255, 253, 249, 0.6);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-soft);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
}

.completed-row-info {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.completed-check-icon {
  color: var(--moss-leaf);
  font-weight: 800;
}

.completed-plant-name {
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.completed-undo-btn {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-soft);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.completed-undo-btn:hover {
  border-color: var(--terracotta);
  color: var(--terracotta);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Plant Detail Inspector (Right Column or Bottom Sheet)
   ========================================================================== */

.plant-inspector {
  display: block;
}

.inspector-card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: var(--border-tactile);
  border-radius: var(--radius-card);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-tactile);
  padding: 20px;
  position: sticky;
  top: 84px;
  max-height: calc(100vh - 104px);
  overflow-y: auto;
}

.inspector-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.inspector-eyebrow {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--moss-leaf);
}

.inspector-close-btn {
  background: var(--bg-subtle);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: 50%;
  width: 30px;
  height: 30px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.inspector-portrait {
  background: var(--bg-subtle);
  border: var(--border-tactile);
  border-radius: var(--radius-leaf-1);
  height: 140px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.inspector-portrait svg {
  height: 116px;
  width: auto;
}

.inspector-identity {
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.inspector-meta-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.inspector-species {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
}

.inspector-location-badge {
  background: var(--bg-subtle);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-soft);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
}

.inspector-name {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.2;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.inspector-status-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-top: 6px;
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 2px 10px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-tag);
}

.care-needs-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.need-box {
  background: var(--bg-subtle);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-soft);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
}

.need-icon {
  font-size: 1rem;
}

.need-label {
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.need-value {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.care-guidance-callout {
  background: var(--bg-subtle);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--moss-leaf);
  border-radius: 0 10px 10px 0;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  font-style: italic;
}

.inspector-action-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.flex-btn {
  flex: 1;
}

/* History Timeline */
.inspector-history-section {
  border-top: 1.5px dashed var(--border-soft);
  padding-top: 14px;
}

.history-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.history-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.history-count {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
}

.quick-observation-form {
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.input-with-button {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
}

.input-with-button input {
  flex: 1;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  color: var(--ink);
}

.input-with-button input:focus {
  outline: 2px solid var(--terracotta);
}

.submit-note-btn {
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: 10px;
  width: 34px;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.submit-note-btn:hover {
  background: var(--moss-leaf);
}

.history-timeline {
  list-style: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  position: relative;
}

.history-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  padding: 4px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted rgba(223, 205, 186, 0.6);
}

.history-item:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.history-bullet {
  color: var(--moss-sprout);
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Toast / Undo Region
   ========================================================================== */

.toast-region {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 24px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 1000;
  pointer-events: none;
  width: 90%;
  max-width: 440px;
}

.toast-card {
  pointer-events: auto;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--bg-card);
  border: 2px solid #000;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25), var(--shadow-tactile-sm);
  padding: 10px 16px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  animation: slideToastUp 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.18, 0.89, 0.32, 1.28);
}

@keyframes slideToastUp {
  from { transform: translateY(40px) scale(0.95); opacity: 0; }
  to { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); opacity: 1; }
}

.toast-icon {
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.toast-message {
  flex: 1;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

.toast-undo-btn {
  background: var(--terracotta);
  color: #fff;
  border: 1.5px solid #000;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  padding: 6px 14px;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  cursor: pointer;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.toast-undo-btn:hover {
  background: #E06D48;
}

.toast-timer-bar {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: 3px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
  width: 100%;
  animation: timerShrink 5s linear forwards;
}

@keyframes timerShrink {
  from { width: 100%; }
  to { width: 0%; }
}

.toast-dismiss-btn {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
  font-size: 1rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 2px;
}

.toast-dismiss-btn:hover {
  color: #fff;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Modals & Dialogs (Backdrop, Shortcuts)
   ========================================================================== */

.modal-backdrop {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(33, 47, 36, 0.45);
  backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
  z-index: 500;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity var(--transition-fast);
}

.modal-backdrop.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.dialog-container {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1000;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 16px;
  background: rgba(33, 47, 36, 0.5);
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
}

.dialog-card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: var(--border-tactile);
  border-radius: var(--radius-card);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-tactile-lg);
  max-width: 480px;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 24px;
}

.dialog-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.dialog-title {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.close-dialog-btn {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
}

.dialog-desc {
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  color: var(--ink-soft);
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.shortcuts-list {
  list-style: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.shortcuts-list li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  padding: 4px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--border-soft);
}

kbd {
  background: var(--bg-subtle);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: 6px;
  box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--border-strong);
  padding: 2px 7px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.dialog-footer {
  text-align: right;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Responsive Architecture
   Mobile: Bottom sheet for inspector, single column
   Tablet: 2 columns
   Desktop: 3 columns (Sidebar, Main Care Agenda, Inspector)
   ========================================================================== */

/* Mobile view (< 768px) */
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .header-container {
    padding: 0 4px;
  }
  
  .brand-subtitle {
    display: none;
  }

  .plant-card {
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
    grid-template-rows: auto auto;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .plant-actions-group {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    border-top: 1px dashed var(--border-soft);
    padding-top: 10px;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }

  .urgency-banner {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }

  .banner-quick-action-btn {
    align-self: flex-start;
  }

  /* Plant Inspector as Mobile Bottom Sheet Drawer */
  .plant-inspector {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    z-index: 600;
    transform: translateY(105%);
    transition: transform var(--transition-bounce);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .plant-inspector.is-open {
    transform: translateY(0);
    pointer-events: auto;
  }

  .inspector-card {
    border-radius: 24px 24px 0 0;
    border-bottom: none;
    max-height: 85vh;
    box-shadow: 0 -8px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
  }
}

/* Tablet view (768px - 1079px) */
@media (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 1079px) {
  .layout-wrapper {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 280px 1fr;
    align-items: start;
    gap: 20px;
  }

  .app-sidebar {
    position: sticky;
    top: 84px;
  }

  /* Plant Inspector as Modal Drawer on Tablet */
  .plant-inspector {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 420px;
    z-index: 600;
    transform: translateX(105%);
    transition: transform var(--transition-bounce);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .plant-inspector.is-open {
    transform: translateX(0);
    pointer-events: auto;
  }

  .inspector-card {
    height: 100vh;
    max-height: 100vh;
    border-radius: 0;
    border-right: none;
    border-top: none;
    border-bottom: none;
    box-shadow: -8px 0 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
  }
}

/* Desktop view (>= 1080px) */
@media (min-width: 1080px) {
  .layout-wrapper {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 300px minmax(460px, 1fr) 340px;
    gap: 24px;
    align-items: start;
  }

  .app-sidebar {
    position: sticky;
    top: 84px;
  }

  .plant-inspector {
    display: block !important;
    position: static;
    transform: none;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }

  .inspector-close-btn {
    display: none; /* Persistent docked inspector on desktop */
  }

  .modal-backdrop {
    display: none !important;
  }
}

/* ==========================================================================
   Reduced Motion Support
   ========================================================================== */

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.001ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.001ms !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }

  .status-dot.alert {
    animation: none !important;
  }

  .plant-card:hover {
    transform: none !important;
  }

  .pill-btn:hover, .pill-btn:active {
    transform: none !important;
  }

  .toast-card {
    animation: none !important;
  }

  .toast-timer-bar {
    animation: none !important;
    width: 0% !important;
  }
}
